summary_en: EasySpider is a completely free visual no-code web crawler and browser automation tool that enables users to design and execute data collection tasks through a graphical interface without programming. It automatically detects similar elements on web pages, supports batch data extraction, and can also run via command line for integration into other systems, ideal for e-commerce scraping and automation testing.

description: Beautiful, Modern & Opinionated Linux
summary_zh: Omarchy 是 DHH 出品的现代 Opinionated Linux 发行版，以美观界面、内置 AI 智能体能力、Neovim 与终端工作流为核心亮点。提供完善的一键配置、主题系统、dotfiles 管理与跨平台适配，面向追求高效开发体验的工程师群体。
summary_en: Omarchy is a beautiful, opinionated Linux distro by DHH featuring built-in AI agent capabilities, Neovim-centric workflows, and a polished terminal environment. It offers one-click configuration, theming, dotfiles management, and cross-platform support for developers seeking a productivity-optimized OS.

description: 免费大模型API，支持免费调用GPT、DeepSeek等主流模型，免费额度10000点，每日刷新！另付费价格最低官方1-2折！
summary_zh: ChatAnywhere 提供免费 ChatGPT 和 DeepSeek API 转发服务，支持 gpt-5、gpt-4o、deepseek-r1/v3、claude、gemini、grok 等主流大模型。采用 OpenAI 标准协议，兼容各类应用，支持流式响应，国内直连无需代理，免费额度每日 200 次（按 IP 和 Key 共享），适合个人非商业用途。
summary_en: ChatAnywhere offers free ChatGPT and DeepSeek API key forwarding services, supporting top-tier models like gpt-5, gpt-4o, deepseek-r1/v3, claude, gemini, and grok. It uses the official OpenAI-compatible protocol, supports streaming responses, and enables direct access from China without proxies. Free tier allows 200 requests/day per IP+Key combination for personal non-commercial use.

description: TensorFlow Tutorial and Examples for Beginners (support TF v1 & v2)
summary_zh: 本项目为 TensorFlow 初学者提供全面且结构化的学习路径，涵盖从基础操作到高级模型的完整示例。通过 Jupyter Notebook 和源码结合的方式，清晰展示 TF v1 与 v2 的实现差异，重点突出现代 API 最佳实践（如 layers、estimator、dataset），适合希望快速上手 TensorFlow 并掌握其核心功能的开发者。
summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive, beginner-friendly tutorial for TensorFlow, featuring clear examples in both notebooks and source code for TF v1 and v2. It covers fundamental operations to advanced models, emphasizing modern API practices such as layers, estimator, and dataset. Ideal for developers seeking hands-on experience with TensorFlow's core functionalities.

description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
summary_zh: agent-browser 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的高效无头浏览器自动化 CLI 工具，基于原生 Rust 构建。它提供简洁的命令行接口，支持通过元素引用（refs）或传统选择器操作网页，实现点击、填充表单、截图等自动化任务，无需依赖 Playwright 或 Node.js，显著提升 AI 代理的网页交互能力。
summary_en: agent-browser is a high-performance headless browser automation CLI tool designed for AI agents, built with native Rust. It offers an intuitive command-line interface to interact with web pages via element references or traditional selectors, enabling actions like clicking, filling forms, and taking screenshots without requiring Playwright or Node.js, significantly enhancing AI agent web interaction capabilities.

description: CowAgent是基于大模型的超级AI助理，能主动思考和任务规划、访问操作系统和外部资源、创造和执行Skills、拥有长期记忆并不断成长，比OpenClaw更轻量和便捷。同时支持微信、飞书、钉钉、企微、QQ、公众号、网页等接入，可选择OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek/ Qwen/GLM/Kimi/LinkAI，能处理文本、语音、图片和文件，可快速搭建个人AI助理和企业数字员工。
summary_zh: CowAgent 是基于大模型的超级AI助理，支持主动任务规划、多模态交互（文本/语音/图片/文件）、长期记忆与技能系统，可接入飞书、钉钉、企业微信、微信公众号等多平台，兼容OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek等主流模型，适用于个人AI助手与企业数字员工场景。
summary_en: CowAgent is a super AI assistant based on large language models, supporting autonomous task planning, multimodal interaction (text/audio/image/files), long-term memory, and a skill system. It integrates with platforms like Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, and WeChat Official Accounts, compatible with OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek models, ideal for personal AI assistants and enterprise digital employees.

description: the runtime your coding agents live on
summary_zh: Herdr 是一个基于 Rust 构建的终端 AI 智能体运行时，支持多任务并行、会话持久化及跨设备重新连接。它提供原生终端视图与 Socket API，允许智能体间协作，并通过插件扩展工作流，专为开发者打造高效自动化环境。
summary_en: Herdr is a Rust-based terminal runtime for AI agents, supporting multi-tasking, session persistence, and reattachment across devices. It offers native terminal views and a Socket API for agent collaboration, extensible via plugins, designed to build efficient automation environments for developers.

description: 微舆：人人可用的多Agent舆情分析助手，打破信息茧房，还原舆情原貌，预测未来走向，辅助决策！从0实现，不依赖任何框架。
summary_zh: 微舆（BettaFish）是一个从0实现的多Agent舆情分析系统，通过AI驱动的全域社媒监控、复合分析引擎、多模态内容解析及Agent协作机制，打破信息茧房，还原舆情原貌并预测趋势。系统支持公私域数据融合，具备轻量化Python架构与高扩展性，可快速定制至金融等垂直领域。
summary_en: BettaFish is a zero-to-one implemented multi-Agent public opinion analysis system that breaks information cocoons and predicts trends through AI-driven social media monitoring, hybrid analysis engines, and agent collaboration. It supports private-public data fusion, offers lightweight Python architecture, and enables rapid customization for vertical domains like finance.

summary_zh: WeChatMsg 是一个微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，支持将聊天记录导出为多种格式（如 Excel、HTML），并提供可视化分析功能。项目强调个人数据主权，倡导用户自主管理生活痕迹，未来计划结合 AI 技术构建个人记忆数据中心，实现智能相册与年度报告生成。
summary_en: WeChatMsg is a WeChat chat export and analysis tool that supports exporting chats to formats like Excel and HTML with visualization features. It emphasizes personal data ownership, enabling users to manage their digital footprints. The project aims to integrate AI for building personal memory data centers, including smart photo albums and annual report generation.

description: Powerful AI Client
summary_zh: Chatbox 是一款跨平台桌面 AI 客户端，支持 ChatGPT、Claude 等主流大模型，提供多端同步、插件扩展、提示工程优化等功能，适用于开发者、研究人员和AI爱好者的高效生产力工具。
summary_en: Chatbox is a powerful cross-platform desktop AI client supporting ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLMs. It offers multi-device sync, plugin support, prompt engineering, and advanced customization for developers and AI enthusiasts.

description: The uncompromising Python code formatter
summary_zh: Black 是一个无妥协的 Python 代码格式化工具，强制统一代码风格，提升团队协作效率。它基于 AST 分析实现确定性格式化，支持 Python 3.10+ 及 Jupyter Notebook，提供极小 diff 输出以加速代码审查，并内置语法有效性验证确保代码安全。
summary_en: Black is the uncompromising Python code formatter that enforces consistent style across projects. It reformats entire files in place using AST analysis, supports Python 3.10+ and Jupyter Notebooks, produces minimal diffs for faster code reviews, and validates syntax safety through built-in AST checks.

description: A fast, simple & powerful blog framework, powered by Node.js.
summary_zh: Hexo 是一个基于 Node.js 的快速、简洁且强大的博客框架，支持 GitHub Flavored Markdown 和 Octopress 插件，提供一键部署到 GitHub Pages 等功能，拥有强大的 API 和丰富的主题插件生态。
summary_en: Hexo is a fast, simple & powerful blog framework powered by Node.js, supporting GitHub Flavored Markdown and Octopress plugins, with one-command deployment to platforms like GitHub Pages, a robust API, and extensive themes and plugins.

description: Open-source Rust agent engine and terminal client for Codewhale, with provider choice, tools, approvals and receipts.
summary_zh: Codewhale是开源终端编程智能体，用Rust构建，支持任意AI模型。它能读取项目、编辑文件、运行命令并验证结果，适用于自动化代码修复、测试调试与本地开发工作流，提供TUI交互与headless模式。
summary_en: Codewhale is an open-source coding agent for the terminal, built in Rust and compatible with any AI model. It reads projects, edits files, runs commands, and verifies its own work, suitable for automated code fixes, test debugging, and local development workflows, with TUI and headless modes.

description: Open-source coding agent for your terminal, built in Rust and on a journey of continuous community improvement. Issues and PRs welcome.
summary_zh: Codewhale是一款基于Rust构建的开源终端AI编码代理，支持连接多种大模型提供商（含Ollama/vLLM本地部署），具备文件编辑、命令执行、任务规划等完整能力。采用分层审批机制保障执行安全，支持MCP协议扩展与Agent协作，可持久化会话与目标管理，适用于开发者终端工作流自动化场景。
summary_en: Codewhale is an open-source Rust-based AI coding agent for the terminal, connecting to various LLM providers including local Ollama/vLLM deployments. It supports file editing, command execution, and task planning with tiered approval for safety. Features MCP extensibility, multi-agent coordination, and session persistence, ideal for developer terminal automation workflows.

description: Open-source coding agent for your terminal, built in Rust and on a journey of continuous community improvement. Issues and PRs welcome.
summary_zh: CodeWhale 是一款基于 DeepSeek V4 模型的终端编程智能体，支持流式推理输出、本地文件编辑（带审批机制）、Shell 命令执行、Git 操作及子代理协调。提供自动模式智能选择模型与思维层级，具备 1M 上下文窗口与缓存成本追踪，适用于高效终端开发辅助。
summary_en: CodeWhale is a terminal-based coding agent powered by DeepSeek V4, featuring streaming reasoning blocks, local file editing with approval gates, shell/Git/web tools, and sub-agent coordination. It includes auto mode for dynamic model/thinking selection, 1M-token context support, and prefix-cache cost tracking for efficient development workflows.

description: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research Skill Router Pack AI-powered routing + On-demand toolchain bootstrapping + Self-evolving knowledge base  Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other AI coding clients 逆向/渗透/安全技能路由包 - AI 自动路由 + 按需自举工具链 + 自动进化经验库 | 支持 Claude Code / Kiro / Cursor / Cline 等代码 AI 客户端
summary_zh: 面向逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究的 AI 技能路由包，提供智能任务分发、按需工具链自举与自进化经验库，支持 Windows/Linux/macOS/Kali 多平台，兼容 Claude Code、Kiro、Cursor、Cline 等主流 AI 编程客户端。
summary_en: An AI-powered skill router for reverse engineering, authorized penetration testing, and security research. It provides intelligent task routing, on-demand toolchain bootstrapping, and a self-evolving knowledge base across Windows/Linux/macOS/Kali, compatible with Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline and other AI coding clients.

description: Create stunning demos for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use. An alternative to Screen Studio.
summary_zh: OpenScreen 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制工具，提供无广告、无订阅、商业可用的屏幕录制与编辑功能，支持自定义缩放、背景、注释及导出设置，适用于制作产品演示和教程视频，是 Screen Studio 的轻量级替代方案。
summary_en: OpenScreen is a free, open-source screen recording tool offering watermark-free, subscription-free recordings with customizable zooms, backgrounds, annotations, and export options. Ideal for product demos and tutorials, it serves as a lightweight alternative to Screen Studio.

description: Free, simple, and intuitive online database diagram editor and SQL generator.
summary_zh: DrawDB 是一款免费、简洁且直观的免费在线数据库关系图编辑器，支持可视化设计数据库结构并自动生成 SQL 脚本。用户无需注册即可直接在浏览器中创建、编辑和导出数据库模型，适用于快速原型设计、文档绘制和团队协作。
summary_en: DrawDB is a free, simple, and intuitive online database schema editor and SQL generator. It enables users to visually design database structures, generate SQL scripts, and export diagrams directly in the browser—no account required. Ideal for rapid prototyping, documentation, and team collaboration.

description: The unified workspace where open-source models get things done for you.
summary_zh: MindsHub 是一个统一的 AI 工作空间，旨在让开源模型完成实际工作。它支持连接多种数据源，通过模型路由器无缝切换不同大模型（如 Claude、GPT、Qwen 等），并运行开源智能体。用户可将智能体输出转化为可发布的 Web 应用或文档，实现从数据分析到应用构建的全流程自动化，支持本地、私有云及托管部署。
summary_en: MindsHub is a unified workspace enabling open-source AI models to perform real work. It connects diverse data sources, routes tasks across frontier and open models via a model router, and runs open-source agents. Users transform agent outputs into publishable web apps or documents, automating workflows from analysis to app creation, with support for local, VPC, or hosted deployment.

description: Delegate anything. It comes back done.
summary_zh: Minds 是一款面向知识工作者的通用 AI 平台，支持在云、VPC、本地及隔离环境中灵活部署，让用户完全掌控基础设施、模型、权限与数据。它帮助创作者、策略师和运营人员自动化复杂的多步骤读写任务，并无需工程背景即可构建和部署内部 AI 工具（如应用、报告、分析等），实现真正可控的 AI 协作体验。
summary_en: Minds is a general-purpose AI platform designed for knowledge workers—creators, strategists, and operators—offering full control over AI systems with flexible deployment across cloud, VPC, on-prem, and air-gapped environments. It enables users to automate complex multi-step read/write tasks and build, deploy internal AI tools (apps, reports, analyses) without engineering expertise, ensuring complete infrastructure, model, permission, and data control.

description: General-purpose AI designed for knowledge workers — creators, strategists, and operators — and individuals seeking AI systems they can truly control to help them get work done, with full flexibility to extend and deploy anywhere (VPC, on-prem, or cloud).
summary_zh: Minds Platform 是一个开源的人工智能基础平台，旨在为开发者、企业和个人提供可完全控制、扩展和随处部署的生产级AI系统。其核心包括 Anton 自动化代理和 Query Engine 语义搜索引擎，支持自动化任务执行、跨数据源智能检索与分析，适用于报表生成、企业知识库搜索、AI运营助手等场景，支持云、VPC、本地及混合部署。
summary_en: Minds Platform is an open-source foundation for applied AI, enabling full control, extensibility, and deployment of production-ready AI systems anywhere—cloud, VPC, on-prem, or hybrid. It combines Anton, a self-improving automation agent, with the Query Engine for semantic search across structured and unstructured data, powering use cases like automated reporting, conversational BI, and enterprise AI assistants.

description: AI Data Vault - A query engine for AI Agents to securely query data from any datasource
summary_zh: MindsDB 是一个开源 AI 分析查询引擎，支持构建能直接访问数据库、数据仓库和应用程序的自主推理 AI 代理。它通过 SQL 兼容语言统一 200+ 数据源，无需 ETL，实现自然语言问答和语义搜索，适用于对话式分析、知识库检索等场景。
summary_en: MindsDB is an open-source AI analytics query engine that powers self-reasoning agents to answer questions directly from live data sources like databases and data warehouses without ETL. It unifies 200+ data sources via SQL-compatible syntax, enabling conversational analytics and semantic search across structured and unstructured data.

description: Materialize, a CSS Framework based on Material Design
summary_zh: MaterializeCSS 是基于 Material Design 原则构建的现代化 CSS 框架，提供丰富的预构建组件（如导航栏、卡片、表单）和流畅的动画效果，支持响应式布局与主流浏览器兼容，适用于快速开发美观且用户友好的 Web 应用。
summary_en: MaterializeCSS is a modern CSS framework based on Material Design principles, offering a rich set of pre-built components (e.g., navigation, cards, forms) with smooth animations and responsive layouts, compatible with major browsers for rapid development of visually appealing and user-friendly web applications.

description: Langchain-Chatchat（原Langchain-ChatGLM）基于 Langchain 与 ChatGLM, Qwen 与 Llama 等语言模型的 RAG 与 Agent 应用 | Langchain-Chatchat (formerly langchain-ChatGLM), local knowledge based LLM (like ChatGLM, Qwen and Llama) RAG and Agent app with langchain
summary_zh: Langchain-Chatchat 是基于 Langchain 框架的开源本地知识库问答系统，支持 ChatGLM、Qwen、Llama 等主流开源大模型，提供 RAG（检索增强生成）与 Agent 应用能力。项目支持离线部署，兼容多种向量数据库与 Embedding 模型，具备 FastAPI 接口与 Streamlit WebUI，适用于私有化部署的文档问答与智能助手场景。
summary_en: Langchain-Chatchat is an open-source local knowledge base QA system built on the Langchain framework, supporting mainstream open-source LLMs like ChatGLM, Qwen, and Llama. It provides RAG and Agent capabilities with offline deployment, compatibility for various vector databases and embedding models, and offers both FastAPI endpoints and a Streamlit WebUI for document-based Q&A and intelligent assistant applications.

description: VoxCPM2: Tokenizer-Free TTS for Multilingual Speech Generation, Creative Voice Design, and True-to-Life Cloning
summary_zh: VoxCPM2 是 OpenBMB 推出的无分词器文本转语音系统，基于端到端扩散自回归架构直接生成连续语音表征，无需离散分词。2B 参数模型在超 200 万小时多语言语音数据上训练，支持 30 种语言、自然语言驱动的创意语音设计、可控语音克隆及 48kHz 录音室级音频输出，RTX 4090 上 RTF 低至 0.3，适合多语言 TTS、个性化语音定制与高质量语音克隆场景。
summary_en: VoxCPM2 by OpenBMB is a tokenizer-free text-to-speech system that directly generates continuous speech representations via an end-to-end diffusion autoregressive architecture, bypassing discrete tokenization. The 2B-parameter model is trained on over 2 million hours of multilingual speech data, supporting 30 languages, natural-language-driven creative voice design, controllable voice cloning, and 48kHz studio-quality audio output. With RTF as low as ~0.3 on RTX 4090, it is ideal for multilingual TTS, personalized voice customization, and high-fidelity voice cloning applications.

description: A powerful 🚀 Android chart view / graph view library, supporting line- bar- pie- radar- bubble- and candlestick charts as well as scaling, panning and animations.
summary_zh: MPAndroidChart 是一个功能强大且易于使用的 Android 图表库，支持折线图、柱状图、饼图、雷达图、气泡图和 K 线图等多种图表类型，具备缩放、平移和动画功能，适用于数据可视化场景。
summary_en: MPAndroidChart is a powerful and easy-to-use Android chart library supporting line, bar, pie, radar, bubble, and candlestick charts with scaling, panning, and animations for data visualization.

description: Open Source Alternative to Vercel, Netlify and Heroku.
summary_zh: Dokploy 是一款开源、可自托管的 PaaS 平台，旨在替代 Vercel、Netlify 和 Heroku。它极大简化了应用与数据库的部署管理，原生支持 Docker Compose 与多节点 Swarm 集群，集成 Traefik 实现自动路由，并提供实时监控、多服务器管理及丰富的通知功能。
summary_en: Dokploy is an open-source, self-hostable PaaS platform designed as an alternative to Vercel, Netlify, and Heroku. It simplifies application and database deployment with native Docker Compose support, multi-node Swarm clustering, integrated Traefik routing, real-time monitoring, and comprehensive multi-server management.

description: One local control plane for every AI agent: route across models, fuse new capabilities, orchestrate tools, and stay fully in control.
summary_zh: Claude Code Router 是基于 Claude Code 构建的智能编码基础设施，支持多模型路由、动态切换及请求/响应转换，兼容 OpenRouter、DeepSeek、Ollama 等主流 AI 模型提供商，提供 CLI 管理和 GitHub Actions 集成，适用于复杂编码场景下的灵活 AI 工具编排。
summary_en: Claude Code Router builds on Claude Code to enable intelligent coding infrastructure with multi-model routing, dynamic switching, and request/response transformation. It supports providers like OpenRouter, DeepSeek, and Ollama, offering CLI management and GitHub Actions integration for flexible AI tool orchestration in complex development workflows.

description: OpenAssistant is a chat-based assistant that understands tasks, can interact with third-party systems, and retrieve information dynamically to do so.
summary_zh: Open Assistant 是一个开源的聊天式AI助手项目，旨在提供可交互、可集成第三方系统的语言模型服务。项目已完成，核心贡献是构建并发布了 oasst2 高质量对话数据集，推动开放语言模型发展。
summary_en: Open Assistant was an open-source chat-based AI assistant project designed to provide accessible, interactive large language model capabilities with third-party system integration. The project is now completed, with its final oasst2 dataset published on HuggingFace, marking a significant contribution to open-source language model training data.

description: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.
summary_zh: Prompt Optimizer 是一款专注于提升 AI 提示词质量的优化工具，支持多轮迭代优化、双模式提示词处理、实时对比测试及多模型集成（OpenAI/Gemini/DeepSeek等），同时提供文生图、图生图、MCP协议支持等高级功能，适用于角色扮演、知识图谱提取、创意写作等场景。
summary_en: Prompt Optimizer is an AI prompt optimization tool designed to enhance prompt quality through intelligent refinement, multi-round iteration, and dual-mode optimization. It supports real-time comparison, integration with major AI models (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek), advanced features like text-to-image generation, MCP protocol compatibility, and secure client-side processing for reliable and efficient prompt engineering.

description: A shadowsocks client for Android
summary_zh: Shadowsocks Android 是一款基于 Kotlin 开发的开源代理客户端，支持 Android 和 Chrome OS 平台。该应用提供安全、快速的科学上网功能，采用 Shadowsocks 协议加密传输数据，兼容多种服务器配置，具备自动切换、流量统计等实用功能，适用于需要隐私保护和网络访问的场景。
summary_en: Shadowsocks Android is an open-source proxy client built with Kotlin for Android and Chrome OS. It enables secure and fast internet access using the Shadowsocks protocol, supporting multiple server configurations, automatic switching, and traffic monitoring for enhanced privacy and network freedom.

description: Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents
summary_zh: AI网站克隆模板通过Claude Code实现网页逆向工程，利用Chrome MCP自动提取设计元素与组件规格，并行构建像素级复刻站点。支持多页面、响应式交互还原及资产下载，基于Next.js 16+shadcn/ui技术栈，提供自动化开发流水线。
summary_en: An AI-powered website cloning template that reverse-engineers any site using Claude Code and Chrome MCP. It extracts design tokens, generates component specs, and rebuilds pages pixel-perfect via parallel builder agents in isolated git worktrees. Built with Next.js 16, shadcn/ui, and Tailwind CSS v4.

description: A next.js web application that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams. This app allows you to create, modify, and enhance diagrams through natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization.
summary_zh: Next AI Draw.io 是一个基于 Next.js 的 AI 驱动图表设计工具，通过自然语言指令与 AI 辅助可视化，支持创建、修改和增强 draw.io 风格的流程图与架构图，集成多模态 AI 能力与云服务商图标库。
summary_en: Next AI Draw.io is a Next.js-based web app that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams, enabling users to create, modify, and enhance diagrams via natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization, featuring multi-cloud icon support and real-time diagram generation.

description: Fish-like autosuggestions for zsh
summary_zh: zsh-autosuggestions 为 zsh 终端提供类 Fish 的实时命令建议功能，基于历史记录和补全引擎智能生成建议。支持自定义高亮样式与建议策略，可无缝集成 Oh My Zsh，显著提升命令行输入效率与用户体验。
summary_en: zsh-autosuggestions delivers Fish-like real-time command suggestions for zsh, leveraging history and completion engines. Features customizable highlighting and multiple suggestion strategies, integrates seamlessly with Oh My Zsh to boost terminal productivity.

description: 本文原文由知名 Hacker Eric S. Raymond 所撰寫，教你如何正確的提出技術問題並獲得你滿意的答案。
summary_zh: 本指南由知名黑客 Eric S. Raymond 撰写，系统阐述高效提问的技术沟通原则，涵盖问题筛选、论坛选择、标题撰写、代码呈现等关键技巧，帮助开发者获得精准解答，提升开源社区协作效率。
summary_en: Authored by renowned hacker Eric S. Raymond, this guide systematically outlines principles for effective technical communication, covering question selection, forum choice, title writing, and code presentation to help developers obtain accurate answers and improve open-source community collaboration.

description: A reliable coding agent for complex software engineering tasks.
summary_zh: Reasonix 是一款专为终端设计的 DeepSeek 原生 AI 编程智能体，基于前缀缓存稳定性优化，支持长时间运行且保持低 token 成本。其核心优势在于高达 99.82% 的缓存命中率，显著降低推理开销，适用于持续编码任务。
summary_en: Reasonix is a DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for the terminal, engineered for prefix-cache stability to minimize token costs during long sessions. It achieves up to 99.82% cache hit rate, drastically reducing inference expenses while enabling persistent, efficient development workflows.

description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.
summary_zh: QwenPaw 是一款个人 AI 助手，支持本地或云端部署，数据完全自主可控。内置日程管理、文档处理等技能，支持多智能体协作与自定义扩展，兼容多种聊天平台，易于安装与集成。
summary_en: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant that can be deployed locally or in the cloud, ensuring full data control. It features built-in skills like scheduling and document processing, supports multi-agent collaboration and extensible custom skills, and integrates with multiple chat platforms.

description: 结巴中文分词
summary_zh: 结巴（jieba）是Python最优秀的中文分词组件，支持精确、全模式、搜索引擎及Paddle深度学习模式四种分词方式，具备新词发现、自定义词典和词性标注能力，采用前缀词典与HMM模型结合的高效算法，适用于文本分析、搜索引擎等场景。
summary_en: Jieba is the best Python-based Chinese text segmentation module, supporting four modes: precise, full, search engine, and Paddle deep learning. It features new word discovery, custom dictionaries, and part-of-speech tagging, using efficient algorithms like prefix dictionaries and HMM models for text analysis and search engines.

description: dev tools, env vars, task runner
summary_zh: mise 是一款基于 Rust 的多功能开发环境管理工具，集工具版本管理、环境变量配置和任务运行于一体。通过 mise.toml 文件统一管理 Node.js、Python、Terraform 等数百种开发工具的版本切换，支持目录级环境变量加载和自定义任务执行，确保本地、CI 和团队协作环境高度一致。
summary_en: mise is a Rust-based comprehensive development environment manager that unifies tool version management, environment variable configuration, and task execution. It uses mise.toml to centrally manage versions of hundreds of dev tools like Node.js, Python, and Terraform, supports directory-scoped env vars and custom tasks, ensuring consistent setups across local, CI, and team environments.

description: A simple Python Pydantic model for Honkai: Star Rail parsed data from the Mihomo API.
summary_zh: mihomo 是一个专为《崩坏：星穹铁道》设计的 Python Pydantic 数据模型库，提供对 Mihomo API 解析数据的强类型支持与自动补全。支持 V1/V2 两种数据格式，内置工具函数处理角色去重与数据合并，并提供 JSON 和 Pickle 持久化方案，显著提升游戏数据集成开发效率。
summary_en: mihomo is a Python Pydantic model library designed for Honkai: Star Rail, offering strongly-typed data structures and autocompletion support for parsed data from the Mihomo API. It supports both V1 and V2 data formats, includes utility functions for character deduplication and data merging, and provides JSON/Pickle persistence options, greatly enhancing game data integration workflows.

description: ⌥ Coding agent with the IDE wired in. Built by Stencil Labs.
summary_zh: oh-my-pi 是一款功能强大的终端 AI 编程代理，内置 31 种工具和 60+ 大模型支持。采用 Rust 核心构建，支持 LSP/DAP 操作、哈希锚定编辑与子代理协同，为开发者提供类 IDE 的智能编码体验。
summary_en: oh-my-pi is a powerful terminal-based AI coding agent featuring 31 built-in tools and 60+ LLM providers. Built on a Rust core (~80k lines), it supports LSP/DAP operations, hash-anchored edits, and subagent orchestration, delivering IDE-grade intelligent coding directly in the terminal.

description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.
summary_zh: 该插件将 OpenAI Codex 深度集成到 Claude Code 工作流中，提供代码审查、任务委派和背景作业管理功能。支持普通审查和对抗性审查两种模式，可处理多文件变更并允许用户通过命令行参数控制执行方式，显著提升开发效率与代码质量。
summary_en: This plugin integrates OpenAI Codex into Claude Code for automated code reviews and task delegation. It offers normal and adversarial review modes, supports multi-file changes, and enables background execution with status tracking via slash commands, enhancing developer productivity and code quality.

summary_zh: TaskMatrix 通过连接 ChatGPT 与一系列视觉基础模型，实现聊天中发送和接收图像。其核心创新在于引入模板机制，将人类经验转化为多模型协作的预定义执行流，支持图像编辑、目标检测、语义分割等复杂视觉任务，无需额外训练即可实现跨模型协同。
summary_en: TaskMatrix connects ChatGPT with visual foundation models to enable image sending/receiving during chat. It introduces a template mechanism—pre-defined execution flows that leverage human expertise to orchestrate complex multi-model tasks like image editing, object detection, and segmentation, enabling seamless collaboration without additional training.

description: 你想蒸馏的下一个员工，何必是同事。蒸馏任何人的思维方式——心智模型、决策启发式、表达DNA。Distill how anyone thinks.
summary_zh: 女娲.skill 是一个 AI 智能体技能库，通过蒸馏顶尖人物的思维方式（如乔布斯、马斯克、芒格等），将其心智模型、决策启发式和表达DNA转化为可调用技能。用户可在 Claude Code 中直接调用这些技能进行跨领域决策分析，实现‘让名人帮你打工’的愿景。
summary_en: Nuwa.skill is an AI agent skill library that distills the thinking patterns of top-tier individuals (e.g., Jobs, Musk, Munger) into actionable skills. It extracts cognitive frameworks, decision heuristics, and communication DNA to enable users to invoke these 'virtual experts' via Claude Code for cross-domain strategic analysis and problem-solving.

description: 快速、简洁、解决大文件内存溢出的java处理Excel工具
summary_zh: EasyExcel 是阿里巴巴开源的高性能 Java Excel 处理工具，解决传统框架如 Apache POI 在处理大文件时的内存溢出问题。通过重写底层解析逻辑，在仅 16M 内存下 23 秒完成 75M 超大 Excel 文件解析，支持读写、模板导出、极速模式，提供简洁 API 和完整文档，适用于企业级大数据量场景。
summary_en: EasyExcel is a high-performance Java tool for reading and writing Excel files, developed by Alibaba. It addresses memory overflow issues in traditional frameworks like Apache POI by re-engineering the parsing logic. Capable of processing a 75MB Excel file (460K rows) in just 23 seconds using only 16MB RAM, it supports templates, export, and ultra-fast mode, offering a simple API and comprehensive documentation for enterprise-scale data handling.

description: A proxy tool to bypass GFW.
summary_zh: XX-Net 是一款运行9年的成熟翻墙工具，支持全平台多设备同时使用。其核心优势在于独创的流量混淆技术，能完美模拟Chrome浏览器行为，实现隐身级网络穿透。软件内置ChatGPT服务，提供百万级token额度，兼具隐私保护与AI生产力工具属性。
summary_en: XX-Net is a mature 9-year-old circumvention tool supporting multi-platform simultaneous connections. Its core strength lies in proprietary traffic obfuscation that mimics Chrome browser behavior for stealthy network bypass. The software integrates built-in ChatGPT with one million free tokens per plan, combining privacy protection with AI productivity features.

description: Open-source 24/7 Cowork app for OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ more CLI Agent | Customize your assistants | Team them up｜Star if you like it!
summary_zh: AionUi 是一款免费、开源的 AI 协作者应用，支持 24/7 自动化，内置多 AI 智能体（如 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Qwen Code 等），提供跨平台（macOS/Windows/Linux）本地运行、零配置启动、远程访问（WebUI/Telegram/Lark）和任务调度功能，适用于代码开发、文件处理与自动化工作流。
summary_en: AionUi is a free, open-source AI coworking app that enables 24/7 automation with built-in multi-agent support (e.g., Claude Code, OpenClaw, Qwen Code). It offers zero-setup local execution, cross-platform compatibility, remote access via WebUI/Telegram, and scheduled task automation for coding, file operations, and workflow management.

description: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.
summary_zh: Handy 是一款免费开源的离线语音转文字桌面应用，基于 Whisper 和 Parakeet 模型实现本地语音识别，支持全局快捷键录音、VAD 降噪及多平台运行，注重隐私保护且高度可扩展。
summary_en: Handy is a free, open-source, offline speech-to-text desktop app powered by Whisper and Parakeet models. It offers local transcription with VAD, global hotkeys, and cross-platform support, prioritizing privacy and extensibility.

description: Multi-platform auto-proxy client, supporting Sing-box, X-ray, TUIC, Hysteria, Reality, Trojan, SSH etc. It’s an open-source, secure and ad-free.
summary_zh: Hiddify 是一款跨平台代理客户端，基于 Sing-box 构建，支持 Vless、Vmess、Reality、TUIC、Hysteria、WireGuard、SSH 等多种协议。具备自动节点选择、TUN 模式、远程配置同步等功能，界面简洁、无广告、开源安全，支持多语言及深色/浅色主题，适用于 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。
summary_en: Hiddify is a multi-platform proxy client built on Sing-box, supporting Vless, Vmess, Reality, TUIC, Hysteria, WireGuard, SSH, and more. It features automatic node selection, TUN mode, remote configuration sync, and an intuitive UI. Open-source, ad-free, and secure, it's available on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.

description: Next Generation of ShadowsocksX
summary_zh: ShadowsocksX-NG 是 ShadowsocksX 的下一代 macOS 客户端，采用 Swift 重写 GUI 并集成 shadowsocks-libev 的 ss-local 组件。支持 SIP003 插件、AEAD 加密、PAC 自动更新及二维码分享服务器配置，提供手动代理模式以兼容其他应用。通过 launchd 后台运行 ss-local，提升稳定性并简化依赖管理。
summary_en: ShadowsocksX-NG is the next-generation macOS client for Shadowsocks, rebuilt with Swift and integrated with ss-local from shadowsocks-libev. It supports SIP003 plugins, AEAD ciphers, PAC auto-updates, QR code sharing, and manual proxy mode. By running ss-local as a background service via launchd, it improves stability and simplifies dependency management.

description: Create polished demo videos without editing skills. Mac/Windows/Linux
summary_zh: Recordly 是一款开源的跨平台屏幕录制与编辑工具，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。它无需后期剪辑即可生成专业级演示视频，内置自动缩放、光标美化、动态摄像头气泡叠加、时间轴编辑及扩展市场等功能，专为教程、产品演示等场景优化，显著提升录制效率与视觉表现。
summary_en: Recordly is an open-source, cross-platform screen recorder and editor for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It enables polished screen recordings without post-editing by offering auto-zooms, cursor enhancements, dynamic webcam overlays, timeline editing, and a community extension marketplace—ideal for demos, walkthroughs, and product videos.

description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
summary_zh: WeKnora 是腾讯开源的 LLM 驱动文档理解与检索框架，基于 RAG 范式实现深度语义检索与上下文感知回答。支持多模态预处理、向量索引、智能检索及自定义 Agent，提供知识库管理、API 认证、K8s 部署等能力，适用于复杂异构文档的智能问答场景。
summary_en: WeKnora is an LLM-powered framework for deep document understanding and semantic retrieval using the RAG paradigm. It features modular architecture with multimodal preprocessing, vector indexing, intelligent retrieval, and custom agents. Supports knowledge base management, API authentication, K8s deployment, and advanced features like thinking mode and data analysis.

description: Coding agent for DeepSeek models that runs in your terminal
summary_zh: DeepSeek TUI 是一款专为 DeepSeek V4 模型设计的终端原生编码代理，支持 1M 上下文窗口与实时思维链流式输出。集成文件操作、Shell 执行、Git 管理、Web 搜索、MCP 协议及 LSP 诊断等全套工具，提供 Plan/Agent/YOLO 三种交互模式，具备会话持久化、成本追踪与技能扩展能力，单二进制部署无需运行时依赖。
summary_en: DeepSeek TUI is a terminal-native coding agent optimized for DeepSeek V4's 1M-token context and prefix cache. It offers real-time chain-of-thought streaming, full tooling (file ops, shell, git, web, MCP), three interaction modes, session persistence, cost tracking, and extensible skills—all in a single binary with no runtime dependencies.

description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Smart routing, automatic failover, encrypted keys. Personal experimentation only.
summary_zh: FreeLLMAPI 是一款聚合 16 家主流 AI 厂商免费额度的 OpenAI 兼容代理网关。它通过单一 /v1 端点提供约 1.7 亿 Token/月的算力，具备智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥存储功能，旨在解决多 SDK 调用复杂和额度分散的痛点，适合个人开发者进行低成本 AI 实验。
summary_en: FreeLLMAPI is an OpenAI-compatible proxy aggregating free tiers from 16 major LLM providers into a single /v1 endpoint, delivering ~1.7B tokens/month. It features smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key storage, eliminating the complexity of managing multiple SDKs and scattered quotas for personal AI experimentation.

description: leaked prompts of GPTs
summary_zh: 该仓库收集了多个泄露的 GPTs 提示词（prompts），涵盖开发、翻译、娱乐、教育、图像生成、视频脚本、游戏等多个领域，展示了 OpenAI GPTs 功能的广泛应用场景与技术实现方式。
summary_en: This repository compiles leaked prompts from various GPTs, covering development, translation, entertainment, education, image generation, video scripting, gaming, and more, showcasing diverse use cases and technical implementations of OpenAI's GPTs platform.

description: Professional Antigravity Account Manager & Switcher. One-click seamless account switching for Antigravity Tools. Built with Tauri v2 + React (Rust).专业的 Antigravity 账号管理与切换工具。为 Antigravity 提供一键无缝账号切换功能。
summary_zh: Antigravity-Manager 是一款专业的 AI 账号管理与协议代理系统，基于 Tauri v2 + Rust + React 构建。提供多账号无缝切换、OAuth 2.0 授权、智能配额监控、协议转换（OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini）、模型路由与后台任务静默降级等核心功能，打造高性能本地 AI 中转网关。
summary_en: Antigravity-Manager is a professional AI account management and protocol proxy system built with Tauri v2 + Rust + React. It enables seamless multi-account switching, OAuth 2.0 authorization, intelligent quota monitoring, protocol conversion (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini), model routing, and silent background task fallback, serving as a high-performance local AI proxy gateway.

description: A categorized collection of Android Open Source Projects,  More powerful web version:
summary_zh: 该仓库是 Android 开源项目的权威分类汇总，涵盖 UI、网络、数据库等 250+ 个精选项目，提供个性化控件、工具库及优质案例。配套开发助手 App 支持反编译、布局分析、屏幕取色等开发调试功能，官网 timeshining.com 提供最新项目搜索与推送服务。
summary_en: This repository is a comprehensive categorized collection of 250+ high-quality Android open-source projects, covering UI components, toolkits, and outstanding apps. It includes a powerful Development Tools app for reverse engineering, layout inspection, color sampling, and debugging. The companion website offers project discovery and updates.

description: JumpServer is an Open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform with AI-powered capabilities, providing DevOps and IT teams a unified workspace to securely access SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, databases, websites, RemoteApp, VirtualApp, and more.
summary_zh: JumpServer 是一款开源的堡垒机（PAM）平台，为 DevOps 和 IT 团队提供通过浏览器安全访问 SSH、RDP、Kubernetes、数据库及远程应用端点的能力，支持权限管理、会话审计与自动化运维，具备完善的 RBAC 权限控制与多协议支持。
summary_en: JumpServer is an open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform enabling secure, on-demand access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, databases, and RemoteApp endpoints via a web browser, featuring comprehensive auditing, RBAC, and multi-protocol support for DevOps and IT teams.

description: Privacy first, AI meeting assistant with 4x faster Parakeet/Whisper live transcription, speaker diarization, and Ollama summarization built on Rust. 100% local processing. no cloud required. Meetily (Meetly Ai - https://meetily.ai) is the #1 Self-hosted, Open-source Ai meeting note taker for macOS & Windows. Understand How to write meeting minutes
summary_zh: Meetily 是一款基于 Rust 构建的隐私优先 AI 会议助手，支持 macOS 和 Windows 平台。它利用本地 AI 模型（如 Ollama）实现 4 倍速的实时转录、说话人分离及会议摘要，所有数据均在本地处理，无需云端，完美契合企业对数据主权与合规性的严苛要求。
summary_en: Meetily is a privacy-first AI meeting assistant built on Rust for macOS and Windows. Leveraging local AI models like Ollama, it delivers 4x faster real-time transcription, speaker diarization, and summarization with 100% local processing, ensuring complete data sovereignty and compliance without cloud dependency.

description: 🃏 A magical documentation site generator.
summary_zh: Docsify 是一个神奇的文档站点生成器，可将 Markdown 文件直接转换为静态网站，无需构建流程。支持全文搜索、多主题切换、插件扩展和 Emoji 渲染，适用于快速搭建技术文档、项目说明等轻量级网站。
summary_en: Docsify is a magical documentation site generator that converts Markdown files into static websites without requiring a build process. It features full-text search, multiple themes, plugin support, and emoji rendering, ideal for rapidly building lightweight technical documentation and project wikis.

description: 前端精读周刊。帮你理解最前沿、实用的技术。
summary_zh: 前端精读周刊是一个深度技术分享平台，聚焦前沿前端技术解析、源码解读与工程实践，涵盖React、JavaScript、编译原理等核心领域，结合大厂经验提供高质量技术洞察，助力开发者提升工程能力。
summary_en: Frontend Weekly is a premium technical publication that delivers in-depth analysis of cutting-edge frontend technologies, including React, JavaScript, and compilation principles. It combines insights from industry experts to provide practical engineering knowledge and elevate developer capabilities.

description: Python资源大全中文版，包括：Web框架、网络爬虫、模板引擎、数据库、数据可视化、图片处理等，由「开源前哨」和「Python开发者」微信公号团队维护更新。
summary_zh: jobbole/awesome-python-cn 是 Python 资源大全的中文镜像仓库，涵盖 Web 框架、网络爬虫、数据库、数据可视化、机器学习等全领域工具链。由开源社区维护，提供分类清晰的资源列表，助力开发者快速定位高质量 Python 生态组件。
summary_en: jobbole/awesome-python-cn is the Chinese mirror of Python's comprehensive resource repository, covering tools across Web frameworks, web scraping, databases, data visualization, machine learning, and more. Maintained by open-source communities, it offers a well-organized catalog of high-quality Python ecosystem components for developers.

summary_zh: Roop 是一款一键式人脸替换工具，支持将视频中的面部替换为任意单张图片中的面孔，无需训练或数据集。基于深度学习技术，提供 CPU/GPU 加速，适用于视频角色动画、影视特效等创作场景，同时内置伦理限制以防范滥用。
summary_en: Roop is a one-click face swap tool that replaces faces in videos using a single image, without requiring training or datasets. Powered by deep learning with CPU/GPU acceleration, it supports creative applications like character animation and film effects, while incorporating safeguards against misuse.

description: Create beautiful slides on the web using a coding agent's frontend skills
summary_zh: Frontend Slides 是一个 Claude Code 技能，专为非设计师打造。它能将 PowerPoint 文件转换为精美的 HTML 幻灯片，或从零开始创建动画丰富的网页演示文稿。该工具通过视觉预览帮助用户选择设计风格，支持零依赖的单文件输出，并提供 12 种 curated 设计风格（如 Dark Botanical、Neon Cyber），避免通用 AI 审美，产出可直接用于生产的响应式、可访问性良好的代码。
summary_en: Frontend Slides is a Claude Code skill that enables non-designers to create stunning, animation-rich HTML presentations from scratch or by converting PowerPoint files. It uses visual previews for style selection, supports zero-dependency single-file output, and offers 12 curated design styles (e.g., Dark Botanical, Neon Cyber) to avoid generic AI aesthetics while delivering production-ready, accessible, and responsive code.

description: 网易云音乐 Node.js API service
summary_zh: 网易云音乐 Node.js API 服务，提供音乐播放、歌单获取、用户信息查询等功能，支持无版权限制访问。因版权政策调整，项目已停止维护，建议用户注意合规使用。
summary_en: Netease Cloud Music Node.js API service offering music playback, playlist retrieval, and user data access. Now deprecated due to copyright policy changes; users advised to ensure compliance.

description: A powerful MCP toolkit for coding, providing semantic retrieval and editing capabilities  - the IDE for your agent
summary_zh: Serena 是一个强大的编码代理工具包，通过语义检索和编辑能力（MCP 服务器等集成）将 LLM 转变为可直接操作代码库的全功能代理。它提供类似 IDE 的符号级代码检索与编辑工具，显著提升大模型在代码理解与修改中的效率与准确性，支持多种 LLM 集成方式，包括 MCP、OpenAPI 及自定义代理框架。
summary_en: Serena is a powerful coding agent toolkit that transforms an LLM into a fully-featured agent capable of directly operating on your codebase. It provides IDE-like semantic code retrieval and editing tools at the symbol level, greatly improving token efficiency and code quality. Serena integrates with LLMs via MCP, OpenAPI, or custom agent frameworks, enabling precise code navigation and modification without full-file reads or string replacements.

description: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.
summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一个通用 CLI 中枢与 AI 原生运行时，可将任意网站、Electron 应用或本地工具转换为标准化命令行接口。支持浏览器自动化、70+ 内置站点适配器（如 Bilibili、知乎等）、AI 智能体无缝集成，具备反检测机制与零 LLM 成本运行特性。
summary_en: OpenCLI is a universal CLI hub and AI-native runtime that transforms websites, Electron apps, and local tools into deterministic command-line interfaces. It features browser automation, 70+ built-in site adapters (e.g., Bilibili, Zhihu), anti-detection measures, and seamless AI agent integration with zero LLM token consumption.

description: Open-Sora: Democratizing Efficient Video Production for All
summary_zh: Open-Sora 是一个开源的高效视频生成项目，致力于降低高质量视频制作的技术门槛。其核心亮点包括11B参数模型在VBench和人类偏好测试中与顶尖模型性能相当，仅需20万美元成本即可训练，并完全开放权重与代码。支持从1B到11B多规模模型，结合3D-VAE、rectified flow等创新架构，显著提升生成质量与效率。
summary_en: Open-Sora is an open-source initiative for efficient high-quality video generation, democratizing access to advanced video creation. Its 11B model matches top-tier performance on VBench and human preference tests at just $200K training cost, with full checkpoint and code transparency. Featuring scalable architectures like 3D-VAE and rectified flow, it enables accessible, high-fidelity video production across model sizes from 1B to 11B.

description: A CSS-first, native, zero-build layout and styling framework for web designers.
summary_zh: Yeti 是 Foundation 推出的下一代纯 CSS 布局与样式框架，零构建依赖，基于 CSS Container Queries、Cascade Layers、原生 Nesting 等现代特性驱动。提供意图导向的命名布局、单一 Token 刻度系统与开箱即用的可访问组件，机器可读清单配合 MCP 服务器，面向 2025 基线浏览器优化。
summary_en: Yeti is Foundation's next-gen CSS-first layout and styling framework with zero build requirements, leveraging native CSS features like Container Queries, Cascade Layers, and Nesting. It offers intent-based named layouts, a single token scale system, accessible-by-default components, and a machine-readable manifest with MCP server support, targeting Baseline 2025 browsers.

description: FastGPT is a knowledge-based platform built on the LLMs, offers a comprehensive suite of out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration, letting you easily develop and deploy complex question-answering systems without the need for extensive setup or configuration.
summary_zh: FastGPT 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的知识型 AI 智能体构建平台，提供开箱即用的数据处理、RAG 检索、可视化 AI 工作流编排等功能，支持复杂问答系统的快速开发与部署，无需繁琐配置。
summary_en: FastGPT is a knowledge-based AI agent platform built on LLMs, offering out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration. It enables rapid development and deployment of complex question-answering systems without extensive setup.

description: The most advanced responsive front-end framework in the world. Quickly create prototypes and production code for sites that work on any kind of device.
summary_zh: Foundation 是全球最先进的响应式前端框架，支持快速从原型开发到生产环境部署。提供完全可定制的响应式网格系统、丰富的 Sass 混合宏、常用 JavaScript 插件及完整的无障碍访问支持，适用于构建跨设备兼容的网站和应用程序。
summary_en: Foundation is the most advanced responsive front-end framework globally, enabling rapid prototyping and production-ready development of sites and apps that work seamlessly across all devices. It features a fully customizable responsive grid, extensive Sass mixins, essential JavaScript plugins, and comprehensive accessibility support.

description: Share a single keyboard and mouse between multiple computers.
summary_zh: Deskflow 是一款免费开源的键鼠共享应用，让用户通过一套键盘和鼠标无缝控制多台相邻计算机，实现类似软件 KVM 的体验（无需视频切换）。默认启用 TLS 加密保障安全，支持 Wayland 显示协议及剪贴板共享，跨平台兼容 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，适合多机办公与开发场景。
summary_en: Deskflow is a free and open-source keyboard and mouse sharing app that lets you seamlessly control nearby computers using one keyboard, mouse, or trackpad — like a software KVM without video switching. TLS encryption is enabled by default, with Wayland support and clipboard sharing. Cross-platform across Windows, macOS, and Linux, ideal for multi-machine workflows.

description: JavaScript in-page GUI agent. Control web interfaces with natural language.
summary_zh: Page Agent 是一个基于 JavaScript 的网页内 GUI 智能体，通过自然语言控制网页界面。无需浏览器扩展、Python 或无头浏览器，直接在页面中运行。支持文本化 DOM 操作、自定义 LLM、人机交互 UI，并提供 Chrome 扩展实现跨标签页任务。适用于 SaaS AI 助手、表单自动化、无障碍访问等场景。
summary_en: Page Agent is a JavaScript-based in-page GUI agent that controls web interfaces via natural language. It runs directly in the browser without requiring extensions, Python, or headless browsers. Features text-driven DOM manipulation, customizable LLMs, human-in-the-loop UI, and optional Chrome extension for multi-tab workflows. Ideal for SaaS AI copilots, form automation, and accessibility tools.

description: Maple Mono: Open source monospace font with round corner, ligatures and Nerd-Font icons for IDE and terminal, fine-grained customization options. 带连字和控制台图标的圆角等宽字体，中英文宽度完美2:1，细粒度的自定义选项
summary_zh: Maple Mono 是一款专为提升编码体验而设计的开源等宽字体，具有圆角设计、连字功能及 Nerd-Font 图标支持，适用于 IDE 和终端环境。其特色包括可变字重、智能连字、中英文 2:1 完美对齐，以及细粒度自定义选项，支持简繁中文和日文，适合多语言开发场景。
summary_en: Maple Mono is an open-source monospace font designed to enhance coding flow, featuring rounded corners, ligatures, and Nerd-Font icons for IDEs and terminals. It offers variable font weights, smart ligatures, perfect 2:1 Chinese-English alignment, and extensive customization, supporting Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese for multilingual development environments.

description: The open source frontend for GitBook doc sites
summary_zh: GitBook 是一个开源的前端文档渲染引擎，专为技术知识管理而设计。它基于 Next.js 构建，支持本地开发和自定义发布站点，提供团队协作的文档管理功能，适用于开源项目和技术团队的知识共享。
summary_en: GitBook is an open-source frontend engine for rendering GitBook documentation sites, built on Next.js. It enables local development and custom publishing of technical knowledge, supporting team collaboration and open-source contributions for documentation workflows.

summary_zh: Void 是一款开源的 Cursor 替代 IDE，支持在代码库中使用 AI 智能体、可视化变更与检查点，并允许本地部署任意模型。其核心优势在于直接与 AI 服务商通信而不保留用户数据，基于 VSCode 深度定制，提供高度可定制的 AI 编程体验。
summary_en: Void is an open-source alternative to Cursor, enabling AI agents to work on your codebase with checkpointing, change visualization, and local model hosting. It communicates directly with AI providers without storing your data, built as a VSCode fork with a focus on innovation over feature parity.

description: 🦄️ 🎃 👻 Clash Premium 规则集(RULE-SET)，兼容 ClashX Pro、Clash for Windows 等基于 Clash Premium 内核的客户端。
summary_zh: 本项目提供专为 Clash Premium 内核设计的规则集（RULE-SET），涵盖直连、代理和广告拦截域名列表，兼容 ClashX Pro、Clash for Windows 等主流客户端。规则数据源自 v2ray-rules-dat、domain-list-community 等权威源，每日自动更新，支持中国大陆 IP 地址识别，适用于科学上网与网络流量精细化管控。
summary_en: This project provides rule sets (RULE-SET) specifically designed for Clash Premium kernel, including direct, proxy, and ad-blocking domain lists. Compatible with ClashX Pro, Clash for Windows, and other GUI clients. Data sources include v2ray-rules-dat and domain-list-community, with daily automatic updates and support for China IP address recognition, ideal for network traffic control and bypassing restrictions.

description: Resume template for Chinese programmers . 程序员简历模板系列。包括PHP程序员简历模板、iOS程序员简历模板、Android程序员简历模板、Web前端程序员简历模板、Java程序员简历模板、C/C++程序员简历模板、NodeJS程序员简历模板、架构师简历模板以及通用程序员简历模板
summary_zh: 本项目提供涵盖PHP、iOS、Android、Web前端、Java、C/C++、NodeJS、架构师等9类程序员岗位的中文简历模板，支持Markdown格式，由AI职业顾问职小兔®优化设计。配套提供在线简历工具冷熊简历与自建版DeerResume，并附《如何写好技术简历》教学资源，助力程序员高效打造专业简历。
summary_en: This repo offers 9 resume templates for Chinese programmers, covering PHP, iOS, Android, Web Frontend, Java, C/C++, NodeJS, and Architect roles in Markdown format, optimized by AI career advisor 职小兔®. It includes tools like Cold Bear Resume and DeerResume, plus teaching resources on writing effective tech resumes to help developers build professional profiles.

description: Get 10X more out of Claude Code, Codex or any coding agent
summary_zh: Vibe Kanban 是一个专为 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）设计的任务管理与协同工具，支持多代理并行/串行调度、任务状态追踪、远程 SSH 项目访问及统一配置管理，显著提升开发效率。
summary_en: Vibe Kanban is a task orchestration and management tool designed for AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It enables parallel/sequential agent execution, real-time task tracking, remote SSH project access, and centralized MCP configuration, boosting developer productivity by 10x.

description: 🚀 The fast, Pythonic way to build MCP servers and clients.
summary_zh: FastMCP 是构建 MCP 服务器和客户端的快速 Pythonic 框架，提供声明式工具定义、自动生成 Schema 和文档、内置协议协商与认证机制，支持从原型到生产的一站式开发，已集成至官方 MCP Python SDK 并成为行业标准。
summary_en: FastMCP is a fast, Pythonic framework for building MCP servers and clients. It enables declarative tool definition, automatic schema generation, protocol negotiation, and authentication, streamlining development from prototype to production. Integrated into the official MCP Python SDK, it powers 70% of MCP servers globally.

description: YApi 是一个可本地部署的、打通前后端及QA的、可视化的接口管理平台
summary_zh: YApi 是一款高效、易用、功能强大的可视化接口管理平台，支持本地部署，专为开发、产品、测试团队提供优雅的 API 管理服务。基于 Json5 和 Mockjs 定义接口结构，集成接口调试、自动化测试、Mock 期望等功能，支持 Postman/HAR/Swagger 导入，并提供丰富的插件生态与代码生成工具，助力企业级接口协作与效率提升。
summary_en: YApi is a powerful, user-friendly, and efficient visual API management platform designed for developers, product managers, and QA teams. It enables seamless creation, publishing, and maintenance of APIs with features like Json5/Mockjs-based data modeling, automated testing, mock server with expectations, and support for importing from Postman, HAR, and Swagger. With a rich plugin ecosystem and code generation tools, it enhances API collaboration and productivity in enterprise environments.

description: 互联网首份程序员考公指南，由3位已经进入体制内的前大厂程序员联合献上。
summary_zh: 《程序员考公指南》由三位成功上岸的前大厂程序员联合撰写，总结一年在职备考经验，提供从备考策略、时间管理到岗位选择的系统性指导，帮助程序员转型进入体制内，涵盖公务员、事业编制及教师岗位，强调实用性与可行性。
summary_en: The 'Programmer's Guide to Civil Service Exams' is co-authored by three former tech employees who successfully transitioned into government roles after a year of part-time preparation. It offers practical strategies for programmers considering public sector careers, covering civil service, public institutions, and teaching positions with real-world insights and actionable advice.

description: Documentation that simply works
summary_zh: Material for MkDocs 是一个基于 MkDocs 的强大文档框架，支持 Markdown 编写，可快速生成专业、可搜索、多语言（60+）且跨设备的静态网站。提供高度定制化主题与现代化界面，适用于开源和商业项目文档。
summary_en: Material for MkDocs is a powerful documentation framework built on top of MkDocs, enabling fast creation of professional, searchable, multilingual (60+), and device-agnostic static sites from Markdown. It offers a customizable Material Design theme ideal for open-source and commercial projects.

description: A cross-platform launcher that simply works
summary_zh: Wox 是一款跨平台启动器，提供快速搜索应用、文件、文件夹及AI聊天功能，支持MCP集成。通过插件系统和主题扩展，用户可用JavaScript或Python开发自定义功能。软件为单文件免安装，兼容Windows/macOS/Linux，快捷键操作高效便捷，是Alfred和Raycast的开源替代方案。
summary_en: Wox is a cross-platform launcher offering fast search for apps, files, and folders, plus AI chat with MCP support. It features a plugin system (JavaScript/Python) and themes, runs as a single executable without installation, and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. Designed as an open-source alternative to Alfred and Raycast, it emphasizes simplicity and extensibility.

description: A UI library by WeChat official design team, includes the most useful widgets/modules in mobile web applications.
summary_zh: WeUI 是腾讯微信官方设计团队打造的开源 UI 库，专为微信小程序和 Web 应用设计，提供丰富的移动端组件（如按钮、表单、弹窗等），确保与微信生态一致的用户体验，支持快速构建美观、标准化的移动 Web 应用。
summary_en: WeUI is an open-source UI library developed by Tencent's WeChat design team, specifically tailored for WeChat web and mini-program development. It offers a comprehensive set of mobile-first components (e.g., buttons, forms, dialogs) to deliver a consistent and standardized user experience across WeChat ecosystems, enabling rapid development of visually appealing mobile web apps.

description: AI-agent Skill for generating polished HTML slide decks: editorial magazine and Swiss layouts, image prompts, social covers, and a WebGL/low-power presentation runtime.
summary_zh: 该仓库是一个 Claude Code Skill，用于将提示词转换为横向翻页的电子杂志风格单文件 HTML PPT。支持 10 种布局、5 套主题色、WebGL 背景，适用于线下分享、AI 产品发布等场景，强调克制美学与结构优先的设计原则。
summary_en: This is a Claude Code Skill that converts prompts into single-file, magazine-style HTML presentations with horizontal swiping. It offers 10 layouts, 5 curated themes, WebGL hero backgrounds, and is ideal for offline talks, AI product launches, emphasizing restrained aesthetics and structural clarity.

description: 插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
summary_zh: MusicFree 是一款开源、无广告、插件化的免费音乐播放器，专为 Android 和 Harmony OS 设计。其核心特性包括完全本地化数据存储、支持自定义主题与歌词关联功能。通过插件架构，用户可接入第三方音源（如音乐搜索、歌单导入、歌词获取），实现高度定制化体验。项目基于 AGPL 3.0 协议开源，强调隐私保护与合法合规使用。
summary_en: MusicFree is an open-source, ad-free, plugin-based music player for Android and Harmony OS. It features local data storage, customizable themes, and lyric linking. Its plugin architecture enables integration with third-party audio sources for search, playback, and playlist import. Built on AGPL 3.0, it prioritizes privacy and ethical use without VIP or cracked content.

description: Lovely console emulator package for Windows
summary_zh: Cmder 是一款专为 Windows 设计的轻量级终端模拟器，基于 ConEmu 深度优化，集成 Monokai 配色、clink 增强命令行及自定义提示符。其核心优势在于完全便携性，无外部依赖，支持 USB 存储或云同步，内置 wget、curl、git 等工具，适合开发者随时随地高效使用命令行环境。
summary_en: Cmder is a portable console emulator for Windows, built on ConEmu with major enhancements including Monokai color scheme, clink integration, and customizable prompts. It offers zero external dependencies, ideal for USB drives or cloud storage, and includes tools like wget, curl, and git for seamless command-line productivity.

description: The Developer Tool for Designers • An Open-Source AI-First Design tool • Visually build, style, and edit your code with AI • World's best, top-most agent recommended #1 Developer tool for Designers to design with Real Code.
summary_zh: Onlook 是一款面向设计师的开源 AI 驱动可视化代码编辑器，支持在浏览器中实时编辑 React 应用。它结合 Next.js 和 TailwindCSS，提供类 Figma 的 UI 设计体验，实现视觉化开发、实时预览、组件管理和一键部署，是 Bolt.new 等工具的替代方案。
summary_en: Onlook is an open-source, AI-first visual code editor for designers, enabling real-time React app editing in the browser. Built with Next.js and TailwindCSS, it offers a Figma-like interface for visual development, component management, and instant deployment, serving as an alternative to tools like Bolt.new.

description: :electron: Another Mihomo GUI.
summary_zh: Clash Party 是一款基于 Electron 的 Mihomo（Clash Meta）图形界面客户端，提供开箱即用的代理管理工具。支持 Smart Core 智能节点选择、多主题 UI、WebDAV 配置备份、Sub-Store 订阅集成及内核切换，简化了复杂代理配置流程，适合需要高效网络代理的用户。
summary_en: Clash Party is an Electron-based GUI for Mihomo (Clash Meta) that offers an out-of-the-box proxy management tool. It features Smart Core AI-driven node selection, multi-theme UI, WebDAV config backup, Sub-Store integration, and dual-core support, streamlining complex proxy configurations for end users.

description: ⭐⭐⭐⭐秒杀系统设计与实现.互联网工程师进阶与分析🙋🐓
summary_zh: 该仓库聚焦秒杀系统的高并发设计与实现，涵盖Spring、Redis、MQ、ZK等核心技术栈，提供完整的高可用、高性能解决方案。项目包含多线程导入框架、JVM调优实战、分布式流程引擎等进阶内容，适合中高级工程师系统学习互联网架构核心能力。
summary_en: This repository focuses on high-concurrency design and implementation of flash sale systems, covering core tech stacks like Spring, Redis, MQ, and ZooKeeper. It provides complete solutions for high availability and performance, including multi-threaded import frameworks, JVM tuning, and distributed workflow engines, ideal for intermediate to advanced engineers.

description: A complete and graceful API for Wechat. 微信个人号接口、微信机器人及命令行微信，三十行即可自定义个人号机器人。
summary_zh: itchat 是一个基于 Python 的微信个人号完整 API，支持微信机器人开发、命令行微信及自动化操作。通过简单代码即可实现消息收发、好友管理、附件下载、群聊处理等功能，支持多开、热重载、命令行二维码显示等高级特性，适合快速构建个性化微信应用。
summary_en: itchat is a complete and elegant Python API for WeChat personal accounts, enabling easy development of WeChat bots, command-line WeChat, and automation. It supports message handling, friend management, file downloads, group chat processing, multi-instance operation, hot reload, and command-line QR code display, ideal for building custom WeChat applications quickly.

summary_zh: 宝玉技能集为Claude Code用户提供高效日常办公工具，包含小红书图文生成、AI内容创作及实用工具三大类。支持风格化模板（可爱/清新/极简等）、色彩方案定制及批量处理，提升内容生产效率。
summary_en: Baoyu Skills enhances daily work efficiency in Claude Code with content generation tools, AI utilities, and publishing helpers. Features style templates (cute/fresh/minimal), color palettes, and batch processing for streamlined content creation.

description: For slim progress bars like on YouTube, Medium, etc
summary_zh: NProgress 是一个轻量级进度条库，专为 Ajax 应用设计，灵感来自 YouTube、Medium 等网站。它提供极简的 API 控制进度条，支持 Turbolinks、Pjax 等现代前端框架集成，并允许自定义配置如最小值、动画速度和模板。
summary_en: NProgress is a minimalist progress bar library for Ajax applications, inspired by YouTube and Medium. It offers a simple API to control the bar, integrates with frameworks like Turbolinks and Pjax, and supports customization of minimum value, animation speed, and template.

description: Patched fonts for Powerline users.
summary_zh: Powerline 字体仓库提供专为 Powerline 状态栏插件优化的预配置字体，支持多种流行编程字体（如 Hack、Fira Mono、Meslo 等），涵盖 BSD、Apache、SIL 等开源许可证，适用于 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 终端环境，提升终端显示美观性与可读性。
summary_en: This repository provides pre-patched fonts optimized for the Powerline statusline plugin, featuring popular programming fonts like Hack, Fira Mono, and Meslo under open licenses such as BSD, Apache, and SIL. It supports quick installation via script or package manager across Linux, macOS, and Windows terminals, enhancing visual appeal and readability.

description: An open-source Chinese font derived from Fontworks' Klee One. 一款开源中文字体，基于 FONTWORKS 出品字体 Klee One 衍生。
summary_zh: 霞鹜文楷是一款基于 FONTWORKS Klee One 衍生的开源中文字体，采用 OFL 1.1 协议授权，支持免费商用。提供多个变体版本，包括屏幕阅读版、轻便版、GB 规范版及繁体旧字形版，适配不同场景需求。
summary_en: LXGW WenKai is an open-source Chinese font derived from Fontworks' Klee One, licensed under OFL 1.1 for free commercial use. It offers multiple variants including screen-optimized, lite, GB-compliant, and traditional character editions for diverse applications.

description: 解决Cursor在免费订阅期间出现以下提示的问题:  Your request has been blocked as our system has detected suspicious activity / You've reached your trial request limit.  /  Too many free trial accounts used on this machine.
summary_zh: 该工具用于重置 Cursor 免费试用限制，解决因系统检测可疑活动或试用请求超限导致的访问阻断问题。支持一键恢复试用额度，适用于开发者快速恢复 AI 编程环境使用权，提升开发效率。
summary_en: This tool resets Cursor's free trial limits, resolving access blocks caused by suspicious activity detection or trial request limits. It enables developers to restore trial credits instantly, ensuring uninterrupted access to AI-powered coding features.

description: Make images smaller using best-in-class codecs, right in the browser.
summary_zh: Squoosh 是一款浏览器内图像压缩工具，利用顶级编解码器显著减小图像体积，所有处理均在本地完成，保护用户隐私。支持多种格式压缩，提供实时预览与尺寸对比，适用于网页优化与资源管理。
summary_en: Squoosh is a browser-based image compression tool that reduces image sizes using best-in-class codecs entirely in the browser. It supports multiple formats, offers real-time preview and size comparison, and ensures privacy by processing images locally without server transmission.

description: A collection of 100+ specialized Claude Code subagents covering a wide range of development use cases
summary_zh: 该仓库是 Claude Code 子代理的精选集合，包含127+个专业化AI助手，覆盖API设计、前后端开发、DevOps、测试等全开发场景。支持插件市场一键安装、交互式脚本及独立安装器，提供开箱即用的开发自动化工具链。
summary_en: This repository is the definitive collection of 127+ specialized Claude Code subagents for development tasks, covering API design, full-stack development, DevOps, and testing. It offers one-click plugin installation, interactive scripts, and standalone installers for instant developer productivity.

description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
summary_zh: REA 是一款基于 AI 智能体的逆向工程工具，支持从应用程序行为到原生二进制的全栈代码审查。它通过 MCP 协议无缝集成 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流 AI 助手，可静态分析 JavaScript、.NET 及动态分析二进制文件，支持 Hopper/Ghidra 引擎，帮助开发者深入理解软件实现机制并快速复用功能。
summary_en: REA is an AI agent-driven reverse engineering tool for full-stack code inspection from app behavior to native binaries. It integrates with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI assistants via MCP protocol, supporting static analysis of JavaScript, .NET assemblies, and dynamic binary analysis with Hopper/Ghidra engines. Developers can inspect undocumented apps, understand implementation details, and rebuild features for their own projects.

description: A simple screen parsing tool towards pure vision based GUI agent
summary_zh: OmniParser 是一个面向纯视觉 GUI 代理的屏幕解析工具，通过将界面截图结构化解析为可理解的元素，显著提升 GPT-4V 等视觉模型在界面区域精准定位和交互的能力。支持图标检测与功能描述，集成 OmniTool 实现 Windows 11 虚拟机控制，兼容多种大语言模型，适用于自动化操作与训练数据生成。
summary_en: OmniParser is a screen parsing tool designed for pure vision-based GUI agents, transforming UI screenshots into structured elements to enhance the accuracy of vision models like GPT-4V in grounding actions. It supports icon detection, interactivity prediction, and integrates with OmniTool for Windows 11 VM control, compatible with OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Anthropic models for automation and training data generation.

description: Development at the speed of light
summary_zh: SpacetimeDB 是一个基于 Rust 构建的分布式数据库系统，专为实时应用设计，支持边缘计算与区块链集成。它通过去中心化架构实现毫秒级数据同步，适用于游戏、物联网和去中心化应用，提供高可用性与强一致性。
summary_en: SpacetimeDB is a distributed database system built in Rust, designed for real-time applications with edge computing and blockchain integration. It enables millisecond-scale data synchronization via a decentralized architecture, ideal for gaming, IoT, and decentralized apps, offering high availability and strong consistency.

description: Bring macOS “Quick Look” feature to Windows
summary_zh: QuickLook 是一款为 Windows 系统移植的 macOS ‘快速查看’ 功能工具，支持通过空格键即时预览文件内容，涵盖图片、文档、视频等多种格式。其核心优势在于轻量化设计、低资源占用和高度可扩展性，用户可通过插件系统自定义预览功能，极大提升文件浏览效率。
summary_en: QuickLook brings macOS 'Quick Look' functionality to Windows, enabling instant file previews by pressing the spacebar. It supports diverse file types including images, documents, and videos with minimal resource usage and extensibility via plugins, significantly enhancing file browsing efficiency.

description: A gallery that showcases on-device ML/GenAI use cases and allows people to try and use models locally.
summary_zh: Google AI Edge Gallery 是一个展示端侧机器学习与生成式 AI 应用的实验性应用，支持在 Android 和 iOS 设备上本地运行大模型，提供离线聊天、图像问答、音频转录、提示工程等功能，并集成 Tiny Garden 小游戏与设备控制能力，实现完全离线的智能体验。
summary_en: Google AI Edge Gallery is an experimental app showcasing on-device ML/GenAI use cases, enabling users to run generative AI models locally on Android and iOS. It supports offline chat, image Q&A, audio transcription, prompt engineering, and includes a mini game and device control via fine-tuned models, all without requiring an internet connection.

description: 面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，吴恩达大模型系列课程中文版
summary_zh: 本项目是面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，基于吴恩达大模型系列课程打造，覆盖 Prompt Engineering、RAG、模型微调等全流程。内容涵盖从基础 API 调用到 LangChain 应用开发，提供中文复现代码与 Prompt 优化方案，支持 Jupyter Notebook 实践，助力开发者快速掌握 LLM 应用开发技能。
summary_en: This project is a developer-focused LLM入门教程 based on Andrew Ng's large language model courses, covering Prompt Engineering, RAG, and fine-tuning. It includes translated, reproduced code examples and optimized Chinese prompts, enabling hands-on learning via Jupyter Notebooks to help developers master LLM application development.

description: Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit.
summary_zh: Vorssaint 是一款免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具箱，旨在替代多个付费系统工具。它集成了应用独立音量调节、系统资源监控、窗口切换、剪贴板历史、文件暂存架及应用卸载等十余项功能。所有功能均本地运行，无需账户或订阅，通过单一图标即可访问，极大提升了 Mac 用户的操作效率。
summary_en: Vorssaint is a free, open-source macOS menu bar toolkit designed to replace a stack of paid utilities. It integrates over a dozen features including per-app volume mixing, system monitoring, window switching, clipboard history, and app uninstallation. Running entirely locally with no accounts or subscriptions, it consolidates multiple tools into a single, efficient menu bar icon.

description: Huashu Design · HTML-native design skill for Claude Code · Claude Code 里 HTML 原生的设计 skill · 高保真原型 / 幻灯片 / 动画 + 20 设计哲学 + 5 维评审 + MP4 导出 · Agent-agnostic
summary_zh: Huashu Design 是一款基于 HTML 原生的 AI 设计技能，专为 Claude Code 等 Agent 环境打造。用户通过自然语言指令即可快速生成高保真原型、可交互 App、演讲 PPT、动画视频及信息图，支持 MP4/GIF/PPTX 多格式导出，内置 20 种设计哲学与 5 维评审体系，实现“打字即交付”的高效设计流程。
summary_en: Huashu Design is an HTML-native AI design skill for Agent environments like Claude Code. It enables users to generate high-fidelity prototypes, interactive apps, slides, animations, and infographics via natural language prompts. It supports MP4/GIF/PPTX exports, includes 20 design philosophies and a 5-dimensional review system, delivering production-ready designs instantly.

description: http下载工具，基于http代理，支持多连接分块下载
summary_zh: Proxyee Down 是一款基于 HTTP 代理和 Netty 的高性能开源下载工具，支持多线程分块下载，具备扩展功能以满足特殊需求。项目因 Java 客户端开发限制暂停维护，作者计划用 Go + Flutter 重写以打造跨平台、低内存占用的下一代下载器。
summary_en: Proxyee Down is an open-source, high-speed HTTP downloader built on HTTP proxy and Netty, supporting multi-threaded chunked downloads and extensible plugins. The project is paused due to Java client limitations, with plans to rewrite using Go + Flutter for cross-platform, low-memory usage.

description: Roo Code gives you a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.
summary_zh: Roo Code 是一款 VS Code 扩展，将 AI 智能体团队集成到代码编辑器中，支持自然语言生成代码、多模式协作（编码/架构/调试/问答）、自动化任务处理及文档维护，显著提升开发效率。
summary_en: Roo Code is a VS Code extension that embeds an AI-powered development team directly into your editor. It enables natural language code generation, multi-mode workflows (coding, architecture, debugging, Q&A), automation, and documentation, dramatically boosting developer productivity.

description: Bootstrap 5 & Material Design UI KIT
summary_zh: MDBootstrap 提供基于 Bootstrap 5 和 Material Design 的免费 UI 组件库，包含 700+ 原生 JavaScript 组件，支持 npm、CDN 和 Webpack 集成，适用于快速构建现代化网页界面，被 NASA、Nike 等企业广泛使用。
summary_en: MDBootstrap offers a free UI kit with 700+ Bootstrap 5 components based on Material Design, built in plain JavaScript. It supports npm, CDN, and Webpack integration, enabling rapid development of modern web interfaces trusted by 3M+ developers and enterprises like NASA and Nike.

description: Happy is the open-source desktop app for Claude Code, Codex, and Grok, with an iOS and Android app to control your coding agents from anywhere.
summary_zh: Happy Coder 是一款移动端和网页端客户端，支持 Claude Code 和 Codex，具备端到端加密、实时语音交互及全功能远程控制。用户可通过手机或网页随时监控 AI 编码进度，实现设备间无缝切换，保障代码安全。
summary_en: Happy Coder is a mobile and web client for Claude Code and Codex, featuring end-to-end encryption, real-time voice, and full-featured remote control. It enables users to monitor AI coding progress from any device, switch sessions instantly, and ensures code privacy with zero telemetry.

description: MagicMirror² is an open source modular smart mirror platform. With a growing list of installable modules, the MagicMirror² allows you to convert your hallway or bathroom mirror into your personal assistant.
summary_zh: MagicMirror² 是一款开源模块化智能镜平台，可将走廊或浴室镜子转换为个人助手。基于 Electron 构建，无需服务器或浏览器，支持大量可安装插件，提供天气、日历、新闻等实时信息展示，适用于智能家居场景。
summary_en: MagicMirror² is an open source modular smart mirror platform that transforms hallways or bathroom mirrors into personal assistants. Built with Electron, it requires no web server or browser, supports numerous installable modules for displaying real-time info like weather, calendar, and news in smart home environments.

description: 🐱 BongoCat — A cross-platform interactive desktop pet that brings fun to your desktop!
summary_zh: BongoCat 是一款跨平台互动桌宠应用，基于 Tauri 框架开发，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 系统。它以可爱的猫咪形象提供桌面陪伴功能，用户可通过点击、拖拽等交互触发趣味动画，为日常办公增添轻松娱乐元素。
summary_en: BongoCat is a cross-platform interactive desktop pet built with Tauri, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a playful cat character that responds to user interactions like clicks and drags with animated effects, adding entertainment to your desktop experience.

description: Python ProxyPool for web spider
summary_zh: ProxyPool 是一个 Python 实现的爬虫代理 IP 池，支持定时采集、验证和更新免费代理 IP，提供 RESTful API 接口。项目具备高可用代理源扩展能力，适用于网页爬虫、数据采集等场景，支持多版本 Python 环境及 Docker 部署，显著提升爬虫反爬绕过效率。
summary_en: ProxyPool is a Python-based proxy IP pool for web scraping, featuring automated collection, validation, and management of free proxies. It offers a RESTful API for integration with crawlers, supports extensible proxy sources, and enables efficient anti-scraping bypass via rotating IPs. Compatible with Python 2.7–3.11 and deployable via Docker.

description: A high quality UI Toolkit built on Vue.js 2.0
summary_zh: iView 是基于 Vue.js 2.0 开发的高质量 UI 组件库，提供数十个美观实用的组件，支持 Vue 1.x 和 2.x、SSR、TypeScript、Electron 等，适用于企业级应用开发，文档详尽且提供丰富示例。
summary_en: iView is a high-quality UI toolkit built on Vue.js 2.0, offering dozens of beautiful and practical components. It supports Vue 1.x/2.x, SSR, TypeScript, Electron, and provides extensive documentation with demos for enterprise-level applications.

description: flutter 开发者帮助 APP，包含 flutter 常用 140+ 组件的demo 演示与中文文档
summary_zh: FlutterGo 是阿里巴巴推出的 Flutter 开发者辅助应用，提供 140+ 组件的中文文档与演示，帮助开发者快速掌握 Flutter 开发。因团队调整暂停维护，但计划未来迭代并招募社区贡献者。
summary_en: FlutterGo is an Alibaba-developed Flutter developer helper app featuring 140+ component demos and Chinese documentation. It aids developers in mastering Flutter. Due to internal restructuring, maintenance is temporarily paused, with plans for future updates and community contributions.

description: Conversational RPA SDK for Chatbot Makers. Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/7q8NBZbQzt
summary_zh: Wechaty 是一个对话式 RPA SDK，专为聊天机器人开发者设计，提供跨 WhatsApp、微信等主流消息平台的统一接口，支持 TypeScript、Python、Go 等多语言开发，实现一次编写多平台运行，显著降低聊天机器人开发复杂度。
summary_en: Wechaty is a conversational RPA SDK that simplifies chatbot development by offering a universal interface across messaging platforms like WhatsApp and WeChat. It supports multiple languages including TypeScript and Python, enabling developers to write once and deploy anywhere, streamlining bot creation with open-source ease and community support.

description: ⚡️A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀 — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry.
summary_zh: OpenLogi 是一款用 Rust 编写的本地优先、原生替代 Logitech Options+ 的工具，无需账户或遥测，通过 HID++ 协议直接控制罗技鼠标的按键映射、DPI 和 SmartShift。支持 macOS，提供 GUI 和 CLI 双模式，配置为纯 TOML 文件，强调隐私与离线使用。
summary_en: OpenLogi is a native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry. Supports macOS with GUI and CLI, plain TOML config, privacy-focused and offline-first.

description: Open source Loom alternative. Beautiful, shareable screen recordings.
summary_zh: Cap 是一款开源的 Loom 替代工具，提供美观、可分享的屏幕录制功能。支持视频录制、编辑与快速分享，采用 Rust + Tauri 构建桌面端，Next.js + React 开发 Web 端，基于 MySQL 和 Drizzle ORM，支持 Docker 一键部署与自托管。
summary_en: Cap is an open-source alternative to Loom, offering beautiful, shareable screen recordings. It enables quick video recording, editing, and sharing via a desktop app (Tauri/Rust) and web interface (Next.js/React), with MySQL backend, Docker deployment, and self-hosting support.

summary_zh: Vibe Coding 指南是一个通过 AI 结对编程实现创意快速落地的开源项目，提供多语言支持与完整工具链，涵盖提示工程、开发流程优化及自动化部署，助力开发者高效构建原型与产品。
summary_en: The Vibe Coding Guide is an open-source project enabling rapid idea-to-prototype development through AI pair programming, featuring multilingual support, prompt engineering frameworks, and automated workflows for efficient software creation.

description: 🐱 🧸跨平台互动桌宠 BongoCat，为桌面增添乐趣！
summary_zh: BongoCat是一款跨平台互动桌宠应用，支持Windows、macOS和Linux。猫咪会在桌面上自由行走、互动，为桌面增添趣味与陪伴感。项目正从Tauri迁移至C/C++、SDL3和OpenGL的原生实现，轻量高效，适合个性化桌面装饰与解压场景。
summary_en: BongoCat is a cross-platform interactive desktop pet app supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. The cat wanders and interacts on your desktop, adding fun and companionship. Migrating from Tauri to a native C/C++ + SDL3 + OpenGL implementation for better performance, ideal for desktop personalization and stress relief.

description: Convert Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF to clean Markdown. Built in Rust, with Node.js and Python bindings.
summary_zh: anydoc 是基于 Rust 的高性能文档转换库，支持 Word、PDF、Excel 等 8 种格式一键转为 GitHub-Flavored Markdown。提供 Node.js、Python、WebAssembly 多语言绑定，毫秒级响应，专为 LLM 数据预处理和 AI Agent 集成设计，是 Firecrawl Parse 的核心引擎。
summary_en: anydoc is a high-performance Rust library that converts 8+ document formats (Word, PDF, Excel, etc.) into clean GitHub-Flavored Markdown in single-digit milliseconds. Offers Node.js, Python, and WebAssembly bindings, purpose-built for LLM data preprocessing and AI Agent integration, powering Firecrawl Parse.

description: 1,324-exercise fitness dataset — animation GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, muscle-group & equipment data, and step-by-step instructions in 6 languages. The exercise data layer behind the LogPress app.
summary_zh: 一个包含1324种健身动作的结构化多语言数据集，涵盖类别、目标肌群、器械、多语言指令及媒体ID。提供开发者向导，便于快速搭建健身应用后端、数据库及API。数据源自ExerciseDB，支持6种语言，适合健身应用开发、AI推荐及健康研究。
summary_en: A structured multilingual dataset of 1,324 fitness exercises with categories, target muscles, equipment, step-by-step instructions in 6 languages, and media IDs. Includes a developer setup wizard for rapid backend, database, and API scaffolding. Ideal for fitness app development, AI recommendations, and health research.

description: 没事写写文章，喜欢的话请点star，想订阅点watch，千万别fork！
summary_zh: 该仓库是作者个人技术博客，专注于前端工程化实践与性能优化，涵盖前端集成、模块化开发、自动化测试、部署流程等核心议题，并收录业界最佳实践与经典技术文章，适合前端工程师系统性提升工程能力。
summary_en: This repository hosts a personal technical blog focused on front-end engineering, covering topics like integration, modular development, automated testing, and deployment. It includes industry best practices and classic articles to help front-end engineers enhance their engineering capabilities.

description: A plugin for Mac WeChat
summary_zh: MustangYM/WeChatExtension-ForMac 是一款专为 macOS 设计的微信插件，支持多开、免认证登录、消息撤回同步、自定义回复及AI自动回复等功能。集成迷离/黑夜/上帝/少女等主题皮肤，适配微信3.1.2+，兼容企业微信与简版助手，提供跨平台消息转发与小程序详情展示，是Objective-C生态中广受欢迎的自动化工具之一。
summary_en: MustangYM/WeChatExtension-ForMac is a macOS plugin for WeChat that enables multi-account login, message recall sync, custom replies, and AI auto-reply. It supports themes like Mysterious/Dark/God/Daughter modes, integrates with WeChat 3.1.2+, and offers features like message forwarding, mini-program details, and cross-device notifications. A popular Objective-C project with enterprise and lightweight versions.

description: An open-source, AI-integrated, cross-platform terminal for seamless workflows
summary_zh: Wave Terminal 是一款开源、集成 AI 的智能跨平台终端，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。它兼容任意 AI 模型（如 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini），支持本地运行 Ollama 等模型，无需账户即可使用。核心特性包括：持久化 SSH 会话、内嵌远程文件编辑器、富文本预览（Markdown/图片/PDF）、AI 助手实时分析终端输出并操作文件，以及强大的 `wsh` CLI 工具实现工作区管理与跨会话数据同步。
summary_en: Wave Terminal is an open-source, AI-integrated terminal for macOS, Linux, and Windows. It supports any AI model via BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or local models like Ollama/LM Studio. Key features include durable SSH sessions with auto-reconnect, built-in remote file editor, rich file previews (markdown, images, PDFs), context-aware Wave AI assistant that analyzes terminal output and performs file operations, and a powerful `wsh` CLI system for workspace management and cross-session data sync.

description: A powerful GUI app and Toolkit for Claude Code - Create custom agents, manage interactive Claude Code sessions, run secure background agents, and more.
summary_zh: opcode 是一款基于 Tauri 2 的 Claude Code GUI 工具，提供项目与会话管理、自定义 AI 代理创建、MCP 服务器集成、使用量分析仪表板等功能，将命令行工具转化为直观的桌面应用，提升 AI 辅助开发效率。
summary_en: opcode is a powerful desktop GUI app built with Tauri 2 for Claude Code, enabling custom agent creation, interactive session management, MCP server integration, usage analytics, and secure background agent execution to enhance AI-assisted development productivity.

description: Show usage stats for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code, without having to login.
summary_zh: CodexBar 是一款 macOS 14+ 菜单栏应用，实时显示 OpenAI Codex、Claude Code 等主流 AI 服务的令牌/额度使用情况（会话+周额度），支持多提供商独立或合并显示，无需登录即可查看窗口重置时间，提供本地成本扫描与状态监控功能。
summary_en: CodexBar is a tiny macOS 14+ menu bar app that displays token/credit usage (session + weekly) for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and other AI providers without requiring login. It supports per-provider toggles, merge icons mode, local cost scanning, and real-time reset countdowns via a compact two-bar meter icon.

description: Buzz transcribes and translates audio offline on your personal computer. Powered by OpenAI's Whisper.
summary_zh: Buzz是一款基于OpenAI Whisper的本地音频转录与翻译工具，支持离线运行。具备多硬件加速、实时麦克风转录、语音分离与说话人识别功能，可将音视频转为TXT/SRT/VTT字幕文件，适配Windows/macOS/Linux全平台。
summary_en: Buzz is a local audio transcription and translation tool powered by OpenAI Whisper, running entirely offline. It features multi-hardware acceleration (CUDA/Apple Silicon/Vulkan), real-time microphone input, voice separation, and speaker identification, with export to TXT/SRT/VTT formats across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

description: Lightweight clipboard manager for macOS
summary_zh: Maccy 是一款轻量级 macOS 剪贴板管理器，支持历史记录保存、快速搜索与检索，提供键盘优先操作体验。具备原生界面、隐私安全、开源免费等特性，支持快捷键复制/粘贴、忽略特定应用、自定义过滤规则等高级功能，适用于高效文本管理与重复内容复用场景。
summary_en: Maccy is a lightweight clipboard manager for macOS that preserves copy history with fast search and retrieval. It emphasizes keyboard-first interaction, native UI, privacy, and open-source design. Features include smart filtering, hotkey-based actions, and customizable ignore rules for enhanced productivity.

description: agent multiplexer that lives in your terminal.
summary_zh: herdr 是一款运行在终端中的智能体多路复用器，支持工作区、标签页和窗格管理，提供鼠标交互、拖拽分割、实时状态查看（阻塞/工作中/完成）等功能。无需 GUI 应用，直接显示智能体原生终端输出，支持断开后重连且智能体持续运行。适用于 Linux 和 macOS 系统，可通过 Homebrew 或脚本安装。
summary_en: herdr is a terminal-based agent multiplexer that supports workspaces, tabs, and panes with mouse-native interactions like click, drag, and split. It displays real-time agent states (blocked, working, done) and shows the agent's native terminal output. Agents keep running after detach and can be reattached later. No GUI or Electron wrapper—works on Linux and macOS, installable via Homebrew or script.

description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘
summary_zh: LinkSwift 是一款基于 JavaScript 的网盘直链提取工具，支持百度网盘、阿里云盘、中国移动云盘、天翼云盘、迅雷云盘、夸克网盘、UC网盘及123云盘八大平台。用户通过浏览器脚本即可快速获取文件真实下载地址，跳过官方客户端的限速与繁琐操作，大幅提升跨平台网盘文件下载效率。
summary_en: LinkSwift is a JavaScript-based tool for extracting direct download links from major Chinese cloud drives, including Baidu Pan, Aliyun Drive, China Mobile Cloud, Tianyi Cloud, Xunlei, Quark, UC, and 123Pan. It enables users to bypass official client restrictions and obtain real file download URLs directly in the browser, significantly improving cross-platform download efficiency.

description: 数字生命卡兹克开源的 AI Skills 合集 | Agent Skills: leader（帮你定义目标）, neat-freak 洁癖, hv-analysis, khazix-writer & more — Claude Code, Codex & 40+ agents
summary_zh: Khazix Skills 是一个开源的 AI 技能合集，包含多个可直接集成到 Claude Code、Codex 等智能体平台的结构化指令（Skills）和通用提示词（Prompts）。核心功能包括自动同步项目文档与记忆（neat-freak）、深度行业分析生成万字 PDF 报告（hv-analysis）以及个性化写作风格迁移（khazix-writer），旨在提升 AI 协作效率与输出一致性。
summary_en: Khazix Skills is an open-source collection of AI skills and prompts designed for integration with agent platforms like Claude Code and Codex. It includes tools for auto-syncing project docs and agent memory (neat-freak), generating in-depth analytical reports via horizontal-vertical analysis (hv-analysis), and mimicking a personal writing style (khazix-writer), enhancing AI consistency and productivity.

description: Apple TV Aerial Screensaver for Mac
summary_zh: Aerial 是一款 macOS 屏保程序，基于 Apple TV 的 Aerial 系列航拍视频，展示纽约、旧金山、夏威夷、中国等地的壮丽景色。支持多语言地理特征标注、实时天气与预报，开源协作，兼容 Apple Silicon。
summary_en: Aerial is a macOS screensaver featuring Apple's Aerial video collection, showcasing aerial views of locations like New York, San Francisco, and Hawaii. It supports multilingual overlays, real-time weather data, and is open-source with community contributions.

description: Lightweight, Portable, Flexible Distributed/Mobile Deep Learning with Dynamic, Mutation-aware Dataflow Dep Scheduler; for Python, R, Julia, Scala, Go, Javascript and more
