summary_zh: Apache MXNet 是一个高效灵活的深度学习框架，支持符号式与命令式编程混合使用，具备动态依赖调度器实现自动并行化，适用于 Python、R、Julia、Scala、Go、JavaScript 等多种语言。其核心优势在于跨平台部署能力、多 GPU 及分布式扩展性，同时提供图优化层提升执行效率与内存利用率，广泛用于工业级 AI 系统开发。
summary_en: Apache MXNet is a deep learning framework optimized for efficiency and flexibility, supporting mixed symbolic and imperative programming with a dynamic dependency scheduler for automatic parallelization. It supports multiple languages including Python, R, Julia, Scala, Go, and JavaScript. MXNet excels in cross-platform deployment, multi-GPU and distributed scalability, and features graph optimization for fast, memory-efficient execution, making it ideal for production AI systems.

description: 全面ESM+Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript编写的一款后台管理系统（兼容移动端）
summary_zh: vue-pure-admin 是一款基于 ESM 规范的现代化中后台管理系统模板，采用 Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript 技术栈构建，支持移动端适配。提供完整的前端架构与组件库，包含国际化精简版本，打包体积优化至350KB以下，配套详细文档与视频教程，支持 Docker 部署与 Gitpod 在线开发。
summary_en: vue-pure-admin is a modern admin template built with ESM standard, using Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript stack. It supports mobile adaptation, offers complete frontend architecture and component library, includes i18n thin version with optimized bundle size under 350KB, and provides comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, Docker support, and Gitpod integration.

description: 🚀✨ Minimalistic, powerful and extremely customizable Zsh prompt
summary_zh: Spaceship Prompt 是一款极简、强大且高度可定制的 Zsh 终端提示符，提供丰富的信息展示，包括 Git 状态、多语言运行时环境、包版本、电池电量、Kubernetes 上下文等，支持深度自定义配置，显著提升终端使用体验。
summary_en: Spaceship Prompt is a minimalistic, powerful, and highly customizable Zsh prompt that displays essential information like Git status, runtime environments (Node.js, Python, etc.), package versions, battery level, and Kubernetes context, with extensive customization options for enhanced terminal productivity.

description: 文言文編程語言 A programming language for the ancient Chinese.
summary_zh: 文言（wenyan-lang）是一款基于文言文语法的编程语言，将古典中文与现代编程结合，支持自然语言编程风格。它可将文言文代码编译为 JavaScript，实现如 Hello World、埃拉托斯特尼筛法、快速排序等算法，兼具文化传承与实用功能，适合教学、趣味编程及跨时代语言实验。
summary_en: Wenyan-lang is a programming language based on Classical Chinese grammar, blending ancient Chinese literature with modern programming. It compiles to JavaScript and supports natural language programming, enabling implementations of algorithms like Hello World, Sieve of Eratosthenes, and Quicksort, making it ideal for educational, cultural, and experimental use cases.

description: Orchestrate multiple coding agents from desktop and mobile
summary_zh: Paseo 是一个跨平台编程代理编排工具，支持通过手机、桌面端和 CLI 远程管理 Claude Code、Codex 和 OpenCode 等 AI 编码助手。核心特性包括本地自托管运行、多模型统一接口、语音控制、跨设备同步以及零追踪的隐私保护。用户可在任意终端启动任务，实现从构思到部署的无缝协作。
summary_en: Paseo is a cross-platform orchestration tool for coding agents, enabling remote management of Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode via phone, desktop, or CLI. Key features include self-hosted local execution, unified multi-provider interface, voice control, device synchronization, and privacy-first design with no telemetry. It allows seamless task delegation and hands-off automation across environments.

description: open-source agentic AI data assistant for the next generation of AI + Data products.
summary_zh: DB-GPT 是一个开源的 AI 原生数据应用开发框架，集成 AWEL（智能体工作流表达式语言）和多智能体协作机制，支持多模型管理与 Text2SQL 优化，提供 RAG 增强生成能力，旨在降低企业级数据应用开发门槛，实现低代码构建定制化数据产品。
summary_en: DB-GPT is an open-source AI-native data application development framework featuring AWEL (Agentic Workflow Expression Language) and multi-agent collaboration. It supports multi-model management, Text2SQL optimization, and RAG-enhanced generation, enabling low-code development of enterprise-grade data applications.

description: 全栈工程师培训材料
summary_zh: 全栈工程师培训材料，系统讲解JavaScript全栈开发技术，涵盖前端React、Node.js后端及工程化实践，适合有HTML/CSS/JS基础的学习者，通过四讲课程帮助掌握Web应用前后端开发技能。
summary_en: Comprehensive full-stack JavaScript training material covering frontend React, Node.js backend development, and engineering practices. Designed for learners with basic HTML/CSS/JS knowledge, featuring four lectures for a two-day bootcamp on building complete web applications.

description: 💻  vibe coding 101｜The first course for AI-native product builders.
summary_zh: 《Easy-Vibe》是面向初学者的现代编程入门课程，主打“会说话就会做应用”的零门槛理念。通过清晰的学习地图与可视化交互教程，帮助新手系统掌握编程技能，避免学完就忘。支持多语言，涵盖从基础到实战的完整路径。
summary_en: Easy-Vibe is a beginner-friendly modern programming course designed to teach coding from scratch with the motto 'if you can talk, you can build apps.' It features a structured learning map and step-by-step visual tutorials to ensure lasting understanding, supported in multiple languages for global accessibility.

description: Share your terminal as a web application
summary_zh: GoTTY 是一个将命令行工具转换为 Web 应用的轻量级工具，支持通过浏览器远程访问终端会话。它提供端口监听、TLS 加密、基础认证、随机 URL 生成等安全特性，适用于运维、开发调试和远程协作场景。
summary_en: GoTTY is a lightweight CLI tool that transforms command-line tools into web-based applications, enabling remote terminal access via browsers. It supports secure features like TLS encryption, basic authentication, random URL generation, and dynamic resizing for use in operations, debugging, and remote collaboration.

description: 🌈一个跨平台的划词翻译和OCR软件 | A cross-platform software for text translation and recognition.
summary_zh: Pot 是一款跨平台划词翻译与 OCR 软件，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 及 Wayland 环境，集成 OpenAI、Google、DeepL 等 20+ 翻译接口，提供多接口并行翻译、语音合成、生词本导出等功能，具备插件系统和外部调用能力，界面简洁高效。
summary_en: Pot is a cross-platform software for text translation and OCR, supporting Windows/macOS/Linux and Wayland. It integrates 20+ translation APIs including OpenAI, Google, and DeepL, offering parallel translation, speech synthesis, vocabulary export, plugin system, and external call functionality with a clean interface.

description: Humanizer 的汉化版本，Claude Code Skills，旨在消除文本中 AI 生成的痕迹。
summary_zh: Humanizer-zh 是 Claude Code 技能插件，专为识别和消除 AI 生成文本中的痕迹设计。基于维基百科 AI 写作特征指南，提供 24 种检测模式，涵盖内容、语言、风格与交流层面。通过规则化改写与人性化表达注入，提升文本自然度与真实感，适用于营销文案、学术摘要等场景的二次润色。
summary_en: Humanizer-zh is a Claude Code skill plugin designed to detect and eliminate traces of AI-generated text. Based on Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI Writing' guidelines, it identifies 24 patterns across content, language, style, and communication. It rewrites AI-like passages using natural expressions while preserving core meaning, enhancing authenticity in marketing copy, academic abstracts, and other content types.

description: 🤖 可 DIY 的 多模态 AI 聊天机器人 | 🚀 快速接入 微信、 QQ、Telegram、等聊天平台 | 🦈支持DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI | 工作流系统、网页搜索、AI画图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话 |
summary_zh: Kirara AI 是一款可自定义的多模态 AI 聊天机器人，支持快速接入微信、QQ、Telegram 等主流聊天平台，兼容 DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI 等主流大模型。具备工作流系统、网页搜索、AI 绘图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话等功能，提供 WebUI 和 Docker 部署方案。
summary_en: Kirara AI is a customizable multimodal AI chatbot that supports rapid integration with WeChat, QQ, Telegram, and other major messaging platforms. It integrates with leading LLMs including DeepSeek, Grok, Claude, Ollama, Gemini, and OpenAI. Features include workflow systems, web search, AI image generation, persona tuning, virtual maid mode, voice interaction, and offers both WebUI and Docker deployment options.

description: CAT 作为服务端项目基础组件，提供了 Java, C/C++, Node.js, Python, Go 等多语言客户端，已经在美团点评的基础架构中间件框架（MVC框架，RPC框架，数据库框架，缓存框架等，消息队列，配置系统等）深度集成，为美团点评各业务线提供系统丰富的性能指标、健康状况、实时告警等。
summary_zh: CAT 是美团点评开源的实时应用监控平台，支持 Java、C/C++、Node.js、Python、Go 等多语言客户端，提供 Transaction、Event、Heartbeat、Metric 四种监控模型。其核心优势在于秒级实时数据处理、全量数据采集、高可用部署及高吞吐扩展能力，广泛应用于服务端性能监控、故障定位与业务优化。
summary_en: CAT is a real-time application monitoring platform developed by Meituan-Dianping, offering multi-language clients (Java, C/C++, Node.js, Python, Go) and supporting four monitoring models: Transaction, Event, Heartbeat, and Metric. It excels in sub-minute real-time processing, full-data collection, high availability, and scalable distributed deployment, enabling comprehensive performance tracking, fault detection, and system optimization across enterprise infrastructure.

description: ZeroNet - Decentralized websites using Bitcoin crypto and BitTorrent network
summary_zh: ZeroNet 是一个去中心化网站平台，利用比特币加密和 BitTorrent 网络实现无中心托管。网站内容通过 P2P 网络分发，支持实时更新、Namecoin 域名、Tor 匿名访问及 TLS 加密，无需服务器即可永久运行，抗审查且用户即服务提供者。
summary_en: ZeroNet is a decentralized web platform using Bitcoin cryptography and the BitTorrent network for censorship-resistant, peer-to-peer hosting. Sites run on users' devices, support real-time updates, .bit domains, Tor anonymity, and automatic peer discovery without relying on central servers.

description: Netflix-level subtitle cutting, translation, alignment, and even dubbing - one-click fully automated AI video subtitle team | Netflix级字幕切割、翻译、对齐、甚至加上配音，一键全自动视频搬运AI字幕组
summary_zh: VideoLingo 是一款全自动 AI 视频字幕处理工具，支持 YouTube 视频下载、WhisperX 精准字幕识别、NLP 驱动的智能分段、术语库构建、Netflix 级单行字幕翻译（三步翻译-反思-适配流程），以及 GPT-SoVITS/Azure/OpenAI 多平台配音，实现一键生成高质量多语言字幕与配音。
summary_en: VideoLingo is an all-in-one AI-powered video translation and dubbing tool that automates YouTube video processing, WhisperX-based word-level subtitle recognition, AI-driven segmentation, custom terminology, Netflix-standard single-line translations via a 3-step Translate-Reflect-Adapt pipeline, and multi-platform dubbing using GPT-SoVITS, Azure, or OpenAI TTS, enabling one-click global video localization.

description: 程序员如何优雅的挣零花钱，2.0版，升级为小书了。Most of this not work outside China , so no English translate
summary_zh: 《程序员如何优雅的挣零花钱？》是一本专为程序员设计的副业指南，聚焦中国市场的变现策略，涵盖知识付费、网课制作、内容创作等路径，结合《一人企业方法论2.0》与《全栈路线图》资源，提供实战思维导图与电子书下载，助力技术人实现可持续的被动收入。
summary_en: This repo offers a practical guide for programmers to earn side income in China, covering monetization strategies like online courses, content creation, and knowledge products. It integrates resources from 'One-Person Business Methodology 2.0' and 'Full-Stack Roadmap', providing downloadable mind maps and eBooks to help tech professionals build passive income streams.

description: Get started with building Fullstack Agents using Gemini 2.5 and LangGraph
summary_zh: 该项目展示了使用 Gemini 2.5 和 LangGraph 构建全栈智能代理的完整应用，包含 React 前端与基于 LangGraph 的后端研究代理。代理能动态生成搜索词、调用 Google Search 进行网络研究，并通过反思识别知识缺口，迭代优化搜索结果，最终输出带引用来源的权威回答，适用于构建增强型对话式 AI 系统。
summary_en: This project demonstrates a fullstack application using React frontend and a LangGraph-powered backend agent to perform comprehensive web research via dynamic query generation, Google Search integration, reflective reasoning, and iterative refinement using Google's Gemini models, ultimately producing cited answers from gathered sources.

description: ai副业赚钱大集合，教你如何利用ai做一些副业项目，赚取更多额外收益。The Ultimate Guide to Making Money with AI Side Hustles: Learn how to leverage AI for some cool side gigs and rake in some extra cash. Check out the English version for more insights.
summary_zh: 该仓库为AI副业赚钱指南，系统整理利用AI技术开展副业的多种方法，涵盖内容创作、图片生成、音频处理、直播等方向。通过技术变现思路分享与实操案例，帮助用户在AI时代构建可持续的流量与收益模式，强调做垂类内容、卖工具（铲子）而非直接挖金子的策略。
summary_en: This repository serves as a comprehensive guide to making money with AI side hustles, curating proven methods across content creation, image generation, audio processing, and live streaming. It emphasizes strategic positioning—focusing on niche content and selling tools (shovels) rather than competing in saturated markets—to help users build scalable AI-driven income streams in the current era.

description: SkillOpt is a text-space optimizer that trains reusable natural-language skills for frozen LLM agents through trajectory-driven edits, validation-gated updates, and deployable best_skill.md artifacts.
summary_zh: SkillOpt 是微软开源的文本空间优化器，专为冻结的 LLM 智能体设计。它借鉴深度学习中的 epoch、batch size 和学习率等概念，通过轨迹驱动编辑和验证门控机制，自动训练可复用的自然语言技能文档（best_skill.md），无需修改模型权重即可显著提升智能体在多种基准测试中的表现。
summary_en: SkillOpt is an open-source text-space optimizer by Microsoft for frozen LLM agents. Borrowing concepts like epochs and learning rates from deep learning, it automatically trains reusable natural-language skill documents (best_skill.md) through trajectory-driven edits and validation gates, significantly boosting agent performance without altering model weights.

description: Visualize any GitHub codebase: free interactive architecture diagrams and one-minute explainer videos. Replace 'hub' with 'diagram' in any GitHub URL.
summary_zh: GitDiagram 是一款免费的交互式 GitHub 仓库可视化工具，可将任意仓库结构秒级转换为系统架构图。支持点击组件跳转源码、导出 Mermaid 代码或 PNG 图片，集成 OpenAI GPT-5.2 实现智能分析，提供私有仓库支持与自托管部署方案，适用于快速理解复杂代码库。
summary_en: GitDiagram is a free, fast tool that converts any GitHub repository into interactive architecture diagrams in seconds. It leverages OpenAI GPT-5.2 for intelligent analysis, supports clickable navigation to source files, exports Mermaid/PNG formats, and offers private repo support with self-hosting capabilities for deep codebase understanding.

description: React Native指南汇集了各类react-native学习资源、开源App和组件
summary_zh: React Native学习指南是一个全面的中文资源库，汇集了React Native开发教程、开源APP案例、组件库、工具链及权威文档，覆盖从入门到原生模块开发的完整技术栈，助力开发者快速构建跨平台移动应用。
summary_en: The React Native Learning Guide is a comprehensive Chinese resource hub compiling tutorials, open-source apps, components, tools, and official documentation for React Native development, covering everything from beginner guides to native module integration for cross-platform mobile app creation.

description: Turn any website into a structured API. Extract, automate, search and monitor the web.
summary_zh: Maxun 是一个开源无代码平台，专为实时网页抓取、爬取、搜索和 AI 数据提取设计，可将任意网站快速转换为结构化 API。支持录制操作、自然语言驱动提取、网页转 Markdown/HTML 及全站爬取，适用于构建自动化数据流水线，无需编程即可实现复杂的数据采集任务。
summary_en: Maxun is an open-source no-code platform for real-time web scraping, crawling, search, and AI-powered data extraction. It transforms any website into a structured API in minutes, offering recorder mode, LLM-driven extraction, full-page scraping, and scalable crawling—ideal for building automated data pipelines without coding.

description: 收集&推荐优秀的 Apps/硬件/技巧/周边等
summary_zh: Best App 是一个精选优质应用、硬件及生活技巧的推荐项目，涵盖 macOS、iOS、Android 等平台。聚焦付费与免费精品应用，提供详细功能介绍与横向测评，帮助用户高效选择提升效率与幸福感的工具。项目强调客观推荐，拒绝广告与捐赠，倡导有章可循的产品选择。
summary_en: Best App is a curated collection of excellent apps, hardware, and life-enhancing tips across macOS, iOS, and Android. It features detailed reviews and comparisons of premium and free apps, helping users make informed choices for productivity and lifestyle improvement. The project maintains objectivity, avoids ads, and encourages community contributions via Star or Pull Request.

description: Mobile UI Components based on Vue & WeUI
summary_zh: Vux 是基于 Vue 2.3+ 和 WeUI 构建的移动端 UI 组件库，提供丰富的微信风格组件与交互效果。支持 webpack 构建，集成数据绑定与事件处理，适用于快速开发移动端 Web 应用，兼容主流移动浏览器。
summary_en: Vux is a mobile UI component library built on Vue 2.3+ and WeUI, offering rich WeChat-style components and interactions. It supports webpack build, data binding, and event handling, ideal for rapid mobile web app development with broad browser compatibility.

description: 关于Python的面试题
summary_zh: 该仓库系统整理了Python语言特性、操作系统、数据库、网络及数据结构等核心面试知识点，涵盖函数参数传递、元类、装饰器、GIL、协程、垃圾回收机制等高级特性，并提供经典编程题解析（如斐波那契、链表操作、排序算法），是Python开发者面试准备的权威资料库。
summary_en: This repository compiles comprehensive Python interview questions covering language features (e.g., metaclasses, decorators, GIL), operating systems (IPC, memory management), databases (transactions, MVCC), networking (TCP/IP, HTTP), and data structures. It includes algorithm implementations like Fibonacci, sorting, and tree traversals, serving as a complete technical reference for Python job interviews.

description: Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex & Claude Code — use any LLM (Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Ollama…) with Codex CLI, App, SDK, and Claude Code
summary_zh: OpenCodex 是一款通用的本地代理工具，旨在打破 OpenAI Codex 与 Claude Code 对特定大模型的限制。它通过将 Codex 的 Responses API 转换为任意 LLM 提供商（如 Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Ollama 等）的接口，实现无缝切换。该工具支持流式传输、工具调用及多模态输入，并内置了 ChatGPT 账号池管理功能，可自动进行配额刷新与负载均衡，确保开发流程的连续性。
summary_en: OpenCodex is a universal local proxy that eliminates vendor lock-in for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code. It translates Codex's Responses API into various LLM provider formats (Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama, etc.), enabling seamless model switching. Supporting streaming, tool calls, and multimodal inputs, it also features a ChatGPT account pool manager for automatic quota refreshing and load balancing to ensure uninterrupted development workflows.

description: Let your Claude able to think
summary_zh: Thinking Claude 是一个 Chrome 扩展项目，通过注入深度思考协议，让 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 在回复前进行系统化、可交互的思维过程展示。核心包含可折叠的思维链模块、一键复制功能和现代化 UI，显著提升 AI 推理透明度与用户体验。
summary_en: Thinking Claude is a Chrome extension that enhances Claude 3.5 Sonnet by injecting a comprehensive thinking protocol. It displays Claude's internal monologue as collapsible, readable sections with copy functionality, making AI reasoning transparent and user-friendly through structured thought processes.

description: The fastest browser for AI agents to run browser automation, built for sharing your logged-in browser state with your AI agents, like Codex or Claude Code, without disturbing you. Zero cost, zero config.
summary_zh: ego-lite 是专为 AI 智能体设计的高速浏览器，支持用户与 AI 代理并行工作。AI 可在独立空间运行浏览器任务，同时共享用户的登录状态、Cookie 和扩展，零配置零成本，无缝集成 Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 助手。
summary_en: ego-lite is a high-performance browser built for AI agents, enabling parallel work between users and AI assistants. Agents run browser tasks in isolated spaces while sharing your logins, cookies, and extensions with zero setup cost, seamlessly integrating with Claude Code, Codex, and other leading AI tools.

description: 一个第三方音乐播放器、本地服务、桌面歌词、音乐下载、远程控制
summary_zh: AlgerMusicPlayer 是一款功能强大的第三方跨平台音乐播放器，支持网易云账号登录、本地服务、桌面歌词、音乐下载及远程控制。基于 Electron 和 Vue 开发，提供沉浸式歌词显示、EQ均衡器、多语言界面和明暗主题切换，支持全平台运行（桌面/Web/移动端），兼顾高品质音质与个性化体验。
summary_en: AlgerMusicPlayer is a powerful third-party cross-platform music player supporting NetEase Cloud login, local services, desktop lyrics, music downloads, and remote control. Built with Electron and Vue, it offers immersive lyrics, EQ equalizer, multi-language UI, dark/light themes, and high-fidelity audio, running on Desktop, Web, and Mobile platforms with personalized features.

description: This repository is outdated and new Boost Note app is available! We've launched a new Boost Note app which supports real-time collaborative writing. https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote-App
summary_zh: BoostNote-Legacy 是一款面向程序员的开源笔记应用，支持多平台（Mac、Windows、Linux）。该仓库已标记为过时，推荐使用支持实时协作的新版 BoostNote 应用，其基于 Electron、React + Redux 构建，提供跨平台桌面与移动端支持。
summary_en: BoostNote-Legacy is an open-source note-taking app designed for programmers, supporting Mac, Windows, and Linux. This repository is deprecated; users are advised to migrate to the new BoostNote app, which features real-time collaborative writing and is built with Electron, React + Redux.

description: 《李宏毅深度学习教程》（李宏毅老师推荐👍，苹果书🍎），PDF下载地址：https://github.com/datawhalechina/leedl-tutorial/releases
summary_zh: 《李宏毅深度学习教程》是台湾大学李宏毅教授经典课程的中文教程，涵盖深度学习核心理论与前沿技术。教程以幽默易懂的方式讲解复杂概念，结合动画案例与详细公式推导，降低学习门槛。内容源自2021年春课程并扩展2017年春课程及外部知识，适合深度学习初学者系统入门。
summary_en: LeeDL-Tutorial is a comprehensive Chinese guide to deep learning based on Professor Hung-yi Lee's renowned courses. It simplifies complex concepts through engaging examples and detailed derivations, covering core theories and techniques. Expanded from the 2021 Spring course with additional content from 2017 and external resources, it serves as an ideal entry point for beginners in deep learning.

description: pushState + ajax = pjax
summary_zh: pjax 是一个 jQuery 插件，通过结合 pushState 和 ajax 技术，实现无刷新页面跳转，提升浏览体验。它支持动态加载 HTML 内容并更新浏览器地址栏，避免资源重复加载，适用于需要快速响应的单页应用。
summary_en: pjax is a jQuery plugin that combines pushState and ajax to enable fast, seamless page navigation without full reloads. It dynamically loads HTML content, updates the browser URL, and preserves permalinks, titles, and back-button functionality for enhanced user experience.

description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具
summary_zh: DouK-Downloader 是一款基于 Python 和 HTTPX 的免费开源数据采集工具，支持批量下载抖音/TikTok 视频、图集、直播、合集及评论数据。具备 Web UI、API 接口、多线程下载、代理支持、增量采集、文件断点续传等功能，可部署至私有或公开服务器，适用于内容创作者、数据分析师等场景。
summary_en: DouK-Downloader is a free open-source data collection tool built with Python and HTTPX, enabling batch downloads of videos, albums, live streams, collections, and comments from Douyin/TikTok. It features Web UI, API interface, multi-threaded downloads, proxy support, incremental scraping, and resume capability, deployable on private or public servers for content creators and data analysts.

description: Mobile UI elements for Vue.js
summary_zh: Mint UI 是一个专为 Vue 2.0 设计的移动端 UI 组件库，提供丰富的移动端常用组件，支持全局注册和按需引入，具备轻量、模块化、易集成的特点，适用于快速开发移动端 Web 应用。
summary_en: Mint UI is a mobile-first UI component library for Vue 2.0, offering a suite of mobile-optimized components. It supports global registration and modular imports, with features like lightweight design, modularity, and easy integration, ideal for rapid mobile web development.

description: a collection of simple demos of React.js
summary_zh: 阮一峰 React.js 简易演示集，通过 13 个清晰示例系统讲解 React 核心概念，涵盖 JSX 语法、组件开发、状态管理、生命周期、表单处理及 Ajax 等，适合初学者快速上手 React 开发。
summary_en: A collection of simple React.js demos by Ruan YiFeng, covering core concepts like JSX, components, state management, lifecycle, forms, and Ajax through 13 clear examples, ideal for beginners to learn React effectively.

description: Material design for AngularJS
summary_zh: AngularJS Material 是 Google Material Design 规范在 AngularJS (v1.x) 中的官方实现，提供轻量级、可复用的 UI 组件库，支持响应式布局和无障碍访问。项目已于2022年终止维护，推荐迁移至 Angular Material (v2+) 版本。
summary_en: AngularJS Material is the official implementation of Google's Material Design specification for AngularJS (v1.x), offering a lightweight set of reusable, accessible UI components. Support ended in January 2022; users are advised to migrate to Angular Material (v2+).

description: Create web-based user interfaces with Python. The nice way.
summary_zh: NiceGUI是一个基于Python的轻量级Web UI框架，通过纯Python代码快速构建按钮、图表、3D场景等交互界面。内置热重载、定时器刷新与数据绑定，支持浏览器访问与原生桌面模式，适用于仪表板、机器人控制和ML调参等场景。
summary_en: NiceGUI is a lightweight Python-based framework for building interactive web UIs with buttons, charts, and 3D scenes. It features auto-reload, timers, data binding, and supports both browser and desktop modes—ideal for dashboards, robotics, and ML tuning.

description: MCP for xiaohongshu.com
summary_zh: 小红书 MCP 是一个专为 xiaohongshu.com 设计的自动化工具，支持登录验证、图文/视频内容发布、内容搜索、推荐列表获取、帖子详情抓取、评论互动及用户主页信息提取。采用本地路径优先的图片处理机制，确保上传稳定性，并提供完整的 HTTP API 与 MCP 工具调用支持，适用于内容运营与数据采集场景。
summary_en: Xiaohongshu MCP is an automation tool designed for xiaohongshu.com, supporting login verification, publishing text/image and video content, searching posts, fetching recommended feeds, retrieving post details with interactions, commenting, and user profile data extraction. It prioritizes local file paths for media uploads to ensure stability, and offers full HTTP API and MCP tool integration for content operations and data collection.

description: A simple app to use Xposed without root, unlock the bootloader or modify system image, etc.
summary_zh: VirtualXposed 是一款基于 VirtualApp 和 epic 技术的 Android 应用，无需 root、解锁 bootloader 或修改系统镜像即可运行 Xposed 模块。支持 Android 5.0~10.0，适用于绝大多数非系统级修改的模块，如广告拦截、功能增强等。用户可在虚拟环境中独立安装应用与模块，并通过内置重启功能快速生效，极大提升了 Android 系统的灵活性与可玩性。
summary_en: VirtualXposed is an Android app built on VirtualApp and epic that enables Xposed module usage without root, bootloader unlock, or system image modification. It supports Android 5.0–10.0 and works with most non-system modules like ad blockers and app enhancements. Users can install apps and modules in a virtual environment and reboot within the app for instant activation, offering a safe and flexible way to customize Android without system-level changes.

description: Swift Featured Projects in brain Mapping
summary_zh: 本项目精选 Swift 开源项目，聚焦应用架构与思维导图形式呈现，涵盖主流开发工具、框架及实践案例，助力开发者快速掌握 Swift 生态。内容持续更新，强调项目影响力、可持续性与实用性，适合中高级开发者参考。
summary_en: This project curates high-quality Swift open-source projects with a focus on application architecture and mind maps. It covers frameworks, tools, and best practices, providing a structured reference for Swift developers. Content emphasizes influence, sustainability, and practicality, targeting intermediate to advanced developers.

description: Bridge local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex) to messaging platforms (Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, Slack, Telegram, Discord, LINE, WeChat Work). Chat with your AI dev assistant from anywhere — no public IP required for most platforms.
summary_zh: CC-Connect 是一款将本地 AI 编程助手（Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Codex）桥接到飞书、钉钉、Slack、Telegram、Discord、LINE、企业微信等即时通讯平台的中间件工具。用户无需公网 IP，即可通过消息平台随时随地与本地 AI 开发助手对话协作，实现远程编程辅助。核心亮点是跨平台消息桥接与零公网部署，极大提升了 AI 编程助手的可访问性和使用灵活性。
summary_en: CC-Connect bridges local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex) to messaging platforms including Feishu, DingTalk, Slack, Telegram, Discord, LINE, and WeChat Work. It enables users to chat with their local AI dev assistant from anywhere without requiring a public IP for most platforms. The core value lies in cross-platform message bridging and zero-public-IP deployment, significantly enhancing the accessibility and flexibility of AI coding assistants.

description: 🎨 Python Echarts Plotting Library
summary_zh: pyecharts 是一个基于 Apache ECharts 的 Python 数据可视化库，提供简洁流畅的 API 设计，支持 30+ 种常见图表类型，兼容 Jupyter 系列 Notebook 和主流 Web 框架（如 Flask、Django），支持链式调用与高度灵活配置，内置 400+ 地图文件，适用于地理数据可视化，当前主推 V1/V2 版本（Python 3.7+）。
summary_en: pyecharts is a Python data visualization library built on Apache ECharts, offering fluent API design with 30+ chart types, seamless integration with Jupyter notebooks and web frameworks like Flask/Django, chainable syntax, extensive map support (400+), and flexible configuration, targeting Python 3.7+ in V1/V2 versions.

description: Elegant theme for Hexo.
summary_zh: NexT 是一个高质量、优雅的 Hexo 主题，提供 Muse、Mist、Pisces 和 Gemini 四种精美配色方案，支持高度自定义配置，适用于个人博客与静态网站搭建。
summary_en: NexT is a high-quality, elegant Hexo theme featuring four distinct color schemes (Muse, Mist, Pisces, Gemini) with extensive customization options, ideal for personal blogs and static site generation.

description: An Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code/Codex as an AI collaborator in your vault
summary_zh: Claudian 是一款 Obsidian 插件，将 Claude Code 嵌入为 AI 协作者，赋予知识库完整的代理能力：文件读写、搜索、Bash 命令执行和多步工作流。支持上下文感知、图像分析、内联编辑、自定义指令、技能扩展、MCP 集成及高级模型控制，适用于桌面端知识管理与自动化任务处理。
summary_en: Claudian is an Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code as an AI collaborator, enabling full agentic capabilities within your vault: file read/write, search, bash commands, and multi-step workflows. It supports context-awareness, vision via drag-and-drop, inline editing, custom instructions, slash commands, MCP integration, and advanced model control for enhanced knowledge management and automation.

description: Automatically add a progress bar to your site.
summary_zh: PACE 是一个自动为网站添加进度条的轻量级 JavaScript 库，无需手动配置即可通过监控 Ajax 请求、事件循环延迟、文档就绪状态和页面元素来智能计算加载进度，支持多种主题样式和自定义配置，适用于提升用户页面加载体验。
summary_en: PACE is a lightweight JavaScript library that automatically adds a progress bar to websites. It intelligently monitors Ajax requests, event loop lag, document readiness, and page elements to calculate loading progress without manual setup, featuring multiple themes and customizable options for enhanced user experience.

description: 经典编程书籍大全，涵盖：计算机系统与网络、系统架构、算法与数据结构、前端开发、后端开发、移动开发、数据库、测试、项目与团队、程序员职业修炼、求职面试等
summary_zh: 该仓库收录100+经典编程书籍，全面覆盖计算机系统与网络、算法与数据结构、前后端开发、数据库、测试、职业修炼等核心领域，精选伯乐在线及社区广泛推荐的权威技术读物，是程序员系统提升技能的理想资源库。
summary_en: This repository curates 100+ essential programming books across core domains including computer systems, algorithms, web/mobile development, databases, testing, and career growth. It aggregates highly recommended technical reads from Jobbole and the developer community, serving as a comprehensive learning resource for programmers.

description: Python version of the Playwright testing and automation library.
summary_zh: Playwright-Python 是微软开源的跨平台浏览器自动化库，支持 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit 三大内核。提供同步/异步 API，具备无头模式、自动等待、网络拦截等特性，适用于端到端测试、网页爬虫和自动化任务，性能可靠且支持多平台部署。
summary_en: Playwright-Python is Microsoft's cross-browser automation library supporting Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. It offers sync/async APIs with features like headless mode, auto-waiting, and network interception, ideal for E2E testing, web scraping, and automation across platforms with high reliability and performance.

description: Superset is an agentic IDE to orchestrate 100+ coding agents in parallel. Run any agent with your own subscription.
summary_zh: Superset 是专为 AI 智能体时代设计的代码编辑器，支持在本地并行运行多个 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI 编码代理。通过 Git 工作树隔离任务、内置终端与差异查看器，实现零切换成本的高效开发流程，显著提升编码效率。
summary_en: Superset is an IDE designed for the AI Agents Era, enabling parallel execution of multiple CLI-based coding agents like Claude Code and Codex on your machine. It isolates tasks via Git worktrees, provides built-in terminal and diff viewer, and eliminates context-switching overhead to boost development efficiency.

description: Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit.
summary_zh: Vorssaint 是一款免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具集，以单一图标整合音量混音、系统监控、窗口管理、剪贴板历史、文本片段等多项实用功能。模块化设计支持按需安装卸载，零账户、零遥测、零订阅，专为用户隐私和性能效率而构建。
summary_en: Vorssaint is a free, open-source macOS menu bar toolkit that consolidates volume mixing, system monitoring, window management, clipboard history, and more into a single lightweight icon. Fully modular, privacy-first with zero telemetry or subscriptions, and requires macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon.

description: Codex Dream Skin
summary_zh: Codex Dream Skin 是一款针对 OpenAI Codex 桌面端的跨平台换肤工具。它通过本机回环 CDP 注入技术，在不修改官方安装包与代码签名的前提下，实现对侧栏、输入框等原生控件的主题化定制。支持一键换图与还原，兼顾个性化氛围感与系统安全性。
summary_en: Codex Dream Skin is a cross-platform theming tool for the OpenAI Codex desktop app. Utilizing local loopback CDP injection, it customizes native UI elements like sidebars and input boxes without altering the official installation package or code signature. It supports one-click image swapping and restoration, balancing personalized aesthetics with system security.

description: The best agent harness.
summary_zh: Trellis 是一款面向团队的 AI 编码可靠性框架，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等 14 个主流 AI 编程平台。它通过自动注入规范、任务中心工作流和项目记忆机制，实现跨会话上下文共享与团队标准统一，显著提升 AI 辅助开发的结构化与可复用性。
summary_en: Trellis is a team-scale AI coding harness that ensures reliable AI-assisted development across 14 platforms like Claude Code and Cursor. It enables auto-injected specs, task-centric workflows, and persistent project memory to standardize context, reduce repetition, and scale best practices across teams.

description: Themes for Bootstrap
summary_zh: Bootswatch 提供一系列开源的 Bootstrap 主题，支持通过预编译 CSS、CDN、Sass 导入、npm 包或 Ruby Gem 集成到项目中，适用于快速美化网页界面，支持主题定制与变量覆盖。
summary_en: Bootswatch offers a collection of open-source themes for Bootstrap, enabling easy integration via pre-compiled CSS, CDN, Sass imports, npm packages, or Ruby Gem. It supports theme customization and variable overrides for rapid UI enhancement.

description: Self-hosted deployment platform
summary_zh: Openship 是一款开源、可自托管的部署平台，内置 CI/CD 功能。它支持通过桌面应用、Web 面板或 CLI 推送代码、部署容器及管理基础设施，实现零配置文件的“一键式”应用交付。
summary_en: Openship is an open-source, self-hostable deployment platform with built-in CI/CD. It enables push-to-deploy workflows, container management, and infrastructure control via desktop app, web dashboard, or CLI, requiring zero configuration files.

description: Personal memory across agents
summary_zh: memU 是一个专为 24/7 主动式 AI 代理设计的内存框架，将内存建模为文件系统，支持层级分类、跨引用和持久化存储。它通过结构化记忆减少 LLM 令牌成本，实现持续理解用户意图并主动执行任务，适用于 openclaw、moltbot 等长期运行代理。
summary_en: memU is a memory framework for 24/7 proactive AI agents, modeling memory as a file system with hierarchical categories, cross-references, and persistent storage. It reduces LLM token costs by caching insights and enables continuous understanding of user intent, making always-on agents practical for production systems like openclaw and moltbot.

description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
summary_zh: waoowaoo 是首款工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台，支持从小说文本自动生成角色、场景、分镜与配音，并合成完整视频。基于 Next.js 与 Docker 构建，提供好莱坞级标准化创作流程，适用于短剧、漫画视频等影视内容自动化生产。
summary_en: waoowaoo is the industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film and video production. It automates script analysis, character & scene generation, storyboard creation, voice synthesis, and full video assembly from novel text, powered by Next.js and Docker with Hollywood-standard workflows.

description: High-Quality Voice Cloning TTS for 600+ Languages
summary_zh: OmniVoice 是一款支持 600+ 语言的零样本语音克隆 TTS 模型，采用扩散语言模型架构，实现高质量语音生成与快速推理（RTF 低至 0.025）。支持语音克隆、音色设计、非语言符号控制及多语言发音修正，适用于跨语言语音合成、虚拟配音、多语言内容创作等场景。
summary_en: OmniVoice is a state-of-the-art zero-shot TTS model supporting 600+ languages with diffusion language model architecture. It delivers high-quality voice cloning, voice design, and fast inference (RTF 0.025), enabling multilingual speech synthesis for content creation, virtual dubbing, and voice AI applications.

description: A simple, Git-powered wiki with a local frontend and support for many kinds of markup and content.
summary_zh: Gollum 是一个基于 Git 的轻量级 Wiki 系统，支持多种标记语言（如 Markdown、AsciiDoc 等），提供本地前端界面和版本控制功能。它允许用户通过 Git 仓库管理 Wiki 页面，支持实时编辑、历史回溯、数学公式、图表（Mermaid/PlantUML）、BibTeX 引用等高级功能，兼容 GitHub/GitLab Wiki，适合团队协作与知识管理。
summary_en: Gollum is a Git-powered wiki system that enables version-controlled, human-editable text files organized in a Git repository. It supports multiple markup languages, real-time editing, page history, diagrams (Mermaid/PlantUML), math rendering, citations, and integrates seamlessly with GitHub/GitLab wikis for collaborative documentation.

description: 微信小助手
summary_zh: WeChatPlugin-MacOS 是一款 macOS 平台的微信小助手工具，旨在提升用户工作效率。它通过自动化消息处理、快捷回复、群管理等功能，简化日常沟通流程，支持多账号管理，适用于需要高效处理微信消息的 macOS 用户。
summary_en: WeChatPlugin-MacOS is a macOS assistant tool for WeChat, designed to enhance productivity. It automates message handling, enables quick replies, and supports group management, streamlining daily communication. Ideal for macOS users managing multiple WeChat accounts efficiently.

description: 微信机器人 / 可能是最优雅的微信个人号 API ✨✨
summary_zh: wxpy 是基于 itchat 封装的优雅微信个人号 API，提供对象化接口与丰富功能扩展，支持自动回复、消息转发、好友管理、智能家居控制等场景，集成聊天机器人与实用工具组件，兼容 Python 2.7 及 3.4-3.6，适合实现微信自动化操作。
summary_en: wxpy is an elegant WeChat personal account API built on itchat, offering object-oriented interfaces and extensive feature extensions. It supports auto-reply, message forwarding, friend/group management, smart home control, and integrates chatbots and utilities. Compatible with Python 2.7 and 3.4-3.6, ideal for WeChat automation.

description: PLEASE READ THE PROJECT STATUS BELOW.  Native AngularJS (Angular) directives for Bootstrap. Smaller footprint (20kB gzipped), no 3rd party JS dependencies (jQuery, bootstrap JS) required. Please read the README.md file before submitting an issue!
summary_zh: UI Bootstrap 是专为 AngularJS 设计的原生指令库，提供 Bootstrap 组件的轻量实现（仅20kB gzipped），无需依赖 jQuery 或 Bootstrap 的 JavaScript。项目已停止维护，推荐迁移至 ng-bootstrap 以支持 Angular 2+。核心优势包括模块化构建、与 AngularJS 深度集成及完善的动画支持。
summary_en: UI Bootstrap provides native AngularJS directives for Bootstrap components with a minimal footprint (20kB gzipped), requiring no jQuery or Bootstrap JS dependencies. The project is now feature-complete and unmaintained, with migration to ng-bootstrap recommended for Angular 2+ users. Key features include modular builds, deep AngularJS integration, and ngAnimate support.

description: A search tool helps dev to solve the naming things problem.
summary_zh: CODELF 是一个智能变量命名工具，通过搜索 GitHub 等代码托管平台上的真实项目，为开发者提供精准的变量命名建议。支持 VS Code、Atom、Sublime Text 等编辑器插件，并集成每日算法题推荐功能，同时可管理 GitHub 仓库标签与收藏，显著提升代码命名效率与规范性。
summary_en: CODELF is a smart variable naming tool that helps developers find real-world naming patterns by searching across GitHub and other code repositories. It offers IDE plugins for VS Code, Atom, and Sublime Text, features a daily algorithm practice guide, and includes GitHub repository tagging/organization tools to improve code naming consistency and productivity.

description: Make Any Website & Tool Your CLI. A universal CLI Hub and AI-native runtime. Transform any website, Electron app, or local binary into a standardized command-line interface. Built for AI Agents to discover, learn, and execute tools seamlessly via a unified AGENT.md integration.
summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一个强大的 AI 原生浏览器自动化工具，可将任意网站或 Electron 应用转换为命令行接口。它支持会话复用、AI 驱动的发现与合成，提供零风险的数据提取和跨平台自动化能力，适用于 Bilibili、知乎、小红书等主流平台。
summary_en: OpenCLI is a powerful, AI-native browser automation tool that turns any website or Electron app into a CLI. It enables seamless web data extraction and automation with session reuse, AI-powered discovery, and dynamic adapter loading, supporting platforms like Bilibili, Zhihu, and Xiaohongshu.

summary_zh: Context Hub 为编码智能体提供版本化、语言特定的 API 文档管理，支持搜索、获取和反馈功能。通过本地注释和全局反馈机制，智能体可不断积累经验并提升代码准确性，所有内容以 Markdown 格式开源维护，便于审查和贡献。
summary_en: Context Hub provides versioned, language-specific API documentation for coding agents. It enables search, fetch, and feedback capabilities, with local annotations and global voting to improve agent performance over time. All content is open-sourced in Markdown format for transparency and community contribution.

description: :speech_balloon: A better WeChat on macOS and Linux. Built with Electron by Zhongyi Tong.
summary_zh: Electronic WeChat 是一款基于 Electron 开发的跨平台微信客户端，专为 macOS 和 Linux 设计。它复刻了网页版微信的所有功能，包括消息撤回拦截、表情包支持、拖拽发送图片等，并优化了原生应用体验。项目已停止维护，但作为 Electron 桌面应用开发的优秀范例仍具参考价值。
summary_en: Electronic WeChat is an Electron-based cross-platform WeChat client for macOS and Linux, replicating all Web WeChat features including message recall blocking and sticker support. It offers native-like experience with optimizations like direct URL access and drag-and-drop file sharing. Though discontinued, it serves as an excellent reference for Electron desktop app development.

description: 微信《跳一跳》Python 辅助
summary_zh: 本项目是一个基于 Python 的微信小游戏《跳一跳》自动化辅助工具，通过图像识别技术自动识别棋子位置与目标方块，结合 ADB 控制手机屏幕实现精准跳跃。支持手动校准与自动识别两种模式，利用像素距离计算按压时长，帮助用户高效刷分登顶排行榜。
summary_en: This project is a Python-based automation tool for WeChat's mini-game 'Jump Jump'. It uses image recognition to detect the player's position and target blocks, calculates the required press duration based on pixel distance, and controls the screen via ADB to achieve precise jumps, enabling automatic high-score gameplay.

description: A command-line tool for tweaking WeChat - 首款微信 macOS 客户端撤回拦截与多开 🔨
summary_zh: WeChatTweak 是一款专为 macOS 设计的命令行工具，支持微信客户端撤回消息拦截、阻止自动更新及多开功能，通过二进制补丁技术实现原生应用增强，显著提升微信使用灵活性与隐私保护。
summary_en: WeChatTweak is a command-line tool for macOS that enables WeChat enhancements including message recall blocking, auto-update prevention, and multi-instance support via binary patching, offering advanced customization for native app workflows.

description: :speech_balloon: A better WeChat on macOS and Linux. Built with Electron by Zhongyi Tong.
summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Electron 开发的跨平台微信客户端，支持 macOS 和 Linux，提供现代化界面和完整 Web 微信功能，包括消息撤回拦截、贴图支持、文件拖拽发送等。项目已停止维护，作为技术存档供学习参考。
summary_en: An Electron-based cross-platform WeChat client for macOS and Linux, featuring modern UI, full Web WeChat functionality, message recall blocking, sticker support, and drag-and-drop file sharing. The project is archived and no longer actively maintained.

description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
summary_zh: fg-data-profiling 是一个用于 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame 的数据质量分析与探索性数据分析（EDA）工具，仅需一行代码即可生成包含统计摘要、缺失值、相关性、时间序列和文本分析的详细报告，支持 HTML 和 JSON 导出，适用于快速数据洞察与质量评估。
summary_en: fg-data-profiling is a one-line code tool for data quality profiling and exploratory data analysis (EDA) on Pandas and Spark DataFrames. It generates comprehensive reports including statistics, missing values, correlations, time-series, and text analysis, with export options in HTML and JSON for rapid data insights.

description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
summary_zh: ydata-profiling 是一款极简的数据质量分析与探索性数据分析工具，支持 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame。仅需一行代码即可生成包含缺失值、相关性、分布统计、时间序列和文本分析的完整报告，支持 HTML/JSON 导出，适用于快速数据洞察与 EDA 场景。
summary_en: ydata-profiling is a one-line data profiling and exploratory data analysis tool for Pandas and Spark DataFrames. It generates comprehensive reports with type inference, missing data analysis, correlations, distributions, time-series insights, and text analysis, exporting to HTML or JSON for rapid EDA.

description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
summary_zh: data-profiling 是一款极简的数据质量探查与探索性数据分析工具，支持 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame。仅需一行代码即可生成包含类型推断、缺失值、相关性、时间序列及文本分析的全面报告，输出 HTML/JSON 格式，适用于快速数据洞察与 EDA 流程。
summary_en: data-profiling is a one-line code solution for data quality profiling and exploratory data analysis (EDA) on Pandas and Spark DataFrames. It delivers comprehensive reports with type inference, missing values, correlations, time-series insights, and text analysis, exporting to HTML or JSON for rapid data understanding.

description: OpenTUI is a library to build terminal user interfaces (TUI)
summary_zh: OpenTUI 是一个用 Zig 编写的高性能终端用户界面（TUI）核心库，提供 TypeScript 绑定和 C ABI 接口，支持多语言调用。其组件化架构与灵活布局能力适用于构建复杂终端应用，已用于 OpenCode 和 terminal.shop 生产环境。支持 React、SolidJS 等前端框架集成。
summary_en: OpenTUI is a high-performance terminal UI (TUI) core library written in Zig, offering TypeScript bindings and a C ABI for cross-language compatibility. It features a component-based architecture with flexible layouts, enabling complex terminal applications. Used in production by OpenCode and terminal.shop, it supports integrations with React, SolidJS, and more.

description: 最接近原生APP体验的高性能框架
summary_zh: mui 是一个专为移动端 HTML5 应用设计的高性能框架，有效解决了浏览器原生体验差的问题，如白屏、动画卡顿、下拉刷新不流畅等。它提供接近原生 APP 的流畅交互与丰富 UI 控件，支持与 HBuilder 开发工具深度集成，显著提升移动端 Web 应用开发效率与用户体验。
summary_en: mui is a high-performance framework for mobile HTML5 apps, addressing core issues like page flickering, poor animations, and unsmooth pull-to-refresh. It delivers near-native app experiences with rich UI components and seamless integration with HBuilder, enabling efficient development of smooth, visually appealing mobile web applications.

description: ✍ WeChat Markdown Editor | 一款高度简洁的微信 Markdown 编辑器：支持 Markdown 语法、自定义主题样式、内容管理、多图床、AI 助手等特性
summary_zh: Doocs MD 是一款专为微信设计的简洁 Markdown 编辑器，支持完整 Markdown 语法、数学公式、Mermaid 图表、PlantUML 和 Ruby 注音，集成多图床上传与主流 AI 助手，提供自定义主题与本地草稿管理，实现 Markdown 内容一键渲染为美观微信图文。
summary_en: Doocs MD is a minimalist Markdown editor tailored for WeChat, supporting full Markdown syntax, math formulas, Mermaid charts, PlantUML, Ruby annotations, multi-image hosting, and AI assistants. It enables instant rendering of Markdown into visually appealing WeChat articles with customizable themes and local draft management.

description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
summary_zh: ydata-profiling 是一款强大的数据质量探查与探索性数据分析（EDA）工具，支持 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame。仅需一行代码即可生成包含类型推断、缺失值分析、统计摘要、可视化图表、时间序列和文本分析的综合报告，支持 HTML 和 JSON 导出，显著提升数据理解效率。
summary_en: ydata-profiling is a powerful data quality profiling and exploratory data analysis (EDA) tool for Pandas and Spark DataFrames. With just one line of code, it generates comprehensive reports including type inference, missing data analysis, statistical summaries, visualizations, time-series, and text analysis, exportable in HTML and JSON formats for rapid data insights.

description: A faster, simpler way to drive browsers supporting the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
summary_zh: chromedp 是一个高效的 Go 语言库，用于通过 Chrome DevTools 协议驱动浏览器，无需外部依赖。它支持无头模式运行、页面截图、自动化操作等场景，适用于网页爬虫、自动化测试和数据采集。核心优势包括高性能、简洁 API 和跨平台兼容性。
summary_en: chromedp is a high-performance Go library for driving browsers via the Chrome DevTools Protocol without external dependencies. It supports headless browsing, page screenshots, and automation tasks like web scraping and testing. Key features include fast execution, simple API, and cross-platform compatibility.

description: Clash Nyanpasu～(∠・ω< )⌒☆​
summary_zh: Clash Nyanpasu 是一款基于 Tauri 框架的 Clash 网络代理图形界面客户端，支持 Clash Premium、Mihomo 和 Clash Rust 内核。提供多配置文件和 Provider 管理功能，采用 Google Material You 设计语言，具备深色/浅色主题切换，支持跨平台运行。
summary_en: Clash Nyanpasu is a Tauri-based GUI client for Clash network proxy, supporting Clash Premium, Mihomo, and Clash Rust cores. It offers profile and provider management with Google Material You UI design, dark/light themes, and cross-platform support.

description: :octocat: A collection of APIs
summary_zh: Awesome APIs 是一个精选的 API 集合库，涵盖动漫、博客、书籍、商业、日历、云服务等 40+ 领域，为开发者提供丰富的第三方接口资源，支持快速集成各类功能，提升开发效率。
summary_en: Awesome APIs is a curated collection of over 40 categories of developer-friendly APIs, including anime, blogging, books, business, cloud services, and more, enabling rapid integration of diverse functionalities and enhancing development efficiency.

description: 小红书（XiaoHongShu、RedNote）链接提取/作品采集工具
summary_zh: XHS-Downloader 是一款功能强大的小红书（XiaoHongShu/RedNote）作品采集与下载工具，支持提取账号作品、收藏、点赞链接，采集作品信息及下载地址，批量下载图文、视频、LivePhoto 文件，具备断点续传、文件完整性校验、自定义命名格式、剪贴板监听、MCP 调用等高级功能，适用于内容创作者与数据收集场景。
summary_en: XHS-Downloader is a powerful tool for extracting and downloading content from Xiaohongshu (XHS/RedNote). It supports fetching posts, likes, collections, and albums, downloading media files (images, videos, LivePhotos), with features like resume downloads, file integrity checks, custom naming, clipboard monitoring, and MCP integration, ideal for content creators and data collectors.

description: ShowDoc is a tool greatly applicable for an IT team to share documents online一个非常适合IT团队的在线API文档、技术文档工具
summary_zh: ShowDoc 是一款专为 IT 团队设计的在线文档协作工具，支持 API 文档、数据字典和技术说明的编写与管理。采用 Markdown 编辑，提供模板插入、版本历史、权限控制等功能，支持响应式网页和离线导出，显著提升团队文档协作效率。
summary_en: ShowDoc is an online documentation tool designed for IT teams to create and share API documents, data dictionaries, and technical specs. It features Markdown editing, template insertion, version history, permission management, responsive design, and offline export, enhancing team collaboration efficiency.

description: Automation&Workflow JavaScript IDE on Android(安卓平台上的JavaScript编程IDE)
summary_zh: Auto.js (Pro) 是一款专为 Android 设计的 JavaScript IDE，专注于编程学习与效率提升，支持自动化脚本开发与工作流管理，提供丰富的 API 和可视化工具，适用于移动端自动化场景。
summary_en: Auto.js (Pro) is a JavaScript-based IDE for Android, designed for programming education and productivity enhancement. It enables automation scripting and workflow management with rich APIs and visual tools, ideal for mobile automation tasks.

description: A powerful HTTP client for Dart and Flutter, which supports global settings, Interceptors, FormData, aborting and canceling a request, files uploading and downloading, requests timeout, custom adapters, etc.
summary_zh: dio 是一个强大的 Dart 和 Flutter HTTP 客户端库，支持全局配置、拦截器、FormData、请求取消、文件上传下载、超时控制及自定义适配器。提供完整的 REST API 调用能力，适用于移动端和 Web 应用开发，具备高度可定制性和跨平台兼容性。
summary_en: dio is a powerful HTTP client for Dart and Flutter, supporting global settings, interceptors, FormData, request cancellation, file uploads/downloads, timeouts, and custom adapters. It offers full REST API capabilities with high customization and cross-platform compatibility for mobile and web apps.

description: A simple, open source bilingual translation extension & Greasemonkey script (一个简约、开源的 双语对照翻译扩展 & 油猴脚本)
summary_zh: KISS Translator 是一款简约开源的双语对照翻译工具，支持浏览器扩展与油猴脚本两种形式。它适配主流浏览器，集成 Google、OpenAI、DeepL 等10+翻译服务，覆盖网页翻译、划词翻译、输入框翻译、YouTube字幕翻译等场景，支持自定义规则、术语词典、跨端数据同步及AI上下文记忆，提供高度灵活的翻译体验。
summary_en: KISS Translator is a minimalist, open-source bilingual translation tool available as both a browser extension and a Tampermonkey script. It supports 10+ translation services including Google, OpenAI, and DeepL, covering web page translation, text selection, input field translation, and YouTube subtitle translation. Features include custom rules, term dictionaries, cross-device sync via KISS-Worker, and AI context memory for enhanced translation quality.

description: wtfpython的中文翻译/持续🚧.../ 能力有限，欢迎帮我改进翻译
summary_zh: wtfpython-cn 是经典项目 wtfpython 的中文翻译版，旨在揭示 Python 中鲜为人知但令人困惑的特性与反直觉行为。通过一系列精心设计的示例，帮助开发者深入理解语言底层机制，涵盖字符串处理、操作符误用、对象身份与相等性、生成器行为等核心议题，适合进阶学习或规避常见陷阱。
summary_en: wtfpython-cn is the Chinese translation of the renowned wtfpython project, exposing obscure yet counterintuitive Python behaviors. Through curated examples, it demystifies core language mechanics—such as string quirks, operator pitfalls, object identity, and generator nuances—making it ideal for intermediate to advanced developers seeking deeper Python mastery.

description: Modern Xposed Framework
summary_zh: Vector Framework 是一款基于 LSPlant 的高性能 ART hooking 框架，专为现代 Android 系统设计。作为 Zygisk 模块运行，它提供与原始 Xposed 兼容的 API，支持 Android 8.1 至 17 Beta 版本。该框架通过内存级修改实现系统与应用行为的非侵入式调整，无需修改 APK，具备可逆性和跨 ROM 兼容性。
summary_en: Vector Framework is a high-performance ART hooking framework for modern Android, built on LSPlant and designed as a Zygisk module. It maintains API compatibility with legacy Xposed while supporting Android 8.1 through 17 Beta. The framework enables non-destructive in-memory modifications to system and app behavior without altering APKs, ensuring reversibility and broad ROM compatibility.

description: 超级速查表 - 编程语言、框架和开发工具的速查表，单个文件包含一切你需要知道的东西 :zap:
summary_zh: 该项目是专为开发者设计的中文速查表集合，涵盖编程语言（如 Bash、Python、Go、JavaScript）、开发工具（如 Git、Gdb、Tmux）和文本编辑器（如 Vim、Emacs）的核心语法与命令，每个速查表均为单个文件，便于快速查阅，解决日常开发中频繁查阅文档的问题。
summary_en: This project provides a curated collection of Chinese cheatsheets for developers, covering programming languages (Bash, Python, Go, JavaScript), development tools (Git, Gdb, Tmux), and text editors (Vim, Emacs). Each cheatsheet is a single-file reference for quick lookup, eliminating the need to search scattered documentation.

description: LangGPT: Empowering everyone to become a prompt expert! 🚀  📌 结构化提示词（Structured Prompt）提出者 📌 元提示词（Meta-Prompt）发起者   📌 最流行的提示词落地范式 | Language of GPT  The pioneering framework for structured & meta-prompt design 10,000+ ⭐ | Battle-tested by thousands of users worldwide  Created by 云中江树
summary_zh: LangGPT 是一个革命性的结构化提示词设计框架，将提示词工程转化为可复用、模块化的‘提示词编程语言’。通过角色定义、目标规范、技能拆解和流程控制，帮助用户快速创建高质量 AI 提示词，已在全球超万名用户中验证有效，相关论文发表于 arXiv。
summary_en: LangGPT is a pioneering framework that treats prompt design as a structured, reusable programming language. It enables anyone to create high-quality prompts through role-based templates, modular skills, and systematic workflows, backed by academic research and battle-tested by 10,000+ users worldwide.

description: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search.
summary_zh: Chrome MCP Server 是一款基于 Chrome 扩展的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，将浏览器功能暴露给 Claude 等 AI 助手，实现复杂浏览器自动化、内容分析与语义搜索。它直接利用用户现有 Chrome 环境，保留登录状态与配置，支持 20+ 工具，提供本地流式 HTTP 通信，并集成 SIMD 加速的向量数据库，实现智能跨标签页语义检索。
summary_en: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex automation, content analysis, and semantic search. It leverages your existing Chrome browser with preserved login states and settings, supports 20+ tools, offers local streamable HTTP communication, and features SIMD-accelerated vector database for intelligent tab content discovery.

description: 中文小黑怪诞正文配图生成 Skill | 16:9 白底手绘 | 少量红橙蓝批注 | Codex Skill
summary_zh: Ian Xiaohei Illustrations 是一个专为中文内容设计的 Codex Skill，用于自动生成16:9横版、白底手绘风格的正文配图。其核心是将文章中的关键认知点（如判断、流程、隐喻）转化为具有记忆点的怪诞视觉表达，主角“小黑”作为抽象概念的参与者贯穿始终。该工具特别适合知识型、方法论类内容的创作者，强调轻量、有辨识度的视觉语言，避免传统PPT或商业插画风格。
summary_en: Ian Xiaohei Illustrations is a Codex Skill that generates 16:9 white-background, hand-drawn illustrations for Chinese articles. It transforms core cognitive elements—judgments, processes, metaphors—into memorable, quirky visuals featuring 'Xiaohei', a minimalist black character actively engaged in the scene. Ideal for knowledge creators seeking distinctive, non-PPT-style visuals with high conceptual clarity and minimalist aesthetics.

description: Make changes to FMHY
summary_zh: FMHY 是一个聚合海量免费资源的互联网平台，涵盖软件、工具、学习资料等，提供结构化索引与社区推荐。项目通过 Wiki 维护内容，支持 Markdown/JSON API 备份，强调去中心化存储与社区协作，所有文件均托管于第三方，确保内容自由开放。
summary_en: FMHY is the largest internet platform curating free resources like software, tools, and learning materials, offering structured indexes and community recommendations. It maintains content via a Wiki, supports Markdown/JSON API backups, emphasizes decentralized storage, and operates without hosting files, ensuring open and free access.

description: :metal: A collection of Alfred 3 and 4 workflows that will rock your world
summary_zh: 该仓库提供一系列 Alfred 3/4 工作流工具，涵盖系统休眠控制、浏览器兼容性查询、色彩格式转换、开发文档检索、域名搜索及表情符号查找等实用功能，通过快捷键快速调用，显著提升 macOS 开发者和效率用户的日常操作体验。
summary_en: This repository offers a curated collection of Alfred 3/4 workflows for macOS, including system sleep control, browser compatibility checks, color format conversion, developer documentation search, domain lookup, and emoji search, all accessible via keyboard shortcuts to boost productivity.

description: A practical Douyin downloader for both single-item and profile batch downloads, with progress display, retries, SQLite deduplication, and browser fallback support. 抖音批量下载工具，去水印，支持视频、图集、合集、音乐(原声)。
summary_zh: 抖音批量下载工具，支持视频、图集、合集、音乐及主页作品去水印下载。具备进度显示、自动重试、SQLite去重、完整性校验及浏览器兜底抓取功能，并提供跨平台桌面端应用（支持抖音、TikTok、YouTube），实现多链接队列与账号内容同步。
summary_en: A practical Douyin batch downloader supporting watermark-free downloads of videos, galleries, collections, and music. Features progress display, auto-retry, SQLite deduplication, integrity checks, and browser fallback. Includes a cross-platform desktop app for Douyin, TikTok, and YouTube with multi-link queuing and account sync.

description: Essential UI blocks for building mobile web apps.
summary_zh: Ant Design Mobile 是构建移动端 Web 应用的核心 UI 组件库，提供高性能、可定制的原子化组件，支持 CSS 变量主题定制与流畅动画，适用于快速开发跨平台移动应用。
summary_en: Ant Design Mobile is a core UI component library for building mobile web apps, offering high-performance, customizable atomic components with CSS variable theming and smooth animations for cross-platform mobile development.

description: 《Python Cookbook》 3rd Edition Translation
summary_zh: 《Python Cookbook》3rd Edition 中文翻译项目，由David Beazley原著，完整覆盖Python 3.6特性，提供100+实用代码示例，涵盖数据结构、并发编程、网络开发等核心领域，是中文开发者掌握Python 3的权威实践指南。
summary_en: This is the Chinese translation of 'Python Cookbook' 3rd Edition by David Beazley, featuring 100+ practical Python 3.6 code examples across core domains like data structures, concurrency, and network programming, serving as an authoritative hands-on guide for Chinese developers mastering Python 3.

description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
summary_zh: waoowaoo 是全球首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台，支持从小说文本自动生成分镜、角色、场景并合成完整视频。具备 AI 剧本分析、角色场景生成、分镜视频制作、AI 多角色配音及双语界面等核心功能，采用 Next.js 15 + Docker 架构，提供好莱坞标准工作流，适用于短剧与漫画视频创作。
summary_en: waoowaoo is the world's first industrial-grade AI-powered film and video production platform, enabling end-to-end creation from novel text to final video with storyboard generation, character/scene synthesis, and multi-character voiceover. Built on Next.js 15 and Docker, it offers Hollywood-standard workflows for short dramas and comic videos, featuring bilingual UI and seamless API integration.

description: Rich MySQL Terminal Client with AutoCompletion, Syntax Highlighting, and Dataframes
summary_zh: mycli 是一个专为 MySQL 设计的终端客户端，支持 SQL 关键字、表名、列名的智能自动补全和语法高亮。基于 prompt_toolkit 构建，提供模糊历史搜索、多行查询、查询收藏夹、执行时间统计、SSL 连接支持等功能，并可通过配置文件自定义行为，显著提升数据库交互效率。
summary_en: mycli is a terminal client for MySQL featuring auto-completion for SQL keywords, tables, and columns, along with syntax highlighting. Built with prompt_toolkit, it offers fuzzy history search, multi-line queries, favorite query management, execution timing, SSL support, and customizable config via ~/.myclirc, enhancing database interaction efficiency.

description: Generic automation framework for acceptance testing and RPA
summary_zh: Robot Framework 是一个开源的通用自动化框架，专用于验收测试、验收测试驱动开发（ATDD）和机器人流程自动化（RPA）。它采用简洁的纯文本语法，易于扩展，支持跨平台运行，并通过丰富的生态系统和 Python 集成提供强大的测试能力。
summary_en: Robot Framework is an open-source generic automation framework for acceptance testing, acceptance test-driven development (ATDD), and robotic process automation (RPA). It features simple plain-text syntax, easy extensibility via Python-based libraries, and cross-platform support, backed by a rich ecosystem of tools and resources.

description: CloudFlare free temp domain email 免费收发 临时域名邮箱 支持附件 IMAP SMTP TelegramBot
summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建的免费临时邮箱服务，支持收发邮件、附件处理、IMAP/SMTP 协议及 Telegram 机器人通知，采用 Rust WASM 实现高性能邮件解析，提供现代化多语言响应式界面，支持邮箱地址密码保护，完全免费且无需服务器部署。
summary_en: A fully-featured free temporary email service built on Cloudflare Workers, supporting email sending/receiving, attachments, IMAP/SMTP protocols, and Telegram bot notifications. Uses Rust WASM for high-performance email parsing, offers a modern responsive UI with multi-language support, and enables password protection for email addresses—all at zero cost with no server required.

description: 👩‍🚒 Good content deserves good paper.
summary_zh: Kami 是一个面向 AI 智能体的文档设计系统，通过一套约束语言和九种模板，将 AI 生成的内容自动排版为可直接交付的 PDF 与落地页。支持中英日韩多语言，提供 Claude Code 插件、通用 Agent 技能包等多种集成方式，解决 AI 输出样式不一致的问题。
summary_en: Kami is a document design system for AI agents: one constraint language, nine templates, producing shippable PDFs and landing pages. Supports English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. Integrates via Claude Code plugin, generic agent skills, or Claude Desktop—ensuring consistent, production-ready output.

description: The open source menu bar manager
summary_zh: Thaw 是一款专为 macOS 设计的菜单栏管理工具，支持 macOS 26+。它提供直观的界面帮助用户整理、隐藏和管理菜单栏图标，提升桌面整洁度与工作效率。项目已通过 OpenSSF 安全认证，支持 20 种语言，拥有活跃的 Discord 社区。
summary_en: Thaw is a menu bar manager for macOS, supporting macOS 26+. It helps users organize, hide, and manage menu bar icons with an intuitive interface, improving desktop cleanliness and productivity. The project has achieved OpenSSF security certification, supports 20 languages, and maintains an active Discord community.

description: An extended table for integration with some of the most widely used CSS frameworks. (Supports Bootstrap, Semantic UI, Bulma, Material Design, Foundation, Vue.js)
summary_zh: Bootstrap Table 是一个功能强大的表格扩展插件，支持 Bootstrap、Semantic UI、Bulma、Material Design 等主流 CSS 框架。提供排序、分页、筛选、多选、卡片视图、详情视图等丰富功能，支持 AJAX 数据加载、本地化和扩展机制，适用于数据展示与交互场景。
summary_en: Bootstrap Table is a feature-rich table extension for popular CSS frameworks like Bootstrap, Semantic UI, Bulma, and Material Design. It offers sorting, pagination, filtering, row selection, card/detail views, AJAX data loading, localization, and extensibility, making it ideal for dynamic data presentation and interaction.

description: 收集整理远程工作相关的资料
summary_zh: 该仓库系统整理远程工作相关资源，涵盖文章、问题解答、团队案例、视频播客、工具站点等，聚焦中国受众，提供远程办公经验分享、招聘信息、协作工具推荐及行业报告，助力远程工作者获取实用信息与职业发展支持。
summary_en: This repository curates comprehensive resources on remote work, including articles, Q&A, team cases, videos, podcasts, tools, and reports, primarily targeting Chinese audiences. It offers practical guidance on remote work, job opportunities, collaboration tools, and industry insights to support freelancers and remote professionals.

description: Self-evolving memory OS for LLM & AI Agents: ultra-persistent memory, hybrid-retrieval, and cross-task skill reuse, with 35.24% token savings and DeepSeek Harness support.
summary_zh: MemOS 2.0（星尘）是一个专为 LLM 和智能体系统设计的 AI 记忆操作系统，支持跨任务技能记忆的持久化存储与进化。通过混合检索机制（FTS5 + 向量搜索）实现高效记忆管理，显著降低 token 消耗（节省35.24%），并在 LongMemEval、PrefEval-10 等基准测试中表现优异。提供云端与本地两种部署模式，兼容 OpenClaw 等多智能体框架，支持技能复用与协作。
summary_en: MemOS 2.0 (Stardust) is an AI memory OS designed for LLM and agent systems, enabling persistent skill memory across tasks with reuse and evolution. It combines FTS5 and vector search for hybrid retrieval, reducing token usage by 35.24% while achieving top-tier performance on benchmarks like LongMemEval (+40.43%) and PrefEval-10 (+2568%). Supports cloud and local deployment modes, integrates with multi-agent frameworks like OpenClaw, and enables skill sharing and collaboration.

description: Not Just A Notepad! (golang + mongodb) http://leanote.org
summary_zh: Leanote 是一款功能强大的开源笔记应用，采用 Go 语言和 MongoDB 构建，提供富文本和 Markdown 编辑器，支持 Vim/Emacs 编辑模式、知识管理、协作分享及博客发布。它弥补了 Evernote 在代码高亮、实时渲染、跨平台支持等方面的不足，适合个人与团队知识管理。
summary_en: Leanote is a powerful open-source note-taking app built with Go and MongoDB, featuring rich-text and Markdown editors, Vim/Emacs modes, knowledge management, collaboration, and blogging. It addresses Evernote's limitations in code syntax highlighting, real-time rendering, and cross-platform support, ideal for personal and team knowledge management.

description: Command-line tool that allows you to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, visionOS, and macOS apps on the App Store, and download .ipa or macOS .pkg app packages.
summary_zh: ipatool 是一款跨平台命令行工具，支持从 App Store 搜索并下载 iOS、iPadOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用的 IPA 包。提供认证、搜索、授权获取、版本管理等核心功能，适用于开发者自动化部署、企业级应用分发及批量下载场景。
summary_en: ipatool is a cross-platform command-line tool for searching and downloading iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS app packages (IPA) from the App Store. It supports authentication, search, license acquisition, and version management, ideal for developer workflows, enterprise distribution, and batch app management.

description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
summary_zh: 这是一款免费无广告的追剧资源聚合指南，人工精选并每日自动检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox配置、IPTV直播源等117个资源，完全开源，支持社区共同维护与贡献。
summary_en: A free, ad-free curated guide for streaming resources with manual selection and daily automated validation. Covers online streaming, TV apps, cloud search, torrent/磁力 links, subtitles, TVBox configurations, and IPTV sources—117 resources total, fully open-source and community-maintained.

description: Vira Theme is the official successor of the popular Material Theme. This premium version is actively maintained, includes hand-curated icons and more features
summary_zh: Vira Theme 是 Material Theme 的官方继任者，为 VS Code 提供现代化主题与图标套件，包含六种精心设计的深色主题（如 Teal、Ocean、Carbon），支持高度定制与持续更新，专为开发者打造视觉沉浸的编码环境。
summary_en: Vira Theme is the premium successor to Material Theme for VS Code, offering six hand-curated dark themes and icons with enhanced customization, modern aesthetics, and continuous updates for an immersive developer experience.

description: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows, available on desktop and the web.
summary_zh: Ekko Studio 是一款本地优先的 AI 工作空间，支持多代理实时协作、可视化工作流构建与编码任务。集成 Hermes、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理运行时，提供桌面端、Web 控制台与 Docker 部署方案，适用于开发者与团队的高效 AI 协作场景。
summary_en: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace supporting multi-agent collaboration, visual workflow building, and coding tasks. It integrates Hermes, Claude Code, Codex and other mainstream AI agent runtimes, offering desktop app, web console and Docker deployment options for developer and team efficiency.

description: Vira Theme is the official successor of the popular Material Theme. This premium version is actively maintained, includes hand-curated icons and more features
summary_zh: Vira Theme 是热门 Material Theme 的官方升级版本，作为高端主题持续维护，提供精心策划的图标库及增强功能，适用于现代化 UI 设计与开发。
summary_en: Vira Theme is the premium successor to the popular Material Theme, actively maintained with hand-curated icons and enhanced features for modern UI design and development.

description: Vira Theme is the official successor of the popular Material Theme. This premium version is actively maintained, includes hand-curated icons and more features
summary_zh: Vira Theme 是广受欢迎的 Material Theme 的官方继任者，提供精心设计的图标和丰富功能。该仓库为 Vira Software 的公共资源库，包含主题资产及设计工具相关素材，支持设计系统一致性与高效开发。
summary_en: Vira Theme is the official successor to the popular Material Theme, offering curated icons and enhanced features. This repository hosts public assets for Vira Software, including theme resources and design tools, supporting consistent design systems and efficient development.

description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
summary_zh: Awesome Zhuiju Free 是一个开源、免费且无广告的追剧资源导航项目。它通过人工精选与每日自动化检测，收录了涵盖在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、TVBox配置及IPTV直播源等80余个高质量资源。项目采用社区共同维护模式，旨在为用户提供纯净、有效且持续更新的影视观看解决方案。
summary_en: Awesome Zhuiju Free is an open-source, ad-free resource guide for tracking dramas and movies. Combining manual curation with daily automated availability checks, it aggregates over 80 high-quality resources including online streaming, apps, cloud storage searches, magnet links, TVBox configurations, and IPTV sources. Maintained by the community, it aims to provide a pure, reliable, and continuously updated viewing solution.

description: 在Github的学习片段
summary_zh: MarkYun Bolg 是一个 GitHub 托管的个人技术博客，涵盖前端开发、摄影等内容。作者为南京 Web 开发者，定期更新前端面试题与 Web 技术周刊，提供学习记录与技术见解，支持 Star 与 Issue 互动。
summary_en: MarkYun Bolg is a GitHub-hosted personal blog by a Nanjing-based Web Developer, covering front-end development, photography, and technical insights. It features updated front-end interview questions and a weekly Web intelligence newsletter, encouraging community engagement via Star and Issue submissions.

description: [deprecated in favor of https://microsoft.github.io/react-native-windows/] React Native for macOS is an experimental fork for writing desktop apps using Cocoa
summary_zh: React Native macOS 是一个实验性分支，允许使用 React Native 和 Cocoa 构建 macOS 桌面应用。该项目已停止维护，推荐迁移至微软官方支持的 React Native Windows 或利用 Catalyst 技术运行。
summary_en: React Native for macOS was an experimental fork enabling desktop app development using React Native and Cocoa. The project is now deprecated and no longer maintained, with Microsoft's React Native Windows recommended as the successor.

summary_zh: beautiful-mermaid 是一个高性能 Mermaid 图表渲染库，支持 SVG 和 ASCII 双输出模式，具备 15 种内置主题、零 DOM 依赖、同步渲染等特性，专为 AI 编程场景优化，可在终端和 UI 中无缝使用。
summary_en: beautiful-mermaid is a high-performance Mermaid diagram renderer supporting dual SVG/ASCII output, 15 built-in themes, zero DOM dependencies, and synchronous rendering. Optimized for AI-assisted programming with seamless terminal and UI integration.

description: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows, available on desktop and the web.
summary_zh: Hermes Studio 是 Hermes Agent 的全功能本地控制平面，提供跨平台 AI 聊天、会话管理、定时任务与用量分析。支持 Telegram、Discord、Slack 等 8 大平台统一配置，内置文件浏览器、Web 终端、语音交互与编码代理运行器。以桌面应用、npm CLI 和 Docker 镜像三种形式分发，所有数据本地存储于 SQLite，确保隐私安全。
summary_en: Hermes Studio is a comprehensive local control plane for Hermes Agent, delivering multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, and usage analytics. It unifies configuration across 8 platforms including Telegram, Discord, and Slack, with built-in file browsing, web terminal, voice I/O, and coding agent runners. Distributed as a desktop app, npm CLI package, and Docker image, all data stays local via SQLite storage.

description: Bytebot is a self-hosted AI desktop agent that automates computer tasks through natural language commands, operating within a containerized Linux desktop environment.
summary_zh: Bytebot 是一个自托管的开源 AI 桌面代理，通过自然语言指令自动化计算机任务。它运行在容器化的 Linux 桌面环境中，拥有完整的虚拟桌面，可自主使用各类应用程序、处理文件、登录网站、读取文档并执行复杂的多步骤工作流程，真正实现 AI 拥有独立计算机的自主操作能力。
summary_en: Bytebot is an open-source, self-hosted AI desktop agent that automates computer tasks via natural language commands. Operating within a containerized Linux desktop environment, it provides a full virtual desktop where it can use any application, manage files, authenticate on websites, process documents, and execute complex multi-step workflows with complete autonomy.

description: Mac Mouse Fix - Make Your $10 Mouse Better Than an Apple Trackpad!
summary_zh: Mac Mouse Fix 是一款 macOS 系统增强工具，通过强大的手势识别与按键自定义功能，将普通鼠标的体验提升至超越 Apple 触控板的水平。它支持平滑滚动、应用切换等高级手势，并兼容罗技等主流鼠标，提供媲美原生触控板的流畅交互体验。
summary_en: Mac Mouse Fix is a macOS utility that enhances any mouse with advanced gestures and customizable buttons, delivering a user experience surpassing Apple Trackpads. It enables smooth scrolling, app switching, and intuitive controls, making budget mice as efficient as premium trackpads or Logitech MX Master.

description: 一款以电影镜头、粒子视觉和歌词舞台为核心的沉浸式音乐播放器。
summary_zh: Mineradio 是一款基于 Electron 的 Windows 桌面沉浸式音乐播放器，融合电影镜头视觉、粒子动画与歌词舞台，打造私人音乐空间。支持网易云/QQ音乐接入、3D歌单架、自定义封面与本地 MP4 播放，项目当前长期停更。
summary_en: Mineradio is an Electron-based Windows desktop immersive music player featuring cinematic visual effects, particle animations, and lyrics stage. It integrates NetEase/QQ Music APIs, 3D playlist browsing, and custom cover support. The project is currently archived.

description: Spark-TTS Inference Code
summary_zh: Spark-TTS 是基于 Qwen2.5 大语言模型的高效文本转语音系统，支持中英双语及零样本语音克隆，具备可控语音生成能力。其核心创新在于单流解耦语音标记与 LLM 直接预测音频编码，无需额外声学模型，显著提升推理效率并降低部署复杂度，适用于多语言场景下的语音合成与跨语言迁移。
summary_en: Spark-TTS is an efficient LLM-based text-to-speech model using Qwen2.5 for high-quality, bilingual (Chinese/English) speech synthesis. It supports zero-shot voice cloning and controllable generation (e.g., gender, pitch) with a single-stream decoupled architecture that directly reconstructs audio from LLM-predicted tokens, eliminating the need for separate acoustic models and enabling cross-lingual applications.

description: Google 开源项目风格指南 (中文版)
summary_zh: 本项目是 Google 开源项目风格指南的权威中文翻译版，涵盖 C++、Python、Java、JavaScript、TypeScript、Shell、HTML/CSS 等 8 种主流语言的编码规范。内容详尽，提供统一的代码风格指导，提升大型项目协作效率与可维护性。
summary_en: This is the authoritative Chinese translation of Google's open-source style guides, covering coding standards for 8 major languages including C++, Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Shell, and HTML/CSS. It provides comprehensive guidelines to ensure consistency, readability, and maintainability in large-scale software projects.

description: JavaScript Date Range, Date and Time Picker Component
summary_zh: Date Range Picker 是一个功能强大的 JavaScript 日期时间选择组件，支持日期范围选择、单日期模式、时间选择及预设范围，具备灵活的日期限制、本地化支持和多种日期格式，适用于报表筛选等场景。
summary_en: Date Range Picker is a robust JavaScript component for selecting date ranges or single dates with time selection, predefined ranges, localization, and customizable date constraints, ideal for reporting and data filtering interfaces.

description: GEO-first SEO skill for Claude Code. Comprehensive AI search optimization for any website — citability scoring, AI crawler analysis, brand authority, schema markup, platform-specific optimization, and PDF reports.  If you want learn how to sell this to real businesses, check out the skool community
summary_zh: 专为 Claude Code 设计的 GEO-first SEO 技能，提供全面的 AI 搜索引擎优化服务，包括内容可引用性评分、AI 爬虫分析、品牌权威性评估、结构化数据生成及跨平台优化，支持 PDF 报告输出，助力企业抢占 AI 流量入口。
summary_en: A GEO-first SEO skill for Claude Code that delivers comprehensive AI search optimization, including citability scoring, AI crawler analysis, brand authority assessment, schema markup generation, and platform-specific tuning, with professional PDF reporting capabilities to capture high-converting AI-driven traffic.

description: Dopamine is a research framework for fast prototyping of reinforcement learning algorithms.
summary_zh: Dopamine 是谷歌开发的强化学习研究框架，专为快速原型设计和算法实验而设计。它支持 DQN、Rainbow、SAC 等主流算法，基于 JAX 实现，强调易实验性、灵活开发和可复现性，适用于学术研究和算法验证。
summary_en: Dopamine is a research framework by Google for rapid prototyping of reinforcement learning algorithms. It supports DQN, Rainbow, SAC, and other state-of-the-art agents, implemented in JAX, with a focus on ease of experimentation, flexibility, and reproducibility for speculative research.

description: 一款以电影镜头、粒子视觉和歌词舞台为核心的沉浸式音乐播放器。
summary_zh: Mineradio 是一款基于 Electron 的 Windows 桌面沉浸式音乐播放器，深度融合电影级镜头、粒子视觉与歌词舞台。它集成了 Open-Meteo 天气电台、网易云/QQ 音乐多平台接入及 3D 歌单架，通过节奏驱动的视觉系统为用户打造极具现场感的私人音乐空间。
summary_en: Mineradio is an Electron-based Windows desktop immersive music player that deeply integrates cinematic camera effects, particle visuals, and lyric stages. Featuring Open-Meteo weather radio, multi-platform music integration (NetEase/QQ), and a 3D playlist shelf, it creates a highly engaging private music space driven by rhythm-based visual systems.

description: proxychains ng (new generation) - a preloader which hooks calls to sockets in dynamically linked programs and redirects it through one or more socks/http proxies. continuation of the unmaintained proxychains project. the sf.net page is currently not updated, use releases from github release page instead.
summary_zh: ProxyChains-NG 是原 proxychains 项目的现代化延续，通过 LD_PRELOAD 技术劫持动态链接程序的 socket 调用，强制流量经 SOCKS4/5 或 HTTP 代理转发。支持 Linux、BSD、macOS 等主流平台，具备 IPv6、DNAT、多线程优化等特性，适用于绕过网络限制的场景，但需谨慎使用以避免法律风险。
summary_en: ProxyChains-NG is a modern successor to the original proxychains project, intercepting socket calls in dynamically linked programs via LD_PRELOAD to route traffic through SOCKS4/5 or HTTP proxies. It supports Linux, BSD, macOS, and other platforms, featuring IPv6, DNAT, and multithreading optimizations. Designed for bypassing network restrictions, it requires careful configuration and legal awareness.

description: Convert PDF to HTML without losing text or format.
summary_zh: pdf2htmlEX 是一款将 PDF 转换为高质量 HTML 的工具，完美保留原文文本、字体、排版及复杂布局（如数学公式、图表、多栏排版），支持链接、书签、SVG 背景等功能。适用于学术文献、杂志等复杂文档的网页化发布，提供单文件输出或按需加载模式，文件体积通常小于原 PDF。
summary_en: pdf2htmlEX converts PDF files into HTML while preserving text, fonts, layout, and complex elements like formulas and figures. It supports links, bookmarks, SVG backgrounds, and more. Ideal for publishing academic papers and magazines online, offering compact output (often smaller than PDF) with optional on-demand loading via JavaScript.

description: Android官方培训课程中文版
summary_zh: 该项目是 Google Android 官方培训课程《Android Training》的中文协作翻译版本，涵盖 Android 应用开发核心知识体系，由社区开发者共同维护。提供在线阅读与在线编辑功能，支持纠错与内容完善，是学习 Android 开发的优质中文资源。
summary_en: This project is the Chinese translation of Google's official Android Training course, collaboratively translated by the community. It covers core Android development topics, offering online reading and editing support for corrections and improvements, serving as a valuable Chinese resource for Android developers.

description: This is a Next.js, Tailwind CSS blogging starter template. Comes out of the box configured with the latest technologies to make technical writing a breeze. Easily configurable and customizable. Perfect as a replacement to existing Jekyll and Hugo individual blogs.
summary_zh: 这是一个功能强大的 Next.js + Tailwind CSS 博客模板，基于 App Router 和 React Server Components，集成 Contentlayer 管理 Markdown 内容。开箱即用，支持高度可定制，适合替代 Jekyll 和 Hugo 个人博客，提供现代化的技术写作体验。
summary_en: A feature-rich Next.js and Tailwind CSS blogging starter template based on the App Router and React Server Components, using Contentlayer for markdown content management. Fully configured out-of-the-box, highly customizable, and ideal for replacing Jekyll and Hugo personal blogs with modern technical writing capabilities.

description: dontbesilent 的商业诊断 Skills
summary_zh: dbskill 是一个基于 Claude Code 的商业诊断工具箱，从 12,307 条推文中提炼出 4,176 个结构化知识原子，提供商业模式诊断、对标分析、内容创作优化、执行力提升等核心技能。支持 Skill 间智能联动，如诊断问题自动推荐解决方案，知识库完全开放可单独使用，适用于 AI 增强、RAG 构建与商业研究场景。
summary_en: dbskill is a commercial diagnostic toolkit for Claude Code, extracting 4,176 knowledge atoms from 12,307 tweets to provide core skills like business model diagnosis, benchmarking, content optimization, and execution improvement. It features intelligent skill chaining (e.g., diagnosing issues auto-recommends solutions) and fully open knowledge resources usable independently for AI enhancement, RAG systems, or research.

description: :zap: Transfer files over wifi from your computer to your mobile device by scanning a QR code without leaving the terminal.
summary_zh: qrcp 是一款通过扫描二维码实现电脑与移动设备间 Wi-Fi 文件传输的工具，无需离开终端即可完成操作。它通过生成包含随机路径 URL 的二维码，扫描后自动在移动端浏览器打开下载链接，支持单文件、多文件或文件夹传输，并提供压缩选项，兼容主流操作系统。
summary_en: qrcp is a tool that enables Wi-Fi file transfer between computers and mobile devices by scanning a QR code, all from the terminal. It generates a QR code containing a URL with a random path; scanning it opens the download link in the mobile browser, supporting single/multiple files, folders, and optional compression. Compatible with Linux, macOS, and Windows.

description: Grumpy is a Python to Go source code transcompiler and runtime.
summary_zh: Grumpy 是一个将 Python 源码编译为 Go 源码并生成原生代码的转编译器，旨在作为 CPython 2.7 的近乎即插即用的替代品。其核心优势在于无虚拟机（VM），直接生成高效 Go 代码，通过 Grumpy 运行时库提供类似 Python C API 的功能，适用于高性能 Python 应用部署。
summary_en: Grumpy is a Python-to-Go transcompiler and runtime designed as a near drop-in replacement for CPython 2.7. It compiles Python source to Go code, which is then compiled to native machine code—eliminating the need for a VM. This enables high-performance execution via a Go-based runtime library, offering a viable alternative for deploying Python applications with native speed.

description: Practice English, one strike, one step forward
summary_zh: TypeWords 是一款开源英语单词与文章练习工具，基于 Nuxt 构建。支持跟读、听写、自测、默写等多种模式，内置 CET-4/6、雅思、托福等主流词库，通过艾宾浩斯记忆曲线智能规划学习，提供双语对照与发音跟读，界面简洁无广告，数据本地存储。
summary_en: TypeWords is an open-source English vocabulary and article practice tool built with Nuxt. It supports follow-along, dictation, self-test, and memory typing modes, with built-in word banks for CET-4/6, IELTS, TOEFL and more. Features spaced repetition algorithms, bilingual comparison, pronunciation playback, and a clean ad-free interface with local data storage.

description: Git. Ship. Done - Core
summary_zh: GSD Core 是一个轻量级元提示与上下文工程系统，专为 Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码工具设计，解决上下文窗口填充导致的质量退化（context rot）问题。通过六步工作流（初始化、讨论、规划、执行、验证、交付），实现规范驱动开发，支持并行子代理执行、原子提交和里程碑管理，帮助工程师高效交付高质量代码。
summary_en: GSD Core is a lightweight meta-prompting and context engineering system for AI coding tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI, solving context rot—the quality degradation from filling context windows. Its six-step workflow (init, discuss, plan, execute, verify, ship) enables spec-driven development with parallel subagent execution, atomic commits, and milestone management, helping engineers ship high-quality code efficiently.

description: Modern Xposed Framework
summary_zh: LSPosed 是一个基于 Zygisk 的 ART 钩子框架，旨在提供与经典 Xposed 框架一致的 API 体验。它利用 LSPlant 实现核心 ART 方法钩取，支持 Android 8.1 至 16 系统，兼容原版 Xposed 模块，无需修改 APK 即可动态修改系统和应用行为，适用于 Magisk 环境。
summary_en: LSPosed is an ART hooking framework based on Zygisk that delivers consistent APIs with the original Xposed. It leverages LSPlant for core ART method hooking, supports Android 8.1–16, and is fully compatible with legacy Xposed modules, enabling dynamic system and app behavior modification without APK changes in a Magisk environment.

description: ✍️ A static blog writing client (一个静态博客写作客户端)
summary_zh: Gridea 是一款跨平台静态博客写作客户端，支持 Markdown 编辑、多语言界面、主题定制及 Gitalk/DisqusJS 评论系统。用户可本地创作并一键发布至 GitHub Pages 等平台，集成 OneDrive/iCloud 实现多设备同步，适合个人知识管理与内容创作。
summary_en: Gridea is a cross-platform static blog writing client that supports Markdown editing, multi-language interface, theme customization, and Gitalk/DisqusJS comment systems. It enables local content creation with one-click publishing to platforms like GitHub Pages, featuring OneDrive/iCloud sync for multi-device workflows, ideal for personal knowledge management and content creation.

description: UAParser.js: The Essential Web Development Tool for User-Agent Detection. Detect Browsers, OS, Devices, Bots, Apps, AI Crawlers, and more. Run in Browser or Node
