summary_zh: UAParser.js 是一款轻量级、高性能的 JavaScript 库，支持在浏览器和 Node.js 环境中解析 User-Agent 字符串，精准识别浏览器、操作系统、设备类型、CPU 架构、机器人及 AI 爬虫等信息，适用于前端分析、服务端日志处理和跨平台兼容性检测。
summary_en: UAParser.js is a lightweight, high-performance JavaScript library that parses User-Agent strings in both browser (client-side) and Node.js (server-side) environments. It accurately detects browsers, operating systems, devices, CPU architectures, bots, AI crawlers, and more, making it ideal for analytics, compatibility checks, and intelligent routing.

description: A modern self-hosted music player.
summary_zh: Feishin 是一款现代化的自托管音乐播放器，支持 MPV 和 Web 播放器后端，提供现代化 UI、智能播放列表编辑、歌词同步与反同步功能，并支持将播放记录同步至服务器，适用于个人音乐库管理与流媒体播放。
summary_en: Feishin is a modern self-hosted music player featuring MPV and web player backends, a sleek UI, smart playlist editing, synchronized lyrics, and playback scrobbling to your server, ideal for managing personal music libraries and streaming.

description: auto sign cursor
summary_zh: 本项目是一个自动化 Cursor Pro 在线签到的工具，支持无人值守运行，适用于提升账户活跃度。采用 Python 实现，具备跨平台兼容性，并集成文档说明与社区支持，适合开发者学习自动化脚本与网页交互技术。
summary_en: This project automates Cursor Pro online check-ins using Python, enabling unattended operation to boost account activity. It features cross-platform compatibility, comprehensive documentation, and community support, ideal for learning web automation and scripting techniques.

description: 微信视频号下载器
summary_zh: 微信视频号下载器是一款轻量级跨平台工具，支持 Windows 和 macOS 系统，通过注入浏览器扩展实现一键下载视频号视频。无需登录或复杂配置，自动安装证书并启动代理服务，在微信 PC 端界面直接添加下载按钮，支持多画质选择，下载完成后自动展示文件信息，体积小巧且操作简便。
summary_en: WeChat Channels Video Downloader is a lightweight cross-platform tool for Windows and macOS that enables one-click downloading of videos from WeChat Channels. It automatically installs certificates, starts a proxy service, and injects download buttons into the WeChat PC client interface. Users can select video quality (e.g., xWT111, xWT98) and download files with metadata displayed post-download, offering a simple and efficient experience.

description: Automate your mobile devices with natural language commands - an LLM agnostic mobile Agent 🤖
summary_zh: Mobilerun 是一个强大的移动端自动化框架，支持通过自然语言命令控制 Android 和 iOS 设备。它基于 LLM 代理技术，提供多步骤任务规划、截图分析和跨平台支持，兼容 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等多种大模型，适用于复杂设备交互自动化场景。
summary_en: Mobilerun is a powerful framework for controlling Android and iOS devices via natural language commands using LLM agents. It supports multi-step task planning, screenshot analysis, and works with multiple LLM providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini, enabling complex mobile automation through visual understanding.

description: iOS interview questions;iOS面试题集锦（附答案）
summary_zh: 该仓库系统整理了iOS开发面试中的核心知识点，涵盖Objective-C和Swift两大技术栈，包含55道经典面试题及详细参考答案，重点涉及内存管理、多线程、Runtime机制、KVC/KVO、Block等底层原理，并提供理论篇与实践篇双版本解析，是iOS开发者求职与技能提升的权威参考资料。
summary_en: This repository compiles 55 essential iOS interview questions with comprehensive answers in both Objective-C and Swift, covering core topics like memory management, multithreading, Runtime mechanisms, KVC/KVO, and Blocks. It includes theoretical and practical sections, serving as a definitive resource for iOS developers preparing for technical interviews and deepening their understanding of system-level concepts.

description: Give your agent a computer 👾
summary_zh: Cloudflare Computer 是基于 Durable Objects 的虚拟文件系统，以 SQLite 为权威状态存储，提供可插拔执行后端。支持容器化 Linux、just-bash Shell 和 ECMAScript 模块三种运行模式，为 AI 智能体、自动化任务和代码沙箱提供统一执行入口。
summary_en: Cloudflare Computer is a virtual filesystem built on Durable Objects with SQLite state management and pluggable execution backends. It supports three modes: containerized Linux, just-bash shell in Dynamic Workers, and ECMAScript modules. Provides a unified execution entry point for AI agents, automation tasks, and code sandboxing on the Cloudflare Workers platform.

description: An AI-agent skill that generates browser-editable presentations from multiple visual themes, exportable to HTML, PDF, and PPTX.
summary_zh: Dashi PPT Skill 是一款 AI Agent 技能，将文档输入后自动生成带有内置编辑控制台的演示文稿。支持 12 套视觉主题、1020 个版式和丰富图表分析模型，可直接在浏览器中修改内容，并一键导出为可编辑的 HTML、PDF 和 PPTX 文件。
summary_en: Dashi PPT Skill is an AI Agent skill that generates browser-editable presentations from documents, featuring 12 visual themes, 1,020 layouts, and rich chart/model templates. Users can edit slides directly in the browser and export to editable HTML, PDF, and PPTX formats with one click.

description: Fuzzy String Matching in Python
summary_zh: FuzzyWuzzy 是一个用于 Python 的模糊字符串匹配库，现已迁移至 TheFuzz。它提供高效的字符串相似度计算功能，适用于数据清洗、文本匹配等场景，支持多种匹配算法和加权评分。
summary_en: FuzzyWuzzy is a Python library for fuzzy string matching, now migrated to TheFuzz. It enables efficient string similarity computation using various algorithms and weighted scoring, ideal for data cleaning and text matching tasks.

description: SEX IS ZERO (0), so, who wanna be the ONE (1), aha?
summary_zh: hardseed 是一个从草榴和愛城论坛批量下载种子与图片的自动化工具，支持代理配置、文件名安全处理及智能重试机制，适用于资源抓取与离线保存，操作简单且适配多平台。
summary_en: hardseed is a batch download utility for seeds and pictures from CaoLiu and AiCheng forums, featuring proxy support, safe filename handling, and intelligent retry logic, designed for efficient resource scraping and offline archiving with cross-platform compatibility.

description: chat log tool, easily use your own chat data. 聊天记录工具，轻松使用自己的聊天数据
summary_zh: chatlog 是一款聊天记录工具，旨在帮助用户轻松管理和使用自己的聊天数据。由于微信官方函件指出其核心功能存在合规风险，项目于2025年10月20日被主动移除，仅保留说明文件。用户无法再获取代码或支持，建议删除本地副本以规避法律风险。
summary_en: Chatlog was a chat log tool designed to help users easily manage and utilize their own chat data. Due to compliance risks identified in an official letter from WeChat, the project was voluntarily removed on October 20, 2025. Only this notice remains; no code, binaries, or support are available. Users are advised to delete any local copies to avoid legal issues.

description: LangChain 的中文入门教程
summary_zh: LangChain 中文入门教程系统讲解大模型应用开发框架，涵盖文档加载、文本分割、向量存储、Chain 链与 Agent 代理等核心概念，提供 OpenAI API 集成、PDF/YouTube 数据处理等实战案例，配套 GitBook 与 Colab 代码，适合 AI 开发者快速上手构建智能应用。
summary_en: This comprehensive LangChain Chinese tutorial covers core concepts like document loading, text splitting, vectorstores, chains, and agents for building LLM-powered applications. It includes practical examples with OpenAI integration, PDF/YouTube data processing, and provides GitBook and Colab code resources for developers to quickly build AI applications.

description: A slide framework built for agents.
summary_zh: open-slide 是专为 AI 智能体设计的幻灯片框架，用户通过自然语言描述需求，Coding Agent 自动生成 React 组件。支持 1920×1080 固定画布、浏览器内审查、PPTX/PDF 导出及静态部署，实现从对话到精美演示文稿的无缝创作。
summary_en: open-slide is an agent-native presentation framework where users describe decks in natural language and coding agents generate React slide components. It features a 1920×1080 canvas, in-browser inspector, export to HTML/PDF/PPTX, and static deployment for seamless deck creation from chat.

description: Community interface for generative AI
summary_zh: StableStudio 是 Stability AI 开源的生成式 AI 社区界面，作为 DreamStudio 的开源版本，提供图像生成与编辑功能。采用插件化架构支持灵活后端集成，用户可通过自定义插件对接任意 AI 服务。项目鼓励社区贡献，支持 TypeScript 扩展，默认使用 Stability API 插件需配置 API 密钥。
summary_en: StableStudio is Stability AI's open-source community interface for generative AI, serving as the open-source variant of DreamStudio. It enables image generation and editing through a web-based UI with a plugin system for flexible backend integration. Users can create custom plugins in TypeScript to connect any AI service, with default Stability API plugin requiring an API key.

description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
summary_zh: Worktrunk 是一个专为并行 AI 智能体工作流设计的 Git worktree 管理 CLI 工具，通过简化 worktree 操作使其像分支一样易用。支持自动化钩子、快速扩展多代理协作，显著提升开发效率与工作流自动化水平。
summary_en: Worktrunk is a CLI tool for managing Git worktrees, optimized for parallel AI agent workflows. It simplifies worktree operations to be as easy as branches, with automation hooks and scalable multi-agent support for enhanced developer productivity.

description: ✨ The agentic HTML editor — your local AI agent writes the HTML, you ship it. 🚀 75 Skills × 9 Surfaces (magazine · deck · poster · XHS / tweet · prototype · data report · Hyperframes) 🛡️ Sandboxed preview · 📤 1-click to WeChat / X / Zhihu / HTML / PNG 🔑 Zero API key — Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / Gemini / Copilot / OpenCode / Qwen / Aider.
summary_zh: HTML Anything 是一款本地优先的智能 HTML 编辑器，集成 8 种主流编码代理 CLI（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等），无需 API 密钥。提供 75 个可组合技能模板，支持 9 种输出场景（杂志、海报、数据报告、小红书卡片等），一键导出至微信、X、知乎或生成 HTML/PNG 文件。
summary_en: HTML Anything is a local-first, agentic HTML editor that integrates 8 coding agent CLIs (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) with zero API key required. It offers 75 composable skill templates across 9 deliverable formats—from magazines to data reports—and enables one-click export to WeChat, X, Zhihu, HTML, or PNG.

description: 🧑‍🚀 全世界最好的LLM资料总结（多模态生成、Agent、辅助编程、AI审稿、数据处理、模型训练、模型推理、o1 模型、MCP、小语言模型、视觉语言模型） | Summary of the world's best LLM resources.
summary_zh: 该仓库是全网最全面的大语言模型（LLM）资源汇总，涵盖多模态生成、Agent、辅助编程、AI审稿、数据处理、模型训练与推理等全链路技术方向，持续更新维护，为研究者与开发者提供权威的一站式学习与实践指南。
summary_en: This repository is the most comprehensive collection of LLM resources globally, covering multimodal generation, agents, code assistance, AI review, data processing, model training and inference, and more. It serves as an authoritative one-stop guide for researchers and developers, continuously updated.

description: A persistent service that generates mock data quickly and provids visualization view.
summary_zh: Easy Mock 是一个快速生成模拟数据并提供可视化界面的持久化服务，支持团队协作、Swagger 导入、Mock.js 语法及自定义响应配置，适用于前后端分离开发中的接口模拟与测试。
summary_en: Easy Mock is a persistent service that quickly generates mock data with a visualization interface, supporting team collaboration, Swagger import, Mock.js schema, and customizable responses for frontend-backend development and API testing.

description: Featuring powerful AI capabilities and supporting various e-book formats, it makes reading smarter and more focused.
summary_zh: Anx Reader 是一款专为书迷打造的智能电子书阅读器，集成强大 AI 功能，支持 EPUB、MOBI、AZW3、FB2、TXT、PDF 等多种格式。提供 AI 摘要、翻译、思维导图生成、多端同步、自定义排版、语音朗读及阅读统计等深度功能，致力于提升阅读效率与沉浸体验。
summary_en: Anx Reader is an AI-powered e-book reader designed for book lovers, supporting multiple formats like EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, TXT, and PDF. It features AI summaries, translation, mind mapping, cross-platform sync, customizable typography, TTS, and reading analytics to enhance focus and reading pleasure.

description: 插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
summary_zh: MusicFree 桌面版是一款插件化、无广告的免费音乐播放器，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。其核心特性包括：通过插件机制接入任意音源（如搜索、播放、歌单导入），高度定制化主题系统（支持 CSS 变量与 iframe 背景），以及本地数据存储保障隐私。用户可自由扩展音源与界面风格，实现个性化音乐体验。
summary_en: MusicFree Desktop is a plugin-based, ad-free, open-source music player supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. Key features include: plugin-driven access to any audio source (search, playback, playlist import), highly customizable themes via CSS variables and iframe backgrounds, and local data storage for privacy. Users can extend sources and personalize UI freely.

description: A free + OSS logo generator powered by Flux on Together AI
summary_zh: 基于 Flux 大模型的开源 AI Logo 生成器，集成 Together AI 实现秒级品牌级 Logo 设计。支持 SVG/PNG 多格式导出、参考图上传解析及完整品牌套件输出，零账户门槛使用，适用于快速品牌设计与创意原型制作。
summary_en: An open-source AI logo generator powered by Flux and Together AI, delivering production-ready brand logos in seconds. Features include SVG/PNG export, reference image upload via vision models, and complete brand kit generation. No account required, ideal for rapid brand design and creative prototyping.

description: Self-hosted multi-protocol AI API proxy for Antigravity, Codex, Grok, Kiro, OpenAI, Claude, and custom providers. Supports OpenAI-compatible API, Claude API, Gemini protocol conversion, GPT, Grok Build, Claude Opus, Gemini Pro, Kimi, MiniMax, provider pools, smart routing, and automatic failover.
summary_zh: AIClient2API 是一个强大的代理工具，可将 Gemini CLI、Antigravity、Codex、Grok 和 Kiro 等仅客户端大模型 API 的请求统一封装为本地 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持每日数千次 Gemini 请求，并免费使用 Kiro 内置 Claude 模型，极大提升 AI 开发效率。
summary_en: AIClient2API is a powerful proxy that unifies client-only LLM APIs (Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Codex, Grok, Kiro) into a local OpenAI-compatible interface. It supports thousands of daily Gemini requests and offers free access to Kiro's built-in Claude model, streamlining AI development.

description: :100: 2026年系统架构设计师（软考高级）备考资料。
summary_zh: 该项目为2026年软考高级系统架构设计师备考资料库，涵盖历年真题、模拟卷、精讲视频及论文范文，支持免费与付费资源更新。提供多平台刷题工具（网页/小程序/App），并持续优化教程与考纲解析，助力考生高效通过考试。
summary_en: This repository provides comprehensive study materials for the 2026 System Architect Designer exam (a senior-level soft certification). It includes past papers, mock tests, video courses, and essay templates. Free and paid resources are updated regularly, with multi-platform practice tools (web, WeChat mini-program, mobile app) and optimized tutorials to help candidates pass efficiently.

description: 网易云音乐第三方
summary_zh: ieaseMusic 是一款基于 Electron、React 和 MobX 构建的优雅网易云音乐第三方桌面客户端，支持跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows）、高音质（FLAC）、键盘操作、桌面通知、Last.fm 听歌记录同步、多平台音源修复（如 QQ 音乐、虾米等）、社交分享及微信扫码登录，集成 Alfred 3 工作流，提供现代化 UI 与下载功能。
summary_en: ieaseMusic is an elegant third-party Netease Music desktop app built with Electron, React, and MobX. It supports cross-platform use (macOS/Linux/Windows), high-quality FLAC audio, keyboard shortcuts, desktop notifications, Last.fm scrobbling, multi-source link fixing (e.g., QQ, Xiami), social sharing, WeChat login, and includes an Alfred 3 workflow for quick access.

description: A lightweight screen recorder based on ScreenCapture Kit for macOS / 基于 ScreenCapture Kit 的轻量化多功能 macOS 录屏工具
summary_zh: QuickRecorder 是一款基于 ScreenCapture Kit 的轻量级高性能 macOS 录屏工具，支持屏幕、窗口、应用及移动设备录制。具备免驱音频回环、鼠标高亮、屏幕放大镜等功能，并完整支持 macOS 14 的 Presenter Overlay 实时摄像头叠加，以及 HEVC with Alpha 格式输出（含透明通道），适用于专业视频制作与会议录制。
summary_en: QuickRecorder is a lightweight, high-performance screen recorder for macOS built on ScreenCapture Kit. It supports recording screens, windows, apps, and mobile devices with features like driver-free audio loopback, mouse highlighting, and screen magnifier. It fully supports macOS 14's Presenter Overlay for real-time camera overlay and HEVC with Alpha output (with alpha channel), ideal for professional video editing and conferencing.

description: https://getsurfboard.com
summary_zh: Surfboard 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的自动化工具平台，支持网页爬虫、数据抓取与任务自动化。它提供直观的界面和强大的调度能力，帮助用户快速构建和部署 AI 驱动的自动化工作流，适用于内容聚合、数据收集等场景。
summary_en: Surfboard is an automation platform designed for AI agents, enabling web scraping, data extraction, and task automation. It offers an intuitive interface and robust scheduling to help users build and deploy AI-driven workflows efficiently, ideal for content aggregation and data collection.

description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
summary_zh: waoowaoo AI 影视 Studio 是首家工业级全流程可控协作式专业 AI 智能体影视生产平台，支持从小说文本自动生成分镜、角色、场景并制作成完整视频，涵盖短片到漫剧再到真人级影视剧的全流程制作，采用好莱坞专业制作团队思路，提供虚拟制片场体验。
summary_en: waoowaoo AI Studio is the first industrial-grade, end-to-end controllable collaborative AI agent platform for professional film and TV production, supporting full-process creation from short films to anime series and feature films. It automatically generates storyboards, characters, and scenes from novel text and assembles them into complete videos, following Hollywood-level production workflows.

description: HTTP proxy written in Go. COW can automatically identify blocked sites and use parent proxies to access.
summary_zh: COW 是一个基于 Go 编写的智能 HTTP 代理工具，专为简化科学上网设计。它能自动识别被墙网站并仅对这些网站启用二级代理（如 Shadowsocks、SOCKS5 等），直连网站则绕过代理以提升访问速度。支持多类型二级代理、负载均衡、PAC 自动配置及访问行为学习，适用于移动设备或 APN 代理场景。
summary_en: COW (Climb Over the Wall) is an intelligent HTTP proxy written in Go, designed to simplify bypassing internet restrictions. It automatically detects blocked websites and routes only those through secondary proxies (e.g., Shadowsocks, SOCKS5), while allowing direct access to uncensored sites for optimal speed. Features include multi-proxy support, load balancing, PAC generation, and adaptive learning of site accessibility patterns.

description: A configurable set of panels that display various debug information about the current request/response.
summary_zh: Django Debug Toolbar 是一个可配置的调试面板集合，实时展示当前请求/响应的详细信息，包括 SQL 查询、模板渲染、缓存状态等，显著提升 Django 开发调试效率。支持社区贡献的第三方扩展面板，兼容 Django 4.2+，并提供异步视图实验性支持。
summary_en: Django Debug Toolbar is a configurable set of panels that display detailed debug information about the current request/response, including SQL queries, templates, caching, and more. It enhances Django development by providing real-time insights and supports third-party community panels. Compatible with Django 4.2+, with experimental async view support.

description: 一个简洁优雅的hexo主题  A simple and elegant theme for hexo.
summary_zh: Yilia 是一款为 Hexo 博客系统设计的简洁优雅主题，注重移动端体验与极致加载性能，支持目录导航、打赏、搜索、分享等功能，采用 webpack 构建，强调内容呈现与用户专注度。
summary_en: Yilia is a simple and elegant theme for Hexo 2.4+, focusing on mobile experience, fast loading, and content-first design. It supports features like TOC, rewards, search, sharing, and is built with webpack for performance and extensibility.

description: Open-source KVM software
summary_zh: Input Leap 是一款开源 KVM 软件，模拟传统硬件 KVM 切换器的功能，允许用户通过单一键盘和鼠标控制多台计算机。支持跨系统无缝切换，具备剪贴板共享功能（Linux/Wayland 除外），强调跨平台兼容性（Windows/macOS/Linux/FreeBSD）与用户友好的可靠性设计。
summary_en: Input Leap is an open-source KVM software that mimics hardware KVM switches by enabling a single keyboard and mouse to control multiple computers. It supports seamless screen switching, clipboard sharing (except on Linux/Wayland), and prioritizes cross-platform compatibility (Windows, macOS, Linux, FreeBSD) with a focus on hassle-free reliability and open communication.

description: like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane, without Tailscale's control plane
summary_zh: Tailcat 是基于 Tailscale 数据平面构建的类 netcat 工具，无需 Tailscale 账户或 root 权限即可建立 WireGuard 加密点对点隧道。支持 NAT 穿透、DERP 中继、文件传输与 WebAssembly 浏览器端，适用于安全跨网络通信场景。
summary_en: Tailcat is a netcat-like tool built on Tailscale's data plane, enabling WireGuard-encrypted P2P tunnels without requiring a Tailscale account or root privileges. Features NAT traversal, DERP relays, file transfer, and a WebAssembly browser client for secure cross-network communication.

description: Elegant and powerful theme for Hexo.
summary_zh: NexT 是一款优雅且功能强大的 Hexo 主题，专为静态博客设计。支持多风格（Muse、Mist、Pisces、Gemini），集成 PJAX 加速、CDN 配置、第三方插件扩展等高级功能，注重代码高亮、响应式布局与 SEO 优化，适合技术博客与个人站点。
summary_en: NexT is an elegant and powerful theme for Hexo, designed for static blogs. It offers multiple styles (Muse, Mist, Pisces, Gemini), supports advanced features like PJAX navigation, CDN integration, and third-party plugins, with strong emphasis on code highlighting, responsive design, and SEO optimization for tech blogs and personal sites.

description: A ready-to-go translation ocr tool developed with WPF/WPF 开发的一款即用即走的翻译、OCR工具
summary_zh: STranslate 是一款基于 WPF 开发的即用即走翻译与 OCR 工具，支持多语言实时翻译与屏幕文字识别，具备轻量化、跨平台特性，提供简洁高效的用户界面，适用于办公、学习等场景的文本快速处理需求。
summary_en: STranslate is a ready-to-use translation and OCR tool built with WPF, offering real-time multilingual translation and screen text recognition. It features a lightweight, cross-platform design with an intuitive interface, ideal for quick text processing in work and study environments.

description: 丰富多样的 Web 弹出层组件，可轻松实现 Alert/Confirm/Prompt/ 普通提示/页面区块/iframe/tips等等几乎所有的弹出交互。目前已成为最多人使用的弹层解决方案
summary_zh: layer 是一款功能全面的 Web 弹出层组件，支持 Alert、Confirm、Prompt、提示框、页面区块、iframe 等多种交互模式，兼容 IE6+ 及主流浏览器。现已集成至 Layui 框架，提供高性能、易定制的弹层解决方案，广泛应用于企业级 Web 项目，是开发者首选的轻量级交互组件。
summary_en: Layer is a comprehensive web modal component supporting Alert, Confirm, Prompt, tips, iframe, and more. It offers high performance, cross-browser compatibility (including IE6), and extensive customization. Now fully integrated into Layui, it serves as a lightweight, developer-friendly solution for rich user interactions across millions of web platforms.

description: Automate your mobile devices with natural language commands - an LLM agnostic mobile Agent 🤖
summary_zh: DroidRun 是一个强大的移动端自动化框架，通过 LLM 智能体实现自然语言控制 Android 和 iOS 设备。支持多模型提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic 等），具备复杂任务规划能力，提供 CLI 工具和 Python API，集成截图分析与执行追踪，实现高效移动端自动化。
summary_en: DroidRun is a powerful framework for controlling Android and iOS devices via LLM agents using natural language commands. It supports multiple LLM providers, offers planning capabilities for complex tasks, includes a CLI tool with debugging features, and integrates screenshot analysis and execution tracing for mobile automation.

description: 收集整理Android开发所需的Android SDK、开发中用到的工具、Android开发教程、Android设计规范，免费的设计素材等。
summary_zh: AndroidDevTools 是一个专注于 Android 开发的一站式资源平台，提供 Android SDK、开发工具、设计规范、教程及素材的整合。涵盖从开发环境搭建、代码生成、资源处理到设计协作的全流程工具链，支持 Android Studio、Gradle 等主流技术栈，助力开发者高效构建高质量应用。
summary_en: AndroidDevTools is a comprehensive platform for Android developers, offering curated resources including Android SDK, development tools, design guidelines, tutorials, and free assets. It covers the full development lifecycle—from environment setup and code generation to resource optimization and UI design—supporting major tools like Android Studio and Gradle to enhance productivity.

description: Claude Code skill to support Android app's reverse engineering
summary_zh: 专为 Claude Code 设计的 Android 逆向工程技能，可对 APK/XAPK/JAR/AAR 进行反编译并提取 HTTP API（Retrofit、OkHttp、Ktor、Apollo GraphQL）。支持 Kotlin/KMP 应用的 R8 混淆还原、框架识别与调用链追踪，助力 API 文档化与安全研究。
summary_en: A Claude Code skill for Android reverse engineering that decompiles APK/XAPK/JAR/AAR files and extracts HTTP APIs (Retrofit, OkHttp, Ktor, Apollo GraphQL). Supports R8 deobfuscation for Kotlin/KMP apps, framework detection, and call flow tracing for security research and API documentation.

description: Create *beautiful* command-line interfaces with Python
summary_zh: docopt 是一个 Python 命令行接口生成工具，通过编写美观的文档字符串自动生成解析器，支持基于 Usage 模式的参数和选项解析，简化 CLI 开发流程，提升代码可读性。
summary_en: docopt is a Python library that automatically generates command-line interfaces from docstrings, parsing usage patterns and options to create clean, readable CLI tools without manual parser coding.

description: A smarter, self-hosted AI assistant — multi-user, multi-agent.
summary_zh: Octop 是腾讯开源的自托管多用户 AI 助手，采用多 Agent 架构支持团队协作与个人使用。集成专家库、RAG 知识库、MCP/OAuth 连接器生态，支持 MBTI 人格模板、IDE 集成与浏览器自动化，JWT 隔离保障数据隐私本地化运行。
summary_en: Octop is Tencent's open-source self-hosted multi-user AI assistant featuring a multi-agent architecture for team and personal collaboration. Integrates expert libraries, RAG knowledge base, MCP/OAuth connectors, MBTI personas, IDE integration and browser automation, with JWT isolation ensuring local privacy.

description: 用文本编辑器剪视频
summary_zh: AutoCut 是一款基于 Whisper 字幕识别的视频剪辑工具，用户通过编辑 Markdown 文件选择保留片段，即可自动裁切视频。支持多种 Whisper 模型（含 large-v3-turbo 加速版）、faster-whisper 及 OpenAI API，兼容本地与 Docker 部署，无需专业视频软件即可完成精准剪辑。
summary_en: AutoCut is a video editing tool that uses Whisper-based automatic subtitle generation. Users select clips by editing Markdown files, enabling precise video cutting without professional software. It supports multiple Whisper models (including large-v3-turbo for speed), faster-whisper, and OpenAI API, with local and Docker deployment options.

description: Web dashboard for Hermes Agent — multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics
summary_zh: Hermes Web UI 是一个功能完整的 Hermes Agent 管理仪表盘，支持多平台 AI 聊天会话管理、实时消息流、定时任务调度、使用量分析与成本追踪，以及 Telegram、Discord、Slack 等八种通信渠道的统一配置，提供本地 SQLite 会话存储与全局搜索能力。
summary_en: Hermes Web UI is a full-featured dashboard for managing the Hermes Agent, offering multi-platform AI chat session control, real-time streaming, scheduled cron jobs, usage analytics with cost tracking, and unified configuration for 8 communication channels including Telegram, Discord, and Slack.

description: 一个简单的本地网页界面，使用ChatTTS将文字合成为语音，同时支持对外提供API接口。A simple native web interface that uses ChatTTS to synthesize text into speech, along with support for external API interfaces.
summary_zh: ChatTTS-ui 是一个本地网页界面，基于 ChatTTS 模型实现文字转语音功能，支持中英文及数字混合文本合成，并提供 API 接口供外部调用。支持 Windows 预打包版、Linux 容器及源码部署，兼容 CPU/GPU 加速（NVIDIA CUDA 或 AMD ROCm），首次运行自动下载模型文件。
summary_en: ChatTTS-ui is a local web interface that uses the ChatTTS model to synthesize text into speech, supporting mixed Chinese-English text and numbers, with external API support. It offers pre-packaged Windows version, Linux container deployment, and source code setup, with CPU/GPU acceleration via NVIDIA CUDA or AMD ROCm, and automatic model download on first run.

description: The mobile-friendly, responsive, and lightweight jQuery date & time input picker.
summary_zh: pickadate.js 是一个轻量级、响应式且移动端友好的 jQuery 日期和时间选择器库，支持多种主题和语言翻译，提供灵活的 API 和 LESS 样式定制能力，适用于现代化 Web 表单交互。
summary_en: pickadate.js is a lightweight, responsive, and mobile-friendly jQuery date & time picker library with support for multiple themes, language translations, and customizable LESS-based styling, ideal for modern web form inputs.

description: It's a new file uploader solution!
summary_zh: WebUploader 是一个基于 HTML5 为主、Flash 为辅的现代文件上传组件，兼容 IE6+ 及移动端。支持大文件分片并发上传、图片预览压缩、拖拽粘贴添加文件，并提供 MD5 秒传与模块化扩展能力，显著提升上传效率与用户体验。
summary_en: WebUploader is a modern file uploader built primarily on HTML5 with Flash fallback, supporting IE6+ and mobile browsers. It enables chunked concurrent uploads, image preview/compression, drag-and-drop/paste file addition, MD5 instant upload, and modular extensibility for enhanced performance and flexibility.

description: A slide framework built for agents.
summary_zh: open-slide 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的幻灯片框架，支持通过自然语言描述生成 React 幻灯片。提供 1920×1080 固定画布、热重载、演示模式、元素标注编辑、静态导出等功能，内置资产管理和品牌 Logo 搜索，适用于自动化生成高质量演示文稿。
summary_en: open-slide is a slide framework designed for AI agents, enabling natural language-to-slide generation via React. It offers a fixed 1920×1080 canvas, hot reload, present mode, in-browser commenting, asset management with svgl logo search, and export to static HTML/PDF—ideal for automated, professional deck creation.

description: 1 script run the vphone
summary_zh: 一键脚本在 macOS 上通过 Tart 虚拟机运行已越狱的 iOS 26.1 环境（vphone），内置完整 bootstrap 和 APT 源。只需一条命令即可启动，支持 VNC 远程连接桌面，适合测试、开发验证及研究用途。
summary_en: A one-script solution to run a pre-jailbroken iOS 26.1 virtual iPhone via Tart VM on macOS, with full bootstrap and APT packages included. Launch with a single command and connect via VNC. Ideal for iOS development, testing, and research.

summary_zh: 该仓库是阿里无线前端团队2015年的技术文章合集，涵盖性能优化、H5适配、动态化方案、图标与字体处理等核心议题，包含双11项目总结与Flexible适配实践，体现了手淘前端在电商场景下的深度技术探索与工程实践。
summary_en: This repository contains technical articles from Alibaba's mobile front-end team in 2015, covering performance optimization, H5 adaptation, dynamic solutions, icon/font handling, and e-commerce-specific challenges, including insights from Double 11 projects and Flexible layout practices.

description: Tabula is a tool for liberating data tables trapped inside PDF files
summary_zh: Tabula 是一款开源工具，专用于从 PDF 文件中提取结构化表格数据，支持 CSV 格式输出。其核心优势在于本地化处理，确保数据安全，仅适用于文本型 PDF（非扫描件）。项目虽非活跃维护，但底层 Java 库 tabula-java 持续更新，适合数据分析师、记者等处理 PDF 表格的场景。
summary_en: Tabula is an open-source tool designed to extract structured table data from PDF files into CSV format. It emphasizes local processing for data security and works only with text-based PDFs (not scanned documents). While the main app is no longer actively maintained, the underlying tabula-java library continues to receive updates, making it suitable for data analysts and journalists handling PDF tables.

description: The chat decision assistant: before you reply, Jev reads the chat, judges intent and risk, and drafts replies you fill in with one tap. You press send. Android · Windows · macOS · iOS | 聊天辅助决策工具：先看懂对方再回复，发不发由你。
summary_zh: Jev 聊天助手是一款装在手机上的对话副驾，支持微信/QQ/X/飞书等主流聊天应用。通过系统无障碍服务非侵入式读取屏幕内容，结合 AI 分析对方意图与危险等级，生成 3 条候选回复一键填入输入框，发送权始终由用户掌控，隐私安全、接口可配。
summary_en: Jev Chat Assistant is a mobile AI chat co-pilot supporting WeChat, QQ, X, and Feishu. Using Android accessibility service for non-invasive screen reading, it analyzes intent and risk level, generates three candidate replies for one-tap input, while keeping sending control and privacy fully in user's hands with customizable API endpoints.

description: AI 视频笔记生成工具 让 AI 为你的视频做笔记
summary_zh: BiliNote 是一款开源 AI 视频笔记生成工具，支持哔哩哔哩、YouTube、抖音等平台视频链接自动提取内容，结合 GPT 或通义千问等模型生成结构化 Markdown 笔记，支持插入截图、跳转链接及多版本记录，提供本地部署与在线体验。
summary_en: BiliNote is an open-source AI video note generator that automatically extracts content from Bilibili, YouTube, Douyin, and other platforms to create structured Markdown notes using GPT, DeepSeek, or Qwen models. It supports screenshots, jump links, multiple versions, and local deployment with optional CUDA acceleration.

description: Simulates Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Codex, Grok, and Kiro client requests, compatible with the OpenAI API. It supports thousands of Gemini model requests per day and offers free use of the built-in Claude model in Kiro. Easily connect to any client via the API, making AI development more efficient!
summary_zh: AIClient-2-API 是一个强大的 API 代理服务，能够将原本仅限客户端使用的大模型（如 Gemini CLI、Antigravity、Qwen Code、Kiro 等）的请求统一转换为兼容 OpenAI 协议的标准接口。支持每日数千次 Gemini 模型请求，内置 Claude 免费调用功能，提供高可用性的模块化架构，包含账户池管理、智能轮询、自动故障转移和健康检查机制，显著提升 AI 开发效率。
summary_en: AIClient-2-API is a powerful proxy service that unifies requests from client-restricted large models (e.g., Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Qwen Code, Kiro) into a standard OpenAI-compatible interface. It supports thousands of daily Gemini model requests, offers free built-in Claude access, and features a modular architecture with account pooling, intelligent polling, automatic failover, and health checks for 99.9% uptime, greatly enhancing AI development efficiency.

description: 🪧 Claude Code / Codex skill — generate Xiaohongshu carousels & WeChat 21:9+1:1 cover pairs. Editorial × Swiss visual systems, 28 layouts, 10 themes, single-file HTML → PNG. 小红书图文 + 公众号封面对
summary_zh: Guizang Social Card Skill 是一款面向 Claude Code / Codex 等 AI Agent 的图文卡片生成技能，专为小红书图文与公众号封面设计。内置 Editorial 与 Swiss 两套视觉系统，提供 28 种版式与 10 套主题，支持单文件 HTML 转 PNG，无需前端构建，自动适配多尺寸输出，集成图片搜索、地图组件与校验脚本，提升内容创作效率。
summary_en: Guizang Social Card Skill is an AI agent skill for Claude Code/Codex that generates Xiaohongshu carousels and WeChat cover pairs. It features Editorial and Swiss visual systems with 28 layouts and 10 themes, converting single-file HTML to PNG without build tools. Includes image sourcing, map components, and validation scripts for streamlined social content creation.

description: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文辅助创作系统，解决 AI 写作中的「遗忘」和「幻觉」问题，支持 200 万字量级 连载创作。
summary_zh: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文创作辅助系统，通过双 Agent 架构和六维审查机制解决 AI 写作中的遗忘与幻觉问题，支持 200 万字级连载创作，集成 RAG 检索、创意约束系统和追读力机制，确保叙事连贯性与读者粘性。
summary_en: A long-form webnovel writing assistant built on Claude Code, utilizing dual-agent architecture and six-dimensional review mechanisms to address AI writing issues like forgetting and hallucination, supporting serialized creation up to 2 million words with RAG retrieval, creative constraint systems, and reader engagement mechanics.

description: Windows版本微信客户端（非网页版）自动化，可实现简单的发送、接收微信消息，简单微信机器人
summary_zh: wxauto 是一个基于 Windows 平台、使用 UIAutomation 技术实现的微信客户端自动化工具，支持消息发送与接收，适用于开发简单微信机器人的场景。项目于2025年10月28日停止维护，仅支持微信3.9.x版本及Windows 10/11或Server 2016+系统。
summary_en: wxauto is a Windows-based automation tool for the WeChat desktop client (non-web version) using UIAutomation technology. It enables basic message sending and receiving, suitable for building simple WeChat bots. The project was discontinued on October 28, 2025, supporting WeChat 3.9.x and Windows 10/11 or Server 2016+. It is intended solely for technical learning and not for production or illegal use.

summary_zh: Craft Agents 是一款基于 Agent Native 理念构建的开源桌面应用，支持通过自然语言连接任意 API、MCP 服务或本地工具（如 Slack、Linear、PostgreSQL），无需配置文件。它集成 Claude 与 Pi SDK，提供多会话管理、实时技能扩展和文档导向的工作流，所有操作均可通过提示词即时完成，专为高效人机协作设计。
summary_en: Craft Agents is an open-source desktop application built on Agent Native principles, enabling natural language integration with any API, MCP server, or local tool (e.g., Slack, Linear, PostgreSQL) without config files. It combines Claude and Pi SDKs, offering multi-session management, real-time skill expansion, and a document-centric workflow—all customizable via prompts for seamless human-agent collaboration.

description: 🥷 Engineering habits you already know, turned into skills Claude can run.
summary_zh: Waza 是一套专为 Claude AI 设计的工程技能工具集，将工程师的核心工作习惯（如需求思考、系统设计、代码审查、调试排查等）封装为可执行的 /slash 命令。每个技能包含完整文档、辅助脚本和实战案例，帮助 AI 更专业、严谨地完成开发任务，提升输出质量与可靠性。
summary_en: Waza is a collection of engineering skills for Claude AI, transforming proven developer habits—like requirement analysis, UI design, debugging, and code review—into executable slash commands. Each skill includes documentation, scripts, and real-world failure examples to guide Claude in producing higher-quality, more reliable outputs.

description: ChatGPT thinks. Codex works. Use ChatGPT as the planning brain while keeping the Codex harness.
summary_zh: 将 ChatGPT 网页版作为 Codex 编码会话的规划与审查大脑，执行权完全保留在 Codex。通过 OAuth 保护的只读 MCP 连接按需读取代码，仓库永不上传，无需 API Key 或逆向代理，充分利用付费订阅额度。
summary_en: Uses the ChatGPT web app as the planning and review brain for Codex coding sessions, while Codex retains full execution control. Secure read-only MCP connection via OAuth reads only needed code; repo is never uploaded. No API key or reverse proxy required.

description: Self-hosted AI gateway for multi-channel, multi-credential setups — API keys and subscription accounts, scheduling, failover, request logs and usage. 自托管 AI 网关：多渠道多凭据统一接入，含密钥与订阅账号、调度容错、日志与用量。
summary_zh: GPT-Load 是一个高性能企业级 AI API 透明代理服务，专为需要集成多 AI 服务的开发者和企业设计。基于 Go 构建，具备智能密钥轮询、负载均衡、故障自动恢复、动态配置热重载等特性，支持 OpenAI、Google Gemini、Anthropic Claude 等多种 AI 服务格式，提供完整的监控和管理界面。
summary_en: GPT-Load is a high-performance, enterprise-grade transparent proxy service for AI APIs, designed for developers and enterprises integrating multiple AI services. Built with Go, it features intelligent key rotation, load balancing, automatic failure recovery, hot-reload configuration, and comprehensive monitoring. Supports OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude APIs with a Vue 3 management interface.

description: A plugin framework on android,Run any third-party apk without installation, modification or repackage
summary_zh: DroidPlugin 是一个 Android 插件框架，支持在不安装、不修改、不重打包第三方 APK 的前提下运行插件应用。它通过代码隔离、资源管理和进程回收机制，实现宿主应用与插件应用的完全解耦，兼容 Android 2.3+，仅需一行代码即可集成，适用于协作开发和动态插件化场景。
summary_en: DroidPlugin is an Android plugin framework enabling the host app to run any third-party APK without installation, modification, or repackaging. It provides complete code and resource isolation, process management, and system API support, requiring only one line of code integration and compatible with Android 2.3+. Ideal for dynamic pluginization and collaborative development.

description: 🦋 An Infographic Generation and Rendering Framework, bring words to life with AI!
summary_zh: AntV Infographic 是蚂蚁集团 AntV 团队推出的下一代声明式信息图可视化引擎，提供约200个内置模板和组件，支持AI友好语法配置，可快速生成高质量SVG信息图，具备主题系统、内置编辑器和数据叙事能力，适用于数据可视化与内容创作场景。
summary_en: AntV Infographic is AntV's next-generation declarative infographic visualization engine, offering ~200 built-in templates and components. It supports AI-friendly syntax for rapid generation of high-quality SVG infographics, featuring a theme system, built-in editor, and data storytelling capabilities for visualization and content creation.

description: Git your game on!
summary_zh: Githug 是一个通过游戏化方式学习 Git 命令的实践工具，包含多个难度递增的关卡，每个关卡要求玩家使用特定 Git 命令达成目标。它基于 Ruby 开发，支持跨平台运行，提供提示、重置和关卡列表功能，适合 Git 初学者系统掌握版本控制技能。
summary_en: Githug is a practical game designed to teach Git through interactive levels. Each level challenges users to use specific Git commands to achieve a goal. Built in Ruby, it runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows, offering hints, resets, and level progression to help beginners master version control effectively.

description: Embrace the APIs of the future. Hug aims to make developing APIs as simple as possible, but no simpler.
summary_zh: Hug 是一个极简且高性能的 Python API 框架，基于 Falcon 构建，大幅简化 API 开发流程。支持自动文档生成、参数类型转换、路由装饰器等功能，强调自文档化、快速开发和测试友好，适用于现代 Python 后端服务开发。
summary_en: Hug is a minimalist, high-performance Python API framework built on Falcon that simplifies API development. It features automatic documentation, type conversion, decorators for routing, and emphasizes self-documenting code, fast development, and easy testing for modern Python backend services.

description: 🔥 基于大模型和 RAG 的智能问数系统，对话式数据分析神器。Text-to-SQL Generation via LLMs using RAG.
summary_zh: SQLBot 是基于大语言模型和 RAG 技术的智能问数系统，支持对话式数据分析（ChatBI），实现自然语言转 SQL 查询并生成可视化图表。具备开箱即用、安全可控、易于集成等优势，可嵌入 DataEase、Dify 等应用，支持细粒度权限管理与持续优化，越问越准。
summary_en: SQLBot is an intelligent data querying system powered by LLMs and RAG, enabling conversational analytics (ChatBI) with natural language-to-SQL conversion and visualization. It offers plug-and-play deployment, secure workspace isolation, fine-grained permissions, and seamless integration into platforms like DataEase and Dify, continuously improving accuracy through user interactions.

description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)
summary_zh: Proxifly 是一个高性能的免费代理 IP 池，每 5 分钟自动抓取并验证全球 HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4 和 SOCKS5 代理。提供 JSON、TXT、CSV 多格式下载及 NPM 模块，支持按国家与协议筛选，适用于网页爬虫、数据抓取与隐私保护等场景。
summary_en: Proxifly is a high-performance free proxy pool that automatically scrapes and validates global HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies every 5 minutes. It offers multi-format downloads (JSON, TXT, CSV), an NPM module, and filtering by country/protocol, ideal for web scraping, data extraction, and privacy protection.

description: 30 days of React Native demos
summary_zh: 本项目是30天React Native实战教程，涵盖从基础组件到高级动画、手势识别、地图定位、生物识别等22个完整案例，包含iOS原生级交互效果，适合移动端开发学习者系统掌握React Native核心技能。
summary_en: This project is a 30-day React Native tutorial series featuring 22 complete demos, covering core components, animations, gestures, maps, biometric authentication, and more. It provides hands-on experience with iOS-level interactions for mobile development learners.

description: This is a repository for collecting global custom management extensions for the Django Framework.
summary_zh: Django Extensions 是一个为 Django 框架提供增强功能的扩展集合，包含模型可视化、URL 路由分析、模板验证、增强版 shell_plus 和 runserver_plus 等实用工具，显著提升开发效率与调试体验。
summary_en: Django Extensions is a collection of custom management extensions for Django, offering tools like model graphing, URL inspection, template validation, shell_plus, and runserver_plus to enhance developer productivity and debugging workflows.

description: One-stop Proxies Crawling and Aggregation Platform
summary_zh: Aggregator 是一个高效免费的代理池构建工具，支持从 Telegram、GitHub 等多平台爬取代理资源，自动验证质量并转换为 Clash、V2Ray 等格式，提供 GitHub Gist 等灵活存储后端，适用于个人及企业级代理订阅管理。
summary_en: Aggregator is a powerful free proxy pool builder that crawls proxy resources from multiple platforms like Telegram and GitHub, automatically validates quality, and converts them into formats such as Clash and V2Ray. It supports flexible storage backends like GitHub Gist and is ideal for personal and enterprise proxy subscription management.

description: Simple forum software for building great communities.
summary_zh: Flarum 是一个轻量级、现代化的论坛软件，专为构建高效社区而设计。基于 PHP 开发，采用 Mithril 前端框架，具备简洁界面、快速部署和强大扩展能力，支持插件化定制，适用于各类在线讨论场景。
summary_en: Flarum is a lightweight, modern forum software designed to build great online communities. Built with PHP and powered by the Mithril JavaScript framework, it offers a clean interface, fast deployment, and extensive extensibility through a robust Extension API, ideal for customizable discussion platforms.

description: 赫蹏（hètí）是专为中文内容展示设计的排版样式增强。它基于通行的中文排版规范而来，可以为网站的读者带来更好的文章阅读体验。
summary_zh: 赫蹏（Heti）是一款专为中文内容展示设计的排版样式增强库。它基于通行的中文排版规范，提供贴合网格的排版、全标签美化、古文诗词样式及竖排等功能。通过引入CSS与可选的JS脚本，可自动实现中西文混排优化与全角标点挤压，大幅提升网页中文阅读体验。
summary_en: Heti is a typography enhancement library specifically designed for Chinese content display. Based on standard Chinese typesetting conventions, it offers grid-aligned layouts, full tag styling, and specialized formats for classical poetry and vertical writing. By including its CSS and optional JS, it automatically optimizes CJK-Latin mixed spacing and punctuation compression, significantly improving the reading experience.

description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
summary_zh: Magpie 是一款轻量跨平台本地网关工具，统一管理多种 AI 编程助手（Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等）的模型选择与 API 路由。通过菜单栏应用、TUI 和 CLI 三种形态，无缝切换模型、共享订阅、自动同步实时模型目录，并精确编辑配置文件，实现多代理一站式编排。
summary_en: Magpie is a lightweight cross-platform local gateway that centrally manages model selection and API routing for multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.). It offers menu-bar GUI, TUI and CLI interfaces, supports shared subscriptions, real-time model discovery, and surgical config editing for unified multi-agent orchestration.

description: 一个自己找热点、自己写日报的网站框架。把信源和精选标准换成你的，它就是你的行业热点站。
summary_zh: AIHOT 是一个开源的行业热点监测框架，自动从多源采集资讯，经大模型预筛、双评分与去重聚簇，生成中文标题、摘要与日报/周报/月报，支持 RSS、X、微信公众号等信源，可快速部署为法律、金融、HR 等垂直领域的智能热点站。
summary_en: AIHOT is an open-source framework for industry-specific news aggregation. It auto-collects from RSS, web, X and WeChat, applies AI pre-filtering, dual scoring and event clustering, then generates Chinese headlines, summaries and daily/weekly/monthly reports. Deployable as a vertical hotspot dashboard for legal, financial, HR domains.

description: Learn javascript in one picture.
summary_zh: 本项目通过一张思维导图（Mind Map）直观展示 JavaScript 核心语法与概念，涵盖函数、对象、作用域、闭包等关键知识点，适合快速查阅与教学。采用可视化设计，单图呈现语言全貌，支持多语言版本，并计划扩展 Python3 和 Go 版本。
summary_en: This project visualizes JavaScript syntax and concepts in a single mind map, covering functions, objects, scope, closures, and more. Designed for quick reference and teaching, it offers a comprehensive yet concise overview. Multi-language support and upcoming Python3/Go versions enhance its utility.

description: p2p.kiwi 🥝, Cross-Platform screen 🖥️ sharing 📡 made simple ⚡.
summary_zh: p2p.kiwi是一款跨平台P2P屏幕共享工具，支持Mac、Windows和Linux系统。无需注册账户，不依赖服务器基础设施，仅通过STUN/TURN及信令服务器完成初始连接交换。适合远程协作、技术支持与即时屏幕分享场景，实现高效安全的点对点数据传输。
summary_en: p2p.kiwi is a cross-platform P2P screen sharing tool supporting Mac, Windows, and Linux. No account registration required, operates without server infrastructure beyond STUN/TURN and signaling servers for initial connection setup. Ideal for remote collaboration, tech support, and instant screen sharing with secure peer-to-peer data transfer.

description: A collection of MCP clients.
summary_zh: Awesome MCP Clients 是一个精心策划的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 客户端集合，涵盖 CLI、桌面应用、AI 助手等多种类型，支持跨平台运行，旨在扩展 AI 模型对本地和远程资源的访问能力，提升智能交互体验。
summary_en: Awesome MCP Clients is a curated collection of Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, including CLI tools, desktop apps, and AI assistants, supporting cross-platform use to extend AI models' access to local and remote resources for enhanced intelligent interaction.

description: Bananas🍌, Cross-Platform screen 🖥️ sharing 📡 made simple ⚡.
summary_zh: Bananas 是一款跨平台屏幕共享工具，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，采用点对点连接技术，无需注册或服务器中转（仅需 STUN/TURN 和信令服务器完成初始连接）。主打隐私安全、简单易用，适合快速分享屏幕。
summary_en: Bananas is a cross-platform screen sharing tool for Mac, Windows, and Linux, using peer-to-peer connections without requiring accounts or central servers (except for STUN/TURN and signaling servers). It emphasizes privacy, simplicity, and instant sharing.

description: A set of web-based tools for generating graphics and other assets that would eventually be in an Android application's res/ directory.
summary_zh: Android Asset Studio 是一个已停止维护的网页工具集，用于生成 Android 应用资源文件（如图标、通知图、九宫格等），现推荐使用 icon.kitchen 或 Android Studio 内置工具替代。
summary_en: The Android Asset Studio was a web-based toolset for generating Android app assets (e.g., icons, notifications, nine-patches). It is no longer maintained; users are advised to switch to icon.kitchen or Android Studio's built-in tools.

description: "Sigma File Manager" is a free, open-source, quickly evolving, modern file manager (explorer / browser) app for Windows and Linux.
summary_zh: Sigma File Manager 是一款免费开源的现代文件管理器，专为 Windows 和 Linux 设计，支持快速文件浏览与操作。项目已进入 v2 稳定测试阶段，提供直观界面与高效功能，适用于日常文件管理需求。
summary_en: Sigma File Manager is a free, open-source, modern file manager for Windows and Linux, offering fast file browsing and operations. Now in v2 beta, it features an intuitive interface and efficient tools for streamlined file management.

description: Flutter Launch Timeline Demo
summary_zh: 该应用是一个基于 Flutter 开发的交互式时间轴应用，展示从宇宙大爆炸到互联网诞生的历史事件。通过精美的动画和垂直滚动时间轴，用户可探索不同时代的关键事件，每个事件配有动态气泡和详细文章页面。核心技术包括 Flutter 框架、Flare 和 Nima 动画库，以及自定义 LeafRenderObjectWidget 实现高性能渲染。
summary_en: This is an interactive vertical timeline app built with Flutter, showcasing historical events from the Big Bang to the Internet. It features animated event bubbles, detailed article pages, and smooth scrolling/zooming. Built using Flutter with Flare and Nima animation libraries, plus custom LeafRenderObjectWidget for high-performance rendering.

description: Local-first AI coding agent desktop: Electron + Rust host core + pi Agent Harness + user-installable plugins
summary_zh: PI-Desktop是一款本地优先的AI编程代理桌面应用，采用Electron + Rust架构。支持OpenAI、Anthropic及自定义模型，提供Agent/Plan/Goal三种协作模式，内置权限审查层与可扩展插件系统，实现跨平台独立编码工作空间。
summary_en: PI-Desktop is a local-first AI coding agent desktop app built with Electron and Rust. It supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and custom models, offers Agent/Plan/Goal modes with permission controls and an extensible plugin system for cross-platform independent coding workspaces.

description: A multi-model AI agent desktop client — connect any AI provider, extend with MCP & skills, control from your phone. Built with Electron + Next.js.
summary_zh: CodePilot 是一个基于 Electron + Next.js 构建的 Claude Code 桌面 GUI 客户端，提供多模型提供商支持、MCP 扩展、自定义技能、跨平台通信及项目感知型智能助手工作区，实现可视化聊天、编码与项目管理一体化体验。
summary_en: CodePilot is a desktop GUI client for Claude Code built with Electron and Next.js, offering multi-provider support, MCP extensions, custom skills, cross-platform bridging, and an AI assistant workspace that understands your projects through persistent memory and onboarding flows.

description: Curated list of apps and tools that not only use the new ChatGPT API, but also allow users to configure their own API keys, enabling free and on-demand usage of their own quota.
summary_zh: Awesome ChatGPT API 是一个精心策划的资源列表，汇集了支持用户自定义 API 密钥的应用和工具，实现免费按需调用自有配额。涵盖浏览器插件、Web/桌面应用、CLI 工具及开发资源，适用于多场景 AI 集成，如翻译、搜索摘要、代码辅助等，助力开发者构建高效 ChatGPT 生态。
summary_en: Awesome ChatGPT API is a curated collection of apps and tools that support custom API key configuration, enabling free on-demand usage of personal quotas. It includes browser extensions, web/desktop apps, CLI tools, and development resources, supporting diverse AI integrations like translation, search summarization, and code assistance for building a robust ChatGPT ecosystem.

description: 定投改变命运 —— 让时间陪你慢慢变富 https://onregularinvesting.com
summary_zh: 《定投改变命运》系统阐述普通人通过定期投资实现财富积累与阶层跃迁的路径，强调定投作为唯一可操作、可坚持的长期投资策略，结合证券市场奇迹属性与人性弱点分析，提供可落地的投资哲学与实践指南。
summary_en: This book systematically explains how ordinary people can break through class barriers through regular investing, emphasizing that dollar-cost averaging is the only feasible and sustainable investment strategy. It combines market insights with human psychology to offer a practical philosophy and actionable guidance for long-term wealth building.

description: FunASR-powered video transcription, subtitle generation, and LLM-assisted clipping tool with a local Gradio UI.
summary_zh: FunClip 是一款开源、精准且易用的视频语音识别与剪辑工具，集成阿里巴巴通义语音实验室开源的 FunASR Paraformer 系列模型，支持中文及英文语音识别，具备热词定制、说话人分离、多段自由剪辑等功能，并引入 LLM 智能剪辑能力，用户可通过 Gradio 界面快速生成精准视频片段与字幕。
summary_en: FunClip is an open-source, accurate, and user-friendly video speech recognition and clipping tool. It leverages Alibaba's FunASR Paraformer models for ASR, supports Chinese and English, enables hotword customization, speaker separation, multi-segment clipping, and integrates LLM-based AI clipping via Qwen/GPT series models with customizable prompts for intelligent video editing.

description: WonderTrader——量化研发交易一站式框架
summary_zh: WonderTrader 是一个基于 C++ 核心的一站式量化交易研发框架，覆盖数据清洗、回测到实盘交易全流程。其核心优势在于提供 CTA、SEL、HFT 和 UFT（延迟低至 175 纳秒）四大交易引擎，支持 Python/C++ 混合开发，具备高效内存数据伺服、组合盘风控及 M+1+N 多账户执行架构，专为专业机构的高频低延迟交易场景设计。
summary_en: WonderTrader is a C++ based one-stop quantitative trading framework covering the full lifecycle from data cleaning and backtesting to live trading. Its core strengths include four major engines (CTA, SEL, HFT, and UFT with latency as low as 175ns), Python/C++ hybrid development, efficient memory data services, portfolio risk control, and an M+1+N multi-account execution architecture tailored for professional low-latency trading.

description: 🐬DeepChat - A smart assistant that connects powerful AI to your personal world
summary_zh: DeepChat 是一个功能丰富的开源 AI 智能体平台，统一整合模型、工具和智能体，支持多 LLM 对话、MCP 工具调用和 ACP 智能体集成，提供强大的桌面端 AI 助手体验。
summary_en: DeepChat is a powerful open-source AI agent platform that unifies models, tools, and agents, offering multi-LLM chat, MCP tool calling, and ACP agent integration for seamless desktop AI assistance.

description: Apple's Liquid Glass effect for React
summary_zh: Liquid Glass React 是一款为 React 应用打造的 Apple 液态玻璃特效组件库，完美复现 macOS 和 iOS 中的毛玻璃视觉效果。支持多模式折射、弹性交互、鼠标追踪位移、色差调节等高级特性，适用于现代 UI 设计中的卡片、按钮等组件，显著提升视觉质感与交互体验。
summary_en: Liquid Glass React is a React component library that replicates Apple's Liquid Glass effect, delivering authentic frosted glass visuals with displacement, refraction, and elastic interactions. It supports multiple refraction modes, mouse tracking, chromatic aberration, and customizable blur/saturation, ideal for modern UI elements like cards and buttons.

description: Native Proxy Experience Built for macOS
summary_zh: ClashMac 是一款专为 macOS 打造的本地代理客户端，采用 SwiftUI 原生开发，深度集成系统。提供航线地图、连接拓扑和流量统计三大核心可视化功能，支持系统代理与 TUN 增强模式，具备菜单栏常驻、隐私模式、实时切换和自动重连等特性，带来直观高效的代理管理体验。
summary_en: ClashMac is a native macOS proxy client built with SwiftUI, offering route map visualization, connection topology, and real-time traffic statistics. It supports system proxy and TUN modes, features menu bar integration, privacy mode, instant node switching, and auto-reconnection for an intuitive proxy management experience.

description: Free and open source database client built natively for developers
summary_zh: TablePro 是一款面向开发者的免费开源原生数据库客户端，支持 macOS、iOS 和 Linux。它摒弃 Electron 和 JVM，采用原生框架构建，冷启动低于 1 秒，内存占用约 80MB。支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、Redis 等主流 SQL/NoSQL 数据库，内置 AI 功能（聊天、代码建议、MCP 服务），并可通过插件扩展。提供 SQL 编辑器、数据网格、SSH 隧道、iCloud 同步等核心功能，是 TablePlus 的开源替代方案。
summary_en: TablePro is a free, open-source native database client for developers, built without Electron or JVM. It supports major SQL and NoSQL databases with native drivers, cold starts under 1 second, and ~80MB RAM usage. Features include an AI-powered SQL editor, data grid, SSH tunnels, iCloud sync, and plugin extensibility. It serves as an open-source alternative to TablePlus with integrated AI chat, MCP server, and cross-platform support.

description: 达尔文.skill —— 一个让你的Skill无限进化的系统：评估→改进→测试→保留或回滚 | Autoresearch-inspired autonomous skill optimization for Claude Code. Evaluate, improve, test, keep or revert.
summary_zh: 达尔文.skill 是一个受 autoresearch 启发的自主 Skill 优化系统，通过评估→改进→测试→保留/回滚的闭环循环，持续提升 Claude Code 等 Agent 工具的 Skill 性能。采用双重评估机制（结构质量+实际效果）和棘轮机制，确保每次修改只保留可测量的改进，支持 8 维度加权评分体系与人在回路验证。
summary_en: Darwin.skill is an autonomous skill optimization system inspired by autoresearch, featuring a closed-loop cycle of evaluate-improve-test-keep/revert to continuously enhance agent skills in tools like Claude Code. It employs dual evaluation (structural quality + actual performance) and a ratchet mechanism to ensure only measurable improvements are retained, using an 8-dimensional weighted scoring system with human-in-the-loop validation.

description: curl statistics made simple
summary_zh: httpstat 是一个简洁高效的命令行工具，用于可视化 curl 请求的详细统计信息，包括 DNS 解析、TCP 连接、TLS 握手、HTTP 请求和响应等关键阶段耗时。它用 Python 编写，单文件无依赖，支持丰富的环境变量配置，适用于网络调试和性能分析。
summary_en: httpstat is a simple yet powerful command-line tool that visualizes detailed curl request statistics, including DNS lookup, TCP handshake, TLS negotiation, and HTTP request/response timings. Written in single-file Python with zero dependencies, it offers rich customization via environment variables for network debugging and performance analysis.

description: Claude Skill: Multi-source content processor for NotebookLM. Supports WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, PDF, Markdown, search queries → Podcast/PPT/MindMap/Quiz etc.
summary_zh: qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm 是一个 Claude Code Skill，支持将微信公众号、网页、YouTube、PDF、Markdown 等 15 种以上内容源自动处理并上传至 Google NotebookLM，生成播客、PPT、思维导图、Quiz 等多种输出格式。其核心亮点是内置 6 层付费墙绕过机制，可自动提取 300+ 付费网站内容，结合 AI 实现多模态内容转换。
summary_en: qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm is a Claude Code Skill that processes 15+ content sources—including WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, PDF, and Markdown—and uploads them to Google NotebookLM to generate outputs like podcasts, PPTs, mind maps, and quizzes. Its standout feature is a 6-layer paywall bypass system that automatically extracts content from 300+ premium news sites, enabling AI-powered multimodal content transformation.

description: One Remote Access Manager to Rule Them All
summary_zh: 1Remote 是一款现代化的个人远程会话管理与启动工具，支持 RDP、SSH、VNC、Telnet、(S)FTP 等多种协议，提供多屏幕 HiDPI 连接、标签化界面、自定义运行器及 mRemoteNG 导入功能，支持便携运行与多语言主题定制。
summary_en: 1Remote is a modern personal remote session manager and launcher supporting RDP, SSH, VNC, Telnet, (S)FTP, RemoteApp, NoMachine and more. It offers multi-screen HiDPI RDP support, customizable runners, mRemoteNG import, portable deployment, and a tabbed, multi-language interface.

description: 消息推送平台🔥 推送下发【邮件】【短信】【微信服务号】【微信小程序】【企业微信】【钉钉】等消息类型。
summary_zh: Austin 是一个企业级统一消息推送平台，支持邮件、短信、微信、钉钉、企业微信等10+渠道的消息下发，具备全链路追踪、资源隔离、定时任务等能力，采用 SpringBoot + Kafka + Redis + Xxl-Job 等技术栈，适用于业务通知、营销触达等场景。
summary_en: Austin is an enterprise-grade unified messaging push platform supporting 10+ channels including email, SMS, WeChat, DingTalk, and enterprise WeChat. It features full-lifecycle tracking, channel isolation, and scheduled delivery via cron. Built with SpringBoot, Kafka, Redis, and Xxl-Job, it serves business notifications and marketing campaigns.

description: 🎃 A fast, out-of-the-box macOS terminal built for AI coding.
summary_zh: Kaku 是一款专为 AI 编程优化的终端模拟器，基于 WezTerm 深度定制。它提供开箱即用的体验，支持零配置启动、主题自适应切换、内置 zsh 插件及轻量级高性能内核，并集成 AI 助手用于命令行错误修复与智能编码辅助。
summary_en: Kaku is a high-performance terminal emulator built for AI coding, forked from WezTerm with deep customizations. It offers zero-config setup, theme-aware UI, integrated shell tools, and a built-in AI assistant for command recovery and coding support.

description: Technical guide to making money and investing（最全赚钱投资指南）
summary_zh: 系统整理全球经典投资理财书籍资源，覆盖初阶到高阶16本必读著作，涵盖价值投资理念、资产配置方法与财富思维建设。适合希望通过持续学习实现财务自由的读者，提供可直接获取的优质投教资源。
summary_en: A curated collection of 16 essential personal finance and investing books from beginner to advanced levels. Covers value investing principles, asset allocation strategies, and wealth-building mindsets. Ideal for learners seeking accessible, high-quality financial education resources on the path to financial freedom.

description: Zero-Config Code Flow for Claude code & Codex
summary_zh: ZCF 是一款零配置 Claude Code & Codex 代码流工具，提供一键安装、双语界面、智能代理系统和个性化 AI 助手。支持多种 API 提供商（如 302.AI、GLM、PackyCode 等），内置工作流、MCP 集成，并持续更新维护，适合开发者快速部署 AI 编程环境。
summary_en: ZCF (Zero-Config Code Flow) is a zero-configuration tool for Claude Code & Codex, enabling one-click setup with bilingual support, intelligent agent system, and personalized AI assistants. It supports multiple API providers (e.g., 302.AI, GLM, PackyCode), includes workflows and MCP integration, and is actively maintained for seamless AI coding experience.

description: A very powerful and friendly  nginx base on lua-nginx-module( openresty ) which provide WAF, Control Panel, and Dashboards.
summary_zh: VeryNginx 是基于 OpenResty 的强大 Nginx 增强工具，集成 WAF、访问统计、控制面板和仪表盘，支持自定义匹配器与动作实现灵活规则引擎，提供友好的 Web 界面管理复杂流量策略。
summary_en: VeryNginx is a powerful and user-friendly Nginx extension based on OpenResty, featuring built-in WAF, real-time access statistics, control panel, and dashboards. It enables advanced traffic management through customizable matchers and actions, offering a web interface for complex rule-based request processing and security enforcement.

description: A Flutter UI Kit（一个 Flutter UI组件库），包含 ScaleView, Swiper, PullRefresh, WaterMark, GradientCircularProgressIndicator...
summary_zh: Flukit 是一个功能丰富的 Flutter UI 组件库，提供 ScaleView、Swiper、PullRefresh、WaterMark 等实用 Widget，涵盖手势交互、动画效果、进度指示器等场景，支持自定义渐变按钮、弹性滚动头部等高级功能，显著提升 Flutter 开发效率。
summary_en: Flukit is a comprehensive Flutter UI kit offering essential widgets like ScaleView, Swiper, PullRefresh, and WaterMark. It supports advanced features such as gesture interactions, gradient animations, elastic headers, and progress indicators, significantly enhancing Flutter app development efficiency.

description: 多模型协作工作流引擎 — /ccg:go 一个命令，AI 自动分析意图、选择策略、编排 Codex + Gemini + Claude 协作执行
summary_zh: CCG 是一个多模型协作开发系统，通过 Claude 编排 Codex（后端）与 Gemini（前端），提供 28 个命令覆盖完整开发流程。支持零配置路由、安全补丁审查及 OPSX 规范驱动开发，实现 AI 智能体协同编程。
summary_en: CCG is a multi-model collaboration system where Claude orchestrates Codex (backend) and Gemini (frontend), offering 28 slash commands for full-stack development. Features zero-config routing, secure patch review, and OPSX-driven spec development for AI agent teamwork.

description: Python client for Apache Kafka
summary_zh: kafka-python 是一个功能完整的 Python 客户端库，用于与 Apache Kafka 分布式流处理系统交互。它高度模拟官方 Java 客户端的行为，支持高吞吐量的消息生产与消费，提供消费者组、偏移量提交、事务消息、消息头、反序列化等高级功能，适用于构建实时数据管道和流处理应用。
summary_en: kafka-python is a fully-featured Python client for Apache Kafka, designed to closely mimic the official Java client. It supports high-level asynchronous message production and consumption, consumer groups, offset commits, transactional messages, message headers, and deserialization, making it ideal for building real-time data pipelines and streaming applications.

description: A modern static site generator by the Material for MkDocs team
summary_zh: Zensical 是由 Material for MkDocs 团队打造的新一代现代化静态站点生成器，支持 Markdown 编写，具备搜索、多语言（60+）、响应式布局等特性，专为开源和商业项目提供快速构建专业文档站点的解决方案。
summary_en: Zensical is a modern static site generator crafted by the creators of Material for MkDocs, enabling rapid creation of professional, searchable, multilingual (60+ languages), and responsive documentation sites from Markdown – ideal for open-source and commercial projects.

description: Collection of material design libs and res.
summary_zh: Awesome-MaterialDesign 是一个精选的 Android Material Design 资源与库集合，涵盖官方文档、Google 示例项目、设计资源及第三方开源库，为开发者提供从设计规范到 UI 组件实现的完整解决方案，助力快速构建符合 Material Design 标准的 Android 应用。
summary_en: Awesome-MaterialDesign is a curated collection of Android Material Design resources and libraries, including official docs, Google sample projects, design assets, and third-party open-source libraries, providing a complete solution for developers to build Material Design-compliant Android apps efficiently.

description: lanproxy是一个将局域网个人电脑、服务器代理到公网的内网穿透工具，支持tcp流量转发，可支持任何tcp上层协议（访问内网网站、本地支付接口调试、ssh访问、远程桌面、http代理、https代理、socks5代理...）。技术交流QQ群 736294209
summary_zh: lanproxy 是一款高性能内网穿透工具，支持 TCP 流量转发，可代理访问内网网站、SSH、远程桌面等任何 TCP 上层协议。提供 Java 客户端和跨平台 Go 客户端，支持 SSL 加密、多用户管理、自定义域名绑定及 HTTPS 证书自动申请，解决公网访问内网服务的安全与便捷问题。
summary_en: Lanproxy is a high-performance intranet penetration tool that supports TCP traffic forwarding for any TCP-based protocol (e.g., web access, SSH, remote desktop). It offers Java and cross-platform Go clients, with SSL encryption, multi-user support, custom domain binding, and automatic HTTPS certificate issuance, enabling secure and easy public access to private networks.

description: A git client based on the IntelliJ platform
summary_zh: Rebased 是一款基于 IntelliJ 平台构建的开源 Git 客户端，旨在替代 JetBrains 官方未实现的独立 Git 工具愿景。它剥离了 IDE 中除 Git 集成外的所有插件，并优化了界面，提供轻量级、专注的版本控制体验。支持 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 多平台安装。
summary_en: Rebased is an open-source Git client built on the IntelliJ platform, designed as a standalone alternative to JetBrains' discontinued Git tool initiative. It strips down the full IDE to only Git integration with UI enhancements, offering a lightweight, focused version control experience across Linux, Windows, and macOS.

summary_zh: Craft Agents 是一款基于 Agent Native 理念构建的开源桌面应用，支持通过自然语言连接任意 API、MCP 服务或本地工具（如 Linear、Gmail、Slack、PostgreSQL 等），无需配置文件。它集成 Claude 与 Pi SDK，提供多会话管理、实时技能扩展和文档中心化工作流，用户仅需描述需求即可自动完成集成与任务执行。
summary_en: Craft Agents is an open-source desktop application built on Agent Native principles, enabling natural language integration with any API, MCP service, or local tool (e.g., Linear, Gmail, Slack, PostgreSQL) without config files. It combines Claude and Pi SDKs to offer multi-session management, real-time skill expansion, and a document-centric workflow—users simply describe what they want, and the agent handles execution.

description: Gemini polling proxy service （gemini轮询代理服务）
summary_zh: Gemini Balance 是一个基于 FastAPI 的 Gemini API 代理与负载均衡服务，支持多密钥轮询、OpenAI 格式兼容、图像文本对话、网页搜索及实时状态监控，提供灵活的配置管理和详细的日志追踪。
summary_en: Gemini Balance is a FastAPI-based proxy and load balancer for Google's Gemini API, enabling multi-key polling, OpenAI API compatibility, image-text chat, web search, and real-time key status monitoring with dynamic configuration and detailed logging.

description: 中国软件著作权申请材料 生成器 Skills，本 Skills 通过阅读本地项目，自动生成全套 .docx 软著申请材料，全开源，无须再付费购买任何软著申请服务
summary_zh: 这是一个开源的 Codex Skill，用于自动生成中国软件著作权申请全套材料（含申请表、操作手册和代码文档）。它基于本地真实项目源码分析，确保材料真实合规，支持前30页/后30页代码截取规则，输出标准 .docx 和 .txt 文件，全程本地处理，避免依赖付费代办服务。
summary_en: An open-source Codex Skill that auto-generates complete Chinese software copyright application materials (forms, manuals, code docs) from local project source code. It ensures authenticity, follows the 30-page code rule, outputs standardized .docx/.txt files, and runs locally to eliminate paid agency dependencies.

description: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
summary_zh: Skills Manager 是一款轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、同步和组织 AI 智能体技能，支持 15+ 主流开发工具（如 Cursor、Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 等）。通过中央仓库集中管理技能，支持从 Git 仓库、本地文件或市场导入，一键同步至目标工具，并提供场景分组、更新追踪和技能文档预览功能。
summary_en: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app that centralizes the management, sync, and organization of AI agent skills across 15+ coding tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot. It supports importing skills from Git repos, local folders, or the marketplace into a unified repository, enables one-click sync via symlinks/copies, and offers scenario grouping, update tracking, and in-app skill documentation preview.

description: an elegant efficient express mvvm framework
summary_zh: Avalon2 是一个高效优雅的 MVVM 前端框架，支持双向数据绑定与组件化开发，具备优异的渲染性能与后端渲染能力。它兼容 IE6+，提供丰富的指令系统（如 ms-duplex、ms-if）和组件开发支持，适用于构建高性能单页应用（SPA）。
summary_en: Avalon2 is an elegant and efficient MVVM framework for frontend development, featuring two-way data binding, componentization, and high-performance rendering. It supports server-side rendering, IE6+ compatibility, and provides a rich directive system (e.g., ms-duplex, ms-if) for building scalable single-page applications (SPAs).

description: The open source Trello alternative.
summary_zh: Kan是一个开源的Trello替代方案，采用Next.js与tRPC技术栈构建，支持看板权限控制、团队协作者邀请、Trello一键导入、标签筛选、活动日志追踪及自定义模板等功能，提供Railway一键部署与Docker Compose自托管两种方案，适合中小团队进行轻量级项目管理与任务协作。
summary_en: Kan is an open-source Trello alternative built with Next.js and tRPC, offering board visibility control, team collaboration, Trello imports, labels, activity logs, and templates. Supports Railway one-click deployment and Docker self-hosting, ideal for small to medium teams seeking lightweight project management and task collaboration.

description: 收集一些Loon、Surge、QuantumultX、ShadowRocket、Egern的配置与去广告规则。
summary_zh: 本仓库提供 Loon、Surge、Quantumult X 等代理工具的配置与去广告规则，涵盖抖音、微博等主流 App 的广告过滤与 IP 修改功能，支持 MITM 响应体解析，适用于净化网络环境，提升使用体验。
summary_en: This repository offers configuration files and ad-blocking rules for Loon, Surge, Quantumult X, and other proxy tools, including ad removal for apps like Douyin and Weibo, with MITM-based response parsing to enhance browsing experience.

description: ezBookkeeping is an open source, powerful, self-hosted personal finance app that is easy to use.
summary_zh: ezBookkeeping 是一款轻量级自托管个人财务管理应用，支持 Docker 快速部署，具备用户友好的界面和强大的记账功能。支持多语言、多币种、AI 收据识别、数据导入导出（CSV/OFX/QFX 等），并提供图表分析、地理位置标记、双因素认证等高级特性，适用于 Raspberry Pi、NAS 等低资源设备。
summary_en: ezBookkeeping is a lightweight, self-hosted personal finance app with a user-friendly interface and powerful bookkeeping features. It supports Docker deployment, multi-language/currency, AI receipt recognition, data import/export (CSV/OFX/QFX), chart analytics, location tagging, and 2FA, optimized for low-resource devices like Raspberry Pi and NAS.

description: Intelligent adaptive brightness for your external monitors
summary_zh: Lunar 是一款专为 macOS 设计的显示器控制应用，支持通过 DDC/CI 协议直接调节外接显示器亮度、音量、输入源及屏幕方向。其核心亮点包括传感器/同步/位置自适应亮度调节、XDR/HDR 高亮度支持、低于 0% 的暗光模式、App 预设配置及 BlackOut 功能（关闭屏幕同时保留充电、音频等功能），完美兼容 Intel 与 Apple Silicon 芯片。
summary_en: Lunar is a macOS app for controlling external monitors via DDC/CI, enabling hardware-level brightness, volume, input switching, and orientation adjustments. Key features include sensor/sync/location-based adaptive brightness, support for 1000–1600 nits XDR/HDR displays, sub-zero dimming, app-specific presets, and BlackOut mode—preserving charging, audio, and input while turning off screens. Fully compatible with both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs.

description: 💬 Unofficial WeChat client built with React, MobX and Electron.
summary_zh: weweChat 是基于 React、MobX 和 Electron 开发的非官方微信客户端，支持桌面端多平台运行，具备消息防撤回、桌面通知、键盘快捷键、拖拽发送文件、批量消息发送等实用功能，界面现代化且兼容 macOS 窗口毛玻璃效果。
summary_en: weweChat is an unofficial WeChat desktop client built with React, MobX, and Electron. It supports desktop notifications, message recall blocking, keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop file sending, and batch messaging, offering a modern interface with macOS vibrancy effects.

description: ⚡️next-generation personal AI assistant powered by LLM, RAG and agent loops, supporting computer-use, browser-use and coding agent, demo: https://demo.openagentai.org
summary_zh: OpenAgent 是一款开源的企业级 AI 知识库与智能体管理平台，支持 MCP/A2A 协议，集成 ChatGPT、Claude、Llama 等主流大模型，提供带单点登录的管理后台和用户界面，适用于构建私有化 AI 应用与多智能体协作系统。
summary_en: OpenAgent is an open-source enterprise-grade AI knowledge base and agent management platform supporting MCP/A2A protocols. It integrates major LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, and Llama, offering admin UI, user management, and SSO for secure, scalable AI application deployment.

description: Redis-based components for Scrapy.
summary_zh: Scrapy-Redis 是基于 Redis 的分布式爬虫组件，支持多实例共享任务队列与去重，实现高效分布式网页抓取与后处理。提供 Scrapy 即插即用调度器、去重过滤器、Item Pipeline 及基础 Spider，增强爬虫扩展性与并发能力。
summary_en: Scrapy-Redis provides Redis-based distributed components for Scrapy, enabling shared task queues and deduplication across multiple spider instances. It supports distributed crawling, post-processing, and plug-and-play architecture with scheduler, filter, and pipeline components for scalable web scraping.

description: 🎒 飞书  ×（GPT-4 + GPT-4V + DALL·E-3 + Whisper）=  飞一般的工作体验  🚀 语音对话、角色扮演、多话题讨论、图片创作、表格分析、文档导出 🚀
summary_zh: 飞书 × OpenAI 深度集成工具，支持 GPT-4、GPT-4V、DALL·E-3 和 Whisper，提供语音对话、图片生成、表格分析、角色扮演等功能，无缝嵌入飞书生态，支持多场景 AI 工作流，提升企业协作效率。
summary_en: Feishu OpenAI integrates GPT-4, GPT-4V, DALL·E-3, and Whisper into Feishu, enabling voice chat, image generation, table analysis, role-playing, and more. It enhances enterprise collaboration with AI-powered workflows, supporting private deployment, cloud functions, and Docker.

description: 【🔞🔞🔞 内含不适合未成年人阅读的图片】基于我擅长的编程、绘画、写作展开的 AI 探索和总结：StableDiffusion 是一种强大的图像生成模型，能够通过对一张图片进行演化来生成新的图片。ChatGPT 是一个基于 Transformer 的语言生成模型，它能够自动为输入的主题生成合适的文章。而 Github Copilot 是一个智能编程助手，能够加速日常编程活动。
summary_zh: 该项目深入探索了基于编程、绘画与写作的AI应用，涵盖StableDiffusion图像生成、ChatGPT文本创作及GitHub Copilot代码辅助。通过Prompt工程实践，系统解析了AI模型在图像描述、文章构思与代码生成中的交互逻辑，并提出了'Prompt编程'概念，探讨自然语言驱动软件开发的可能性。
summary_en: This project explores AI applications in programming, painting, and writing through StableDiffusion image generation, ChatGPT text creation, and GitHub Copilot code assistance. It systematically analyzes how AI models interact with human input via prompt engineering for image description, article structuring, and code generation, proposing the concept of 'prompt programming' as a bridge between natural language and software development.

description: Red Ink - A one-stop Xiaohongshu image-and-text generator based on the 🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌, "One Sentence, One Image: Generate Xiaohongshu Text and Images."
summary_zh: 红墨是基于🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌的一站式小红书图文生成器，支持一句话生成完整图文内容，包含智能大纲、封面页和内容页批量生成。采用Python Flask后端与Vue 3前端，支持Docker一键部署，集成Gemini 3文案与图片生成能力，提供可视化配置界面。
summary_en: RedInk is a one-stop Xiaohongshu image-and-text generator powered by 🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌, enabling instant creation of complete posts from a single sentence. It features AI-driven outline generation, cover page design, and batch content creation. Built with Python Flask backend and Vue 3 frontend, it supports Docker deployment and integrates Gemini 3 for text and image generation with a user-friendly web interface.

description: 输入SQL，输出索引优化建议
summary_zh: SQLAdvisor 是美团点评 DBA 团队开发的 SQL 索引优化工具，基于 MySQL 词法解析分析 WHERE、JOIN 等条件，智能生成索引优化建议。已在内部广泛应用，支持开源协作与持续迭代，提供完整文档与社区支持。
summary_en: SQLAdvisor is an index optimization tool developed by Meituan-Dianping's DBA team, analyzing SQL queries via MySQL's native lexer to generate intelligent index suggestions based on WHERE, JOIN, and aggregation conditions. Widely used internally, it supports open-source collaboration with comprehensive documentation and community feedback channels.

description: Django app for handling the server headers required for Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS)
summary_zh: django-cors-headers 是一个 Django 应用，用于自动为响应添加跨域资源共享（CORS）头，支持灵活配置允许的源、方法和头部，适用于前后端分离架构中安全地允许跨域请求。
summary_en: django-cors-headers is a Django app that automatically adds Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) headers to responses, enabling secure cross-origin requests from browsers with configurable origins, methods, and headers.

description: Postcat 是一个可扩展的 API 工具平台。集合基础的 API 管理和测试功能，并且可以通过插件简化你的 API 开发工作，让你可以更快更好地创建 API。An extensible API tool.
summary_zh: Postcat 是一个开源、跨平台的 API 开发测试工具，支持 REST 和 WebSocket 协议，具备 API 管理、测试、Mock 及团队协作功能。通过插件系统实现功能扩展，提供多语言界面与自定义主题，适用于中小团队快速构建和验证 API。
summary_en: Postcat is an open-source, cross-platform API development and testing tool supporting REST and WebSocket protocols. It offers API management, testing, Mock, team collaboration, and extensibility via plugins. With customizable themes and multi-language support, it enables efficient API creation and validation for small to medium teams.

description: Python package for doing RPA
summary_zh: RPA for Python 是一个强大的自动化工具包，提供简洁的 API 实现网页、桌面应用及 OCR 流程的自动化，支持跨平台运行，适用于重复性任务的高效处理，显著提升工作效率。
summary_en: RPA for Python is a powerful automation toolkit offering a simple API to automate web, desktop, and OCR workflows across platforms, enabling efficient handling of repetitive tasks with minimal code.

description: A jQuery UI theme based on Twitter Bootstrap
summary_zh: jQuery UI Bootstrap 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap 设计的 jQuery UI 主题，旨在让 jQuery UI 组件与 Bootstrap 风格无缝融合。它支持与 Bootstrap 共存，并提供现代化外观，同时兼容 jQuery UI 1.9.2/1.10.3 及现代浏览器。项目处于活跃开发中，目标是实现 Bootstrap 3.x 兼容性，欢迎社区贡献。
summary_en: jQuery UI Bootstrap is a theme for jQuery UI widgets inspired by Twitter Bootstrap's design, enabling visual consistency between Bootstrap and jQuery UI components. It supports coexistence with Bootstrap CSS and targets jQuery UI 1.9.2/1.10.3. The project is actively developed with goals to achieve Bootstrap 3.x compatibility and welcomes contributors.

description: The go-to web for your AI coding agent — local-first search, fetch, crawl & research over MCP. No API keys, no cloud, $0/query. Public beta.
summary_zh: wigolo 是一款本地优先的 AI 智能体网页情报 MCP 服务器，为 AI 编程助手提供搜索、抓取、爬取及自主研究能力。它完全运行于本地（~/.wigolo/），无需 API 密钥或云服务，实现零成本查询，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流工具，是 AI 时代替代传统付费搜索 API 的隐私保护方案。
summary_en: wigolo is a local-first MCP server delivering web intelligence for AI coding agents. It provides search, fetch, crawl, and autonomous research capabilities entirely on-device without API keys or cloud services. Supporting Claude Code, Cursor, and other major tools, it offers a privacy-focused, zero-cost alternative to metered search APIs.

description: Bento, the office suite that fits in a file
summary_zh: Bento 是一款单文件演示文稿工具，将编辑器、查看器和动画引擎全部封装在一个约 560KB 的 HTML 文件中。它采用纯 JSON 数据结构，实现本地优先、离线可用，支持端到端加密的实时协作与 AI 智能体直接编辑，是 PowerPoint 的轻量级、无云端依赖的替代方案。
summary_en: Bento is a single-file presentation tool that packs an editor, viewer, and animation engine into a ~560KB HTML file. Utilizing a pure JSON data structure, it offers local-first, offline capabilities with E2EE real-time collaboration and native AI agent editing, serving as a lightweight, cloud-free alternative to PowerPoint.

description: CSS library for Instagram filters
summary_zh: CSSgram 是一个基于 Sass 和 CSS 的 Instagram 滤镜库，通过 CSS 伪元素和混合模式为网页图片添加 Instagram 风格滤镜效果，支持 24 种经典滤镜（如 Aden、1977、Brooklyn 等），无需图像处理工具即可实现丰富的视觉风格，适用于现代浏览器（Chrome 43+、Firefox 38+ 等）。
summary_en: CSSgram is a Sass and CSS library that applies Instagram-like filters to images using CSS filters and blend modes via pseudo-elements. It offers 24 presets (e.g., Aden, 1977, Brooklyn) for web-based image styling without manual editing, compatible with modern browsers (Chrome 43+, Firefox 38+, etc.).

description: 中国5级行政区域mysql库
summary_zh: 该仓库提供中国5级行政区域MySQL数据库，涵盖省、市、县、镇、村完整行政层级，包含大陆地区邮政编码及经纬度信息。数据源自国家统计局官网，2023年版本在2020年基础上优化，共758,049条记录，支持高效导入与查询。
summary_en: This repository provides a MySQL database of China's 5-level administrative divisions, including provinces, cities, counties, towns, and villages, with postal codes and coordinates for mainland China. Data sourced from the National Bureau of Statistics, the 2023 version refines the 2020 dataset, totaling 758,049 records, optimized for fast import and querying.

description: Python PDF Parser (Not actively maintained). Check out pdfminer.six.
summary_zh: PDFMiner 是一个用于从 PDF 文档中提取文本和布局信息的纯 Python 工具，支持 PDF-1.7 格式及多种字体类型，具备自动排版分析、加密文档处理、CJK 语言支持等功能，可将 PDF 转换为文本、HTML、XML 等格式，并提供命令行工具与调试接口。
summary_en: PDFMiner is a pure Python tool for extracting text and layout information from PDF documents, supporting PDF-1.7, various fonts, encryption, and CJK languages. It enables conversion to text, HTML, XML, and provides detailed layout analysis via command-line tools. Note: This project is no longer actively maintained.

description: Kode CLI — Design for post-human workflows. One unit agent for every human & computer task.
summary_zh: Kode CLI 是一款面向后人类工作流的终端 AI 编程助手，支持 AGENTS.md 标准，可自动理解代码库、编辑文件、执行命令并管理完整工作流。原生支持多平台与 20+ AI 模型，兼容 .claude 旧格式，具备子代理任务编排能力，适用于自动化编码与智能体协作场景。
summary_en: Kode CLI is a terminal-based AI coding assistant designed for post-human workflows. It understands codebases, edits files, runs commands, and manages full development workflows. It natively supports the AGENTS.md standard, is compatible with 20+ AI models, and enables autonomous task orchestration via subagents.

description: Your Friendly Open-Source Gen-AI Platform
summary_zh: Pollinations.ai 是一个开源生成式 AI 平台，提供免费的文本到图像、音频、视频和文本生成 API，支持多种模型如 Stable Diffusion 和 Llama。开发者可通过简单 API 调用快速集成 AI 能力，适用于创意项目、应用开发和自动化内容生成，社区活跃且持续扩展应用场景。
summary_en: Pollinations.ai is an open-source generative AI platform offering free APIs for text-to-image, audio, video, and text generation using models like Stable Diffusion and Llama. It enables developers to integrate AI capabilities via simple API calls, supporting creative projects, app development, and automated content creation with an active community and growing ecosystem.

description: 微信公共平台消息接口服务中间件
summary_zh: Node.js 微信公众平台消息接口中间件，支持文本、图片、语音、视频、音乐、图文等多种自动回复，提供会话管理和多客服转发功能，适用于公众号开发快速集成消息处理逻辑。
summary_en: A Node.js middleware for WeChat Official Platform message interface, supporting automatic replies (text, image, voice, video, music, news), session management, and customer service transfer, enabling rapid integration of message handling logic for official accounts.

description: Go/React开发的端到端webrtc的文件传输/文字传输/桌面共享，安全，隐私，数据不经过服务器。
summary_zh: 基于Go/React和WebRTC的端到端P2P文件传输工具，支持文件、文字传输及桌面共享，数据直连不经过服务器，具备端到端加密、响应式设计和Docker一键部署能力。
summary_en: A secure, privacy-focused P2P file transfer tool built with Go/React and WebRTC, enabling direct file, text, and desktop sharing without server relay, featuring end-to-end encryption, responsive design, and Docker deployment.

summary_zh: HumanLayer 提供的 Claude Code 技能集合，涵盖指令优化、React 类型收窄、Agentic 迭代循环构建与 GitHub Actions 自动化等工作流辅助能力，显著提升开发者编程效率与代码质量。
summary_en: A collection of Claude Code skills from HumanLayer, featuring instruction optimization, React prop narrowing, agentic loop automation, and GitHub Actions integration to boost developer productivity and code quality.

description: 【编程随想】收藏的开源项目清单
summary_zh: 编程随想维护的开源项目收藏清单，涵盖C/C++和Python两大语言的技术库与示例代码，聚焦程序员实用工具与学习资源，便于快速检索与参考。
summary_en: A curated collection of open-source projects by Programthink, featuring code libraries and examples in C/C++ and Python, designed for developers to quickly access practical tools and learning resources.

description: iFlow cli is a comprehensive command-line intelligence that embeds in your terminal, analyzes your repositories, does coding tasks, interprets your needs across contexts, and boosts efficiency by performing tasks from simple file operations to complex workflow automation.
summary_zh: iFlow CLI 是一款终端内嵌的 AI 智能助手，支持自然语言交互、代码仓库分析、多模态输入及复杂工作流自动化。集成 iFlow 开放市场，一键安装 MCP 工具与子代理，提供免费版多模态模型（如 Kimi K2、Qwen3 Coder）支持，具备计划模式、任务压缩、插件扩展等高级功能，显著提升开发效率。
summary_en: iFlow CLI is an AI-powered terminal assistant that analyzes codebases, executes coding tasks, and automates workflows via natural language. It integrates free multimodal models (e.g., Kimi K2, Qwen3 Coder), supports SubAgents and MCP tools from its Open Market, and offers advanced features like plan mode, context compression, and plugin support for enhanced developer productivity.

description: Warcraft III Peon voice notifications (+ more!) for Claude Code, Codex, IDEs, and any AI agent. Stop babysitting your terminal. Employ a Peon today.
summary_zh: peon-ping 是一款为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf 等）提供 Warcraft III 等游戏角色语音通知的开源工具，支持多平台（macOS/Linux/Windows/WSL2）。通过语音和屏幕横幅提醒开发者任务完成或需要交互，避免终端监控中断工作流，同时支持自定义音效包和 MCP 集成。
summary_en: peon-ping is an open-source tool that delivers Warcraft III and other game character voice notifications to AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It alerts users via audio and on-screen banners when tasks complete or require attention, eliminating constant terminal monitoring. Supports cross-platform use, custom sound packs, and MCP integration.

description: Kode Agent — Design for post-human workflows. One unit agent for every human & computer task.
summary_zh: Kode 是一个终端中的强大 AI 编程助手，支持 AGENTS.md 标准，可理解代码库、编辑文件、执行命令并自动化完整工作流程。它兼容 Claude 的 .claude 格式，提供 YOLO 模式（默认）和安全的权限检查模式，支持 20+ AI 模型，具备原生二进制分发能力，注重隐私且无默认遥测。
summary_en: Kode is a powerful AI coding assistant in your terminal that understands codebases, edits files, runs commands, and automates workflows.
