It supports the AGENTS.md standard, is compatible with .claude formats, offers YOLO and safe modes, works with 20+ AI models, and features native binary distribution with privacy-first design and no telemetry by default.

description: ReactiveX for Python
summary_zh: RxPY 是一个基于 Python 的 ReactiveX 实现，支持响应式编程范式，提供超过 120 个操作符和 1300+ 单元测试，支持异步事件流处理、可观察序列操作及调度器管理，兼容 Python 3.9+，适用于构建高并发、事件驱动型应用。
summary_en: RxPY is a ReactiveX implementation for Python, enabling reactive programming with over 120 operators and 1300+ unit tests. It supports asynchronous event streams, observable sequences, and schedulers, designed for building concurrent, event-driven applications in Python 3.9+.

description: Wrappers for JavaScript alert(), confirm() and other flexible dialogs using Twitter's bootstrap framework
summary_zh: Bootbox 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap 框架的 JavaScript 对话框封装库，提供简洁易用的 alert()、confirm() 等弹窗接口，支持高度定制化与响应式设计，适用于现代 Web 应用的用户交互场景。
summary_en: Bootbox is a JavaScript library that wraps native alert(), confirm(), and other dialog functions using Twitter's Bootstrap framework, offering customizable, responsive modal dialogs for modern web applications.

description: Learn python3 in one picture.
summary_zh: 本项目通过一张图片全面展示 Python3 核心语法与特性，涵盖数据类型、流程控制、函数、类、模块等关键内容，辅以 IPython Notebook 交互版本，适合快速入门与参考。
summary_en: This project presents a comprehensive one-page visual guide to Python 3 syntax and features, including data types, control flow, functions, classes, and modules, with an interactive IPython Notebook version for easy learning and reference.

description: Repo for BenCao [original name: HuaTuo (华驼)], Instruction-tuning Large Language Models with Chinese Medical Knowledge. 本草（原名：华驼）模型仓库，基于中文医学知识的大语言模型指令微调
summary_zh: 本草（原名华驼）开源基于中文医学知识指令微调的LLaMA、Alpaca-Chinese、Bloom、活字等模型，采用LoRA方法在医学知识库与文献数据上训练，显著提升医疗问答效果，支持多基模型适配与推理部署。
summary_en: BenTsao (formerly HuaTuo) is an open-source collection of instruction-tuned large language models including LLaMA, Alpaca-Chinese, Bloom, and Huozi, fine-tuned on Chinese medical knowledge using LoRA. It enhances medical Q&A performance across multiple base models with support for inference deployment.

description: Python QR Code image generator
summary_zh: 纯 Python 编写的 QR 码生成库，支持生成 PNG、SVG 等格式图像，提供命令行工具和 Python API。可自定义尺寸、颜色、纠错等级等参数，适用于快速生成二维码并集成到自动化流程中。
summary_en: A pure Python library for generating QR codes, supporting PNG, SVG, and console output. Offers command-line interface and Python API with customizable parameters like size, colors, and error correction levels, ideal for automation and integration.

description: Self-hosted webscraper.
summary_zh: Scraperr 是一款强大的自托管网页爬虫解决方案，支持无代码配置、XPath精准提取、多任务队列管理、媒体下载及结果可视化导出，适用于数据采集与自动化分析场景。
summary_en: Scraperr is a powerful self-hosted web scraping tool enabling code-free configuration, XPath-based extraction, queue management, media downloads, and structured data export, ideal for automated data collection and analysis.

description: 🚀 KIMI AI 长文本大模型逆向API【特长：长文本解读整理】，支持高速流式输出、智能体对话、联网搜索、探索版、K1思考模型、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
summary_zh: KIMI AI 长文本大模型逆向API，支持高速流式输出、多轮对话、联网搜索、智能体对话、长文档解读及图像解析，零配置部署，兼容ChatGPT接口，支持多路token轮询与自动会话清理，仅供测试用途。
summary_en: KIMI AI long-text LLM reverse API supporting high-speed streaming, multi-turn dialogue, web search, agent conversations, document interpretation, and image parsing. Zero-config deployment, ChatGPT-compatible interface, multi-token support, and automatic session cleanup. For testing only.

description: AI coding platform for teams
summary_zh: MonkeyCode 是一款企业级 AI 编程助手，专为研发协作与管理场景设计，支持私有化部署与本地大模型接入，提供 IDE 对话式编程、代码补全、安全扫描及 Git 平台机器人能力，内置企业级管理面板用于审计管控与资源统一调度，兼顾效率与代码安全。
summary_en: MonkeyCode is an enterprise-grade AI programming assistant designed for R&D collaboration and management. It supports private deployment, local LLM integration, and offline usage, offering IDE-based coding, intelligent completions, security scanning, Git platform bots, and a management panel for auditing, compliance, and centralized model usage control.

description: Making AJAX as easy as anchor tags
summary_zh: Intercooler 是一个轻量级（6.74KB gzipped）的 AJAX 增强库，通过 HTML 属性即可实现类似锚标签的异步交互。它支持事件触发、进度指示、RESTful 依赖、AJAX 历史记录等功能，无需编写 JavaScript 即可构建现代 Web 应用，适用于渐进式增强现有项目。
summary_en: Intercooler is a lightweight (6.74KB gzipped) library that enables AJAX functionality using HTML attributes, similar to anchor tags. It supports event triggers, progress indicators, RESTful dependencies, AJAX history, and more, allowing developers to build modern web apps with minimal JavaScript, ideal for incremental enhancement of existing applications.

description: 查看被删的微信好友
summary_zh: 该项目通过微信网页版接口检测被删除好友，原理为新建群组测试好友是否可添加。因接口存在人数限制及微信策略变更，已无法正常使用。推荐替代方案包括网页版微信API及Electron桌面客户端，支持Python、Go、Node.js等多语言实现。
summary_en: This project detects WeChat users who deleted you by creating group tests via the web interface. It is now unusable due to API rate limits and policy changes. Alternatives include web-based WeChat APIs and Electron desktop clients, with implementations in Python, Go, and Node.js.

description: cursor IDE enjoy VIP
summary_zh: cursor-vip 是一个通过共享方式解锁 Cursor IDE 付费 VIP 功能的工具，支持多语言配置与代理模式。它提供稳定的 Claude 模型访问，通过脚本或二进制文件快速部署，适用于开发者绕过区域限制使用高级 AI 编程功能，但稳定性不及官方版本。
summary_en: cursor-vip is a tool that unlocks Cursor IDE's paid VIP features via shared access, supporting multi-language configuration and proxy modes. It offers stable Claude model access, easy deployment via scripts or binaries, and enables developers to use advanced AI coding features despite regional payment restrictions, though with lower stability than the official version.

description: Drop-in replacement of Django admin comes with lots of goodies, fully extensible with plugin support, pretty UI based on Twitter Bootstrap.
summary_zh: xadmin 是 Django 管理后台的现代化替代方案，基于 Twitter Bootstrap 提供美观 UI，支持插件扩展、数据导出（XLS/CSV/XML/JSON）、仪表盘、书签等功能，兼容 Django 1.9+，适合快速构建企业级后台管理系统。
summary_en: xadmin is a modern drop-in replacement for Django admin with a Bootstrap-based UI, extensible plugin system, data export (XLS/CSV/XML/JSON), dashboard widgets, and bookmarking. Compatible with Django 1.9+, ideal for building enterprise-grade admin interfaces.

description: Collection of China illegal cases about web crawler 本项目用来整理所有中国大陆爬虫开发者涉诉与违规相关的新闻、资料与法律法规。致力于帮助在中国大陆工作的爬虫行业从业者了解我国相关法律，避免触碰数据合规红线。
summary_zh: 本项目系统整理中国大陆爬虫开发者违法违规案例，涵盖隐私数据抓取、商业数据侵权、验证码破解服务等场景，并解析《刑法》《网络安全法》等法律条文，为从业者提供合规指引，避免触碰数据安全与个人信息保护的法律红线。
summary_en: This project compiles Chinese web crawler violation cases involving illegal data collection, commercial infringement, and unauthorized access. It analyzes relevant laws including the Criminal Law and Cybersecurity Law to guide practitioners in avoiding legal risks related to data compliance and personal information protection.

description: 手绘风格编号画廊与双语提示词 Skill
summary_zh: 整合324种手绘风格、161种排版图型与36种主题色的AI生图提示词库。通过编号精准控制画风与构图，支持智能推荐与精准指定双模式，一键生成中英双语提示词，适配小红书、公众号、条漫等多场景创作。
summary_en: A curated AI image generation prompt library featuring 324 hand-drawn styles, 161 layout templates, and 36 classic color themes. Generate precise bilingual prompts through numbered style codes with smart recommendation and precise selection modes, ideal for social media content, comics, and visual design.

description: Use any LLMs (Large Language Models) for Deep Research. Support SSE API and MCP server.
summary_zh: Deep Research 是一个基于 AI 的极速深度研究工具，支持多 LLM 模型（如 Gemini、OpenAI、Anthropic 等）和主流搜索引擎，可在约 2 分钟内生成高质量研究报告。采用 Thinking 与 Task 模型协同工作，支持本地知识库构建、知识图谱可视化、内容编辑与历史记录管理，所有数据均本地处理，保障隐私安全。
summary_en: Deep Research is an AI-powered tool for lightning-fast in-depth research, supporting multiple LLMs (e.g., Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic) and search engines. It generates comprehensive reports in ~2 minutes using Thinking and Task models, with local knowledge base, knowledge graph, content editing, and full privacy via on-device processing.

description: 专注批量推送的小而美的工具，目前支持：模板消息-公众号、模板消息-小程序、微信客服消息、微信企业号/企业微信消息、阿里云短信、阿里大于模板短信 、腾讯云短信、云片网短信、E-Mail、HTTP请求、钉钉、华为云短信、百度云短信、又拍云短信、七牛云短信
summary_zh: WePush 是一款专注于批量消息推送的轻量级工具，支持微信公众号、小程序、企业微信、短信平台（阿里云、腾讯云等）及邮件等多种渠道。具备变量消息、定时推送、用户导入、多账号管理等功能，提供可视化界面与推送历史管理，适用于营销通知、系统告警等场景。
summary_en: WePush is a lightweight tool for bulk message pushing, supporting WeChat official accounts, mini-programs, enterprise accounts, SMS platforms (e.g., Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud), and email. It offers variable messaging, scheduled delivery, user import, multi-account management, and a user-friendly GUI, ideal for marketing alerts and system notifications.

description: A generic system for filtering Django QuerySets based on user selections
summary_zh: Django-filter 是一个用于在 Django 中基于用户选择动态过滤 QuerySet 的通用应用，支持通过 URL 参数生成类似 admin 的筛选界面，提供类似 ModelForms 的声明式 API，并深度集成 Django REST Framework，适用于构建灵活的数据筛选接口。
summary_en: Django-filter is a reusable Django application that enables declarative dynamic QuerySet filtering via URL parameters, offering an API similar to ModelForms. It supports admin-like filtering interfaces and integrates seamlessly with Django REST Framework for building flexible data filtering endpoints.

description: Bootstrap components built with Vue.js
summary_zh: VueStrap 是一个基于 Vue.js 和 Bootstrap 3 构建的原生组件库，提供无需 jQuery 依赖的轻量级 UI 解决方案。现已停止维护，推荐使用功能更完善的替代方案 BootstrapVue 或 uiv。
summary_en: VueStrap is a native Vue.js component library built on Bootstrap 3, offering jQuery-free UI components. It is no longer maintained; users are advised to migrate to BootstrapVue or uiv for enhanced features and accessibility.

description: WeRoBot 是一个微信公众号开发框架
summary_zh: WeRoBot 是一个基于 Python 的微信公众号开发框架，采用 MIT 协议开源。它提供简洁的装饰器语法处理消息事件，支持文本、图片、事件等交互类型，内置消息解析、签名校验和自动回复功能，极大简化微信公众号后端开发流程。
summary_en: WeRoBot is a Python-based WeChat Official Account development framework licensed under MIT. It offers a clean decorator syntax for handling message events like text, images, and events, with built-in message parsing, signature verification, and auto-reply capabilities, streamlining backend development for WeChat Official Accounts.

description: Collection of China illegal cases about web crawler 本项目用来整理所有中国大陆爬虫开发者涉诉与违规相关的新闻、资料与法律法规。致力于帮助在中国大陆工作的爬虫行业从业者了解我国相关法律，避免触碰数据合规红线。 [AD]企业租显卡算力部署AI请选Novagrid
summary_zh: 本项目系统整理中国大陆爬虫开发者违法违规案例，涵盖隐私数据抓取、商业数据侵权、验证码破解服务等五大禁区，并附相关法律法规解读与律师观点，旨在警示从业者遵守数据合规要求，规避法律风险。
summary_en: This project compiles illegal cases involving Chinese web crawler developers, covering five major violation zones such as privacy data scraping and commercial data infringement. It includes legal regulations and expert opinions to help practitioners comply with data compliance and avoid legal risks.

description: 中文网页重设与排版 CSS，面向现代中文阅读优化字体、行高、CJK 断行、中西文间距与着重号。
summary_zh: typo.css 是一个专为中文网页设计的样式重置与排版工具，旨在统一浏览器渲染差异，优化中文阅读体验。它提供完整的 reset 样式、阅读内容排版类 `.typo` 及专名号、着重号等中文排版增强功能，支持桌面与移动端，适用于文章、文档等长文本场景。
summary_en: typo.css is a CSS framework designed for Chinese web typography, aiming to standardize browser rendering and optimize readability. It offers a complete reset, a `.typo` class for article layouts, and enhancements like underlines for proper nouns and emphasis marks, supporting both desktop and mobile platforms.

description: A light and plugable JavaScript library for integrated 2D/3D maps.
summary_zh: maptalks-gl 是一个基于 WebGL 和 WebGPU 驱动的全新地图引擎，专为高性能 2D/3D 地图可视化而设计。支持矢量切片、3DTiles 和 GLTF 格式，提供丰富的 3D 分析功能与交通模拟动画，兼容旧版 maptalks API，便于迁移。
summary_en: maptalks-gl is a WebGL and WebGPU-driven map engine for high-performance 2D/3D mapping. It supports vector tiles, 3DTiles, and GLTF formats, offering advanced 3D analysis and traffic simulation. With backward-compatible APIs, it enables seamless migration from legacy maptalks.

description: Your agents don’t hand off the work. Kungfu keeps the same Work moving across Codex, Claude, OpenCode, and your own execution surface.
summary_zh: Kungfu 是一款面向 AI 智能体的连续性保障框架，旨在解决会话结束后工作丢失的痛点。它通过声明式项目源管理上下文，使智能体在重启或切换时无需重复解释即可无缝续接任务，并保留完整的决策证据与行动边界。
summary_en: Kungfu is a continuity framework for AI agents, designed to prevent work loss when chats end. It manages context from declared project sources, allowing agents to seamlessly resume tasks across restarts or handoffs without re-explaining, preserving decision evidence and action boundaries.

description: 这是一个Android系统TTS应用，内置微软演示接口，可自定义HTTP请求，可导入其他本地TTS引擎，以及根据中文双引号的简单旁白/对话识别朗读 ，还有自动重试，备用配置，文本替换等更多功能。
summary_zh: TTS Server 是一款专为 Android 设计的文本转语音应用，集成微软演示接口，支持自定义 HTTP 请求、本地 TTS 引擎导入及基于中文双引号的智能旁白识别朗读，具备自动重试、备用配置和文本替换等高级功能，适用于多场景语音合成需求。
summary_en: TTS Server is an Android-based text-to-speech application featuring Microsoft demo interface integration, customizable HTTP requests, local TTS engine support, and smart narration recognition via Chinese quotation marks. It includes advanced features like auto-retry, fallback configurations, and text replacement for versatile speech synthesis.

description: ⚡️AI Cloud OS: Open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP (model-context-protocol)/A2A (agent-to-agent) management platform with admin UI, user management and Single-Sign-On⚡️, supports ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, HuggingFace, etc., chat bot demo: https://ai.casibase.com, admin UI demo: https://ai-admin.casibase.com
summary_zh: Casibase 是一个开源企业级 AI 知识库与 MCP/A2A 管理平台，提供管理员界面、用户管理及单点登录功能，支持 ChatGPT、Claude、Llama、Ollama 等多种模型，具备完整的知识库管理、智能对话和 Agent 协作能力。
summary_en: Casibase is an open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP/A2A management platform featuring admin UI, user management, and SSO, supporting ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, and more, with full knowledge management and agent collaboration capabilities.

summary_zh: ShadowsocksR for Windows 是一款基于 ShadowsocksR 协议的跨平台代理工具，专为绕过网络审查设计。支持多服务器配置、系统级代理、PAC自动更新及UDP流量转发，提供完整的隐私保护和网络访问解决方案。
summary_en: ShadowsocksR for Windows is a cross-platform proxy tool based on the ShadowsocksR protocol, designed to bypass internet censorship. It supports multiple server configurations, system-wide proxy, automatic PAC updates, and UDP forwarding, offering comprehensive privacy protection and network access.

description: Lightweight CSS framework
summary_zh: MUI 是一个轻量级 CSS 框架，严格遵循 Google 的 Material Design 设计规范，提供响应式网格系统、无依赖组件和邮件样式支持，核心优势在于极小的体积（CSS 6.6KB，JS 5.4KB）和高度可定制性，适合快速构建现代化网页界面。
summary_en: MUI is a lightweight CSS framework adhering to Google's Material Design guidelines, offering a responsive grid, zero dependencies, customizable styling, and email support. Key strengths include minimal footprint (6.6KB CSS, 5.4KB JS gzipped) and async JS loading for fast, modern web development.

description: Telegram Bot API server
summary_zh: Telegram Bot API官方服务器实现，支持本地自托管部署。提供完整Bot API HTTP接口，支持无限制文件下载、2000MB大文件上传、自定义Webhook地址与端口。适用于高并发场景、数据隐私保护及绕过官方API限制的企业级应用。
summary_en: Official Telegram Bot API server implementation supporting self-hosted deployment. Provides complete Bot API HTTP interface with unlimited file downloads, 2000MB upload support, and custom webhook configuration. Ideal for high-concurrency scenarios, data privacy protection, and enterprise applications requiring API customization.

description: 拼多多、千牛、抖店 AI 客服机器人：自动回复客户咨询、商品答疑、售后申诉处理，支持微信、小红书、京东、抖音、B站、微博等多平台统一接待；可接入 DeepSeek / 通义千问 等大模型，支持自有知识库定制。
summary_zh: 金销数据云智能客服是基于大语言模型的专业电商SaaS解决方案，支持微信、拼多多、千牛、抖音、小红书等10+主流平台接入，具备文本/语音/图片处理能力，支持自有知识库定制与插件扩展，提供多维度数据分析与意图识别功能。
summary_en: JinXiao Data Cloud AI Customer Service is a professional e-commerce SaaS solution powered by large language models, supporting integration with 10+ mainstream platforms including WeChat, Pinduoduo, Qianniu, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, with capabilities for text/voice/image processing, custom knowledge base configuration, plugin ecosystem, and multi-dimensional data analytics including intent recognition.

description: Quick and easy product tours with Twitter Bootstrap Popovers
summary_zh: Bootstrap Tour 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap Popovers 的快速易用的产品引导工具，专为构建交互式用户引导流程设计。支持 Bootstrap 2.3.0+ 版本，提供灵活的 API 和丰富的配置选项，适用于提升用户体验和引导新用户。
summary_en: Bootstrap Tour is a quick and easy product tour library built on Twitter Bootstrap Popovers, designed to create interactive onboarding experiences. Compatible with Bootstrap >= 2.3.0, it offers a flexible API and extensive configuration options for guiding users through applications.

description: Enable Apple Intelligence on Macs sold in Mainland China with SIP enabled, for version between  MacOS 15.4.1+ and 26.5 beta3
summary_zh: 本工具通过修改系统缓存文件及注入eligibiltyd进程，绕过Apple对Apple Intelligence在中国销售Mac上的区域限制，支持macOS 15.4+及26.1+，无需常驻后台服务。提供方法1（lldb注入+文件锁定）和方法2（直接修改plist）两种方案，新增强制修改地区为美国功能以解锁ChatGPT整合等高级特性，适用于M1及以上芯片设备。
summary_en: This tool enables Apple Intelligence on Macs sold in Mainland China by bypassing regional restrictions via system cache modification and eligibilityd process injection, tested on macOS 15.4+ and 26.1+. It requires no persistent background services and offers two methods: Method 1 (lldb injection + file locking) and Method 2 (direct plist editing), with an added option to force region change to US for advanced features like ChatGPT integration, compatible with M1+ chips.

description: WeChat SDK for Python
summary_zh: WeChatpy 是一个功能完整的微信公众平台第三方 Python SDK，支持普通公众平台被动响应、企业微信、微信支付、第三方平台代调用及小程序云开发等核心 API 集成，提供简洁易用的接口封装，适用于快速构建微信生态应用。
summary_en: WeChatpy is a comprehensive third-party Python SDK for the WeChat public platform, supporting core APIs such as passive response, enterprise WeChat, WeChat Pay, third-party proxy calls, and mini-program cloud development, offering a clean interface for rapid integration into WeChat ecosystem applications.

description: IPProxyPool代理池项目，提供代理ip
summary_zh: IPProxyPool是一个开源代理IP池项目，支持Python 2/3，提供高匿、匿名和透明代理IP抓取与验证服务。通过多线程爬虫自动采集代理源，结合评分机制筛选可用IP，支持HTTP/HTTPS协议及国内外地域过滤。项目采用SQLite默认数据库，可扩展至MySQL、MongoDB等，并提供RESTful API供外部调用，适用于爬虫、数据采集等场景。
summary_en: IPProxyPool is an open-source proxy IP pool project supporting Python 2/3, offering automated collection and validation of anonymous, high-anonymity, and transparent proxy IPs. It uses multi-threaded crawlers to gather proxies from multiple sources, filters them via a scoring system, and supports HTTP/HTTPS protocols with geographic filtering. Built on SQLAlchemy ORM, it defaults to SQLite but can be extended to MySQL or MongoDB. A RESTful API enables external access for use in web scraping and data collection applications.

description: Multi-Platform Live Stream Automatic Recording Tool | 多平台直播流自动录制客户端 · 基于FFmpeg · 支持监控/定时/转码
summary_zh: StreamCap 是一款基于 FFmpeg 的多平台直播流自动录制工具，支持 40+ 国内外主流直播平台（如抖音、B站、Twitch、TikTok），具备循环监控、定时录制、批量任务管理和自动转码功能，提供 Windows/macOS/Linux/Web 全平台支持，适用于内容存档与直播数据分析。
summary_en: StreamCap is a multi-platform live stream recording tool powered by FFmpeg and StreamGet, supporting 40+ global platforms (e.g., Douyin, Bilibili, Twitch, TikTok). It features real-time monitoring, scheduled recording, batch processing, and automatic transcoding, with full support for Windows, macOS, Linux, and web deployment for content archiving and live data analysis.

description: Run Claude Design locally as an Agent Skill — Cursor, Claude Code & more. Produce polished UI mockups, prototypes, decks & wireframes as self-contained HTML, without claude.ai/design. Best with Opus or Claude.
summary_zh: baoyu-design 将 Claude Design 设计引擎封装为本地 Agent Skill，可在 Cursor、Claude Code 等编码 Agent 中直接生成高质量 UI 原型、线框图、落地页、仪表盘和演示文稿，输出为自包含 HTML。无需访问 claude.ai/design 网站，支持 Opus 4.8 获得最佳效果，通过 localhost 预览实现可视化迭代编辑。
summary_en: baoyu-design packages the Claude Design engine as a portable Agent Skill, enabling local coding agents like Cursor and Claude Code to generate polished UI mockups, prototypes, wireframes, landing pages, dashboards, and slide decks as self-contained HTML. No website or subscription needed—everything runs locally with tight visual iteration via localhost preview, best paired with Opus 4.8.

description: A Python implementation of John Gruber’s Markdown with Extension support.
summary_zh: Python-Markdown 是 Python 实现的 John Gruber 官方 Markdown 语法解析器，高度兼容参考实现，支持扩展机制，提供简洁的 API 将 Markdown 文本转换为标准 HTML，广泛用于文档生成、静态站点构建和内容管理系统。
summary_en: Python-Markdown is a Python implementation of John Gruber's Markdown, nearly fully compliant with the reference implementation. It supports extensible syntax via plugins, offering a clean API to convert Markdown text into HTML, widely used in documentation, static site generation, and content management systems.

description: ⭐This is a lightweight kit for generating astrolabes for Zi Wei Dou Shu (The Purple Star Astrology), an ancient Chinese astrology. It allows you to obtain your horoscope and personality analysis. 支持多语言轻量级获取紫微斗数排盘信息的javascript开源库。
summary_zh: iztro 是一个轻量级紫微斗数排盘 JavaScript 库，支持多语言输入输出，可生成星盘数据、生肖星座、四柱运限及四化分析，提供链式调用和插件扩展，适用于个人命理分析、文化应用开发及学术研究。
summary_en: iztro is a lightweight JavaScript library for generating Zi Wei Dou Shu astrolabes, supporting multi-language input/output, star charts, zodiac signs, four pillars, luck cycles, and four transformations. It offers chainable APIs, plugin extensibility, and is ideal for astrology apps, cultural tools, and research.

description: ShadowsocksR update rss, SSR organization https://github.com/shadowsocksr
summary_zh: ShadowsocksR C# 版本4.8.0 是一个全能代理工具，支持Socks4/4a/5、HTTP协议，具备节点统计、连接管理、UDP-over-TCP、多重代理及自定义协议插件功能。支持服务器订阅与自动更新，提供GPG签名校验确保安全性，适用于绕过网络限制与隐私保护。
summary_en: ShadowsocksR C# v4.8.0 is a comprehensive proxy tool supporting Socks4/4a/5, HTTP, with features like node statistics, connection management, UDP-over-TCP, multi-hop proxying, and custom protocol plugins. It supports server subscription with GPG signature verification for security, ideal for bypassing censorship and enhancing privacy.

description: High-crafted UI libraries for AI agents: Border beam, Orbs, Metal, Gooey, Voice, Image, Avatar bots
summary_zh: 专为 AI 智能体打造的高品质 React UI 特效库集合，包含 border-beam 动态边框光束、liquid-gooey 液态流体效果和 thinking-orbs 点阵加载动画。支持 React Native 与 SwiftUI 跨平台复用，采用 npm workspaces 多包管理，提供可视化演示站点与 CI 自动化发布流程。
summary_en: High-quality React UI effect libraries tailored for AI agents, featuring animated border beams, liquid morph effects, and dotted orb loaders. Supports cross-platform React Native and SwiftUI ports. Built with npm workspaces for multi-package management, including hot-reload development and automated CI deployment.

description: 👻 A simple & beautiful GUI application for scrcpy.
summary_zh: Scrcpy GUI 是一个简洁美观的图形界面应用，用于便捷控制 Android 设备屏幕。它基于 scrcpy 实现，支持 USB 和无线连接、实时屏幕镜像、键盘鼠标控制、多设备管理、剪贴板共享等功能，无需 Root，跨平台运行，提升手机操作效率。
summary_en: Scrcpy GUI is a simple and beautiful graphical application for controlling Android devices via scrcpy. It supports USB and wireless connections, real-time screen mirroring, keyboard/mouse input, multi-device management, clipboard sharing, and more—without requiring root access. It enhances mobile productivity across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

description: A lightweight Vue.js UI library with a simple API, inspired by Google's Material Design.
summary_zh: Keen UI 是一个轻量级 Vue.js 3 UI 组件库，采用简洁 API 设计，灵感来自 Google Material Design。它专注于交互式 JavaScript 组件，不依赖 CSS 框架，支持自定义主题与尺寸，并提供独立组件打包方案以优化体积。
summary_en: Keen UI is a lightweight Vue.js 3 UI library featuring a simple API inspired by Google's Material Design. It focuses on interactive JavaScript-driven components without bundling CSS frameworks, supports theme and sizing customization, and offers standalone component builds for bundle optimization.

description: React Native入门指南
summary_zh: React Native入门指南，系统讲解从环境搭建到组件开发的全流程，涵盖JSX语法、布局设计、UI组件使用及与原生代码集成，适合初学者快速掌握移动端跨平台开发技能。
summary_en: A comprehensive React Native tutorial covering fundamentals like JSX, layout design, UI components, and native module integration, designed for developers to master cross-platform mobile app development efficiently.

description: Material Design theme for hexo.
summary_zh: Material Theme 是一款专为 Hexo 博客框架设计的纯净 Material Design 风格主题，支持响应式布局和现代化 UI 交互。提供多版本下载（稳定版/开发版/历史版），集成 BrowserStack 浏览器兼容测试与 jsDelivr CDN 加速服务，具备完善的文档与社区支持。
summary_en: Material Theme is a pure Material Design theme for Hexo, featuring responsive layouts and modern UI interactions. It offers multiple download versions (stable/canary/historical), integrates BrowserStack for cross-browser testing, and uses jsDelivr CDN for fast asset delivery, backed by comprehensive documentation and community support.

description: 让 AI 写的中文读起来像一个具体的人在说话。通用创作与改稿 Skill，开箱即用。
summary_zh: 让 AI 写的中文摆脱模型腔，读起来像具体的人在说话。提供开箱即用的写作 Skill，覆盖知乎、公众号、博客、小说等多种场景，内置事实核查、逻辑推进与中文韵律三重把关，附检测脚本与蒸馏版提示词。
summary_en: Eliminates AI-generated Chinese stiffness, making outputs read like a real person speaking. Provides a ready-to-use writing Skill for Zhihu, WeChat articles, blogs, fiction and more, with built-in fact-checking, logical progression and Chinese rhythm controls, plus a detection script and distilled prompt version.

description: Chrome extension & CLI to let agents control your browser. Runs Playwright snippets in a stateful sandbox. Available as CLI or MCP
summary_zh: Playwriter 是一款 Chrome 扩展工具，允许 AI 智能体通过 CLI 或 MCP 协议控制用户浏览器。它直接连接已登录的 Chrome 实例，保留用户会话状态（如 cookies、扩展），避免新建浏览器带来的安全风险和检测问题。核心功能包括 Playwright API 调用、多会话隔离、网络请求拦截、页面调试编辑等，适用于自动化测试、数据采集和智能体交互场景。
summary_en: Playwriter is a Chrome extension enabling AI agents to control your browser via CLI or MCP. It connects directly to your running Chrome instance, preserving logins, extensions, and cookies—avoiding the security risks and detection issues of spawning new browsers. Key features include full Playwright API access, isolated sessions, network interception, page debugging, and live code editing for automation, testing, and agent-driven workflows.

description: 把 Markdown 一键排成可直接粘进公众号编辑器的精致 HTML —— 6 套精选主题 + 主题生成器 + 双关卡校验。An AI-agent skill that turns Markdown into paste-ready WeChat article HTML.
summary_zh: gzh-design-skill 是一款专为 AI Agent 设计的公众号排版工具，能将 Markdown 一键转换为可直接粘贴进微信公众号编辑器的精致 HTML。它提供 6 套精选主题及自定义主题生成器，通过全内联样式与特定标签规避平台过滤，并具备章节编号、关键词标记及双关卡质量校验功能，确保排版的高保真与一致性。
summary_en: gzh-design-skill is an AI-agent skill that converts Markdown into paste-ready WeChat Official Account HTML. It features 6 preset themes and a custom theme generator, utilizing inline styles and specific tags to bypass platform filters. With auto-numbering, keyword marking, and dual-stage quality validation, it ensures high-fidelity, consistent formatting for content creators.

description: Per object permissions for Django
summary_zh: django-guardian 是 Django 的细粒度对象权限管理库，通过扩展 Django 的授权后端实现基于对象的权限控制。支持为单个模型实例分配权限，适用于需要复杂权限模型的应用场景，如多租户系统或内容协作平台。
summary_en: django-guardian is a Django library implementing per-object permissions by extending Django's authorization backend. It enables fine-grained access control at the object level, allowing assignment of permissions to individual model instances—ideal for multi-tenant or collaborative applications requiring complex permission models.

description: WeChat local data CLI with daemon architecture
summary_zh: wx-cli 是一款基于 Rust 开发的本地微信数据命令行工具，支持会话、聊天记录、联系人、群成员、收藏、朋友圈等数据的毫秒级查询与导出。采用守护进程架构实现高效缓存，零依赖安装，支持 YAML/JSON 输出，专为 AI Agent 和开发者设计，数据完全本地化处理，保障隐私安全。
summary_en: wx-cli is a Rust-based CLI tool for querying local WeChat data, including chats, contacts, groups, favorites, and Moments. It features a daemon architecture for millisecond-level response, zero-dependency installation, YAML/JSON output, and full local data processing, making it ideal for AI agents and developers.

description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
summary_zh: Codeg是一款协作式多智能体AI编码工作空间，统一整合Claude Code、Codex、Grok等15+主流AI编程代理。提供桌面应用、自托管服务及Docker部署方案，支持跨平台使用。核心特性包括会话跨代理迁移、任务委托协作、统一对话界面，大幅降低多代理协作门槛。
summary_en: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace unifying 15+ AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Grok. Supports desktop, self-hosted, and Docker deployments across all platforms. Key features include session migration between agents, collaborative task delegation via @mentions, and a unified conversation interface.

description: An unofficial bilibili client for mac
summary_zh: Bilibili Mac Client 是一款非官方哔哩哔哩桌面客户端，基于 mpv 实现硬解播放与 libass 弹幕渲染，支持多视频网站解析、分段视频拼接、弹幕发送与屏蔽、本地视频播放及自定义配置，显著降低 CPU 占用并优化能效表现。
summary_en: An unofficial Bilibili desktop client for macOS, built on mpv with hardware decoding and libass-based danmaku rendering. It supports multi-site video parsing, segmented video stitching, danmaku interaction, local playback, and extensive customization via mpv config, offering superior performance and energy efficiency compared to HTML5 players.

description: 云微WOC，云微信，自由连接
summary_zh: 云微（WechatOnCloud）是一款自托管的微信多端共享解决方案，允许用户在 NAS 或服务器上通过 Docker 运行官方原版微信，并让多个浏览器设备共享同一微信会话。其核心采用 Xvfb 虚拟显示 + KasmVNC 串流技术，配合自研面板实现实例生命周期管理、RBAC 权限控制、文件传输及多端协作软锁，支持 amd64/arm64 架构与 PWA 安装，适用于家庭或团队跨设备统一微信使用场景。
summary_en: WechatOnCloud (WOC) is a self-hosted solution that runs the official WeChat desktop client in Docker containers, enabling multiple browser-based devices to share a single WeChat session. It leverages Xvfb virtual display and KasmVNC streaming, with a custom panel for instance lifecycle management, RBAC permissions, file transfer, and collaborative soft-locking. Supporting amd64/arm64 and PWA, it's ideal for unified cross-device WeChat access in homes or teams.

description: ⚙️ Convert HTML to Markdown. Even works with entire websites and can be extended through rules.
summary_zh: html-to-markdown 是一款强大的 HTML 到 Markdown 转换工具，支持完整网页转换、复杂格式处理、自定义选项和插件扩展。提供 Golang 库、CLI 工具和在线 API 三种使用方式，具备智能转义、表格支持、嵌套列表等高级功能，适用于内容提取、文档转换等场景。
summary_en: html-to-markdown is a robust HTML-to-Markdown converter that transforms entire websites into clean, readable Markdown with support for complex formatting, customizable options, and extensible plugins. It offers a Golang library, CLI tool, and hosted REST API, featuring smart escaping, table conversion, nested lists, and relative-to-absolute link resolution.

description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
summary_zh: Codeg 是一个企业级多智能体编码工作台，统一集成 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等本地 AI 编程助手。支持桌面应用、独立服务器或 Docker 部署，提供浏览器远程访问。核心功能包括对话聚合、Git worktree 并行开发、MCP/Skills 管理、Telegram/Lark 等聊天渠道集成及终端集成，实现全链路工程化开发流程。
summary_en: Codeg is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace that unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container. It enables remote development via any browser with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree workflows, MCP/Skills management, chat channel integration (Telegram, Lark, iLink), and integrated terminal/file/Git workflows.

description: XIAOJUSURVEY is an enterprises form builder and analytics platform that allows users to create questionnaires, exams, polls, quizzes, and analyze data online.
summary_zh: XIAOJUSURVEY 是一套企业级表单构建与数据分析平台，支持问卷、考试、投票等多样化调研场景。基于 Vue3 + NestJS 技术栈，提供 40+ 题型、100+ 模板，具备智能逻辑编排、AI 生成问卷、分题统计与交叉分析能力，支持品牌化定制与多端嵌入，适用于市场调研、客户满意度测评等复杂业务场景。
summary_en: XIAOJUSURVEY is an enterprise-grade form builder and analytics platform enabling creation of questionnaires, exams, polls, and quizzes with online data analysis. Built on Vue3 + NestJS, it offers 40+ question types, 100+ templates, AI-powered survey generation, logic rules, cross-analysis, and brand customization for market research, customer feedback, and educational assessments.

description: Record your screen, ship a demo. Free and open-source, GPU-accelerated, no watermarks, no subscriptions. Windows, macOS, Linux. Actively maintained.
summary_zh: OpenScreen 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制与演示制作工具，作为 Screen Studio 的开源替代方案。支持窗口/全屏录制、自动缩放、光标特效、摄像头画中画、本地 AI 字幕生成及 AI 编辑助手，适用于产品演示、教程视频和社交媒体内容创作，支持 macOS/Windows/Linux 跨平台使用。
summary_en: OpenScreen is a free, open-source screen recording and demo creation tool, positioned as an alternative to Screen Studio. It features window/full-screen recording, auto-zooms, cursor effects, webcam overlay, on-device AI captions, and an AI editing assistant. Ideal for product demos, tutorials, and social media content across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

description: Enhanced MCP server for interactive user feedback and command execution in AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and Desktop Application) with intelligent environment detection and cross-platform compatibility.
summary_zh: MCP Feedback Enhanced 是一个增强型 MCP 服务器，专为 AI 辅助开发设计，支持 Web UI 和跨平台桌面应用双界面，具备智能环境检测与反馈驱动工作流，可显著降低平台成本并提升开发效率。
summary_en: MCP Feedback Enhanced is an enhanced MCP server designed for AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and cross-platform desktop app) with intelligent environment detection and feedback-driven workflows to reduce platform costs and boost development efficiency.

description: A plugin for AI coding agents (Antigravity, Claude Code) enabling Spec-Driven Development to specify, plan, and implement software features.
summary_zh: Conductor 是 Gemini CLI 的扩展工具，通过上下文驱动开发（Context-Driven Development）实现软件功能的规范化生命周期管理。它支持在编码前制定详细规格与执行计划，确保代码质量与团队一致性，适用于新项目和现有项目的智能开发流程管控。
summary_en: Conductor is a Gemini CLI extension enabling Context-Driven Development by managing the full lifecycle of software features—from context setup, spec/plan generation, to safe implementation. It ensures high-quality, team-aligned development with intelligent planning and git-aware reverts.

description: Hold a key, speak, release — AI-polished text appears at your cursor in any app. Open-source voice input for macOS & Windows. (按住快捷键说话，松开即得润色后的文字)
summary_zh: OpenLess 是一款开源的跨平台语音输入工具，支持 macOS 和 Windows。用户按住快捷键说话，松开后即可获得 AI 润色后的文本，并自动插入光标位置或复制到剪贴板。其核心亮点是 AI 提示模式，能将口语化表达转化为结构清晰、上下文丰富的提示词，适用于 ChatGPT、Claude 等 AI 工具，提升输入效率。
summary_en: OpenLess is an open-source, cross-platform voice input app for macOS and Windows. Press a hotkey, speak naturally, and get AI-polished text inserted at your cursor or copied to clipboard. Its standout feature is AI-prompt mode, which transforms rambling speech into structured, context-rich prompts ready for use in ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools.

description: 表白代码收藏馆~谁说程序猿不懂浪漫❤️
summary_zh: Awesome Love Code 是一个创意表白代码集合项目，汇集多种网页表白特效，涵盖动画、交互、音乐等元素，为开发者提供浪漫表白的技术实现方案，展现程序员表达爱意的独特方式。
summary_en: Awesome Love Code is a curated collection of romantic coding projects featuring web-based confession effects with animations, interactions, and music. It showcases how programmers express love through creative technical implementations.

description: 面向 AI Agent 的微信公众号创作与发布 CLI：Markdown 排版、AI 配图、预览与草稿创建；支持由浏览器 Agent 保存知乎、CSDN、头条未发布草稿。
summary_zh: md2wechat 是一款专为 AI 时代设计的公众号创作工具，支持用 Markdown 编写文章并一键转换为精美排版，自动上传至微信草稿箱。提供 43 个高级排版模块、40+ 专业主题、AI 配图及批量发布功能，全流程 CLI 操作，兼容 Claude Code 等智能体，让公众号写作高效如发朋友圈。
summary_en: md2wechat is an AI-native WeChat article creation tool that converts Markdown into beautifully formatted posts and auto-uploads to the draft box. It offers 43 advanced layout modules, 40+ professional themes, AI image generation, and batch publishing via CLI, with native support for agents like Claude Code.

description: LiYing is an automated photo processing program designed for automating the post-processing workflow of ID photos in general photo studios. | LiYing 是一套适用于自动化 完成一般照相馆后期证件照处理流程的照片自动处理的程序。
summary_zh: LiYing 是一款专为照相馆设计的证件照自动化处理程序，支持人体与面部智能识别、角度自动校正、背景色更换、多尺寸裁切及排版。完全离线运行，所有图像处理均在本地完成，适用于单人标准肖像照的批量高效处理。
summary_en: LiYing is an automated photo processing program tailored for photo studios, enabling intelligent human and face detection, automatic angle correction, background replacement, multi-size cropping, and layout. It runs entirely offline with all image processing performed locally, ideal for batch processing standard single-person ID photos.

description: Visual Skills Pack for Obsidian: generate Canvas, Excalidraw, and Mermaid diagrams from text with Claude Code
summary_zh: Obsidian Visual Skills Pack 是一个实验性插件，通过 Claude Code 将文本自动转换为 Excalidraw（手绘风格）、Mermaid（流程图）和 Canvas（彩色卡片布局）三种可视化图表。支持中文文本处理、动画生成及多输出模式，适用于思维导图、流程设计、系统架构等场景，显著提升知识表达效率。
summary_en: The Obsidian Visual Skills Pack is an experimental plugin that uses Claude Code to automatically convert text into three types of visual diagrams: Excalidraw (hand-drawn style), Mermaid (flowcharts), and Canvas (colorful card layout). It supports Chinese text, animations, multiple output modes, and is ideal for mind maps, workflows, and system architecture visualization.

description: 微信4.x数据解密并生成年度总结，高仿微信，实时更新，导出和修改聊天记录，朋友圈，收藏，自动回复等大量便捷功能
summary_zh: 微信4.x数据解密与分析工具，支持聊天记录、朋友圈解密与可视化，提供高仿微信界面的年度总结生成、实时更新、搜索及导出功能，涵盖联系人管理与多消息类型展示。
summary_en: WeChat 4.x data decryption and analysis tool with chat history, Moments decryption, annual summary generation, real-time updates, search, export, and contact management features, featuring a WeChat-like interface.

description: macOS Adobe apps download & installer
summary_zh: Adobe Downloader 是一款专为 macOS 设计的 Adobe 应用程序下载与安装工具，支持多产品并行下载、版本与语言选择，并集成自动化安装与清理功能。通过内置 Helper 机制实现免密操作，无需用户干预即可完成 Setup 组件修改，确保合法官方渠道下载，适用于专业创意软件部署。
summary_en: Adobe Downloader is a macOS-native tool for downloading and installing Adobe applications. It supports parallel downloads, version/language selection, and automated installation via a built-in Helper mechanism that eliminates password prompts. All downloads are from official Adobe sources, with full cleanup utilities for residual files, ideal for enterprise or personal use.

description: A smart, powerful, and beautiful excalidraw drawing tool.Draw Professional Charts with Natural Language
summary_zh: Smart Excalidraw 是一款基于自然语言的专业图表生成工具，集成 AI 大模型与 Excalidraw 画布，支持 20+ 种图表类型（如流程图、架构图、ER 图等），通过独创连接算法优化布局，用户仅需描述需求即可自动生成可编辑的专业级图表，支持本地部署与服务器端 LLM 配置，兼顾易用性与隐私安全。
summary_en: Smart Excalidraw is an AI-powered diagramming tool that generates professional charts from natural language descriptions. It integrates with Excalidraw canvas, supports 20+ chart types (e.g., flowcharts, architecture diagrams, ER diagrams), uses an innovative connection algorithm for optimal layout, and allows users to edit AI-generated diagrams in real-time. Supports local deployment and server-side LLM configuration for enterprise use.

description: ✨ AsrTools: Smart Voice-to-Text Tool | Efficient Batch Processing | User-Friendly Interface | No GPU Required | Supports SRT/TXT Output | Turn your audio into accurate text in an instant!
summary_zh: AsrTools 是一款智能语音转文字工具，支持批量音频/视频文件处理，提供 SRT/TXT/字幕文件输出，具备高颜值 PyQt5 界面与多线程并发能力，无需 GPU 即可快速生成准确文本，适用于字幕制作与语音内容提取。
summary_en: AsrTools is an intelligent voice-to-text tool that supports batch processing of audio and video files, generating SRT/TXT/subtitle outputs with a user-friendly PyQt5 interface. It uses multi-threading for fast conversion, requires no GPU, and enables instant text extraction from media files.

description: MarkDown在线简历工具，可在线预览、编辑和生成PDF。[此项目已不再维护，建议使用 cv.ftqq.com 替代 ]
summary_zh: DeerResume 是一款功能强大的 Markdown 在线简历工具，支持实时编辑、预览、密码保护和一键生成 PDF。用户可自主部署，自由定制样式，适用于技术岗位简历制作，尤其适合开发者使用。
summary_en: DeerResume is a powerful Markdown-based online resume tool that supports real-time editing, preview, password protection, and PDF generation. It allows self-hosting with customizable styles, making it ideal for developers creating professional tech resumes.

description: Simple tagging for django
summary_zh: django-taggit 是一个为 Django 框架提供的简洁高效的标签管理库，支持通过 TaggableManager 轻松为模型添加标签功能，兼容 Django 3.2+，提供 API 操作、表单集成和后台管理支持，适用于内容分类与检索场景。
summary_en: django-taggit is a simple and efficient tagging library for Django, enabling easy tag management via TaggableManager. It supports Django 3.2+, offers API-driven tag operations, form integration, and admin support, ideal for content categorization and retrieval.

description: Super tiny size multi-touch gestures library for the web. 　　　You can touch this →
summary_zh: AlloyFinger 是一个超轻量级的多点触控手势库，专为网页设计，支持触摸、滑动、缩放、旋转等手势识别。采用模块化设计，体积小巧，API 简洁易用，兼容主流框架（如 Omi），适用于移动端和桌面端交互场景。
summary_en: AlloyFinger is a super lightweight multi-touch gesture library for the web, supporting gestures like touch, swipe, pinch, and rotate. It features a modular design, small size, simple API, and compatibility with frameworks like Omi, ideal for mobile and desktop interactive applications.

description: Trying to complete over 100 projects in various categories in golang.
summary_zh: 《Go实战开发》是一本通过100+实战项目系统学习Go语言的书籍，涵盖Web开发、网络编程、数据库操作等全场景。作者astaxie结合PHP开发经验，以项目驱动方式帮助开发者掌握Go核心特性与工程实践，配套开源代码与社区支持，适合中高级开发者进阶。
summary_en: 《Go实战开发》 is a project-driven book teaching Go through 100+ practical projects across categories like web development and networking. Authored by astaxie, it leverages PHP experience to guide developers in mastering Go's core features and engineering practices, with open-source code and community support for advanced learning.

description: 签到
summary_zh: qiandao 是一个基于 HAR 编辑器的自动化签到框架，支持多平台自动签到任务管理。核心功能包括通过 HAR 文件录制与编辑浏览器操作，结合 Python 脚本实现定时自动签到，支持邮件通知与数据库存储。提供 Web 管理界面与 Docker 部署方案，适用于各类周期性签到场景，如论坛、学习平台等。
summary_en: Qiandao is an automated check-in framework based on HAR editor, enabling scheduled check-ins across multiple platforms. It records and edits browser actions via HAR files, executes tasks using Python scripts, and supports email notifications and database storage. Features include a web admin interface and Docker deployment, ideal for recurring check-in scenarios such as forums and learning platforms.

summary_zh: 该项目用AI将《史记》57万字转化为可交互知识图谱，标注14,065个实体、3,198个历史事件及7,637条关系。创新提出Agentic Ontology范式，提供完整方法论（14元技能+89管线技能）与可视化探索工具，适用于古籍数字化、历史研究与AI知识工程。
summary_en: Transforms the 570,000-character Records of the Grand Historian into an interactive knowledge graph using AI. Extracts 14,065 entities, 3,198 historical events, and 7,637 relations. Introduces Agentic Ontology paradigm with comprehensive methodology (14 meta-skills + 89 pipeline skills), suited for digital humanities, historical research, and AI knowledge engineering.

description: Python 黑魔法手册
summary_zh: 《Python 黑魔法手册》是一本深入解析 Python 语言隐藏特性与进阶技巧的电子书，涵盖冷门语法、Shell 高级用法、代码炫技及底层机制解读，旨在帮助开发者突破常规认知，掌握高效、优雅的 Python 编程范式。
summary_en: The 'Magic Python' handbook is an eBook exploring advanced and lesser-known Python features, including obscure syntax, shell tricks, code hacks, and deep technical insights, designed to help developers master elegant and efficient Python programming beyond basic tutorials.

description: Remote Control for Codex.
summary_zh: Remodex 是一款本地优先的开源桥接工具，结合 iOS 应用与 macOS 后台服务，实现 iPhone 对 OpenAI Codex 的远程控制。支持端到端加密配对、实时流式交互、Git 操作、子智能体调用及结构化规划模式，提供低延迟响应与细粒度访问控制，全程无需依赖公共服务器。
summary_en: Remodex is a local-first open-source bridge with an iOS app that enables remote control of OpenAI Codex from your iPhone. It features end-to-end encrypted pairing, real-time streaming, Git actions, subagents, planning mode, and secure access controls—all running on-device without relying on public endpoints.

description: Django application and library for importing and exporting data with admin integration.
summary_zh: django-import-export 是一个专为 Django 应用设计的强大数据导入导出库，支持 CSV、Excel、JSON 等多种格式，提供 Admin 后台集成和编程接口。核心功能包括数据预览、批量导入、CRUD 操作控制、外键与多对多关系处理、数据验证及自定义转换，适用于需要高效处理大规模数据迁移或批量操作的 Web 应用。
summary_en: django-import-export is a robust Django library for importing and exporting data across multiple formats (CSV, Excel, JSON, etc.). It offers seamless Admin UI integration and programmatic access, featuring data preview, bulk import, CRUD control, foreign key/many-to-many relation handling, validation, and custom transformations—ideal for data migration and batch operations in Django applications.

description: Auto-register & manage accounts for ChatGPT, Cursor, Kiro, Grok, Windsurf, Trae & 13+ AI platforms · Protocol/browser dual-mode · Plugin-based · One-click Mac/Windows desktop app
summary_zh: Any Auto Register 是一个多平台账号自动注册与管理系统，支持 Trae.ai、Tavily、Cursor 等主流 AI 平台。采用 FastAPI + React 架构，具备插件化扩展能力，集成邮箱服务（MoeMail/Laoudo/DuckMail）、验证码识别（YesCaptcha/2Captcha/Camoufox）及代理池管理功能，提供实时日志推送的 Web UI 界面。
summary_en: Any Auto Register is a multi-platform account auto-registration and management system supporting major AI platforms like Trae.ai, Tavily, and Cursor. Built with FastAPI + React, it features plugin-based extensibility, integrated mailbox services (MoeMail/Laoudo/DuckMail), captcha solving (YesCaptcha/2Captcha/Camoufox), proxy pool management, and real-time log streaming via SSE to a web UI.

description: 基于LangChain和ChatGLM-6B等系列LLM的针对本地知识库的自动问答
summary_zh: 本项目基于LangChain和ChatGLM-6B系列大模型，构建了一个针对本地知识库的自动问答Web应用。支持上传PDF、TXT、DOCX、MD等格式文档，结合多种Embedding模型实现语义检索，提供本地部署和云端体验，适用于私有知识问答、文档理解等场景。
summary_en: This project builds a web-based QA system using LangChain and ChatGLM-6B series LLMs for local knowledge base queries. It supports uploading PDF, TXT, DOCX, MD files and integrates multiple embedding models for semantic retrieval, enabling private, offline document understanding and question answering.

description: 搞快点
summary_zh: QiuChenly CoreInject 是一个集成化逆向工程与IPA注入工具，主打一键破解与自动化脚本分发。其核心是 QiuChenly AppStore，将破解库、脚本、社区交流统一封装为跨平台桌面应用，支持macOS系统，提供预破解包上传与管理后台，构建去中心化的自由软件生态。
summary_en: QiuChenly CoreInject is an integrated reverse engineering and IPA injection tool, focusing on one-click cracking and automated script distribution. Its core is the QiuChenly AppStore, which unifies cracked libraries, scripts, and community sharing into a cross-platform desktop app for macOS, offering pre-cracked package uploads and admin backends to build a decentralized free software ecosystem.

description: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology.
summary_zh: RAG Web UI 是一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）技术的智能对话系统，支持多格式文档管理与向量化处理，提供精准知识问答服务。系统具备前后端分离架构、分布式文件存储及高性能向量数据库（如 ChromaDB、Qdrant），支持 OpenAI、DeepSeek 及本地 Ollama 模型部署，适用于私有化部署与 API 集成场景。
summary_en: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system powered by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology, enabling precise knowledge-based Q&A through document retrieval and LLM integration. It supports multi-format document ingestion, asynchronous processing, vectorization, and flexible LLM deployment (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama), with a scalable backend architecture and OpenAPI for external access.

description: NanoBanana PPT Skills 基于 AI 自动生成高质量 PPT 图片和视频的强大工具，支持智能转场和交互式播放
summary_zh: NanoBanana PPT Skills 是一款基于 AI 的自动化演示工具，支持智能分析文档并生成高质量 PPT 图片与视频。核心功能包括 Google Gemini 图像生成、可灵 AI 转场动画合成、交互式播放控制及 FFmpeg 视频导出，适用于科技产品、商务汇报等场景。
summary_en: NanoBanana PPT Skills is an AI-powered automation tool that generates high-quality PPT images and videos by intelligently analyzing documents. It leverages Google Gemini for image generation, Kling AI for smooth transition animations, interactive playback controls, and FFmpeg video synthesis, ideal for tech demos and business presentations.

summary_zh: 本仓库是冬瓜关于 Pi-Agent SDK 的深度学习笔记，系统拆解了生产级 AI Agent 运行时的核心架构。教程涵盖 Agent Loop、工具系统、事件驱动等 10 大模块，通过 TypeScript 与 Python 双语言对照，深入剖析了 Agent SDK 的设计取舍与源码实现，适合希望构建或理解 Agent 底层逻辑的开发者。
summary_en: A deep-dive tutorial repository on the Pi-Agent SDK, systematically deconstructing the core architecture of production-grade AI Agent runtimes. Covering 10 modules including Agent Loop, tool systems, and event-driven design, it provides TypeScript and Python dual-language comparisons to analyze the source code and design trade-offs of Agent SDKs for developers.

description: 一个基于✨HOOK机制的微信机器人，支持🌱安全新闻定时推送【FreeBuf，先知，安全客，奇安信攻防社区】，👯Kfc文案，⚡漏洞查询，⚡手机号归属地查询，⚡知识库查询，🎉星座查询，⚡天气查询，🌱摸鱼日历，⚡微步威胁情报查询， 🐛视频，⚡图片，👯帮助菜单。📫 支持积分功能，⚡支持自动拉人，，🌱自动群发，👯Ai回复（国内主流AI模型，扣子，FastGpt，Dify全面支持！），⚡视频号解析，😄自定义程度丰富，小白也可轻松上手！
summary_zh: NGCBot 是一款基于 HOOK 机制的微信机器人，集成安全资讯推送、AI 智能回复、漏洞查询、天气日历等丰富功能，支持主流 AI 平台，具备自动拉群、群发、视频解析等自动化能力，自定义程度高，适合安全从业者与社群运营。
summary_en: NGCBot is a HOOK-based WeChat robot supporting security news push, AI replies, vulnerability queries, weather, calendar, and more. It integrates with major AI platforms, offers automation features like auto-invite and group messaging, and is highly customizable for non-technical users.

description: The simplest desktop client for OpenClaw 🦞 — bridge your Agent to WeChat, Feishu, Slack & Discord in one click. Works with Claude Code, Codex & any LLM. BYOK, Oauth, local-first, chat from your phone 24/7.
summary_zh: nexu 是一款开源桌面客户端，专为 OpenClaw 🦞 设计，一键桥接 Agent 到微信、飞书、Slack 和 Discord。支持 Claude Code、Codex 等 LLM，采用 BYOK（自带密钥）、OAuth 认证及本地优先架构，实现全天候手机聊天。所有数据本地存储，隐私可控，提供图形化安装与多模型切换功能。
summary_en: nexu is an open-source desktop client for OpenClaw 🦞 that bridges your AI agent to WeChat, Feishu, Slack, and Discord with one click. It works with Claude Code, Codex, and any LLM via BYOK, OAuth, and local-first architecture. Chat from your phone 24/7 with full privacy control—no vendor data routing. Features GUI setup, multi-model support (e.g., Gemini), and built-in IM integrations.

description: 翻译自Miguel Grinberg的blog https://blog.miguelgrinberg.com 的2017年新版The Flask Mega-Tutorial教程
summary_zh: 本仓库是 Miguel Grinberg 《The Flask Mega-Tutorial》2017年版的完整中文翻译，涵盖从基础到部署的全栈开发实践。通过23章系统讲解 Flask 框架核心功能，包括模板、表单、数据库、用户认证、Ajax、全文搜索、国际化及多平台部署（Linux/Heroku/Docker），适合中高级开发者构建复杂 Web 应用。
summary_en: This repository contains the complete Chinese translation of Miguel Grinberg's 2017 'The Flask Mega-Tutorial', covering full-stack web development with Flask from basics to deployment. Spanning 23 chapters, it systematically teaches core Flask features including templating, forms, databases, authentication, Ajax, full-text search, internationalization, and multi-platform deployment (Linux/Heroku/Docker), ideal for intermediate to advanced developers building complex web applications.

description: 🌊 AChat - An open-source/self-hosted/local-first AI platform, designed for enterprises and teams, perfectly combining powerful local processing capabilities with seamless remote synchronization.
summary_zh: AChat 是一个开源、自托管的企业级 AI 协作平台，支持本地化处理与远程同步，提供用户管理、支付集成、内容过滤等全套功能，适用于团队和组织内部 AI 应用部署。
summary_en: AChat is an open-source, self-hosted AI platform designed for enterprises and teams, combining local processing with remote synchronization. It offers user management, payment integration, and content filtering out of the box.

description: 中国行政区划代码【省、市、区县、乡镇街道】中国省市区镇三级四级联动行政区划数据（GB/T 2260）
summary_zh: 提供中华人民共和国省、市、区县、乡镇街道四级完整行政区划数据，严格遵循GB/T 2260国家标准，数据权威且实时更新。支持三级联动选择、身份证号识别等实用功能，适用于地址选择、表单验证、地理信息系统等场景。
summary_en: Comprehensive Chinese administrative division data covering provinces, cities, districts, counties, towns, and streets, adhering to the national standard GB/T 2260. Includes authoritative and regularly updated data from official sources, supporting three-level cascading selection, ID card validation, and integration with web components or jQuery plugins for address selection and geographic applications.

description: Document (PDF, Word, PPTX ...) extraction and parse API using state of the art modern OCRs + Ollama supported models. Anonymize documents. Remove PII. Convert any document or picture to structured JSON or Markdown
summary_zh: text-extract-api 是一个本地部署的文档提取与解析 API，支持 PDF、Word、PPT 和图片转换为高精度 Markdown 或结构化 JSON，集成 EasyOCR、Llama3.2-vision 等先进 OCR 模型及 Ollama 大模型，具备 PII 匿名化、分布式 Celery 队列处理、Redis 缓存等功能，无需依赖云端服务。
summary_en: text-extract-api is a locally deployed document extraction and parsing API that converts images, PDFs, and Office documents into high-accuracy Markdown or structured JSON using advanced OCRs like EasyOCR and Llama3.2-vision, integrated with Ollama LLMs for text refinement and PII removal. It features distributed Celery processing, Redis caching, and no external cloud dependencies.

description: JSON Web Token Authentication support for Django REST Framework
summary_zh: 该项目为 Django REST Framework 提供 JSON Web Token (JWT) 身份验证支持，实现无状态用户认证。适用于需要安全、可扩展 API 的场景，如前后端分离应用。现已停止维护，建议使用官方或活跃替代方案。
summary_en: This package adds JSON Web Token (JWT) authentication support for Django REST Framework, enabling stateless API security. Ideal for modern web applications requiring secure, scalable authentication. Note: Project is unmaintained; alternatives recommended.

description: gfw_whitelist
summary_zh: 该项目提供基于白名单的PAC代理配置方案，通过维护国内常用域名白名单，实现国内网站直连、境外网站走代理的科学上网模式。支持自动生成whitelist.pac/whiteiplist.pac/proxy.pac三种格式的代理配置文件，兼容Chrome、Firefox等主流浏览器，支持SOCKS5/HTTPS等多种代理协议，并提供在线PAC生成服务。
summary_en: This project provides a PAC proxy configuration solution based on whitelisting, allowing direct connection for domestic websites and proxy for international sites. It supports generating three types of proxy config files (whitelist.pac/whiteiplist.pac/proxy.pac), compatible with major browsers, supporting multiple proxy protocols like SOCKS5/HTTPS, and offers online PAC generation service.

description: Full featured redis cache backend for Django.
summary_zh: django-redis 是一个功能完整的 Redis 缓存和会话后端，专为 Django 设计。它支持原生 redis-py URL 连接字符串、可插拔客户端/解析器/序列化器，提供主从支持、无限超时、Unix 套接字连接及原始 Redis 客户端访问，适用于高并发生产环境。
summary_en: django-redis is a full-featured, BSD-licensed Redis cache and session backend for Django. It supports native redis-py URL connections, pluggable clients/parsers/serializers, primary/secondary setups, infinite timeouts, Unix sockets, and raw Redis client access, making it ideal for production-scale Django applications.

description: Legacy code of V2EX running on Google App Engine
summary_zh: Project Babel 2 是基于 Python 和 Google App Engine 的开源社区建站系统，专为构建类似 V2EX 的分享与发现型社区设计。支持节点分类、多主题管理、响应式主题、WebDAV 头像托管、Atom 订阅、HTML5 兼容、MapReduce 数据优化及 Twitter OAuth 集成，具备高性能扩展能力，支持百万级日访问量。
summary_en: Project Babel 2 is an open-source community platform built with Python on Google App Engine, designed for sharing and discovery communities like V2EX. It features node-based organization, responsive themes, WebDAV avatars, Atom feeds, HTML5 support, MapReduce data optimization, and Twitter OAuth integration, capable of scaling to millions of daily pageviews with proper configuration.

description: Collaborator is a place to create with agents.
summary_zh: Collaborator 是一款面向智能体开发的跨平台桌面应用，将终端、代码编辑器和上下文文件整合在无限画布中，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。基于 Electron 40、React 19 和 Tailwind CSS 4 构建，集成 Monaco 编辑器、xterm.js 终端和 D3 可视化，实现本地优先、无账号的协作开发环境，消除上下文切换，提升智能体协作效率。
summary_en: Collaborator is a cross-platform desktop environment for agentic development, unifying terminals, code editors, and context files on an infinite canvas. Built with Electron 40, React 19, and Tailwind CSS 4, it integrates Monaco Editor, xterm.js terminal, and D3 visualization. Designed for local-first, account-free workflows, it eliminates context switching and enhances agent collaboration across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

description: Material Design 中文协同翻译 - design.1sters.com
summary_zh: Material Design 中文协同翻译项目致力于将 Google 官方 Material Design 规范完整翻译为中文，覆盖动画、样式、布局等核心模块，采用 GitHub 协作模式，支持多人参与翻译与校对，最终生成网页和 PDF 文档，助力国内设计师与开发者掌握统一设计语言。
summary_en: This project translates Google's Material Design specification into Chinese collaboratively, covering animation, style, layout, and more. It uses GitHub for open collaboration, enabling translators and reviewers to contribute, with final outputs published as web pages and PDFs to support designers and developers in adopting a unified design language.

description: README file generator, powered by AI.
summary_zh: ReadmeAI 是一款基于 AI 的 README 文件自动生成工具，支持通过代码仓库 URL 或本地路径一键生成结构化、详细的文档。支持 OpenAI、Ollama、Anthropic、Gemini 等多种 LLM 模型，具备智能文件过滤、离线模式运行、高度可定制化模板与样式等功能，旨在提升开发者文档编写效率。
summary_en: ReadmeAI is an AI-powered tool that automatically generates high-quality README files from code repositories. It supports multiple LLM backends (OpenAI, Ollama, Anthropic, Gemini), offers customizable templates, intelligent file filtering via .readmeaiignore, and works offline. Designed to boost developer productivity and ensure consistent documentation across projects.

description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
summary_zh: Cindy 是一款开源、开箱即用的跨平台 AI Agent 客户端，支持 Claude Code 和 Codex 等多种模型编排。它可在本地运行，集成文件系统访问、浏览器自动化和 MCP 协议，实现跨设备的任务编排与自动化执行。
summary_en: Cindy is an open-source, out-of-the-box AI agent client supporting Claude Code and Codex orchestration. It runs locally with file system access, browser automation, and MCP protocol integration for cross-device task orchestration and automated execution.

description: 浸入式学语言助手 (Immersive Language Learning Assistant)
summary_zh: 浸入式语言学习助手是一款基于‘可理解输入’理论的浏览器插件，通过智能翻译网页词汇并集成发音功能，实现自然语言习得。支持自动语言检测、AI选词、双语音频朗读及交互式提示，将整个互联网转化为个性化学习材料。
summary_en: An immersive language learning browser extension based on 'comprehensible input' theory, intelligently translating selected words with pronunciation support. Features automatic language detection, AI-driven vocabulary selection, dual TTS, and interactive tooltips to turn the web into personalized learning content.

description: 做最好的接口管理平台
summary_zh: DOClever 是一款专为中小型团队打造的商业化开源接口管理平台，完全免费并支持内网部署。它提供接口全生命周期管理、可视化调试、Mock 服务、自动化测试、团队协作及多格式导入导出等功能，支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议及多种参数类型，具备版本控制与快照能力，助力高效开发协作。
summary_en: DOClever is a commercial open-source API management platform, fully free and supportable for on-premise deployment. It offers comprehensive API lifecycle management, visual debugging, Mock services, automated testing, team collaboration, and import/export in multiple formats. Supporting HTTP/HTTPS protocols and various parameter types, it features version control, snapshots, and seamless integration with Postman, Swagger, and RAP.

description: An unofficial 12306 Client for Mac
summary_zh: 12306ForMac 是一款非官方的 Mac 版 12306 火车票订票助手，支持自动捡票与下单功能。基于 Swift 开发，依赖 Carthage 管理 CocoaPods 依赖，兼容 OS X 10.11 及以上系统。项目采用 Alamofire、PromiseKit 等主流框架，提供图形化界面替代官方网页购票，适用于 macOS 用户便捷购票。
summary_en: 12306ForMac is an unofficial macOS client for 12306 railway ticket booking, supporting auto-search and purchasing. Built with Swift 3.2 and Xcode 9.0, it uses Carthage for dependency management and integrates Alamofire, PromiseKit, and FMDB. Designed for OS X 10.11+, it offers a native GUI alternative to the official web interface for convenient ticket booking.

description: 🚀 DeepSeek-V3 & R1大模型逆向API【特长：良心厂商】（官方贼便宜，建议直接走官方），支持高速流式输出、多轮对话，联网搜索，R1深度思考，零配置部署，多路token支持，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
summary_zh: 本项目提供 DeepSeek-V3 和 R1 大模型的逆向 API 接口，支持高速流式输出、多轮对话、联网搜索及深度思考功能，兼容 ChatGPT 接口标准，支持零配置部署与多账号 token 负载均衡，仅限个人测试使用，商用请转官方平台。
summary_en: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for DeepSeek-V3 and R1 models, featuring high-speed streaming output, multi-turn conversations, web search, and deep reasoning. It is fully compatible with ChatGPT's API interface, supports zero-configuration deployment and multi-token load balancing, intended only for personal testing, commercial use requires official platform access.

description: Some Chinese Android Developers Information, 微信公众号:codekk, 网站:
summary_zh: 该仓库整理了中国知名 Android 开发者信息，包含 GitHub 账号、博客链接及个人简介，涵盖源码分析、性能优化、动画开发、开源项目等多个方向，是中文 Android 开发者社区的重要资源集合。
summary_en: This repository compiles information about prominent Chinese Android developers, including GitHub profiles, blog links, and professional introductions, covering areas such as source code analysis, performance optimization, animation development, and open-source projects, serving as a key resource for the Chinese Android developer community.

description: Bridge Claude Code / Codex to IM platforms — chat with AI coding agents from Telegram, Discord, or Feishu/Lark.
summary_zh: Claude-to-IM Skill 是一个轻量级 CLI 工具，将 Claude Code / Codex 与 Telegram、Discord、飞书/Lark 或 QQ 等即时通讯平台桥接，实现通过 IM 聊天与 AI 编程代理交互。支持权限控制、流式响应预览、会话持久化，无需编码即可快速部署。
summary_en: Claude-to-IM Skill is a lightweight CLI tool that bridges Claude Code/Codex with IM platforms like Telegram, Discord, Feishu/Lark, and QQ. It enables chatting with AI coding agents directly from your chats, featuring permission control, streaming previews, session persistence, and zero-code setup.

description: Pic Smaller – Compress JPEG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, SVG and GIF images intelligently
summary_zh: Pic Smaller 是一款智能在线图像压缩工具，支持 JPEG、PNG、WEBP、AVIF、SVG 和 GIF 格式。采用纯前端技术实现，无需服务器处理，确保数据安全。提供格式转换、色彩优化、压缩对比等高级功能，界面简洁，兼容桌面与移动端，适合快速压缩与编辑图像。
summary_en: Pic Smaller is an intelligent online image compression tool supporting JPEG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, SVG, and GIF formats. Built with pure frontend technologies like WebAssembly and Web Worker, it ensures complete privacy by processing images locally. Offers advanced features such as format conversion, color optimization, and side-by-side compression comparison, with a responsive UI for desktop and mobile.

description: This guide is designed for OpenClaw itself (Agent-facing), not as a traditional human-only hardening checklist.
summary_zh: 本指南专为高权限自主AI代理OpenClaw设计，采用‘代理式零信任架构’范式，从传统静态防御转向动态防护。通过三层防御矩阵（事前行为黑名单、事中权限限制、事后夜间审计）有效应对提示注入、供应链投毒等AI特有风险，支持强推理模型自动部署，显著降低用户配置成本。
summary_en: This guide is tailored for high-privilege autonomous AI agents like OpenClaw, shifting from traditional static defense to 'Agentic Zero-Trust Architecture'. It implements a battle-tested 3-Tier Defense Matrix—pre-action blacklists, in-action permission controls, and post-action nightly audits—to mitigate LLM-specific threats like prompt injection and supply chain poisoning. Designed for seamless integration with strong reasoning models to minimize manual security setup.

description: weui for react
summary_zh: React-WeUI 是基于 React 框架封装的 WeUI 组件库，提供与微信原生 UI 风格一致的移动端界面组件，支持 npm 安装与 CDN 引用，具备完善的文档与示例，适用于快速构建移动端 Web 应用。
summary_en: React-WeUI is a React-based component library implementing WeUI's native WeChat UI design, enabling rapid development of mobile web interfaces with npm installation, CDN support, and comprehensive documentation.

description: AutoJs6-based ant forest energy auto-collect script (基于 AutoJs6 的蚂蚁森林能量自动收取脚本)
summary_zh: 基于 Auto.js 6 的蚂蚁森林能量自动收取脚本，支持自动收集好友能量、能量雨识别与点击、排行榜策略配置等功能，提供模块化扩展与配置工具，适用于 Android 设备自动化操作，显著提升蚂蚁森林能量获取效率。
summary_en: An Auto.js 6-based script for automating energy collection in Ant Forest, featuring auto-collection of friend energy, rain energy detection, ranking strategies, and modular configuration tools to enhance efficiency on Android devices.

description: markdown2: A fast and complete implementation of Markdown in Python
summary_zh: markdown2 是一个高性能、完整的 Python Markdown 解析器，严格遵循原始 Perl 实现的行为。支持丰富的扩展语法（如代码高亮、表格、脚注等），兼容 Python 3.5+，提供模块和命令行两种使用方式，适合快速将 Markdown 转换为结构化的 HTML。
summary_en: markdown2 is a fast, complete Python implementation of Markdown that closely matches the original Perl version. It supports numerous extras like syntax highlighting, tables, and footnotes, works with Python 3.5+, and offers both module and CLI usage for converting Markdown to HTML.

description: 中文langchain项目|小必应，Q.Talk，强聊，QiangTalk
summary_zh: Chinese-LangChain 是基于 ChatGLM-6B 和 LangChain 的中文本地化智能问答系统，支持知识库检索与生成、多文档解析（PDF/DOCX/PPT）、互联网搜索及增量更新，提供 Gradio 交互界面，适用于垂直领域知识问答场景。
summary_en: Chinese-LangChain is a localized Chinese LLM application built on ChatGLM-6B and LangChain, enabling knowledge retrieval, multi-format document parsing, web search, and incremental updates via a Gradio interface for domain-specific Q&A.

description: A cute temporary email service built with NextJS + Cloudflare technology stack 🎉 | 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务🎉
summary_zh: MoeMail 是一个基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务，提供隐私保护、实时邮件接收、灵活有效期设置、主题切换、PWA 支持等功能，支持自建部署、邮件发送、Webhook 通知及 OpenAPI 访问，界面简洁友好，适合个人或团队使用。
summary_en: MoeMail is a cute temporary email service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, offering privacy protection, real-time email receipt, flexible validity periods, theme switching, PWA support, and self-hosting capabilities. It supports email sending, webhook notifications, OpenAPI access, and a user-friendly interface for personal or team use.

description: A Claude Code skill for generating UI in the Nothing design language. Monochrome, typographic, industrial.
summary_zh: 专为 Claude Code 设计的 Nothing 设计语言技能，提供极简工业风 UI 生成能力。基于瑞士排版、OLED 黑、分段进度条等核心视觉规则，支持 HTML/CSS、SwiftUI、React/Tailwind 多平台输出，内置明暗双模式设计令牌系统。
summary_en: A Claude Code skill for generating UI in the Nothing design language. Features monochrome, typographic, industrial aesthetics with Swiss typography, OLED blacks, segmented progress bars, and dot-matrix motifs. Outputs to HTML/CSS, SwiftUI, or React/Tailwind across light/dark mode token systems.

description: Social auth made simple
summary_zh: Python Social Auth 是一个简单易用的社交认证/注册机制库，支持多种框架和第三方认证提供商。基于 django-social-auth 重构，提供统一接口定义新认证源，并扩展对更多框架和 ORM 的支持。该项目已于2016年12月3日停止维护，代码已迁移至 python-social-auth 组织。
summary_en: Python Social Auth is a simple social authentication/registration library supporting multiple frameworks and auth providers. Built on django-social-auth, it offers a unified interface to define third-party authentication providers and extend support for additional frameworks and ORMs. Deprecated since Dec 3, 2016, with code migrated to the python-social-auth organization.

description: A better file browser and calendar inspired by Apple Notes, Bear, Evernote and Day One.
summary_zh: Notebook Navigator 是 Obsidian 的一款插件，用简洁的双窗格界面替代默认文件浏览器，支持文件夹树、标签浏览、文件预览、键盘导航、拖拽操作、固定笔记及高度可定制化显示选项，显著提升笔记管理效率。
summary_en: Notebook Navigator is an Obsidian plugin that replaces the default file explorer with a clean two-pane interface, offering folder tree navigation, tag browsing, file previews, keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop, pinned notes, and customizable display options for efficient note management.

description: splinter - python test framework for web applications
summary_zh: Splinter 是一个简洁易用的 Python Web 应用自动化测试框架，提供直观的 API 支持浏览器交互自动化。它基于 Selenium 构建，支持多浏览器驱动，具备快速开发、灵活扩展和真实场景适配能力，适用于 Web 测试、爬虫及自动化任务。
summary_en: Splinter is a simple and consistent Python framework for automating web applications. Built on Selenium, it offers an intuitive API for browser automation, supporting multiple drivers and real-world use cases. Ideal for testing, scraping, and UI automation with robust and flexible capabilities.

description: 🚀 A statistical analysis tool for performance testing
summary_zh: Hiper 是一款专为性能测试设计的统计分析工具，支持通过 Chrome 浏览器自动化采集页面加载时间、DNS 查询、TCP 连接等关键性能指标，提供详细的统计报告与可视化分析，适用于 Web 性能监控与优化。
summary_en: Hiper is a statistical analysis tool for performance testing that automates Chrome browser interactions to collect key metrics like DNS lookup, TCP connection, and page load times, delivering detailed reports and visualizations for web performance monitoring and optimization.

description: Collection of effects for React: Border beam, Liquid Gooey, Thinking orbs
summary_zh: 该仓库提供两个 React UI 动效组件库：border-beam 实现流光边框动画，liquid-gooey 提供液态变形与流动特效。适用于现代 Web 应用视觉增强，支持源码热更新、独立 npm 发布与 CI 构建部署。
summary_en: This repository provides two React UI animation libraries: border-beam for glowing border effects and liquid-gooey for morphing blob animations. Built with npm workspaces, supporting hot-reload source editing, independent package publishing, and automated CI deployment for modern web visual enhancement.

description: A command line tool for upgrading every outdated app installed by Homebrew Cask
summary_zh: brew-cask-upgrade 是一个命令行工具，用于升级通过 Homebrew Cask 安装的过时 macOS GUI 应用。它提供交互式界面、细粒度控制及自动更新检测，支持批量升级、排除自动更新应用、清理缓存等功能，是 Homebrew Cask 生态中提升应用管理效率的关键工具。
summary_en: brew-cask-upgrade is a CLI tool to upgrade outdated macOS GUI apps installed via Homebrew Cask. It offers interactive prompts, granular control, auto-update detection, batch upgrades, and features like cleanup and quarantine bypass, enhancing the efficiency of managing Homebrew Cask applications.

description: YAO = Yielding AI Outcomes. A rigorous engineering, evaluation, governance, and portability system for reusable agent skills.
summary_zh: YAO是AI智能体技能的可复用工程与治理系统，将重复工作流打包为跨平台技能包。2.0升级为Skill OS，提供技能IR中间表示、目标编译器、评估证据库、发布门禁和技能生命周期治理，实现从创建到迭代的完整闭环。
summary_en: YAO is a rigorous engineering and governance system for reusable AI agent skills. Version 2.0 upgrades to a Skill OS with platform-neutral IR, target compilers, evaluation evidence lab, release gates, and full lifecycle governance — turning repeated workflows into installable, cross-platform skill packages.

summary_zh: Cursor Fake Machine 是一款专为 Cursor 编辑器设计的 VSIX 扩展工具，通过修改 machineid 实现机器信息伪装，帮助用户绕过设备限制或环境检测，适用于开发环境隔离与多实例管理场景。
summary_en: Cursor Fake Machine is a VSIX extension for the Cursor editor that modifies the machineid to spoof device information, allowing users to bypass device restrictions or environment checks. It's useful for managing isolated development environments or multiple instances.

description: Django social authentication made simple
summary_zh: Django Social Auth 是一个为 Django 项目提供社交登录功能的库，支持 Google、Facebook、Twitter 等 40+ 主流平台的 OAuth/OAuth2/OpenID 认证。它基于 python-social-auth 构建，提供用户注册、多账号关联、自定义用户模型和认证管道扩展等核心能力，现已被官方标记为弃用状态。
summary_en: Django Social Auth is a deprecated library enabling social login via OAuth/OAuth2/OpenID for Django projects. It supports 40+ providers including Google, Facebook, and Twitter, offering user registration, multi-account association, custom user models, and extensible authentication pipelines. Now superseded by python-social-auth.

description: Modern photo gallery for photographers, with S3/GitHub sync, EXIF details, maps, and a WebGL viewer.
summary_zh: Afilmory 是一款专为摄影师打造的高性能现代照片画廊平台，支持 S3/GitHub 同步、EXIF 元数据展示、地理地图可视化和 WebGL 渲染，提供响应式瀑布流布局和国际化支持，适用于自建或 SaaS 部署。
summary_en: Afilmory is a modern, high-performance photo gallery platform for photographers, featuring S3/GitHub sync, EXIF metadata, interactive maps, and WebGL rendering. Built with React + TypeScript, it offers responsive masonry layouts, multi-storage support, and HDR/Live Photo compatibility for professional photo curation.

description: Minimal plugin that lets Claude Code call you on the phone.
summary_zh: CallMe 是一个极简的 Claude Code 插件，允许通过电话在任务完成、卡住或需要决策时呼叫用户。支持多轮语音对话，兼容智能手机、智能手表等设备，并可通过 ngrok 实现远程 webhook 连接。
summary_en: CallMe is a minimal plugin for Claude Code that enables phone calls to alert users when tasks are done, stuck, or require decisions. It supports multi-turn voice conversations via OpenAI's TTS/STT, works across smartphones and smartwatches, and uses ngrok for secure webhook tunneling.

description: 一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每天自动抓取 Hacker News 热门文章，通过 AI 生成中文总结并转换为播客内容。
summary_zh: Agili 的 Hacker Podcast 是一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每日自动抓取热门文章，利用 AI 生成中文摘要并转换为语音播客。项目采用 Cloudflare Workers 部署，结合 OpenAI API 与 TTS 技术，支持多平台订阅，实现技术资讯的自动化聚合与分发。
summary_en: Agili's Hacker Podcast is an AI-powered Chinese podcast project that automatically fetches daily top articles from Hacker News, generates Chinese summaries via AI, and converts them into audio content. Built with Cloudflare Workers, OpenAI API, and TTS, it supports multi-platform RSS and web access for automated tech news aggregation.

description: Swagger Documentation Generator for Django REST Framework: deprecated
summary_zh: Django REST Swagger 是一个为 Django REST Framework 提供 Swagger 文档生成的工具，现已废弃。它通过 OpenAPIRenderer 和 SwaggerUIRenderer 自动生成 API 的 OpenAPI 规范及交互式文档界面，支持自定义标题和路由配置，适用于快速构建可浏览的 REST API 文档。
summary_en: Django REST Swagger was a deprecated tool for generating Swagger documentation for Django REST Framework. It provided OpenAPIRenderer and SwaggerUIRenderer to auto-generate API specs and interactive UI, enabling browsable REST API docs with customizable titles and routing, now succeeded by drf-yasg.

description: Provider-neutral Codex Skill for producing verified AI presenter videos from a script and an authorized presenter image.
summary_zh: Provider-neutral的Codex Skill，将脚本与授权肖像转化为AI演示者视频。支持9种视觉风格、运行时动态选择AI提供商、音频锁定时间线确保口型同步，内置成本防护与验证交付流程，适配Claude Code、Cursor等多Agent平台。
summary_en: Provider-neutral Agent Skill for producing verified AI presenter videos from scripts. Supports 9 visual styles, dynamic provider selection at runtime, audio-locked timeline for lip-sync accuracy, cost guardrails, and evidence-gated QA. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agent platforms.

description: Material Design for Django
summary_zh: Django Material 是一个为 Django 框架打造的 Material Design 3 组件库，提供完整的 CRUD 和管理界面。它基于 TailwindCSS 和 django-cotton，无需构建步骤即可使用预编译的 CSS/JS，支持响应式、无障碍访问及 SPA 式导航，专为 AI 辅助开发优化，实现快速、现代化的 Django 前端开发。
summary_en: Django Material brings Google's Material Design 3 to Django with full-featured CRUD and admin interfaces. Built on TailwindCSS and django-cotton, it offers zero-build, responsive, accessible components powered by Unpoly.js for seamless navigation. Designed for AI-assisted development, it enables rapid, modern frontend development in Django without React, Vue, or Angular.

summary_zh: Litter 是 OpenAI Codex 的原生 iOS 与 Android 客户端，支持连接本地或远程服务器，在移动端运行智能体编程工作流。采用 Rust 核心通过 UniFFI 跨平台共享，Swift/Kotlin 仅处理 UI 与平台 API，实现高性能与代码复用。
summary_en: Litter is a native iOS and Android client for OpenAI Codex, enabling users to connect to local or remote servers and run agentic coding workflows on mobile. It shares a single Rust core via UniFFI, keeping platform code (Swift/Kotlin) thin for high performance and code reuse.

description: Collaborator is a place to create with agents.
summary_zh: Collaborator 是一个专为 AI 智能体协作设计的 macOS 桌面应用，提供无限画布环境，集成终端、代码编辑器和文件管理功能。支持多工作区、实时终端交互和拖拽式文件操作，采用 Electron + React 技术栈，所有数据本地存储，适用于端到端的智能体开发流程。
summary_en: Collaborator is a macOS-native desktop app for building with AI agents, featuring an infinite canvas workspace with integrated terminals, code editors, and file navigation. It supports multi-workspace management, real-time agent interaction, and local data storage, built on Electron, React, and xterm.js for seamless agentic development.

summary_zh: 基于多智能体协同与LLM增强的AI投资决策系统，集成多头/空头研究员、辩论室机制和宏观分析，通过智能新闻搜索与缓存优化实现自动化投资建议生成，支持Gemini/OpenAI兼容模型，适用于AI与金融交叉领域研究。
summary_en: An AI investment system leveraging multi-agent collaboration and LLM-enhanced decision-making, featuring bull/bear researchers, debate room mechanisms, and macro analysis. It integrates intelligent news search with caching optimization for automated investment recommendations, supporting Gemini/OpenAI-compatible models for AI-finance research applications.

description: Browser-native Office / PDF / CAD / archive viewer for internal web apps, with Vue, React, Svelte, jQuery, Web Components, and no server-side conversion.
summary_zh: Flyfish File Viewer 是一款纯前端文件预览组件，支持 Office、PDF、CAD、压缩包等 208 种格式。它利用浏览器原生解析与渲染技术，无需后端转换，确保数据隐私与安全。支持 Vue、React 等主流框架，具备按需加载和私有化部署能力，适用于企业内部系统。
summary_en: Flyfish File Viewer is a browser-native file preview component supporting 208 formats including Office, PDF, CAD, and archives. It leverages client-side parsing and rendering without server-side conversion, ensuring data privacy. Compatible with Vue, React, and other frameworks, it offers lazy loading and private deployment for enterprise internal systems.

description: 📺 Homebrew's official macOS GUI
summary_zh: Homebrew官方macOS图形界面应用，采用SwiftUI构建，为不熟悉终端的用户提供直观的包管理体验。通过透明展示底层brew操作，实现软件包的安全发现、安装、更新与管理，适用于追求现代化原生体验的macOS开发者与普通用户。
summary_en: Homebrew's official macOS GUI built with SwiftUI, offering an intuitive package management experience for users who prefer graphical interfaces over terminal. It transparently exposes underlying brew operations while enabling safe discovery, installation, and update of packages through a native macOS application.

description: 一个 Linux.do 第三方客户端
summary_zh: FluxDO 是一款基于 Flutter 框架开发的 Linux.do 社区第三方客户端，覆盖 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS 和 Linux 全平台。它采用 Material Design 3 设计语言，集成了 Rust 编写的高性能 DOH（DNS over HTTPS）代理以保障网络安全与防污染，并提供完整的论坛交互、Markdown 编辑及实时消息推送功能。
summary_en: FluxDO is a cross-platform third-party client for the Linux.do community, built with Flutter. It features Material Design 3 and integrates a Rust-based DOH (DNS over HTTPS) proxy for secure, pollution-free networking. The app offers a complete forum experience with Markdown editing, real-time notifications, and native performance across mobile and desktop systems.

description: Magic auto brightness based on screen contents 💡
summary_zh: Lumen 是一款 macOS 菜单栏应用，能根据屏幕内容自动调节亮度。用户只需使用亮度键即可控制，系统会自动学习偏好。当屏幕显示深色内容（如终端）时自动调亮，显示浅色内容（如网页）时自动调暗，显著提升夜间使用舒适度，尤其适合长时间编程或阅读。
summary_en: Lumen is a macOS menu bar app that automatically adjusts screen brightness based on displayed content. It learns user preferences via brightness keys, brightening the screen for dark content (e.g., terminal) and dimming it for light content (e.g., web pages), offering a more comfortable viewing experience, especially at night.

description: 一个基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Durable Objects 的免费多服务器监控探针系统，支持实时监控、离线告警，到期通知，历史数据查看、延迟追踪、地图展示等功能。兼容主流Linux系统，Alpine Linux，OpenWrt，macOS，群晖 DSM、飞牛 fnOS、Windows系统。
summary_zh: CF-Server-Monitor 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 的多服务器监控探针系统，支持实时追踪 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络等指标，提供历史图表、全球地图展示、离线告警及 WebSocket 实时推送。兼容 Linux、Alpine、OpenWrt 和 Windows 系统，集成 JWT 认证与 Turnstile 人机验证，通过 GitHub Actions 实现一键部署，适合运维自动化与多节点监控场景。
summary_en: CF-Server-Monitor is a multi-server monitoring probe system built on Cloudflare Workers and D1, offering real-time tracking of CPU, memory, disk, and network metrics with historical charts, global map visualization, offline alerts, and WebSocket-based live updates. Compatible with Linux, Alpine, OpenWrt, and Windows, it integrates JWT authentication and Turnflare Turnstile verification, enabling one-click deployment via GitHub Actions for efficient operations automation and multi-node monitoring.

description: Clamps an HTML element by adding ellipsis to it if the content inside is too long.
summary_zh: Clamp.js 是一个轻量级 JavaScript 库，用于在 HTML 元素内容过长时自动截断并添加省略号。支持单行、多行及基于高度的自适应截断，提供灵活的字符分割策略和原生 WebKit 支持，适用于响应式文本展示场景。
summary_en: Clamp.js is a lightweight JavaScript library that truncates HTML element content with ellipsis when text overflows. It supports single/multi-line clamping, auto-sizing based on height, customizable truncation characters, and optional native WebKit -webkit-line-clamp support, ideal for responsive text display.

summary_zh: Yetone语音输入是一款macOS菜单栏语音输入应用，支持按住Fn键录音、实时流式语音识别（Apple Speech框架），自动注入文本到当前焦点输入框。具备CJK输入法兼容处理、多语言切换、动态波形动画浮窗、LLM后处理纠错等功能，采用Swift开发，提供Makefile构建脚本。
summary_en: Yetone Voice Input is a macOS menu-bar app enabling voice input via Fn key hold/release. It features real-time streaming speech recognition (Apple Speech), text injection with CJK IME compatibility, animated waveform floating window, multi-language support, and optional LLM-based transcription refinement via OpenAI-compatible API.

description: Modern theme for Django admin interface
summary_zh: Django Suit 是一个现代化的 Django 管理后台主题，提供简洁美观的界面设计，显著提升 Django 管理员的使用体验。支持 v1 稳定版与 v2 开发版，具备响应式布局和增强的交互功能，适用于需要优化后台管理界面的 Django 项目。
summary_en: Django Suit is a modern theme for the Django admin interface, offering a clean and enhanced UI to improve the admin experience. It supports both stable v1 and experimental v2 versions, featuring responsive design and improved usability for Django projects requiring a professional admin panel.

description: Some Famous Android Developers Information, 微信公众号:codekk, 网站:
summary_zh: 该仓库整理了全球知名 Android 开发者及其公司信息，涵盖 Google、Square 等核心贡献者的 GitHub 和博客链接，重点展示 Picasso、okhttp、EventBus 等经典开源项目作者，提供开发者影响力与项目关联的权威参考。
summary_en: This repository compiles information about renowned Android developers and their companies, featuring core contributors from Google, Square, and others. It highlights authors of iconic open-source projects like Picasso, okhttp, and EventBus, serving as a reference for developer influence and project affiliations.

description: worktree coding agents command center.
summary_zh: Supacode 是一个原生终端编码智能体指挥中心，专为 macOS 设计。它采用 Swift Composable Architecture 构建，集成 libghostty 实现高性能终端交互，支持通过 mise 管理依赖，提供完整的开发、测试与格式化工具链，致力于提升终端环境下的 AI 辅助编程体验。
summary_en: Supacode is a native terminal coding agent command center for macOS, built with Swift Composable Architecture and integrated with libghostty for high-performance terminal interaction. It supports dependency management via mise and offers a full development workflow including build, test, and formatting tools, focusing on enhancing AI-assisted programming in the terminal environment.
