description: A tab bar that switches between scenes, written in JS for cross-platform support
summary_zh: react-native-tab-navigator 是一个基于 JavaScript 的跨平台标签栏组件，专为 React Native 设计，支持 iOS 和 Android。它允许在多个场景间切换，提供自定义图标、徽章、标题等交互元素，兼容 React Native 0.16+，适用于构建原生级标签导航界面。
summary_en: react-native-tab-navigator is a cross-platform tab bar component written in JavaScript for React Native, supporting iOS and Android. It enables switching between scenes with customizable icons, badges, and titles, compatible with React Native 0.16+. Ideal for building native-like tab navigation interfaces.

description: Django friendly finite state machine support
summary_zh: Django-fsm 是一个为 Django 设计的有限状态机支持库，用于以声明式方式管理对象的状态与状态转换规则。它通过 Python 枚举定义状态，提供装饰器方式声明合法转换路径，防止非法状态变更，适用于构建持久化工作流系统。自 2024 年发布 3.0 版本后更名为 viewflow.fsm，API 重构更现代化，支持快速搭建带 UI 的工作流应用。
summary_en: Django-fsm is a finite state machine library designed for Django, enabling declarative management of object states and transitions. It uses Python enums to define states and decorators to enforce valid state changes, preventing unauthorized transitions. Ideal for building persistent workflow systems with minimal setup. Renamed to viewflow.fsm in its 3.0 release (2024), it features a modernized API better suited for current development needs.

description: Django friendly finite state machine support
summary_zh: viewflow.fsm 是专为 Django 设计的有限状态机（FSM）支持库，提供声明式工作流建模能力。通过 Python 枚举和 Django 枚举类型定义状态与转换规则，确保状态变更的严格控制和数据库无关性，适用于构建持久化业务流程与自动化工作流系统。
summary_en: viewflow.fsm is a Django-friendly finite state machine library enabling declarative workflow modeling. It uses Python enums and Django enumeration types to define states and transitions, enforcing strict state control and database independence for building persistent business processes and automated workflows.

description: Bootstrap 3 integration with Django.
summary_zh: django-bootstrap3 是 Bootstrap 3 与 Django 的无缝集成库，提供简洁的模板标签（如 `bootstrap_form`）快速渲染响应式表单。现已进入维护模式，仅修复漏洞，建议新项目使用 Bootstrap 5 及对应包 django-bootstrap5。
summary_en: django-bootstrap3 integrates Bootstrap 3 with Django via easy-to-use template tags like `bootstrap_form` for rapid responsive form rendering. Now in maintenance mode—only security fixes—with recommended migration to django-bootstrap5 for new projects.

description: Check酱：监测网页内容变化，并发送异动到微信。亦支持http status、json和rss监测。配合自架云端，关电脑后也能运行。
summary_zh: Check酱是一款网页内容监控工具，支持通过浏览器插件监测网页内容变化，并将异动推送至微信等消息通道。支持HTTP状态、JSON和RSS监测，配合自建云端服务可实现24小时运行。具备可视化选择器、周期任务调度及多平台部署能力。
summary_en: Check酱 is a web content monitoring tool that detects changes on web pages via a browser plugin and sends alerts to WeChat or other channels. It supports HTTP status, JSON, and RSS monitoring, with optional cloud deployment for continuous operation. Features include visual selector, scheduled tasks, and multi-platform support.

summary_zh: litter 是一个原生 iOS 和 Android 客户端，专为 Codex 设计，支持跨平台连接 Mac 设备并通过 SSH 访问 Codex 会话。项目采用 Rust 编写核心模块，使用 UniFFI 实现移动端与 Rust 的桥接，集成音频处理（AEC）和网络发现功能（Bonjour/Tailscale），提供高对比度、无障碍友好的 UI 界面。
summary_en: Litter is a native iOS and Android client for Codex, enabling cross-platform access to Mac-based Codex sessions via SSH. Built with Rust for core logic and UniFFI for mobile bridging, it includes audio processing (AEC), network discovery (Bonjour/Tailscale), and supports accessibility features like high contrast and large text modes.

description: A lightweight, scalable, mobile-first CSS framework
summary_zh: Mobi.css 是一个轻量级、可扩展、移动优先的 CSS 框架，默认包仅 3kb（gzip 后），提供基础样式以构建简洁优雅的网页。其插件系统支持模块化扩展，可独立使用插件，专为移动端优化，同时兼容桌面端，适合内容丰富的页面。
summary_en: Mobi.css is a lightweight, scalable, mobile-first CSS framework. With a default bundle of only 3kb (gzipped), it provides essential styles for clean and elegant webpages. Its plugin system enables modular scalability, allowing plugins to be used standalone or integrated, optimized for mobile but also excellent on desktop.

description: 开源免费的 Wispr Flow 替代方案 | 集成FunASR本地模型和可配置大语言模型的下一代中文桌面语音工作流
summary_zh: 蛐蛐 (QuQu) 是一款开源免费的 Wispr Flow 替代方案，专为中文用户打造的桌面端智能语音工作流工具。集成阿里巴巴 FunASR 本地语音识别模型和可配置大语言模型，实现高精度中文识别与智能文本优化，支持隐私保护、国产 AI 模型适配及开发者友好功能，完全免费且跨平台。
summary_en: QuQu is an open-source, free alternative to Wispr Flow, designed as a next-generation Chinese desktop voice workflow tool. It integrates Alibaba's FunASR local speech recognition model with configurable large language models, enabling high-precision Chinese transcription and intelligent text optimization. Features include privacy protection, support for domestic AI models, and developer-friendly formatting, all completely free and cross-platform.

description: ChatMCP is an AI chat client implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
summary_zh: ChatMCP 是一款跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，完整实现 Model Context Protocol (MCP)，支持 MacOS、Windows、Linux、iOS、Android 和 Web 多端运行。提供本地存储、数据同步、LaTeX 渲染、Mermaid 图表生成、HTML 预览及多 LLM 模型接入等功能，适用于智能对话与工具集成场景。
summary_en: ChatMCP is a cross-platform AI chat client implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP), supporting MacOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, and Web. It offers local storage, data sync, LaTeX rendering, Mermaid diagram generation, HTML preview, and multi-LLM provider integration for intelligent conversations and tool workflows.

summary_zh: AI驱动的YouTube视频剪辑工具，集成语义章节分析、精准裁剪、双语字幕翻译与烧录功能。支持通过Claude Code调用，自动下载视频并生成结构化片段，适用于内容创作者快速产出社交媒体素材。
summary_en: AI-powered YouTube video clipper for Claude Code that downloads videos, generates semantic chapters (2-5 min), clips segments with frame accuracy, translates subtitles to bilingual format, and burns them into videos. Ideal for content creators to produce social media clips efficiently.

description: Cross domain local storage, with permissions
summary_zh: cross-storage 是一个跨域本地存储解决方案，通过权限控制实现多浏览器窗口/标签页安全共享 localStorage。采用 Hub-Client 架构，支持 ES6 Promise API，突破同源限制，允许不同域名间共享最多 2.49MB 数据，适用于单点登录、多页面状态同步等场景。
summary_en: Cross-storage enables secure cross-domain localStorage sharing via a permission-controlled Hub-Client architecture. Using iframes and postMessage, it allows multiple browser tabs/windows from different domains to share a single storage space with up to 2.49MB capacity, featuring ES6 Promise-based API for seamless integration.

description: logo-generator-skill
summary_zh: 专业SVG Logo生成器，基于产品特性生成6+设计变体，结合12种高端背景风格创建展示图。支持Gemini 3.1 Flash图像预览生成高品质效果图，提供可编辑SVG与即用PNG格式，适用于初创公司、开发者和设计团队快速打造品牌标识。
summary_en: Professional SVG logo generator creating 6+ design variants with 12 curated background styles for high-end showcases. Leverages Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview to produce studio-quality presentation images, offering editable SVG and ready-to-use PNG formats for startups, developers, and design teams.

description: Elegant Microsoft To-Do desktop app
summary_zh: Ao 是一款优雅的开源 Microsoft To-Do 桌面应用，支持深色/黑色/琥珀色主题、紧凑模式、全局快捷键、列表导航及跨平台使用，覆盖 120 余国用户，提供高度可定制界面与自动夜间模式，通过 GitHub Sponsors 获得社区支持。
summary_en: Ao is an elegant, unofficial, open-source Microsoft To-Do desktop app used globally, featuring dark themes, compact mode, global shortcuts, list navigation, scalable UI, and auto-night mode, with community-driven development and support via GitHub Sponsors.

description: Simple and complete web UI framework to create web apps with Windows 8 Metro user interface, based on Bootstrap 2.
summary_zh: BootMetro 是一个基于 Bootstrap 2 的 Web UI 框架，专为创建具有 Windows 8 Metro 风格界面的应用而设计，无需依赖 Windows 8 系统。它整合了 HTML5 Boilerplate 和 IcoMoon 图标库，提供 Metro 风格的布局、磁贴、通知、列表视图和翻转视图等组件，适用于企业内部网等现代 Web 应用。
summary_en: BootMetro is a web UI framework built on Bootstrap 2, designed to create web apps with the Windows 8 MetroUI style without requiring Windows 8. It integrates HTML5 Boilerplate and IcoMoon icons, offering Metro-styled layouts, tiles, toasts, list views, and flip views, ideal for modern intranet applications.

description: A web developer workflow used by WeChat team based on Gulp, with cross-platform supported and solutions prepared.
summary_zh: Tencent tmt-workflow 是基于 Gulp 的前端自动化开发工作流工具，专为微信团队设计，支持跨平台（macOS & Windows）。提供 Less/Sass 编译、CSS 雪碧图、图片压缩、SVG 内联、JS 合并、LiveReload 实时刷新、FTP 部署等完整解决方案，集成 px2rem、WebP 适配等现代前端优化方案，现已迁移至 Feflow 项目。
summary_en: Tencent's tmt-workflow is a Gulp-based frontend development workflow tool designed for the WeChat team, offering cross-platform support (macOS & Windows). It provides comprehensive automation features including Less/Sass compilation, CSS sprites, image compression, SVG inlining, JS bundling, LiveReload, and FTP deployment. Integrated solutions for px2rem, WebP, and MD5 reversion are included. The project has been migrated to Feflow.

description: A beautiful screenshot + screen recording + Loom alternative - all native, self hostable and free.
summary_zh: Screendrop 是一款 macOS 原生免费开源的截图与屏幕录制工具，作为 Loom 的自托管替代方案。支持全屏/窗口/区域捕获、视频转录、字幕生成、画中画剪辑，并通过 Cloudflare 实现带搜索与评论功能的链接分享，深度集成 Apple Shortcuts 与 Siri 自动化。
summary_en: Screendrop is a free, native macOS screenshot and screen recording app — an open-source, self-hostable Loom alternative. Features include AI on-device transcription, karaoke captions, video editing with zooms and picture-in-picture, smart redaction, and shareable links with searchable transcripts and comments via Cloudflare. Integrates with Apple Shortcuts, Siri, and Finder for seamless automation.

description: 《面向开发者的 ChatGPT 提示词工程》非官方版中英双语字幕 Unofficial subtitles of "ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers"
summary_zh: 该项目为非官方中英双语字幕，涵盖吴恩达与 OpenAI 开发者合著的《ChatGPT 提示工程》课程，重点讲解面向开发者的 Prompt 编写技巧，包括文本分类、摘要、翻译、聊天机器人构建等 9 个实战章节，配套交互式 Notebook 与 B 站视频，助力开发者掌握高杠杆 AI 技能。
summary_en: This project provides unofficial bilingual Chinese-English subtitles for Andrew Ng and OpenAI's 'ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers' course, covering 9 practical chapters on prompt writing, including text classification, summarization, translation, and chatbot development, with interactive notebooks and Bilibili videos to help developers master this high-leverage AI skill.

description: ClawGod is a runtime patch applied to the official Claude Code. It continues to be supported with each version update.
summary_zh: ClawGod 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的运行时补丁工具，通过动态注入方式解锁官方版本限制的功能，包括隐藏命令、多智能体协作、屏幕控制等。支持跨平台自动更新与卸载，绿色图标标识已打补丁状态，显著提升开发效率与功能自由度。
summary_en: ClawGod is a runtime patch for Claude Code that unlocks restricted features like hidden commands, multi-agent collaboration, and computer use without Pro subscription. It auto-reapplies patches after updates, uses green branding to indicate patched status, and supports cross-platform installation with one-line scripts.

description: Give your localhost a local or public URL
summary_zh: Slim 是一个 Go 编写的本地开发代理工具，为 localhost 服务提供干净的 HTTPS 自定义域名（如 myapp.test），支持多路由配置、CORS 和自动证书管理。同时可将本地服务安全暴露为公网 URL，便于远程调试与协作演示。
summary_en: Slim is a Go-based local development proxy tool that assigns clean HTTPS custom domains (e.g., myapp.test) to localhost services. It supports multi-route configuration, CORS, and automatic certificate management. Additionally, it can securely expose local servers as public URLs for remote debugging and collaborative demos.

description: A React markdown editor and previewer.
summary_zh: MarkPlus 是一个功能强大的 React Markdown 编辑器与预览组件，支持实时编辑、多主题切换、可定制工具栏及数学公式、流程图等高级功能。它提供编辑器、预览或双栏模式，适用于内容创作与文档开发场景。
summary_en: MarkPlus is a powerful React-based Markdown editor and previewer with real-time editing, customizable toolbar, multi-theme support, and advanced features like math formulas and flowcharts. It supports editor, preview, or dual-pane modes, ideal for content creation and documentation.

description: 突破百度云限速合集，另外附带Baidu-Go、Tampermonkey、Proxyee-down教程。从此云端女友从不断线，有了这个它，忘掉那个她!
summary_zh: 该仓库提供Aria2下载工具及百度网盘破解限速方案，集成BaiduPCS-Go、Tampermonkey脚本和Proxyee-down等工具，支持多平台下载加速，实现百度云资源高速下载，解决限速问题。
summary_en: This repository offers Aria2 download tools and solutions to bypass Baidu Cloud speed limits, integrating BaiduPCS-Go, Tampermonkey scripts, and Proxyee-down for multi-platform accelerated downloads, enabling high-speed access to Baidu Cloud resources.

description: 📦 A macOS utility to seamlessly migrate applications to external storage and reclaim local disk space.【一款 macOS 工具，无缝迁移应用到外部存储并自动建立链接，释放宝贵的本地空间】
summary_zh: AppPorts 是一款专为 macOS 设计的应用迁移工具，可将大型应用一键移至外部存储（SSD/SD卡/NAS），并在原位保留极小的启动桩，实现无快捷箭头、无缝启动。具备自动更新保护、代码签名修复、孤立链接检测及数据目录迁移功能，有效解决 Mac 本地空间不足问题。
summary_en: AppPorts is a macOS utility for seamlessly migrating large applications to external storage (SSD/SD card/NAS) while leaving a tiny launcher stub locally. It features arrow-free linking, auto-update protection, code signature repair, and orphaned link detection, effectively reclaiming precious local disk space without breaking system integration.

description: Beautiful  UI components build with vue and ant design
summary_zh: vue-beauty 是一个基于 Vue 和 Ant Design 构建的精美 UI 组件库，提供丰富的常用场景组件，采用组件化开发模式，封装复杂逻辑并提供简洁 API，内置样式优化与 ES 新特性垫片，支持现代浏览器，助力开发者快速构建美观的 Vue 应用。
summary_en: vue-beauty is a beautiful UI component library built with Vue and Ant Design, offering a rich set of components for common scenarios. It follows Vue's component-driven architecture, encapsulates complexity with simple APIs, includes optimized Ant Design styling and ES polyfills, and supports modern browsers to accelerate Vue app development.

description: 🎒 钉钉 & 🤖 GPT-3.5 让你的工作效率直接起飞 🚀 私聊群聊方式、单聊串聊模式、角色扮演、图片创作 🚀
summary_zh: 基于Go语言开发的钉钉ChatGPT机器人，集成GPT-3.5/4/4o-mini模型，支持私聊、群聊、角色扮演、图片生成等功能，提供Docker部署和Azure-OpenAI支持，显著提升办公沟通效率。
summary_en: A Go-based ChatGPT bot integrated with DingTalk, supporting GPT-3.5/4/4o-mini models, featuring private/group chat, role-playing, image generation, and Azure-OpenAI compatibility via Docker deployment for enhanced workplace productivity.

description: 🐒一些修改自网络的油猴脚本 Some Tampermonkey scripts modified from the internet
summary_zh: 该仓库提供一系列基于油猴脚本（Tampermonkey）的自动化工具，多数脚本改编自网络资源，涵盖网页功能增强、界面优化及实用小工具。所有脚本均托管于GreasyFork平台，支持多语言版本，具备高安装量和良好用户评价，适用于提升日常浏览与操作效率。
summary_en: This repository hosts a collection of Tampermonkey user scripts, mostly modified from online sources, designed to enhance web functionality, optimize interfaces, and provide utility tools. Hosted on GreasyFork with multi-language support, these scripts boast high installation counts and positive user ratings, ideal for improving browsing efficiency and user experience.

description: Automatic Panorama Stitching From Scratch
summary_zh: OpenPano 是一个从零开始用 C++ 编写的自动全景拼接程序，无需依赖任何计算机视觉库。它实现了基于不变特征的经典全景拼接算法，支持圆柱面、相机参数估计和平移三种模式，适用于手持相机拍摄的连续图像拼接，输出高质量无缝全景图。
summary_en: OpenPano is a C++-based automatic panorama stitching tool implemented from scratch without external vision libraries. It follows the pipeline from 'Automatic Panoramic Image Stitching using Invariant Features' and supports cylinder, camera estimation, and translation modes for seamless image stitching from handheld captures.

description: Elasticsearch权威指南中文版
summary_zh: 《Elasticsearch权威指南》中文版由Looly团队主导翻译，系统解析Elasticsearch核心原理与高级特性，涵盖索引设计、查询优化、集群管理等关键技术点，是深入掌握Elasticsearch的权威学习资料，支持多平台阅读。
summary_en: The Chinese translation of 'Elasticsearch: The Definitive Guide', led by Looly, provides a comprehensive deep-dive into Elasticsearch's core concepts, including indexing, advanced querying, and cluster management. It serves as an authoritative resource for mastering Elasticsearch's advanced features and internal mechanisms.

description: 妈妈计划-众人拾柴火焰高
summary_zh: 妈妈计划2（MAMA2）是一个开源项目，旨在解决MacBook观看在线视频时发热严重的问题，通过将Flash播放器替换为HTML5 Video实现。项目支持哔哩哔哩、优酷、土豆、芒果TV等主流视频网站，采用模块化架构，开发者可编写seeker脚本解析视频源地址。支持本地开发环境搭建，具备跨域请求、日志记录等工具函数，鼓励社区参与扩展支持网站。
summary_en: MAMA2 is an open-source project designed to resolve overheating issues in MacBooks when watching online videos by replacing Flash players with HTML5 Video. It supports major platforms like Bilibili, Youku, Tudou, and more. The project uses a modular architecture where developers can write 'seeker' scripts to extract video URLs. It includes tools for AJAX, logging, and cross-domain requests, with a local development environment using Node.js and Gulp. Community contributions are encouraged to expand site support.

description: Every display control macOS hides, in one menu bar app: sharp HiDPI/Retina scaling (no more blurry or tiny text), DDC brightness and volume, Extra Brightness past 100%, presets, virtual displays. Free and open source, a no-cost alternative to BetterDisplay and Lunar.
summary_zh: Crisp是免费开源的macOS外接显示器控制面板，提供锐利HiDPI缩放、DDC亮度调节、显示器预设与虚拟屏幕等功能，替代BetterDisplay等付费工具，提升多屏显示体验。
summary_en: Crisp is a free, open-source external monitor control app for macOS, offering sharp HiDPI scaling, DDC brightness control, display presets and virtual displays as an alternative to paid tools like BetterDisplay.

description: python ip proxy tool  scrapy crawl. 抓取大量免费代理 ip，提取有效 ip 使用
summary_zh: 基于 Scrapy 的 Python 代理 IP 抓取与验证工具，支持多源采集、异步验证、MySQL 存储及 RESTful 数据接口，提供高匿/匿名/透明代理筛选与 HTTPS 支持检测，适用于爬虫反爬、数据采集等场景。
summary_en: A Python-based proxy IP crawler and validator using Scrapy, featuring multi-source scraping, asynchronous validation, MySQL storage, and RESTful API for filtering proxies by anonymity and HTTPS support, ideal for web scraping and anti-bot bypass.

description: Awesome Django authorization, without the database
summary_zh: django-rules 是一个轻量级但功能强大的 Django 权限管理库，无需数据库即可实现对象级权限控制。它基于规则系统构建，支持复杂谓词组合、动态权限判断，并深度集成 Django 视图、模板和 Admin，提供高效、灵活的授权解决方案。
summary_en: django-rules is a lightweight yet powerful Django authorization library enabling object-level permissions without requiring a database. Built on a rule-based system, it supports complex predicate logic, dynamic permissions, and seamless integration with Django views, templates, and Admin for efficient access control.

description: A clock-style timepicker for Bootstrap (or jQuery). Sorry but no longer maintained.
summary_zh: ClockPicker 是一个基于 Bootstrap 或 jQuery 的类时钟风格时间选择器，提供直观的时钟界面用于时间输入。支持桌面和移动设备，兼容 IE9+，具备自动关闭、12/24小时制切换、回调函数等丰富功能，适用于需要美观时间选择器的 Web 应用。
summary_en: ClockPicker is a clock-style timepicker built for Bootstrap or jQuery, offering an intuitive analog clock interface for time selection. It supports major browsers including IE9+, works on both desktop and mobile devices, and provides features like autoclose, 12/24-hour modes, and customizable callbacks for enhanced user experience.

description: 体验极佳的Android图片手势控件。An Android image gesture control with excellent user experience.
summary_zh: PinchImageView 是一款高性能 Android 图片手势控件，提供流畅的单指滑动、双指缩放、惯性滚动等交互体验。支持大图分段加载、分辨率切换、边界反弹及自定义扩展，集成简单且无外部依赖，适用于高清图片浏览场景。
summary_en: PinchImageView is a high-performance Android image gesture control with smooth single-finger swipe, two-finger pinch-zoom, and inertia scrolling. It supports large image segment loading, resolution switching, boundary rebound, and extensible APIs, making it ideal for high-definition image viewing with minimal integration effort.

description: A collapsible jQuery menu plugin
summary_zh: metismenu 是一个轻量级 jQuery 插件，用于创建可折叠的侧边栏菜单。支持现代浏览器，提供流畅的展开/折叠动画，具备 ARIA 可访问性支持，可通过 CSS 类（如 has-arrow）自定义箭头样式，适用于后台管理系统等需要多级导航的场景。
summary_en: MetisMenu is a lightweight jQuery plugin for creating collapsible sidebar menus. It supports modern browsers only, offers smooth expand/collapse animations, includes ARIA accessibility features, and allows customization via CSS classes like has-arrow, making it ideal for admin dashboards and multi-level navigation systems.

description: GitHub notifications alike app for Django
summary_zh: django-notifications 是一个专为 Django 设计的 GitHub 风格通知系统，基于 Activity Streams 规范构建。它通过 Actor、Verb、Action Object 和 Target 四元组模型实现灵活的事件通知机制，支持任意 Django 对象间的关联，适用于构建用户动态、活动提醒等场景。
summary_en: django-notifications is a GitHub-style notification system for Django, built on the Activity Streams specification. It uses a four-component model (Actor, Verb, Action Object, Target) to create flexible event-based notifications, supporting arbitrary Django object relationships for user activity feeds and real-time alerts.

description: Your AI agent skills, finally organized. A macOS app to browse, edit, and manage skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and Amp.
summary_zh: Chops 是一款 macOS 原生应用，专为统一管理和编辑 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Windsurf、Amp 等 AI 编程工具的代码技能而设计。支持实时文件监控、全文搜索、集合分类和远程技能库连接，提供 SwiftUI + SwiftData 架构下的流畅编辑体验。
summary_en: Chops is a native macOS app that centralizes management of AI coding agent skills across tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It features real-time file watching, full-text search, collections, and remote skill server integration, built with SwiftUI and SwiftData for seamless editing.

description: Snip Anything Solve Everything​
summary_zh: Snippai 是一款基于先进 AI 算法的智能截图工具，支持公式识别（转 LaTeX）、文本提取、表格转 Markdown、图像分析、代码理解、颜色检测和多语言翻译等功能，显著提升截图处理效率与智能化水平。
summary_en: Snippai is an AI-powered intelligent snipping tool that leverages advanced algorithms to recognize formulas (LaTeX conversion), extract text, convert tables to Markdown, analyze images, understand code, detect colors, and translate text in any language—enhancing productivity through smart screenshot processing.

description: 😁 git commit message emoji 使用指南
summary_zh: 本项目提供了一套中文化的 Git Commit Emoji 使用指南，涵盖 30+ 个常用 emoji 及其对应代码，用于规范提交信息格式，提升代码历史可读性与团队协作效率。支持命令行显示 emoji，适用于多平台开发场景。
summary_en: This repo provides a comprehensive guide for using Git commit emojis in Chinese, including 30+ emoji codes and their meanings to standardize commit messages, enhance code history clarity, and improve team collaboration. It supports emoji display in terminals and is suitable for cross-platform development.

description: [废弃] {官方中文马上就来了} GitHub 汉化插件，GitHub 中文化界面。 (GitHub Translation To Chinese)
summary_zh: GitHub 汉化插件为英文基础薄弱用户提供中文界面支持，通过 Tampermonkey 实现 GitHub 全站翻译，帮助新手快速上手。插件每日自动更新翻译内容，支持 Chrome、Opera 等主流浏览器，并提供手动安装指南。
summary_en: GitHub Hans is a Tampermonkey-based plugin that translates GitHub's full interface into Chinese, aiding users with limited English proficiency. It auto-updates translations daily and supports major browsers like Chrome and Opera, with clear installation instructions.

description: A powerful no-code automation tool. Build workflows via drag-and-drop modules for web scraping, form filling and automated testing. | 一款功能强大的自动化工具，通过拖拽模块的方式快速构建自动化工作流，无需编写任何代码即可实现网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等任务。【QQ交流群：115069513】
summary_zh: Web RPA 是一款强大的可视化网页自动化工具，支持零代码拖拽构建自动化工作流，涵盖网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等场景。基于 FastAPI + React 架构，集成 273 个功能模块，涵盖浏览器自动化、数据处理、数据库操作、媒体处理、PDF 转换、文档转换等全栈能力，提供智能搜索、Mermaid 流程图、变量自动补全等高效开发特性，支持非商业免费使用。
summary_en: Web RPA is a powerful visual automation tool enabling zero-code workflow creation via drag-and-drop. It supports web scraping, form filling, and testing with 273 built-in modules across browser automation, data processing, database operations, media handling, PDF conversion, and document transformation. Built on FastAPI + React, it offers smart search, Mermaid flowcharts, variable autocompletion, and full non-commercial free usage.

description: Flexible Node.js crawler library
summary_zh: x-crawl 是一个灵活的 Node.js AI 辅助爬虫库，集成 Ollama 和 OpenAI，支持动态/静态页面、接口及文件数据抓取，具备设备指纹伪装、代理轮换、失败重试、优先级队列等功能，通过 AI 智能解析应对网页结构变更，提升爬虫效率与智能化水平。
summary_en: x-crawl is a flexible Node.js AI-assisted crawler library integrating Ollama and OpenAI. It supports dynamic/static pages, API, and file data crawling with features like device fingerprinting, proxy rotation, retry mechanisms, and priority queues. AI-powered semantic parsing helps adapt to website structural changes, enhancing efficiency and intelligence.

description: 🤖 叮当是一款可以工作在 Raspberry Pi 上的中文语音对话机器人/智能音箱项目。
summary_zh: 叮当是一款专为树莓派设计的开源中文语音对话机器人/智能音箱项目，支持模块化插件扩展、微信远程操控、多平台语音识别与合成技术，并集成智能家居控制功能，旨在帮助中国开发者快速构建个性化智能设备。
summary_en: Dingdang is an open-source Chinese voice dialogue robot/smart speaker project designed for Raspberry Pi, featuring modular plugins, WeChat integration, multi-platform STT/TTS support, and smart home control, enabling developers to easily build personalized voice assistants.

description: 将视频瞬间转化为手绘故事 Turn Video Moments into Hand-Drawn Stories
summary_zh: ClipSketch AI 是一款专为视频创作者设计的 AI 驱动内容创作工具，支持解析 Bilibili 和小红书视频链接，实现帧级精准标记，并借助 Google Gemini 多模态模型将精彩瞬间一键转化为手绘风格故事板，自动生成适配社交媒体的爆款文案，涵盖角色融合、封面生成和批量精修功能。
summary_en: ClipSketch AI is an AI-powered content creation tool for video creators, enabling frame-level tagging of Bilibili and Xiaohongshu videos, transforming key moments into hand-drawn storyboards via Google Gemini's multimodal models, and auto-generating social media captions, character fusion, cover images, and batch-enhanced visuals.

description: File and Image Management Application for django
summary_zh: django-filer 是专为 Django 设计的文件与图片管理应用，提供直观的文件库管理、图片裁剪、批量操作等功能，深度集成 django CMS，支持拖拽上传、权限控制和多格式预览，显著提升内容管理系统的媒体资源管理效率。
summary_en: Django Filer is a file and image management application for Django that simplifies handling of media assets. It offers intuitive file browsing, image manipulation, batch operations, and seamless integration with django CMS, enhancing content management workflows with drag-and-drop uploads, permission controls, and multi-format support.

description: Authenticator on Windows for Battle.net / Steam / Guild Wars 2 / Glyph / Runescape / SWTOR / Bitcoin and digital currency exchanges
summary_zh: WinAuth 是一款开源的 Windows 多平台双因子认证工具，支持 RFC 6238 时间型（TOTP）和 HOTP 计数器型验证码，兼容 Battle.net、Steam、Guild Wars 2、SWTOR 及主流数字货币交易所。具备密码保护、机器绑定、YubiKey 支持、热键操作、便携模式及跨设备导入导出功能，适用于安全与便捷的双重认证管理。
summary_en: WinAuth is an open-source, portable authenticator for Windows that supports RFC 6238 (TOTP) and HOTP-based 2FA codes. It integrates authenticators for Battle.net, Steam, Guild Wars 2, SWTOR, and major cryptocurrency exchanges like Coinbase and Bitstamp. Features include password protection, machine binding, YubiKey support, hotkey controls, portable mode, and import/export via UriKeyFormat, enabling secure and unified two-factor authentication management.

description: A high performance open-source forum software written in PHP. Discussions Tags based with Quora/StackOverflow style.
summary_zh: Carbon-Forum 是一款高性能开源 PHP 论坛系统，采用 Quora/StackOverflow 式标签讨论机制，支持移动端适配、实时推送、异步设计和完整 SEO 优化，具备现代通知中心与草稿保存功能，适用于构建高效知识分享社区。
summary_en: Carbon-Forum is a high-performance open-source PHP forum software featuring Quora/StackOverflow-style discussion tags, mobile support, real-time notifications, asynchronous architecture, and full SEO optimization, ideal for building efficient knowledge-sharing communities.

description: 一键将视频转换为优质小红书笔记，自动优化内容和配图
summary_zh: 视频笔记生成器一键将视频内容转换为优质小红书笔记，支持自动语音转文字、AI内容优化、标题创作、配图获取及标签生成。V2.0版本采用FastAPI提供现代化Web界面，支持批量处理、长视频解析、智能错误重试与历史记录管理，显著提升内容创作效率。
summary_en: Video Note Generator automatically converts videos into high-quality Xiaohongshu notes with speech-to-text, AI content optimization, title generation, image fetching, and hashtag creation. V2.0 features a modern FastAPI web interface, batch processing, 30-minute video support, smart retry mechanisms, and history tracking for efficient content production.

description: An issue tracking tool based on laravel+reactjs for small and medium-sized enterprises, open-source and free, similar to Jira.
summary_zh: ActionView 是一款基于 Laravel+React 的开源问题跟踪工具，专为中小型企业设计，功能类似 Jira。支持敏捷看板、甘特图、自定义工作流、权限管理、LDAP 集成、GitLab/GitHub Webhook 联动等，提供清晰代码结构和 Docker 部署方案，适用于轻量级项目管理和团队协作。
summary_en: ActionView is an open-source issue tracking tool built with Laravel (backend) and React+Redux (frontend), targeting SMEs as a Jira alternative. It supports agile boards, Gantt charts, custom workflows, LDAP integration, GitLab/GitHub webhooks, and Docker deployment, offering clean code and extensibility for team collaboration.

description: HTML to PDF in the browser — one line of code for selectable, searchable vector PDFs (10,000+ pages). Pure frontend: zero backend, zero runtime deps. TypeScript over a Rust + WebAssembly engine; an html2canvas/jsPDF alternative.
summary_zh: dompdf.js 是一个前端库，可将 HTML 转换为多页矢量 PDF，支持分页和数千页文档生成。基于 html2canvas 和 jspdf 改造，直接在浏览器中生成可编辑、非图像式的 PDF，具备高质量输出、小文件体积、无需服务端渲染等优势，适用于网页内容导出和打印场景。
summary_en: dompdf.js is a frontend library that converts HTML into multi-thousand-page vector PDFs with a single line of code. Built on html2canvas and jspdf, it generates editable, non-image PDFs directly in the browser, offering high quality, small file size, and no server-side rendering. Ideal for web content export and printing.

description: 搜索真实文献并生成引用对应文献的AI论文
summary_zh: paper-ai 是一个基于 AI 的论文写作工具，支持通过真实文献自动生成引用，集成 Semantic Scholar、arXiv 和 PubMed 进行文献检索，结合大模型生成高质量学术内容，显著提升论文撰写效率与引用准确性。
summary_en: Paper-ai is an AI-powered academic writing tool that generates papers with real citations by searching Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and PubMed. It combines large language models with academic databases to streamline research and writing workflows.

description: 无线麦（SayAll.app）：支持小米蓝牙遥控器 2 和 2 Pro，变成 Mac 语音输入设备
summary_zh: 无线麦 SayAll 是一款 macOS 原生应用，可将小米蓝牙遥控器 2 Pro 转化为 Mac 语音输入设备，支持按住说话实时输入、多套键位方案按 App 自动切换，以及组合动作自动化流程，内置记录回眸与 MCP 本地 Agent 集成，CPU 占用低于 0.5%，内存约 50MB，兼顾轻量与高效。
summary_en: SayAll is a native macOS app that transforms Xiaomi Bluetooth Remote 2 Pro into a wireless microphone for Mac, enabling real-time voice typing, per-app shortcut profiles, and automation workflows. It features voice history logging with local MCP agent integration, runs lightweight under 0.5% CPU and ~50MB memory.

description: Connect to any agents with WeChat ClawBot.
summary_zh: WeClaw 是一个 WeChat AI Agent 桥接工具，支持连接 Claude、Codex、Gemini 等主流 AI 模型。通过 QR 码登录微信后自动检测并集成已安装的 AI 代理，提供 ACP/CLI/HTTP 三种交互模式，支持消息转发、图片文件传输、Markdown 转换及主动推送功能，具备持久化配置和命令行/API 双重控制能力。
summary_en: WeClaw is a WeChat AI Agent Bridge that connects WeChat to AI agents like Claude, Codex, and Gemini. It auto-detects installed agents via QR login, supports ACP/CLI/HTTP modes, handles media/image forwarding, converts markdown responses, and enables proactive messaging via CLI or HTTP API with persistent config.

description: Animated border beam effect for React
summary_zh: border-beam 是一个轻量级 React 组件，为卡片、按钮等元素提供动态流光边框动画效果。支持多种尺寸预设、颜色主题（彩虹/单色/海洋/日落）和强度调节，可自动适配明暗背景。通过 CSS @property 实现高性能 GPU 加速动画，不影响内容交互。
summary_en: border-beam is a lightweight React component that adds animated glowing border effects to any element. It supports multiple size presets, color variants (rainbow/mono/ocean/sunset), and intensity controls. Automatically adapts to dark/light themes with GPU-accelerated animations using CSS @property, ensuring smooth performance without interfering with content interaction.

description: 极简且免费的微信消息推送服务 (基于golang)
summary_zh: 基于 Golang 开发的极简免费微信消息推送服务，支持 Docker 一键部署（镜像仅 2MB），提供每日 10 万次推送额度，支持原生弹窗与声音提醒，具备多用户管理、自定义跳转页面及无限换肤功能，适用于个人及小型项目消息通知场景。
summary_en: A minimalist and free WeChat message push service built with Golang, supporting one-click Docker deployment (2MB image), 100K daily push quota, native pop-up and sound alerts, multi-user support, customizable redirect pages, and unlimited skin switching, ideal for personal and small-scale notification systems.

description: 租房要点，适用于北上广深杭，欢迎补充。
summary_zh: 该仓库整理了中国一线城市（北上广深杭）租房核心要点，聚焦避坑指南与实操策略，涵盖直租识别、中介甄别、合同陷阱防范及合租注意事项，强调实地验房与房东资质核查，旨在帮助租客规避常见纠纷、保障居住安全与权益。
summary_en: This repository compiles essential rental tips for major Chinese cities (Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Hangzhou), focusing on avoiding pitfalls and practical strategies. It covers identifying direct landlord rentals, vetting agents, contract traps, and co-living safety, emphasizing on-site inspections and landlord qualification checks to protect tenants from disputes and unsafe housing.

description: MultiAgentPPT 是一个集成了 A2A（Agent2Agent）+ MCP（Model Context Protocol）+ ADK（Agent Development Kit） 架构的智能化演示文稿生成系统，支持通过多智能体协作和流式并发机制
summary_zh: MultiAgentPPT 是基于 A2A+MCP+ADK 架构的多智能体演示文稿生成系统，通过大纲生成、主题拆分、并行调研和流式汇总等智能体协作，实现高质量PPT的自动化生成，支持实时编辑与下载，具备可扩展性和本地模型适配能力。
summary_en: MultiAgentPPT is a multi-agent system leveraging A2A+MCP+ADK architecture to automate PPT generation through outline creation, topic splitting, parallel research, and streaming synthesis. It supports real-time editing, high-quality content, extensibility, and local model compatibility.

description: 高颜值的第三方网易云播放器；通过自写插件可支持其他线上音乐服务；支持流媒体音乐，如navidrome、jellyfin、emby；支持本地音乐播放、离线歌单、逐字歌词、桌面歌词、Touch Bar歌词、Mac状态栏歌词显示、Linux-gnome与Linux-kde桌面状态栏歌词显示；支持降调降速，支持自定义主题等。支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron:
summary_zh: VutronMusic 是一款高颜值跨平台第三方网易云音乐播放器，支持本地音乐、流媒体服务（如Navidrome、Jellyfin）、离线歌单及逐字歌词。具备桌面歌词、状态栏歌词、变调变速、自定义主题等功能，采用 Vue3 + TypeScript + Fastify 架构，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 多平台。
summary_en: VutronMusic is a high-end third-party NetEase Cloud Music player supporting local music, streaming services (Navidrome, Jellyfin), offline playlists, and karaoke-style lyrics. Features include desktop lyrics, system tray display, pitch/speed control, custom themes, and advanced audio effects. Built with Vue3, TypeScript, Fastify, and Electron for cross-platform support.

description: Modern mouse gestures for Windows. (C#)
summary_zh: WGestures 是一款现代化的 Windows 全局鼠标手势工具，支持 Win7/8/10，提供直观的手势操作以提升效率。采用 C# 开发，集成数字签名与安装程序，适用于快速执行系统命令或应用操作。
summary_en: WGestures is a modern global mouse gesture tool for Windows (Win7/8/10), enabling efficient navigation via intuitive gestures. Built in C# with digital signing and MSI installer support, it streamlines workflow automation through customizable gesture actions.

description: jQuery Mobile Flat UI Theme
summary_zh: jQuery Mobile Flat UI Theme 是一款基于 Flat-UI 设计风格的移动端主题，提供现代化扁平化界面，支持 jQuery Mobile 1.3.0 至 1.4 版本，通过 Stylus 和 Grunt 实现自定义配色与样式扩展，适用于快速构建美观的移动端 Web 应用。
summary_en: jQuery Mobile Flat UI Theme is a modern, flat design theme for jQuery Mobile inspired by Flat-UI. It supports versions 1.3.0 to 1.4, allows custom swatches via Stylus and Grunt, and enables rapid development of visually appealing mobile web applications.

description: Let your AI agent get the sources behind logins and paywalls.
summary_zh: Actionbook 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的浏览器操作引擎，提供实时更新的网页操作手册和 DOM 结构信息，使智能体能快速、精准地执行网页交互任务。相比传统方法，其性能提升 10 倍，显著降低 LLM 的 token 消耗，并通过语义化 JSON 定义实现高容错性和跨框架兼容性。
summary_en: Actionbook is a browser action engine designed for AI agents, delivering up-to-date action manuals and DOM structure so agents can instantly operate any website without guessing. It enables 10x faster execution, 100x token savings, resilient automation via versioned manuals, and universal compatibility with any LLM or agent framework.

description: Google Assistant for macOS!
summary_zh: MacAssistant 是一款将 Google Assistant 集成到 macOS 的 Swift 应用，支持语音交互与系统控制。通过 Google Assistant SDK 实现自然语言处理，支持天气查询、日程管理等常见指令，需用户自行配置 OAuth 凭证。项目采用 Swift 4.2 开发，基于 gRPC 和 Protocol Buffers，提供跨平台语音助手解决方案。
summary_en: MacAssistant is a Swift-based macOS app integrating Google Assistant via the Google Assistant SDK, enabling voice interaction and system control. It supports natural language queries like weather and agenda, requiring user-provided OAuth credentials. Built with Swift 4.2, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers, it offers a cross-platform voice assistant solution for macOS.

description: A Django admin theme using Twitter Bootstrap. It doesn't need any kind of modification on your side, just add it to the installed apps.
summary_zh: django-admin-bootstrapped 是一个为 Django 管理后台提供 Twitter Bootstrap 主题的插件，无需修改现有代码即可集成。它支持 Bootstrap 3 样式渲染、可拖拽排序内联表单、自定义 HTML 注入及 XHTML 兼容，显著提升管理界面的视觉体验与交互性。
summary_en: django-admin-bootstrapped is a Django admin theme powered by Twitter Bootstrap, requiring no code changes—just add it to INSTALLED_APPS. It offers Bootstrap 3 styling, drag-and-drop sortable inlines, custom HTML injection, XHTML compatibility, and enhanced message alerts for a modern admin interface.

description: Multi-service toolkit for Tavily and Firecrawl signup automation, key validation, and isolated proxy pools.
summary_zh: 该工具专注于自动化注册和验证 Tavily、Firecrawl 及 Exa 的 API Key，支持多服务并发注册、邮箱验证码自动处理、真实接口可用性验证，并可选上传至统一代理池，为 MySearch-Proxy 提供稳定上游密钥源。
summary_en: This toolkit automates registration and validation of API keys for Tavily, Firecrawl, and Exa. It supports concurrent signups, email verification handling, real-time API testing, and optional upload to a unified proxy pool, serving as a reliable upstream key provider for MySearch-Proxy.

description: AI-powered daily intelligence for indie hackers and builders. 20 questions, 10+ sources, every morning.
summary_zh: BuilderPulse 为独立开发者和创业者提供每日AI驱动的智能简报，聚合Hacker News、GitHub、Product Hunt等300+信号源数据，每日生成20个关键洞察与可执行建议，帮助快速发现高价值项目机会。
summary_en: BuilderPulse delivers AI-powered daily intelligence for indie hackers and builders, curating 20 insights from 10+ sources including Hacker News, GitHub, and Product Hunt to surface actionable project ideas every morning.

description: Responsive Image Maps jQuery Plugin
summary_zh: jQuery RWD Image Maps 是一个响应式图像地图插件，通过动态重计算坐标，使 HTML 图像映射在窗口缩放或图像尺寸变化时保持精准定位，适用于响应式网页设计中的交互式图像区域。
summary_en: jQuery RWD Image Maps is a responsive image maps plugin that recalculates area coordinates dynamically to maintain accurate clickable regions when images resize, ideal for interactive responsive web designs using HTML image maps.

description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents.
summary_zh: Burrow 是一款开源免费的 macOS 原生系统管理工具，集垃圾清理、应用卸载、磁盘分析、重复文件查找和实时状态监控于一体。内置 MCP 服务器，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 代理安全可控地监控和维护 Mac，所有操作可审计、可回滚。
summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS system management tool that combines junk cleanup, app uninstallation, disk analysis, duplicate finding, and live status monitoring. It features a built-in MCP server for AI agents like Claude Code and Cursor to safely monitor and maintain your Mac, with all actions consent-gated, audited, and reversible.

description: Obfuscate all your TCP connections into HTTP protocol.
summary_zh: FakeHTTP 是一款基于 Netfilter Queue 的 TCP 连接混淆工具，可将任意 TCP 流量伪装成 HTTP/HTTPS 协议，有效绕过网络审查与深度包检测。支持自定义接口、目标主机、TTL 跳数及防火墙规则配置，适用于高级网络隐蔽通信场景。
summary_en: FakeHTTP is a TCP connection obfuscation tool that disguises all TCP traffic as HTTP/HTTPS protocols using Netfilter Queue. It enables stealthy network communication by bypassing deep packet inspection and censorship, with support for custom interfaces, hostnames, TTL manipulation, and firewall rule integration.

description: Old Celery integration project for Django
summary_zh: django-celery 是 Celery 与 Django 的集成项目，专为 Celery v3.x 至 v4.x 设计，提供基于 Django ORM 和缓存的结果存储、任务模块自动发现及后台管理功能。现已停止维护，推荐使用新版 Celery 教程替代。
summary_en: django-celery is a legacy integration project for Celery with Django, supporting Celery v3.x to v4.x only. It enables Django ORM-based result storage, automatic task discovery, and admin integration. The project is no longer actively maintained; users are advised to follow the updated Celery Django tutorial.

description: DRF-extensions is a collection of custom extensions for Django REST Framework
summary_zh: DRF-extensions 是 Django REST Framework 的扩展集合，提供 DetailSerializerMixin、缓存、条件请求、嵌套路由和批量操作等核心功能，支持多版本 Django 和 DRF，文档完善，适合企业级 API 开发。
summary_en: DRF-extensions is a collection of custom extensions for Django REST Framework, offering features like DetailSerializerMixin, caching, conditional requests, nested routes, and bulk operations. It supports multiple Django and DRF versions with comprehensive documentation, ideal for enterprise-grade API development.

description: Visual design tool for building Terminal User Interfaces
summary_zh: TUIStudio 是一款类 Figma 的终端用户界面可视化设计工具，支持拖拽式组件编排、实时 ANSI 预览、多框架代码导出（Ink/BubbleTea/Textual 等），内置 20+ TUI 组件与丰富主题系统，提供绝对/弹性/网格布局引擎及完整撤销重做功能。
summary_en: TUIStudio is a Figma-like visual editor for designing Terminal UIs, featuring drag-and-drop components, live ANSI preview, multi-framework export (Ink/BubbleTea/Textual), 20+ built-in TUI elements, layout engines (absolute/flex/grid), and real-time theme switching with gradient support.

description: Flarum - 优雅自由的 PHP 轻社区
summary_zh: Flarum 是一款基于 PHP 和 Mithril 框架的自由开源轻量级论坛软件，以简洁、响应式设计和高度可扩展性为核心特色。它提供完整的 API 支持与模块化扩展机制，适合快速搭建现代化社区平台，采用 MIT 许可证确保完全开放。
summary_en: Flarum is a free, open-source forum software built with PHP and the Mithril JavaScript framework, emphasizing simplicity, responsiveness, and extensibility. It offers a modular architecture with comprehensive APIs for customization, ideal for building modern online communities under MIT license.

description: 中华人民共和国国家标准 GB/T 2260 行政区划代码
summary_zh: GB/T 2260 是中国行政区划代码国家标准，提供县及县级以上行政区划的完整编码数据，支持多语言实现（Python、JavaScript、Ruby、Java、PHP、Go、Elixir、Swift、C#），可用于构建地理信息系统、地址解析、数据统计等应用，数据权威且持续更新。
summary_en: GB/T 2260 is the Chinese national standard for administrative division codes, providing complete coding data for counties and above-level administrative regions. It supports multi-language implementations (Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Java, PHP, Go, Elixir, Swift, C#) and is ideal for GIS, address parsing, and data analysis applications with authoritative and regularly updated sources.

description: Hacknical, hacker & technical. A website for GitHub user to make a better resume.
summary_zh: Hacknical 是一个专为 GitHub 用户打造的在线简历生成平台，通过深度分析用户的 GitHub 贡献、代码仓库、技术栈等数据，自动生成可视化分析报告，帮助用户打造专业、数据驱动的编程简历。支持中英文切换、组织账号分析、移动端展示及 PDF 导出，技术栈涵盖 React、Koa2、MongoDB 等。
summary_en: Hacknical is a web platform designed for GitHub users to generate data-driven resumes by analyzing their GitHub contributions, repositories, and tech stacks. It provides visual analytics and exportable reports, supporting English, organizations, mobile viewing, and PDF export with a tech stack including React, Koa2, and MongoDB.

description: Boss直聘爬虫 / BOSS直聘职位数据抓取工具，基于 Chrome CDP 协议复用真实登录态，绕过字体反爬，输出明文薪资 JSON/CSV + 薪资技能分析。A Chrome-CDP-based BOSS Zhipin job scraper/crawler.
summary_zh: 基于 Chrome CDP 协议的 BOSS直聘职位抓取工具，通过复用本地真实登录态调用官方搜索 API，有效绕过前端字体反爬机制，直接获取明文薪资数据。支持 JSON/CSV 双格式输出，并提供薪资分布、技能词频分析及求职材料优化提示词生成，可作为 CLI 工具或 Hermes Agent Skill 使用。
summary_en: A Chrome CDP-based BOSS Zhipin job scraper that leverages local authenticated sessions to invoke official search APIs, effectively bypassing font anti-scraping to extract plain-text salary data. It supports JSON/CSV output and provides salary distribution analysis, skill frequency statistics, and job application prompt generation, usable as both a CLI tool and a Hermes Agent Skill.

description: Desktop Agent for Any Task
summary_zh: WorkAny 是一款桌面 AI 智能体应用，通过自然语言指令执行复杂任务，支持实时代码生成、工具调用和沙箱环境运行。基于 Claude Agent SDK 构建，集成 MCP 协议与多模型供应商，提供文件管理、文档/网页/表格/幻灯片生成等全场景能力，适用于自动化办公与软件开发。
summary_en: WorkAny is a desktop AI agent that executes tasks via natural language, featuring real-time code generation, sandboxed execution, and workspace management. Built on Claude Agent SDK with MCP support and multi-provider LLM integration, it enables automated file organization, document/web/table/slide generation, and software development workflows.

description: 原生 macOS 菜单栏代理客户端，基于 SwiftUI + AppKit，由 mihomo 驱动。 轻量、稳定，在菜单栏完成配置、节点、规则、连接与系统代理管理。
summary_zh: ClashBar 是一款原生 macOS 菜单栏代理客户端，基于 mihomo Core，采用 SwiftUI + AppKit 构建。主打轻量化设计（37.5MB），支持配置管理、节点切换、流量策略控制、实时连接监控与系统代理集成，提供中英文双语界面，专注提升代理工具在 macOS 上的易用性与稳定性。
summary_en: ClashBar is a native macOS menu bar proxy client built with SwiftUI + AppKit, powered by mihomo Core. It emphasizes lightweight design (37.5MB), offering configuration management, node switching, traffic policy control, real-time connection monitoring, and system proxy integration. With bilingual support (zh/en), it enhances usability and stability for proxy tools on macOS.

description: A Python library that provides an easy way to identify devices like mobile phones, tablets and their capabilities by parsing (browser) user agent strings.
summary_zh: user_agents 是一个 Python 库，用于解析浏览器 User-Agent 字符串，精准识别设备类型（手机、平板、PC）及其功能特性（如触屏能力），支持主流移动平台与爬虫检测，依赖 ua-parser 实现高效解析。
summary_en: user_agents is a Python library that parses browser User-Agent strings to accurately identify device types (mobile, tablet, PC) and capabilities (e.g., touch support), supporting major platforms and bot detection via the ua-parser engine.

description: MemFree - Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator
summary_zh: MemFree 是一款混合 AI 搜索引擎与 AI 页面生成器，支持多模态输入（文本/图片/文件）、多 AI 模型（Claude/GPT/Gemini）及多搜索引擎，可快速检索知识库与全网信息并生成生产级 UI 页面，显著提升效率并降低成本。
summary_en: MemFree is a Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator that supports multimodal inputs (text/images/files), integrates multiple AI models (Claude/GPT/Gemini) and search engines, enabling fast retrieval from knowledge bases and the web, plus instant generation of production-ready UI pages to boost efficiency and reduce costs.

description: A beautiful component library based on vue3
summary_zh: Lew UI 是一个基于 Vue3 的美观组件库，提供丰富的 UI 组件和开箱即用的样式。它集成了 Tippy.js、Lucide 图标、VueUse 等优质开源库，支持虚拟列表、表单验证等高级功能，文档完善，易于集成，适合快速构建现代化 Web 应用。
summary_en: Lew UI is a beautiful Vue3-based component library offering a rich set of UI components with out-of-the-box styling. It integrates high-quality open-source libraries like Tippy.js, Lucide icons, and VueUse, supporting advanced features such as virtual lists and form validation. With comprehensive documentation and easy integration, it's ideal for rapidly building modern web applications.

description: Full-stack AI agent for coding, files, terminals, tools, research, content, multimodal work, and multi-agent workflows.
summary_zh: ProxyCast 是一款基于 Tauri 的本地优先 AI Agent 创作工作台，整合 Workspace、Skills、MCP 标准能力与 Claw 渠道协作，实现从灵感到可发布内容的闭环流程。支持文档生成、研究整理、多平台异步协作及浏览器/终端扩展执行，适合创作者与知识工作者高效沉淀可复用资产。
summary_en: ProxyCast is a local-first AI Agent workspace built with Tauri, integrating Workspace, Skills, MCP-standardized capabilities, and Claw channel collaboration to close the loop from idea to publishable content. It supports document generation, research organization, cross-platform async workflows, and browser/terminal extensions, ideal for creators and knowledge workers to streamline reusable output.

description: 腾讯会议摸鱼工具
summary_zh: TMSpeech 是一款 Windows 平台的实时语音转文字工具，基于 sherpa-onnx 框架实现中文会议语音识别，支持 WASAPI 内录、实时字幕显示与历史记录保存。具备低 CPU 占用（<5%）、无边框可拖动界面、自定义外部识别器集成等功能，适用于会议转录、走神备忘等场景。
summary_en: TMSpeech is a Windows-based real-time speech-to-text tool using the sherpa-onnx framework for Chinese meeting transcription. It captures system audio via WASAPI, displays live subtitles like lyrics, and saves recognition history. Features include low CPU usage (<5%), draggable UI, and support for custom external recognizers, ideal for meetings and note-taking.

description: quick-cocos2d-x is a quick framework, based on cocos2d-x. Make mobile games in Lua.
summary_zh: quick-cocos2d-x 是触控科技基于 cocos2d-x 开发的 Lua 脚本扩展框架，专为移动端游戏快速开发设计。它提供完整的 Lua 脚本支持、高级 UI 库、代码加密与自动更新功能，显著降低开发成本并提升效率，适用于高品质手游产品的敏捷开发。
summary_en: Quick-Cocos2d-x is a Lua-based extension framework built on cocos2d-x by Touch Technology, designed for rapid mobile game development. It offers full Lua scripting support, advanced UI libraries, code encryption, and auto-update features, significantly reducing development costs and accelerating time-to-market for high-quality mobile games.

description: MacOS语音输入法，实时识别、大模型文本优化、全本地存储
summary_zh: Type4Me 是一款 macOS 语音输入工具，支持本地/云端双引擎识别、大模型文本优化及全本地存储。基于 SherpaOnnx 实现设备端离线语音识别，无需 API Key；集成火山引擎等云端服务，提供实时流式识别与多模态 Prompt 处理。支持自定义快捷键、热词管理、片段替换及 CSV 导出，兼顾隐私性与扩展性。
summary_en: Type4Me is a macOS voice input tool featuring dual local/cloud ASR engines, LLM-powered text optimization, and full local storage. Powered by SherpaOnnx for offline on-device recognition without API keys, it integrates cloud services like Volcengine for real-time streaming and advanced prompt processing. Includes customizable hotkeys, vocabulary management, clipboard context support, and CSV export, balancing privacy with extensibility.

description: Django-ERP是一款基于Django开发的ERP管理软件，包含常用的销售管理、采购管理、库存管理、组织管理等，支持按项目归集费用，支持工作流审批，支持采购单、报价单的批量导入。
summary_zh: Django-ERP是基于Django框架开发的开源企业资源管理系统，涵盖销售、采购、库存及组织管理模块，支持项目费用归集、工作流审批及单据批量导入，适用于中小企业内部管理需求。
summary_en: Django-ERP is an open-source ERP management system built on Django, featuring modules for sales, procurement, inventory, and organizational management. It supports project-based cost allocation, workflow approvals, and bulk import of purchase orders and quotations, ideal for SMEs seeking streamlined internal operations.

description: Yet another reusable writing skill for Chinese technical documentation and product copy.
summary_zh: 面向中文技术文档与产品文案的写作 Skill，帮助 AI 助手（Codex、Claude Code）生成克制、准确、易读的中文技术内容。解决空泛表达、机械直译、中英混排可读性差等问题，覆盖接口文档、落地页、FAQ 等高频场景。
summary_en: A reusable writing skill for Chinese technical documentation and product copy. Helps AI agents (Codex, Claude Code) generate precise, readable Chinese tech content. Solves issues like empty rhetoric, mechanical translations, and mixed Chinese-English typography. Covers API docs, landing pages, and FAQs.

description: 中文手绘技术 PPT 整页图像生成 Skill | 21:9 封面 + 16:9 正文配图 | PNG 输出
summary_zh: 该仓库是一个 Codex Skill，用于将文章、课程笔记等内容转化为风格统一的中文手绘技术解释图。支持生成 21:9 封面与 16:9 正文 PNG 图像，强调内容叙事规划与视觉一致性，适用于技术文章配图、课件制作和知识卡片生成，推荐使用 ChatGPT Image 2.0 模型以保证输出质量。
summary_en: This Codex Skill transforms articles, course notes, or outlines into stylistically consistent Chinese hand-drawn technical illustration images. It generates 21:9 cover images and 16:9 content pages in PNG format, emphasizing narrative planning and visual coherence. Ideal for technical articles, courseware, and knowledge cards, it recommends ChatGPT Image 2.0 for optimal output quality.

description: Fast, context-efficient repository tools for AI agents (MCP)
summary_zh: FastCtx 是一款基于 Rust 的高性能本地工具运行时，专为 AI 编程智能体设计，通过 MCP 协议提供文件读取、内容搜索、文件发现、批量替换及 Bash 命令执行等结构化仓库操作。它将复杂的 Shell 命令封装为稳定的输入输出模型，显著降低 AI 代理在工具调用上的认知负担，提升上下文效率，使模型能更专注于代码理解与任务规划。
summary_en: FastCtx is a high-performance Rust-based local tool runtime designed for AI coding agents, providing structured repository operations like file reading, content search, file discovery, batch replacement, and Bash execution via MCP. It encapsulates complex shell commands into stable I/O models, significantly reducing the cognitive load on AI agents, improving context efficiency, and allowing models to focus more on code comprehension and task planning.

description: DCloud开源项目集锦
summary_zh: DCloud开源项目合集，涵盖uni-app、uni-app x、uniCloud、UTS等全栈开发框架的示例工程，提供uni-ai x全平台AI聊天套件及uVue语法测试项目，助力开发者快速构建跨平台移动应用与云端一体化解决方案。
summary_en: DCloud's open-source project collection featuring example projects for uni-app, uni-app x, uniCloud, UTS, and more, including the open-source cross-platform AI chat suite uni-ai-x and uVue syntax test project, enabling rapid development of mobile and cloud-integrated applications.

description: Dujiao-Next
summary_zh: Dujiao-Next 是一款数字商品电商系统，包含 Go 后端、Vue 3 用户前台与管理后台。采用模块化单体架构，支持 JWT/Casbin RBAC/TOTP 双因素认证，集成 Redis 异步任务，适用于虚拟商品、AI 服务与数字礼品卡等电商场景。
summary_en: Dujiao-Next is a digital goods e-commerce platform featuring a Go backend, Vue 3 storefront, and admin panel. It uses modular monolith architecture with JWT, Casbin RBAC, and TOTP 2FA, plus Redis-based async jobs via asynq — ideal for virtual products, AI services, and digital gift cards.

description: 把家用 USB 打印机变成随时可访问的网络打印服务
summary_zh: 该项目基于 CUPS 构建网页打印管理平台，支持通过浏览器远程提交 PDF、图片、Office 文档等多种格式打印任务，具备多用户权限管理、实时预览、打印记录追踪及自动清理功能，适用于家庭与小型办公场景。
summary_en: A web-based print management system built on CUPS that enables remote printing via browser for PDFs, images, and Office documents. It features multi-user roles, real-time preview, print job tracking, and automated cleanup, ideal for home and small office use.

description: All your AI agent sessions in one place — browse, search, resume. Rust + GPUI.
summary_zh: Wake是一款基于Rust+GPUI的macOS原生应用，聚合Claude、Codex、Copilot、Cursor等多个AI编程代理的会话记录。支持全文搜索（FTS5）、会话一键恢复、本地隐私保护（零网络请求），统一浏览所有编码助手历史。
summary_en: Wake is a native macOS app built with Rust + GPUI that unifies all coding-agent sessions — Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, and more. Features full-text search (FTS5), one-click resume, local-first privacy (zero network), and incremental real-time scanning.

description: BrowserWing turns your browser actions into MCP commands Or Claude Skill, allowing AI agents to control browsers efficiently and reliably. Say goodbye to slow, token-heavy LLM interactions — let agents call commands directly for faster automation. Perfect for AI-driven tasks, browser automation, and boosting productivity.
summary_zh: BrowserWing 是一款原生浏览器自动化平台，支持通过 MCP 协议和 Claude Skill 让 AI 智能体直接控制浏览器。提供 26+ HTTP API 接口、可视化脚本录制、LLM 驱动的数据提取及会话管理，实现高效可靠的浏览器自动化，显著减少 LLM 交互延迟。
summary_en: BrowserWing is a native browser automation platform that enables AI agents to control browsers via MCP commands or Claude Skills. It offers 26+ HTTP APIs, visual script recording, LLM-powered data extraction, and session management for fast, reliable automation with minimal token overhead.

description: :books: 一起写Python文章，一起看Python文章 - 利用readthedocs的Python技术文章的收集和翻译。
summary_zh: PyZh 是一个基于 ReadTheDocs 的 Python 技术文章翻译与收集项目，致力于汇聚优质英文技术文档并提供中文翻译。项目采用 RST 格式编写，支持多语言协作，提供 RSS 订阅和在线浏览功能，鼓励社区共同参与内容创作与翻译。
summary_en: PyZh is a Python technology article translation and collection project built on ReadTheDocs, aiming to aggregate high-quality English technical articles with Chinese translations. It uses RST format, supports collaborative writing, offers RSS subscription and online reading, and encourages community contributions.

description: 支持 AnyRouter、AgentRouter 的多平台多账号签到，理论兼容所有基于 NewAPI、OneAPI 的平台。
summary_zh: AnyRouter 多账号自动签到工具，支持 AnyRouter 和 AgentRouter 平台，兼容 NewAPI/OneAPI 架构。通过 GitHub Actions 实现定时自动签到，支持多账号并行处理、WAF 绕过及机器人通知，配置灵活且维护良好。
summary_en: A multi-account auto check-in tool for AnyRouter and AgentRouter platforms, compatible with NewAPI/OneAPI architectures. Uses GitHub Actions for scheduled automation, supports parallel account processing, WAF bypass, and notification alerts with flexible configuration.

description: :books:Java核心知识点整理（包括Java基础、JVM、数据库、计算机网络、算法、操作系统、设计模式、系统设计、框架原理）
summary_zh: 本仓库系统整理 Java 核心技术知识体系，涵盖 Java 基础、JVM、并发编程、容器类、数据库（MySQL、Redis）、计算机网络、算法（数据结构、LeetCode、海量数据处理）、操作系统（Linux）、设计模式及主流框架原理（Spring、MyBatis、Dubbo、Netty、Kafka、Zookeeper、Nginx、Tomcat）。内容结构清晰，适合 Java 开发者系统学习与面试准备。
summary_en: This repository systematically organizes core Java knowledge, covering Java fundamentals, JVM, concurrency, collections, databases (MySQL, Redis), computer networks, algorithms (data structures, LeetCode, big data), operating systems (Linux), design patterns, and framework principles (Spring, MyBatis, Dubbo, Netty, Kafka, Zookeeper, Nginx, Tomcat). It provides structured learning materials ideal for Java developers and interview preparation.

description: A Django app that keeps a log of changes made to an object.
summary_zh: django-auditlog 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，用于自动记录模型对象的所有变更，包括操作用户、变更摘要及详细 JSON 数据，支持灵活查询与审计追踪，适用于需要完整操作日志的场景。
summary_en: django-auditlog is a lightweight Django app that automatically logs all changes to model objects, capturing the actor, change summary, and detailed JSON data for flexible auditing and traceability.

description: 一款白噪音应用送给你，祝您牛掰，有的是钱
summary_zh: XMSLEEP 是一款专注于白噪音播放的 Android 应用，提供雨声、篝火、雷声等多种自然声音，支持音量调节、倒计时、预设播放区域及收藏功能。采用 Material Design 3 和 Jetpack Compose 构建，具备深色模式、动态主题色、无缝循环播放及蓝牙耳机支持，界面简洁流畅，适用于放松、专注和助眠场景。
summary_en: XMSLEEP is an Android app focused on white noise playback, offering natural sounds like rain, fire, thunder, and bird chirps. It supports volume control, countdown timer, preset playlists, favorites, and seamless looping. Built with Jetpack Compose and Material Design 3, it features dark mode, dynamic theming, Coil image loading, and Bluetooth headset support for immersive relaxation, focus, and sleep aid.

description: 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱消息推送服务, 支持多种消息推送渠道✨
summary_zh: MoePush 是基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 构建的开源消息推送服务，支持钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 等 8 种推送渠道，提供简洁的 API 接口与精美 UI，采用 Drizzle ORM 和 D1 数据库，支持 GitHub 登录与 Docker 部署，适合快速集成多平台消息通知。
summary_en: MoePush is an open-source message push service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, supporting 8+ channels including DingTalk, WeCom, and Telegram. It offers a clean API, shadcn/ui-based UI, GitHub OAuth, D1 database via Drizzle ORM, and Docker deployment for easy multi-platform notification integration.

description: Bootstrap Colorpicker is a modular color picker plugin for Bootstrap.
summary_zh: Bootstrap Colorpicker 是一个专为 Bootstrap 4 设计的模块化颜色选择插件，支持 jQuery 和 Bootstrap CSS/JS。它提供灵活的颜色选择功能，兼容 v2.x（Bootstrap 3/4）和 v3.x（Bootstrap 4 或无 Bootstrap）版本，适用于网页颜色输入场景。
summary_en: Bootstrap Colorpicker is a modular color picker plugin for Bootstrap 4, built with jQuery and optional Bootstrap CSS/JS. It supports v2.x (Bootstrap 3/4) and v3.x (Bootstrap 4 or standalone), offering flexible color selection for web applications. Available via npm, yarn, or direct download.

description: Claude Code 中文开发套件 - 为中国开发者定制的零门槛 AI 编程环境。一键安装完整中文化体验，集成 MCP 服务器、智能上下文管理、安全扫描，支持免翻墙访问。让 AI 编程更简单。
summary_zh: Claude Code 中文开发套件是为中国开发者量身定制的零门槛 AI 编程环境，提供一键安装的全中文化体验。集成 MCP 服务器、智能上下文管理、安全扫描等核心功能，支持免翻墙访问。最新版本融合 Anthropic 黑客松冠军配置，包含 9 个专用智能体、7+ 技能模块、10 个快捷指令和完整规则体系，实现从需求分析到代码审查的全流程 AI 驱动开发。
summary_en: Claude Code Chinese Development Kit is a zero-threshold AI programming environment tailored for Chinese developers, offering one-click installation with full Chinese localization. It integrates MCP servers, intelligent context management, security scanning, and supports direct access without VPN. The latest version incorporates the Anthropic Hackathon-winning configuration, featuring 9 specialized agents, 7+ skill modules, 10 slash commands, and a complete rule system for end-to-end AI-driven development workflows.

description: pip install python-office 自动化办公专用库
summary_zh: python-office 是一个专为自动化办公设计的 Python 第三方库，支持一键安装所有功能模块。用户仅需一行代码即可实现微信机器人、PDF处理、邮件发送、Excel/Word/PowerPoint 操作、OCR 识别、AI 工具调用等办公场景需求，无需掌握 Python 编程即可快速上手，显著提升办公效率。
summary_en: python-office is a Python third-party library designed for office automation, enabling one-line code solutions for tasks like WeChat bots, PDF processing, email sending, Excel/Word/PowerPoint operations, OCR, and AI tools. It requires no Python knowledge, supports modular imports, and significantly boosts productivity with zero learning curve.

description: Native GUI for Homebrew Casks
summary_zh: CaskHub 是 Homebrew Casks 的原生 macOS 图形界面应用，支持浏览、搜索、安装、更新和卸载 Mac 应用。采用 SwiftUI 构建，提供分类导航、排行榜、一键 Adopt 非 Homebrew 应用等功能，完全免费开源，无广告订阅。
summary_en: CaskHub is a native macOS GUI for Homebrew Casks, enabling browsing, searching, installing, updating, and uninstalling Mac apps. Built with SwiftUI, it features category browsing, popularity charts, one-click app adoption, and is 100% free and open source with no ads or subscriptions.

description: Skill and MCP server for searching and retrieving icons
summary_zh: Better Icons 是一个图标搜索与检索工具，提供20万+图标资源，支持150+主流图标库（如 Lucide、Heroicons）。可作为 MCP 服务器集成到 AI 编程助手（Cursor/Claude等），或作为 CLI 工具直接调用。具备智能学习、批量获取、跨框架导出等功能，显著提升开发者在 AI 辅助编码中的图标使用效率。
summary_en: Better Icons is a skill and MCP server for searching and retrieving over 200,000 icons from 150+ collections (e.g., Lucide, Heroicons). It integrates with AI coding agents like Cursor and Claude Code via MCP, or functions as a CLI tool. Features include auto-learning usage patterns, batch retrieval, multi-framework exports (React/Vue/Svelte), and direct SVG output to save tokens in AI chats.

description: 微信公众平台 Python 开发包 [DEPRECATED]
summary_zh: wechat-python-sdk 是一个已停止维护的微信公众平台 Python 开发包，支持订阅号和服务号官方接口，提供消息处理、加解密、模板消息等功能。该 SDK 设计为轻量级，便于集成到各类 Web 框架中，不处理 HTTP 请求响应，仅封装微信 API 操作并返回合规响应数据。
summary_en: wechat-python-sdk was a deprecated Python SDK for WeChat Official Accounts (subscription/service accounts), offering message handling, encryption/decryption, template messages, and menu management. It focused on simplifying WeChat API integration by returning compliant response data without handling HTTP layers, designed for easy integration into web frameworks.

description: 如果有人让你推荐 Python 技术书，请让他看这个列表
summary_zh: 本项目为 Python 开发者精心整理的权威技术书籍推荐列表，涵盖入门到进阶全阶段，包含《Head First Python》《集体智慧编程》《利用 Python 进行数据分析》等经典著作，结合社区投票与豆瓣评分，提供高质量学习资源导航。
summary_en: This repo curates a comprehensive list of authoritative Python technical books from beginner to advanced levels, featuring classics like 'Head First Python', 'Programming Collective Intelligence', and 'Python for Data Analysis', backed by community votes and Douban ratings for reliable learning guidance.

description: A JQuery validation framework for bootstrap forms.
summary_zh: jqBootstrapValidation 是一个专为 Bootstrap 表单设计的 jQuery 验证框架，支持实时输入验证并在 help-block 元素中显示错误提示，提升表单交互体验。
summary_en: jqBootstrapValidation is a jQuery validation framework designed for Bootstrap forms, providing real-time input validation and displaying error messages in help-block elements to enhance form user experience.

summary_zh: Any Code 是一款专业的 AI 代码助手桌面应用，基于 Tauri 框架构建，支持 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex 和 Google Gemini 三大 AI 引擎。提供统一会话管理、智能成本追踪、MCP 扩展集成、Hooks 自动化等核心功能，具备多项目并行处理、实时流式输出、Token 优化及开发者友好工具链，适用于高效 AI 辅助开发场景。
summary_en: Any Code is a professional AI-powered code assistant desktop application built with Tauri, supporting three major AI engines: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Google Gemini. It offers unified session management, intelligent cost tracking, MCP extension integration, Hooks automation, multi-project parallel processing, real-time streaming output, token optimization, and developer-friendly tooling for efficient AI-assisted development.

description: 文档（小说、论文、字幕）翻译工具（支持 pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...）Document (Novel, Thesis, Subtitle) Translation Tool (Supports pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...)
summary_zh: DocuTranslate 是一款基于大语言模型的本地文档翻译工具，支持 PDF、Word、Excel、JSON、EPUB、SRT 等多种格式。具备自动术语表生成、PDF 表格/公式/代码识别、JSON 路径翻译、格式保留、多 AI 平台支持、异步高并发处理、局域网多用户共享及交互式 Web 界面等功能。提供便携版安装包，适合小说、论文、字幕等场景的批量翻译。
summary_en: DocuTranslate is a lightweight local document translation tool powered by Large Language Models. It supports multiple formats including PDF, Word, Excel, JSON, EPUB, and SRT. Features include automatic glossary generation, PDF table/formula/code recognition, JSON path-based translation, format preservation, multi-AI platform support, async concurrency, LAN multi-user access, and an integrated Web UI. Ideal for translating novels, academic papers, and subtitles with portable installers under 40MB.

description: Tiny JS library using bootstrap's popovers to help guide your users around your website
summary_zh: Bootstro.js 是一个轻量级 JavaScript 库，利用 Bootstrap 的弹出框（popover）功能，为网站提供用户引导功能。支持 Bootstrap 2 和 3，无需修改代码即可适配，仅需一行变更即可从 Bootstrap 2 升级。支持通过 JS 变量或 AJAX 动态加载引导数据，避免污染 HTML，提升可维护性。
summary_en: Bootstro.js is a lightweight JavaScript library that leverages Bootstrap's popover functionality to guide users through a website. It supports both Bootstrap 2 and 3 with minimal code changes. It enables dynamic slideshow creation via JavaScript variables or AJAX, avoiding HTML pollution and improving maintainability.

description: A dev environment for AI agents.
summary_zh: Jean 是一款基于 Tauri v2 的桌面 AI 助手应用，专为多项目管理、git worktree 自动化及 Claude/Codex/OpenCode CLI 集成设计。支持会话管理、AI 编程助手（含思维链与 MCP 支持）、GitHub 问题追踪、终端集成及远程 Web 访问，提供本地化的无厂商锁定开发体验。
summary_en: Jean is a desktop AI assistant built with Tauri v2, designed for managing multiple projects, git worktrees, and integrating Claude CLI, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. It offers session management, AI-powered development workflows (with thinking modes and MCP support), GitHub integration, terminal access, and remote web access—all running locally without vendor lock-in.

description: Simple prebuilt applications.
summary_zh: Django Basic Apps 是一组预构建的 Django 应用集合，提供博客、媒体内嵌等基础功能模块。支持通过模板标记语法 `<inline type="app.model" id="1"/>` 实现内容内嵌，需依赖 Django Comments、Tagging、Markdown 等第三方库。
summary_en: Django Basic Apps is a collection of prebuilt Django applications offering core features like blogging and content inlining. It supports embedding objects via template markup `<inline type="app.model" id="1"/>` and requires dependencies such as Django Comments, Tagging, and Markdown libraries.

description: WebSockets for Django
summary_zh: django-socketio 是一个 BSD 许可的 Django 应用，通过集成 gevent-socketio 实现 WebSocket 支持，提供频道订阅、事件广播和信号式事件系统，支持实时通信与自动重载服务器，适用于需要实时交互的 Django 项目。
summary_en: django-socketio is a BSD-licensed Django application that enables WebSocket support via gevent-socketio, offering channel-based subscriptions, event broadcasting, and a signals-like event system for real-time communication in Django projects.

description: Power Keys - 解放 Windows 和 macOS 使用效率
summary_zh: Power Keys 是一款专为 Windows 和 macOS 设计的效率工具，通过精心设计的无冲突快捷键组合，显著提升系统操作效率。其核心价值在于统一跨平台快捷键逻辑，降低学习成本，适用于日常办公、开发及多任务处理场景。
summary_en: Power Keys is an efficiency tool for Windows and macOS that boosts productivity through well-designed, non-conflicting keyboard shortcuts. It unifies cross-platform shortcut logic, reducing learning curves for developers and power users in daily workflows and multitasking.

description: elasticsearch 权威指南
summary_zh: 《Elasticsearch 权威指南》中文版项目，由译者 Gavin Foo 翻译自 Clinton Gormley 和 Zachary Tong 的原作，涵盖 Elasticsearch 的核心概念、全文搜索、结构化查询、数据分析、地理定位、自动补全等高级功能，并提供生产环境配置与监控实践，适合开发者与数据工程师系统学习 Elasticsearch。
summary_en: The Chinese translation of 'Elasticsearch: The Definitive Guide' by Gavin Foo, based on the original work by Clinton Gormley and Zachary Tong. This project covers core concepts, full-text search, structured queries, analytics, geolocation, autocomplete, and production deployment of Elasticsearch, serving as a comprehensive resource for developers and data engineers.

description: V2EX 撕逼大战
summary_zh: 该仓库专门收集 V2EX 社区及类似平台上的公开争议事件，涵盖技术争论、价值观冲突、商业纠纷等多元议题，通过存档原始帖子与补充背景资料，系统记录中国互联网技术圈内的公共舆论交锋与社区生态变迁。
summary_en: This repository archives public disputes from V2EX and related platforms, covering technical debates, value conflicts, and business controversies. It systematically documents public discourse and community evolution in China's tech ecosystem through original posts and contextual materials.

description: A news-reading App (MVP+Dagger2+RxJava+Retrofit2+Material Design)
summary_zh: ColorfulNews 是一款基于 MVP 架构的新闻阅读应用，采用 Material Design 风格，集成 Dagger2、RxJava 和 Retrofit2 实现高效的数据绑定与网络请求。支持多频道浏览、图片新闻展示及流畅交互体验，适用于 Android 平台学习与实践。
summary_en: ColorfulNews is a news-reading app built with MVP architecture and Material Design, utilizing Dagger2, RxJava, and Retrofit2 for robust dependency injection, reactive programming, and network communication. It supports multi-channel browsing, image news display, and smooth user interactions, ideal for Android development learning.

description: 把灵感、写作、出图、改稿、沉淀放进同一个工作台，让创作从“想到”直接走到“可发布”
summary_zh: ProxyCast 是一个面向创作者的 AI Agent 平台，整合灵感发散、内容生成、素材制作与版本沉淀全流程，支持社媒、短视频、小说、海报等九大创作主题，实现从想法到可发布内容的一站式高效创作。
summary_en: ProxyCast is an AI Agent platform for creators, integrating ideation, content generation, asset creation, and versioning into a unified workspace. It supports nine major creative domains—from social media to novels—enabling seamless workflows from concept to publishable output.

description: Diycode每日文章精选
summary_zh: Diycode每日精选是一个技术文章聚合项目，专注于每日精选高质量技术文章并附带点评，覆盖Android开发、React Native、性能优化、架构设计等领域，内容由社区维护并归档，旨在为开发者提供有价值的知识分享与学习资源。
summary_en: Diycode Daily Selection is a curated tech article aggregation project that collects and reviews high-quality technical articles daily, covering Android development, React Native, performance optimization, and architecture. Maintained by the community, it archives content for developers to access valuable knowledge and learning resources.

description: 人教社电子教材下载器
summary_zh: FreePEP是一款人教社中小学电子教材批量下载工具，内置全量780+教材目录与AES解密引擎，自动破解WAF滑块验证码。支持WebUI与CLI双模式，提供多线程并发下载、断点续传及高清PDF合成功能，可一键获取指定学段、学科、年级的全套教材。
summary_en: FreePEP is a batch downloader for People's Education Press textbooks, featuring 780+ built-in titles and an AES decryption engine. It automatically bypasses WAF CAPTCHA, supports dual WebUI/CLI modes, multi-threaded downloads with resumption, and high-quality PDF synthesis for quick textbook access.

description: Hexo theme, Blog theme, Clean, Responsive theme
summary_zh: Hexo主题diaspora是一款简洁清新的响应式博客主题，支持Ajax加载、音乐播放、分类标签页和本地搜索功能，适合摄影、影评、乐评等文艺类博客，提供丰富的自定义配置选项。
summary_en: Hexo-theme-diaspora is a clean, responsive blog theme featuring Ajax loading, music playback, category/tag pages, and local search. Ideal for photography, film, and music reviews, it offers extensive customization via configuration options.

description: A drop-in replacement for Django's runserver.
summary_zh: django-devserver 是 Django runserver 的即用型替代方案，提供实时 SQL 日志、Werkzeug 调试器集成、多进程/线程支持及内存分析等功能，显著提升开发调试效率。
summary_en: django-devserver is a drop-in replacement for Django's runserver, offering real-time SQL logging, Werkzeug debugger integration, multi-process/threaded modes, and memory profiling to enhance development debugging.

description: A free and open-source collection of native macOS menu bar tools.
summary_zh: MacTools 是一款免费开源的原生 macOS 菜单栏工具集，提供系统状态监控、活动统计、快捷控制（显示/音频/电源）等插件面板。支持自定义组件排列、多主题切换（兼容 iTerm2/Base16）及插件市场扩展，界面深度适配 macOS 原生风格，基于 SwiftUI 构建，要求 macOS 14+
summary_en: MacTools is a free, open-source native macOS menu bar toolkit offering system status widgets, activity analytics, and quick controls for display, audio, and power. It features a plugin marketplace, draggable custom panels, light/dark theme support (including iTerm2 and Base16 palettes), and a polished SwiftUI-based interface requiring macOS 14+.

description: 一句话生成大师级海报、书籍封面、专辑封面和各类设计作品。无需懂PS、配色或艺术史，AI自动选择最佳风格（基于20位传奇海报设计师）。支持电影海报、读书笔记、公众号封面、小红书配图等。默认9:16竖版，完美适配社交媒体。包含AI提示词优化、风格对比、图生图转换功能。触发词："Mondo风格"、"书籍封
summary_zh: 乔木Mondo海报设计是一款AI驱动的设计工具，用户只需一句话描述需求，即可自动生成专业级海报、书籍封面、专辑封面等设计作品。基于20位传奇设计师风格库，支持多场景适配（公众号、小红书、电影海报等），内置AI提示词优化与风格对比功能，无需设计基础即可产出大师级作品。
summary_en: Qiaomu Mondo Poster Design is an AI-powered tool that generates professional posters, book covers, and album art from a single sentence. It leverages styles from 20 legendary designers, supports multiple social media formats (WeChat, Xiaohongshu), and includes AI prompt optimization and style comparison features, enabling anyone to create master-level designs without design skills.

description: Standalone CliProxyAPI usage tracker with SQLite persistence and built-in dashboard.
summary_zh: CPA Usage Keeper 是一款独立的 CLIProxyAPI 用量持久化与仪表盘服务，通过消费 Redis 队列将 CPA 用量数据写入 SQLite，并提供聚合 API 与内置 Web 仪表盘，支持按时间、模型、API Key 等多维度筛选，可视化展示请求量、Token 消耗、成本、缓存命中率及请求健康度。
summary_en: CPA Usage Keeper is a standalone usage persistence and dashboard service for CLIProxyAPI. It consumes Redis usage events into SQLite, exposes aggregation APIs, and provides a built-in web dashboard for request volume, token usage, cost, cache hit rate, success rate, and multi-dimensional filtering by time, model, API key, and provider.

description: A free, elegant Markdown editor for macOS, Windows and Linux. Simple by design, always in sync with the file on disk.
summary_zh: ColaMD 是一款专为 AI 智能体协作设计的原生 Markdown 编辑器，支持实时同步 AI 对 .md 文件的修改，具备 WYSIWYG 编辑、多主题支持和跨平台导出功能。其核心亮点在于通过文件监听实现 AI 操作的无缝可视化，让用户像结对编程一样观察智能体工作过程。
summary_en: ColaMD is an Agent-Native Markdown editor designed for real-time collaboration between humans and AI agents. It instantly reflects AI-generated changes to .md files via file system monitoring, featuring WYSIWYG editing, cross-platform support, and theme customization—eliminating manual refresh cycles during agent-assisted writing.

description: Accounts for Django made beautifully simple
summary_zh: Django Userena 是一个为 Django 项目提供完整账户管理的开源应用，涵盖用户注册、激活、消息通知等功能，采用 BSD 许可可免费商用。其核心优势在于高度可定制性与开箱即用的用户体验，显著简化 Django 用户认证系统的开发流程。
summary_en: Django Userena is an open-source Django application that provides complete account management including signup, activation, and messaging. It features full customization, BSD licensing for free commercial use, and streamlines user authentication development with a polished, production-ready interface.

description: A free and open-source collection of native macOS menu bar tools.
summary_zh: MacTools 是一款基于 SwiftUI 和 AppKit 开发的免费开源 macOS 菜单栏工具集，专为 macOS 14.0+ 设计。它集成了显示器亮度调节、分辨率切换、深色模式、夜览、防睡眠、鼠标增强、隐藏刘海、磁盘清理及 Xcode 缓存清理等数十项高频系统操作，旨在通过轻量、无干扰的原生应用提升 Mac 用户的工作效率与系统管理能力。
summary_en: MacTools is a free, open-source collection of native macOS menu bar utilities built with SwiftUI and AppKit for macOS 14.0+. It consolidates dozens of high-frequency system actions—including display brightness/resolution control, Dark Mode, Night Shift, sleep prevention, mouse enhancement, notch hiding, disk cleanup, and Xcode cache management—into a lightweight, unobtrusive app to boost productivity and system control.

description: 完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App | Completely free, open-source, collaborative accounting Web App
summary_zh: Cent 是一款完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App，基于 GitHub 仓库实现数据同步与版本控制，无需服务器即可跨平台实时协作。支持语音记账、AI 智能分析、多币种管理、地图可视化、周期记账等高级功能，采用纯前端 PWA 架构，数据完全自持于用户私有仓库，保障隐私安全。
summary_en: Cent is a completely free, open-source collaborative accounting web app that uses GitHub repositories for data synchronization and version control, enabling real-time cross-platform collaboration without servers. It supports advanced features like voice记账, AI analysis, multi-currency management, map visualization, and recurring transactions. Built as a pure frontend PWA with data stored in user-owned private repositories for full privacy and security.

description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents. Coming to Windows
summary_zh: Burrow 是一款免费开源的原生 macOS GUI 工具，为 Mole CLI 提供可视化操作界面。它集成了磁盘清理、应用卸载、系统优化、磁盘分析及实时状态监控功能，并支持长期历史记录与本地 MCP 服务器，方便 AI 智能体通过自然语言直接操控系统维护任务，即将支持 Windows 平台。
summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS GUI for the Mole CLI engine. It bundles disk cleaning, app uninstallation, system optimization, disk analysis, and live status monitoring. Featuring long-range history and a local MCP server, it enables AI agents to autonomously diagnose and resolve system issues via natural language, with a Windows version in preview.

description: Awesome AI GPTs, OpenAI GPTs, GPT-4, ChatGPT, GPTs, Prompts, plugins, Prompts leaking
summary_zh: Awesome AI GPTs 是一个精选的 OpenAI GPTs 资源库，涵盖提示词工程、内容创作、编程辅助、数据分析等场景。项目提供热门 GPTs 推荐、插件安装指南、知识库构建工具及安全防护方案，助力用户高效利用 AI 能力。
summary_en: Awesome AI GPTs is a curated collection of OpenAI GPTs resources, covering prompt engineering, content creation, coding assistance, and data analysis. It offers hot GPTs recommendations, plugin installation guides, knowledge base tools, and security solutions to enhance AI utilization.

description: [NeurIPS 2024] DreamClear: High-Capacity Real-World Image Restoration with Privacy-Safe Dataset Curation
summary_zh: DreamClear 是 NeurIPS 2024 论文提出的高容量真实世界图像修复系统，通过隐私安全的语料库构建技术，实现高质量图像恢复。其核心创新在于结合 PixArt-α 生成模型与多模态对齐能力，支持文本引导修复，并在 RealLQ250 基准测试中表现优异，适用于摄影、遥感等真实场景。
summary_en: DreamClear, presented at NeurIPS 2024, is a high-capacity real-world image restoration framework featuring privacy-safe dataset curation. It leverages the PixArt-α generative model with multimodal alignment for text-guided restoration, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the RealLQ250 benchmark across diverse real-world scenarios including photography and remote sensing.

description: 归藏的材质插画 skill：生成带字解释图、图表美化和参考辅助配图。
summary_zh: 歸藏的材质插画 Skill 是专为 AI Agent（如 Claude Code/Codex）设计的配图工具，核心解决文章、PPT 及社交卡片中“中心配图”的生成难题。它通过材质化 3D 风格，将抽象概念、数据图表及工作流程转化为带中文标签的解释图、美化图表及参考辅助图，强调信息传达的准确性与视觉的专业性，适配从小红书卡片到教学材料的多种场景。
summary_en: Guizang Material Illustration Skill is an AI Agent-native tool for generating explanatory center graphics. It transforms abstract concepts, data charts, and workflows into labeled 3D material-style illustrations, beautified charts, and reference-assisted visuals. Focusing on information accuracy and Swiss editorial aesthetics, it supports various scenarios from social media cards to educational content.

description: A feature-rich, efficient text editor - Web Site
summary_zh: Yu Writer Site 是一个功能丰富、高效的文本编辑器网站，提供现代化的写作体验。支持 Markdown 编辑、实时预览、多主题切换和本地存储，适用于内容创作者和开发者。项目采用轻量级架构，注重性能与用户体验。
summary_en: Yu Writer Site is a feature-rich, efficient text editor web application offering a modern writing experience. It supports Markdown editing, live preview, multi-theme switching, and local storage, ideal for content creators and developers. Built with a lightweight architecture focused on performance and user experience.

description: Material Design 中文版 ( 2015 年 8 月更新)
summary_zh: Material Design 中文版是 Google 官方设计规范的首个完整中文翻译项目，由 1sters 团队联合极客学院于 2015 年 8 月完成全面更新。该项目系统性地将 Material Design 核心理念、组件规范与交互原则转化为高质量中文文档，覆盖 60+ 章节，极大推动了中国开发者对现代移动 UI 设计的理解与实践。
summary_en: Material Design 中文版 is the first complete Chinese translation of Google's official design specification, collaboratively completed by the 1sters team and Geekbang Academy in August 2015. This project systematically translates core concepts, component specifications, and interaction principles of Material Design into high-quality documentation, covering over 60 chapters, significantly advancing the understanding and practice of modern mobile UI design among Chinese developers.

description: 🚀 即梦3.0逆向API【特长：图像生成顶流】，零配置部署，多路token支持，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
summary_zh: 即梦3.0逆向API服务，提供零配置部署的图像生成能力，支持多路token并发，兼容OpenAI接口标准，每日免费66次生成额度，适用于个人测试与学习用途。
summary_en: Jimeng AI Free API service enables zero-configuration deployment of image generation via reverse-engineered API, supporting multiple tokens and OpenAI-compatible interface, offering 66 daily free generations for testing purposes.

description: 一款完全开源的微信公众号文章获取、RSS 订阅 API 服务，支持整号文章一键导出 7 种格式（Markdown/HTML/Word/PDF/EPUB/Excel/JSON）、IP 代理池反风控、MCP 接入各种 AI Agent 工具。
summary_zh: 完全开源的微信公众号文章获取与RSS订阅API服务，支持Chrome TLS指纹模拟、SOCKS5代理池反风控，提供公众号搜索、文章抓取、图片代理及Webhook通知功能。基于FastAPI构建，支持Docker一键部署和多架构兼容，本地扫码登录即可使用。
summary_en: Fully open-source WeChat public account article fetching and RSS subscription API service with Chrome TLS fingerprint simulation, SOCKS5 proxy pool anti-detection, supporting account search, article scraping, image proxy, and webhook notifications. Built on FastAPI, Docker-deployable across multiple architectures, accessible via local QR login.

description: 一款基于 AI 技术的 Web 应用程序，可将文本内容智能转换为 Mermaid 格式的代码，并将其渲染成可视化图表。
summary_zh: Smart Mermaid 是一款基于 AI 的 Web 应用，可将自然语言文本智能转换为 Mermaid 图表代码并实时渲染。支持流程图、序列图等多种图表类型，提供标准 SVG 与手绘风格双渲染器，具备 AI 代码修复、优化及文件导入功能，适合快速生成可视化图表。
summary_en: Smart Mermaid is an AI-powered web app that converts natural language text into Mermaid diagram code and renders it visually. It supports multiple chart types, dual rendering modes (SVG and hand-drawn), AI-assisted code fixing/optimization, and file import, enabling efficient text-to-diagram conversion for technical documentation and planning.

description: Cache-based rate-limiting for Django
summary_zh: Django Ratelimit 是一个基于缓存的 Django 速率限制中间件，通过装饰器为视图提供灵活的限流功能，支持基于 IP 地址或请求参数（GET/POST）进行访问控制，适用于防止滥用和保障 API 安全。
summary_en: Django Ratelimit is a cache-based rate-limiting library for Django that uses decorators to limit view access, configurable by IP address or request parameters (GET/POST), ideal for preventing abuse and securing APIs.

description: Hand-drawn CSS annotations for inline content
summary_zh: neat-annotations 是一个纯 CSS 库，用于在网页内联内容上添加手绘风格的箭头和手写标签。无需 JavaScript 和构建步骤，仅通过一个自包含的 CSS 文件即可实现。支持 8 个方向、6 种内置配色及自定义颜色，并提供丰富的 CSS 变量进行微调，适合用于文档说明、教程演示或 UI 原型标注。
summary_en: neat-annotations is a pure CSS library for adding hand-drawn arrows and handwritten labels to inline web content. It requires no JavaScript or build steps, operating via a single self-contained CSS file. Featuring 8 directions, 6 built-in color themes, custom color support, and extensive CSS variable fine-tuning, it is ideal for documentation, tutorials, and UI prototyping annotations.

description: vue2.0-tutorial
summary_zh: 本仓库是一个基于 Vue 2.0 的单页应用教程，使用 vue-cli、vue-router、vuex 和 vue-resource 构建完整前端架构，结合 webpack 实现热加载与组件化开发，并集成 Bootstrap UI 框架，适合学习现代 Vue.js 项目工程化实践。
summary_en: This repository is a Vue 2.0 tutorial for building a single-page application using vue-cli, vue-router, vuex, and vue-resource.
