It demonstrates project scaffolding, component-based development, hot-reload via webpack, and integration with Bootstrap, serving as a practical guide for modern Vue.js engineering practices.

description: css files created from pygment's built-in styles
summary_zh: 该项目提供由 Pygments 内置样式生成的预编译 CSS 文件，用于代码高亮显示，避免用户手动生成。支持一键重新生成所有样式文件，简化了代码语法高亮在网页中的集成流程。
summary_en: This repository provides pre-generated CSS files from Pygments' built-in styles for code syntax highlighting, eliminating the need for manual generation. It allows easy regeneration of all styles using the current Pygments version via a simple make command.

description: A simple android app to enable Google Location Report, Google Now and related functions in China mainland or somewhere like.
summary_zh: LocationReportEnabler 是一款专为中国大陆用户设计的 Android 应用，通过修改系统参数启用 Google 位置报告、Google Now 及相关功能。支持 ROOT 和 Xposed 框架两种模式，后者更稳定。核心功能包括设置运营商代码和 ISO 国家代码，以绕过地理限制，恢复 Google 服务的时间线功能。
summary_en: LocationReportEnabler is a simple Android app designed to enable Google Location Report, Google Now, and related features in mainland China. It works by setting system properties like gsm.sim.operator.numeric and iso-country to bypass regional restrictions. Available in ROOT and Xposed variants, with the latter recommended for better stability and clarity.

description: Free gemini-3-flash  | cursor不倒我不倒🙏 ❌ 这次倒下啦
summary_zh: Cursor2API 是一个将 Cursor Web 转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API 的高性能服务，支持 Claude Sonnet 4.6 模型，提供完全兼容 OpenAI API 格式的接口，具备低延迟响应、安全认证、流式/非流式输出及完善的错误处理机制，可通过 Docker、系统服务或本地编译部署。
summary_en: Cursor2API is a high-performance service that converts Cursor Web into an OpenAI-compatible API, supporting Claude Sonnet 4.6. It offers full OpenAI API compatibility with low-latency responses, secure authentication, streaming/non-streaming support, and robust error handling, deployable via Docker, systemd, or local compilation.

description: 基于@a937750307 项目lan-printing的修改
summary_zh: 基于原项目的改进版内网打印解决方案，支持多种Office文档与图片格式自动转换为PDF，通过Web界面实现跨设备打印。内置文件拖拽上传、PDF预览与管理功能，适用于无法直连打印机时的远程打印需求。
summary_en: An improved intranet printing solution supporting automatic conversion of Office documents and images to PDF. Features a web interface for cross-device printing, drag-and-drop upload, PDF preview and file management. Ideal for remote printing scenarios where direct printer connection is unavailable.

description: Develop desktop apps with a web frontend or native UI in Go
summary_zh: 用Go开发桌面应用，支持WebView网页前端或纯Go原生UI，混合使用。纯Go无cgo跨平台，类型化IPC，内置Flexbox/Grid布局、动画等UI工具包，自带完整打包分发能力，单二进制仅数MB，低内存CPU占用。
summary_en: Build desktop apps in Go with web or native UI. Pure Go, no cgo, cross-platform. Typed IPC with generated TypeScript client. Built-in UI toolkit (flexbox/grid, animations). Complete bundling & distribution. Single binary, low memory/CPU footprint.

description: :no_entry: currently unmaintained :no_entry: A minimal JS library for showing & hiding things
summary_zh: Wallop 是一个轻量级（4KB）JavaScript 库，用于实现元素的显示与隐藏切换，支持移动端优先、渐进增强和纯 CSS 动画。它通过添加动态类名控制内容展示，内置多种动画修饰符（如滑动、淡入淡出），提供灵活的 API 和自定义事件，适用于轮播、选项卡等场景。
summary_en: Wallop is a minimal 4kb JavaScript library for showing and hiding elements, designed with mobile-first, progressive enhancement, and CSS-based animations. It dynamically adds classes to control visibility, supports multiple animation modifiers (e.g., slide, fade), and offers a flexible API with custom events for use in sliders, tabs, and more.

description: 中国省/自治区/直辖市、市/自治州、区/县/旗数据，包含名称、拼音、拼音首字母、行政代码、区号
summary_zh: 该仓库提供中国完整的行政区划数据，涵盖省、市、县三级行政单位，包含名称、拼音、行政代码、区号等关键字段，支持MySQL和CSV格式导出，适用于地理信息系统、地址解析、数据统计分析等场景，数据来源权威且定期更新。
summary_en: This repository provides comprehensive Chinese administrative division data, covering provinces, cities, and counties, including name, pinyin, administrative code, and area code. It supports MySQL and CSV formats for easy integration into various databases and applications, ideal for GIS, address parsing, and data analysis.

description: 文颜- Markdown文章排版美化工具，支持微信公众号、今日头条、知乎等平台。
summary_zh: 文颜是一款专为 Markdown 内容创作者设计的排版美化工具，支持一键将 Markdown 文章转换为适配微信公众号、知乎、今日头条等主流平台的富文本格式，内置多款 Typora 主题并支持自定义样式，自动处理图片上传与数学公式渲染，让写作者专注于内容创作而非繁琐排版。
summary_en: Wenyan is a Markdown formatting and publishing tool designed for content creators, enabling one-click conversion of Markdown articles into platform-specific rich text formats for WeChat Official Accounts, Zhihu, Toutiao, and more. It features built-in Typora themes, custom styling, automatic image uploads, MathJax support, and seamless cross-platform publishing.

description: Free gemini-3-flash  | cursor不倒我不倒🙏 ❌ 这次倒下啦
summary_zh: Cursor2API 是一个将 Cursor Web 转换为 OpenAI chat/completions API 兼容服务的 Go 项目，支持 Google Gemini-3-flash 模型及自动派生的 thinking 版本，具备高性能、安全认证、工具调用和流式响应等特性，提供 Docker 和系统服务部署方案。
summary_en: Cursor2API is a Go service that converts Cursor Web into an OpenAI chat/completions API-compatible endpoint, supporting Google Gemini-3-flash and its thinking variant. It offers high performance, secure authentication, tool calls, streaming responses, and supports deployment via Docker or systemd services.

description: 微信公众号文章抓取 & Markdown 转换工具
summary_zh: 该工具利用 Camoufox 实现反检测抓取，自动提取微信公众号文章的标题、账号、发布时间及原文链接，并将 HTML 内容转换为结构清晰的 Markdown 格式，同时下载图片至本地并重写链接，支持代码块语法高亮，适用于内容归档与知识管理。
summary_en: This tool uses Camoufox for anti-detection fetching to extract WeChat Official Account articles, converting HTML content into clean Markdown with metadata (title, account, publish time, URL), downloading images locally, and preserving code blocks with language syntax. Ideal for content archiving and knowledge management.

description: An open-source presentation theme ecosystem for Marp/Markdown users.
summary_zh: Awesome Marp 是一个基于 Markdown 的演示文稿工具，提供 38 种自定义 CSS 样式和 6 种主题，支持分栏布局、导航进度、封面页、目录页及定理框等，可替代 LaTeX Beamer。配套 VS Code 和 Obsidian，支持字体自定义，适合高效制作美观幻灯片。
summary_en: Awesome Marp is a Markdown-based presentation tool offering 38 custom CSS styles and 6 themes, supporting multi-column layouts, navigation progress bars, cover pages, table of contents, and callout boxes. It replaces LaTeX Beamer with enhanced styling, integrates with VS Code and Obsidian, and allows font customization for professional slides.

description: A simple yet powerful JQuery star rating plugin with fractional rating support.
summary_zh: bootstrap-star-rating 是一款基于 jQuery 的 Bootstrap 星级评分插件，支持分数评级、RTL 方向及纯 CSS3 矢量图标渲染。它可自动将输入框转换为评分控件，兼容 Bootstrap 3/4/5，并支持 FontAwesome 等字体图标库，适用于需要灵活星级评分功能的 Web 应用。
summary_en: bootstrap-star-rating is a jQuery plugin for Bootstrap that enables star rating controls with fractional support, RTL compatibility, and pure CSS3 styling. It auto-converts inputs marked with class 'rating', supports Bootstrap 3/4/5, and integrates with font icon libraries like FontAwesome for scalable vector star symbols.

summary_zh: 这是一个简洁的 GitHub 仓库，项目名称为 'bye'，带有告别表情符号，可能用于快速退出或关闭某个进程、服务或应用，适合作为轻量级工具或脚本使用。
summary_en: This is a simple GitHub repository named 'bye' with a farewell emoji, likely intended as a lightweight utility or script for exiting or closing processes, services, or applications.

description: Twitter Bootstrap with Metro style
summary_zh: metro-bootstrap 是基于 Twitter Bootstrap 的 Metro 风格主题，提供现代化的扁平化界面设计，支持通过 npm、Git 或 CDN 快速集成，包含预编译 CSS 和 FontAwesome 字体，适用于快速构建 Windows Metro 风格网页应用。
summary_en: metro-bootstrap is a Metro-styled theme built on Twitter Bootstrap, offering a modern flat UI design. It supports easy integration via npm, Git clone, or CDN, includes precompiled CSS and FontAwesome fonts, ideal for quickly building Windows Metro-style web applications.

description: Use opencli CLI to interact with social/content websites (Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, YouTube, Weibo, 小红书, V2EX, Reddit, HackerNews, 雪球, BOSS直聘 etc.)
summary_zh: Qiaomu OpenCLI Skills 是基于 opencli 框架的 Claude Code 技能集合，支持79+网站和桌面应用的CLI化操作，涵盖B站、Twitter、知乎等主流平台的内容获取、发布、下载及浏览器自动化功能，具备智能搜索路由和适配器自动修复能力。
summary_en: Qiaomu OpenCLI Skills is a collection of Claude Code skills built on the opencli framework, enabling CLI operations for 79+ websites and desktop apps. It supports content retrieval, publishing, downloading, and browser automation across platforms like Bilibili, Twitter, Zhihu, with intelligent search routing and auto-repair capabilities.

description: AndroidCat安卓书签导航集合
summary_zh: AndroidCat 是一个专为 Android 开发者打造的网址导航集合，涵盖资源文档、技术社区、教程、开源项目等八大类别，提供官方文档、设计指南、开发框架、技术资讯等一站式学习资源，助力开发者高效获取 Android 开发所需工具和知识。
summary_en: AndroidCat is a curated collection of Android development resources, serving as a comprehensive navigation hub for developers. It aggregates official documentation, design guidelines, frameworks, tutorials, open-source projects, and tech communities across eight categories, enabling efficient access to essential tools and knowledge for Android development.

description: Spec-driven development workflow for AI coding agents: architecture-first planning, task decomposition, GitHub Issue/PR tracking, Deep Discuss, and adaptive control for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other Markdown-capable agents.
summary_zh: Spec-Driven Develop 是一个平台无关的 AI 代理技能，通过单个 `SKILL.md` 文件为大规模复杂任务提供全流程预开发自动化。它不依赖框架或运行时，而是以纯 Markdown 结构化指令驱动代理完成项目分析、任务拆解、进度跟踪和迭代开发，实现轻量级但高度可控的开发方法论。
summary_en: Spec-Driven Develop is a platform-agnostic AI agent skill that automates pre-development workflows via a single SKILL.md file. It enables any coding agent to execute structured methodologies—including project analysis, task decomposition, and progress tracking—without frameworks or runtime dependencies, offering lightweight yet powerful automation for complex tasks.

description: A CLI for BOSS 直聘 — search jobs, view recommendations, manage applications via reverse-engineered API
summary_zh: boss-cli 是一个基于逆向工程 API 的 BOSS 直聘命令行工具，支持职位搜索、个性化推荐、申请管理、与招聘者聊天及发送问候等功能。具备多浏览器 Cookie 自动提取、丰富筛选条件、结构化输出和跨平台支持，适用于求职自动化场景。
summary_en: boss-cli is a CLI tool for BOSS Zhipin that enables job searching, recommendations, application management, and recruiter chat via reverse-engineered APIs. It supports browser cookie extraction, advanced filtering, structured output, and cross-platform usage for automated job hunting.

description: 鲁班 | Luban — 把'能用的Skill'打磨成'能被装、能传播、能验证、能进化'的公共资产。Agent skill-polishing workshop: 验料·访行·过尺·慢刨·回炉
summary_zh: 鲁班是一款AI智能体Skill打磨工坊，通过

description: ridiculously fast object serialization
summary_zh: serpy 是一个极致快速的 Python 对象序列化框架，专为高性能场景设计。它支持将复杂数据类型（如 Django 模型、自定义类）高效转换为原生类型（字典、列表等），并易于转为 JSON。相比 marshmallow 或 Django REST Framework，其性能优势可达一个数量级以上，同时保持简洁的类继承式架构和高度可定制性。
summary_en: serpy is a ridiculously fast object serialization framework for Python, optimized for high performance. It efficiently converts complex data types (e.g., Django models, custom classes) into native Python types (dicts, lists), easily convertible to JSON. It outperforms alternatives like marshmallow or Django REST Framework by an order of magnitude, while offering a clean, extensible class-based design with minimal code duplication.

description: 参考Spec-kit 实现小说撰写工具
summary_zh: Novel Writer 是基于规格驱动开发（SDD）的 AI 智能中文小说创作工具，支持在 Claude、Cursor、Gemini 等 13 个 AI 助手中通过斜杠命令系统化创作。提供七步创作方法论、情节追踪、角色一致性验证等核心功能，专为中文小说写作优化，支持跨平台使用与插件扩展。
summary_en: Novel Writer is an AI-driven Chinese novel writing tool based on Specification-Driven Development (SDD), enabling systematic creation through slash commands in 13 AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, and Gemini. It offers a 7-step methodology, plot tracking, character consistency checks, and Chinese-optimized features, with cross-platform support and extensible plugin architecture.

description: 乔布斯.skill — Steve Jobs的认知操作系统。6个心智模型 + 8条决策启发式 + 完整表达DNA。由女娲.skill生成。
summary_zh: Steve Jobs.skill 是一个基于乔布斯一手资料提炼的认知操作系统，包含6个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和独特表达DNA。它不是语录复述，而是可运行的思维框架，用于分析产品方向、竞争格局等复杂问题，强调聚焦、端到端控制、死亡过滤器等核心理念。
summary_en: Steve Jobs.skill is a cognitive operating system distilled from Steve Jobs' firsthand materials, featuring 6 mental models, 8 decision heuristics, and a unique expression DNA. It functions as an executable thinking framework—not just quoting—to analyze product directions and competitive landscapes through Jobs' lenses like focus, end-to-end control, and the 'death filter'.

description: 清理Augment缓存和生成设备SessionId/解决 VSCode、Cursor、JetBrains 系列 IDE 中 Augment 插件无法登录的问题（Sign in failed. If you have a firewall, please add）/将所有 d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com 域名统一指向延迟最低的服务器IP
summary_zh: Augment 插件清理工具 v3.4 是一款专为解决 VSCode、Cursor、JetBrains 系列 IDE 中 Augment 插件登录失败问题而设计的跨平台工具。核心功能包括彻底清理插件缓存数据、生成设备 SessionId，以及通过智能测速优化 API 域名解析（将 d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com 指向延迟最低服务器）。支持交互式菜单和命令行模式，提供代理配置、安全预览等高级功能，兼容 Windows/macOS/Linux。
summary_en: Augment Plugin Cleaner v3.4 is a cross-platform utility designed to resolve login failures in Augment plugin for VSCode, Cursor, and JetBrains IDEs. It features comprehensive cache/data cleanup, SessionId generation, and intelligent API domain optimization by testing latency of d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com endpoints. Supports interactive menus, CLI arguments, proxy configurations (Clash/V2Ray/custom), dry-run previews, and works on Windows/macOS/Linux with admin privileges for hosts file modification.

description: This is a Opensource Live wallpaper solution for MacOS
summary_zh: 这是一个为 macOS 14+ 设计的开源动态壁纸应用，支持 MP4 和 MOV 视频格式，具备多显示器支持与高性能渲染。用户可通过 Homebrew 或源码编译安装，需注意绕过 Gatekeeper 安全限制。项目计划将 Objective-C++ UI 迁移至 SwiftUI，但守护进程保持不变。
summary_en: An open-source live wallpaper app for macOS 14+, supporting MP4/MOV video playback with multi-display rendering and high performance. Install via Homebrew or compile from source using Xcode and CMake. Requires Gatekeeper bypass for unsigned apps. UI modernization to SwiftUI is planned while maintaining the daemon component.

description: ✨❤️‍🔥Turn the cities you love into stunning designs
summary_zh: MapPoster Online 是一款基于浏览器的地图海报生成工具，可将任意城市地图转化为精美的艺术海报。作为 Python CLI 工具的 Web 升级版，它无需安装，开箱即用。项目采用 React 19 与 TypeScript 构建前端，利用 Rust 编译为 WebAssembly 实现高性能图像处理，结合 Tailwind CSS 打造现代化 UI，支持全球主要城市的地图风格化设计。
summary_en: MapPoster Online is a browser-based map poster generator that transforms city maps into stunning artistic designs. As a web upgrade to the Python CLI tool, it requires no installation and is ready to use instantly. Built with React 19 and TypeScript, it leverages Rust compiled to WebAssembly for high-performance image processing, paired with Tailwind CSS for a modern UI, supporting stylized map designs for major global cities.

description: A verified, community-maintained catalog of 981 open-source projects built with Jev.
summary_zh: Awesome Jev 是社区维护的开源项目目录，收录 640 个基于 Jev（TypeSafe AI 的类型决策模型）构建的项目，涵盖 SDK、AI 智能体工具、浏览器自动化、游戏模拟等 11 个类别。每个条目均标注具体决策点及可验证的公开证据，帮助开发者快速发现并评估真实参考实现。
summary_en: Awesome Jev is a community-maintained catalog of 640 open-source projects built with Jev, TypeSafe AI's System One model for typed decisions in software. Spanning 11 categories across SDKs, agent tooling, browser automation, games, and more, each entry identifies concrete decision points and links to verifiable public evidence for evaluating real implementations.

description: A Gorgeous LoadingView (一个绚丽的LoadingView )
summary_zh: GADownloading 是一个绚丽的自定义 Android LoadingView，无需图片资源，通过代码实现动态加载动画。支持成功/失败状态切换，提供丰富的自定义属性（颜色、线条、文本等），可自动调整尺寸。适用于下载进度展示，兼容 JitPack 集成与源码复制两种接入方式，强调纯代码实现与高度可定制性。
summary_en: GADownloading is a visually stunning custom Android LoadingView that renders animations purely through code without image resources. It supports dynamic progress updates, success/failure states, and extensive customization via XML attributes. Designed for download progress indication, it offers JitPack integration or direct source copying, emphasizing code-only implementation and high configurability.

summary_zh: 本项目将《数理化自学丛书》17册扫描PDF重建为语义化Markdown与可复现EPUB3电子书，保留全部4,875幅插图与88,653个MathML公式。提供完整构建工具链、来源审计与隐私门禁，适用于文献保存、校勘与个人研究场景。
summary_en: Rebuilds the 17-volume Self-Study Series of Math, Physics & Chemistry from scanned PDFs into semantic Markdown and reproducible EPUB3 ebooks, preserving 4,875 illustrations and 88,653 MathML formulas. Provides full build toolchain, provenance auditing, and privacy gates for archival and research use.

description: :collision::collision::collision:【Flutter版】玩安卓，非常适合学习，代码不多、注释多。
summary_zh: 这是一个基于 Flutter 开发的玩安卓客户端应用，代码简洁、注释详尽，非常适合 Flutter 初学者学习。项目完整实现了登录注册、首页列表、搜索、侧边栏、WebView 加载、主题切换、状态管理等功能，涵盖常用 UI 组件和状态管理方案，并提供多平台截图与 APK 下载。
summary_en: This is a WanAndroid client app built with Flutter, featuring clean code and extensive comments, ideal for Flutter beginners. It implements core features like login, homepage, search, sidebar, WebView, theme switching, and state management, covering essential UI components and state management patterns, with multi-platform screenshots and APK available.

description: ajax + history.pushState = pjax
summary_zh: Pjax 是一个基于 pushState 和 AJAX 的前端技术，用于实现无刷新页面内容更新，支持 jQuery、qwrap 和 KISSY 框架。它提供缓存、本地存储、动画过渡及自定义过滤功能，适用于提升单页应用体验。
summary_en: Pjax is a frontend technology combining AJAX and pushState to enable seamless, partial page updates without full reloads. It supports jQuery, qwrap, and KISSY, with features like caching, localStorage persistence, animation transitions, and URL filtering for enhanced SPA performance.

description: A JavaScript library to display Photo Sphere panoramas.
summary_zh: Photo Sphere Viewer 是一个基于 Three.js 的 JavaScript 库，用于在网页上展示 360×180 度全景图。支持 equirectangular 投影格式，兼容 Android 4.2+ 拍摄的照片球，提供丰富的交互控制与自定义选项，适用于虚拟旅游、房地产展示等场景。
summary_en: Photo Sphere Viewer is a JavaScript library built on Three.js for displaying 360×180 degree panoramas on web pages. It supports equirectangular projection, integrates with Android Photo Sphere, and offers extensive customization and interaction features for immersive experiences.

description: 自动视频生成器，给定主题，自动生成解说视频。用户输入主题文字，系统调用大语言模型生成故事或解说的文字，然后进一步调用语音合成接口生成解说的语音，调用文生图接口生成契合文字内容的配图，最后融合语音和配图生成解说视频。
summary_zh: 自动视频生成器通过大语言模型生成解说文本，调用语音合成与文生图接口生成音视频素材，最终合成主题解说视频。支持PPT/PDF输入、免费资源校对、千帆ERNIE模型及百度千帆平台集成，提供Gradio交互界面与完整工作流。
summary_en: Auto Video Generator creates explanatory videos by generating text via LLMs, synthesizing speech, producing images via text-to-image models, and combining them into final videos. It supports PPT/PDF input, free resource checking, integrates with Baidu Qianfan's ERNIE models, and offers a Gradio-based interactive interface with full workflow automation.

description: nothing
summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Go 语言开发的微信小程序 OCR 识别工具，旨在为小程序用户提供便捷的文本识别功能，支持多种图片格式输入，并可将识别结果直接复制到剪贴板。
summary_en: This is a WeChat Mini Program OCR tool built with Go, designed to provide convenient text recognition for mini-program users. It supports multiple image formats and allows direct copying of recognition results to the clipboard.

description: ✨ AI Gist 是一款隐私优先的 AI 提示词管理工具，致力于让个人收藏的 AI 提示词能够发挥最大价值。支持变量替换、Jinja 模板、AI 生成与调优、历史版本记录、云端备份等核心功能。
summary_zh: AI Gist 是一款隐私优先的 AI 提示词管理工具，支持 Jinja 模板与变量动态替换，集成多种 AI 模型实现自动生成与调优提示词。所有数据本地存储，支持 WebDAV/iCloud 云端备份，跨 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 多平台运行，帮助用户高效收藏与管理个人提示词资产。
summary_en: AI Gist is a privacy-first AI prompt management tool featuring Jinja template support and dynamic variable substitution. It integrates multiple AI models for auto-generating and optimizing prompts, with all data stored locally. Cloud backup via WebDAV/iCloud is supported. Cross-platform for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS, it helps users efficiently collect and manage personal prompt assets.

description: 个人博客
summary_zh: 个人技术博客，涵盖算法、数据结构、计算机基础、分布式系统等核心领域，包含MIT 6.824课程笔记、Go/PHP语言实践、Pulsar消息队列及自研库设计文档，是系统性技术知识沉淀平台。
summary_en: Personal technical blog covering core computer science topics including algorithms, data structures, distributed systems (MIT 6.824 course notes), Go/PHP programming, Pulsar MQ, and custom library design docs, serving as a comprehensive knowledge repository.

summary_zh: VSC社区维护的Codex Skills集合，聚焦AIGC创作与视觉工作流。提供提示词工程、稀有风格探索、东方神话插画、抓拍人像摄影及虚拟Vlog生成等技能封装，支持一键安装至Codex并通过$skill-name调用，辅助创作者高效复用创意方法与管理生成资产。
summary_en: A community-maintained collection of Codex Skills focused on AIGC creation and visual workflows. Covers prompt engineering, rare style exploration, Eastern mythology illustration, candid photography prompts, and virtual vlog generation. Skills are installed into Codex and invoked via $skill-name for efficient creative reuse and asset management.

description: Give AI coding agents eyes. Records browser sessions, captures screenshots, collects errors, and bundles proof artifacts — so humans can verify what the agent built.
summary_zh: ProofShot 是一个开源 CLI 工具，专为 AI 编程代理设计，提供视觉验证能力。它通过录制浏览器操作视频、捕获关键截图和系统日志，帮助 AI 代理在无头环境中验证 UI 功能是否正确实现。支持与 Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等主流 AI 开发工具集成，自动生成可交互的验证报告，并将结果上传至 GitHub PR，实现端到端的自动化测试闭环。
summary_en: ProofShot is an open-source, agent-agnostic CLI tool that gives AI coding agents visual verification capabilities. It records browser session videos, captures screenshots, and collects console/server logs to validate UI functionality in headless environments. Integrated with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, it auto-generates interactive reports and uploads results to GitHub PRs for seamless human review.

description: 此项目已停止维护，建议迁移到  https://github.com/museui/muse-ui/
summary_zh: vue-carbon 是基于 Vue.js 1.0 开发的 Material Design 风格移动端 Web UI 库，提供丰富的组件如 Refresh Control、HeaderBar 等，支持 npm 安装与 webpack 集成，现已停止维护，推荐迁移至 Muse UI。
summary_en: Vue-carbon is a Material Design style mobile web UI library built with Vue.js 1.0, featuring components like Refresh Control and HeaderBar. It supports npm installation and webpack integration but is no longer maintained; migration to Muse UI is recommended.

description: 🎙️ An intelligent voice productivity assistant that turns speech into clean text, useful actions, and structured knowledge. It helps users capture ideas, communicate naturally, automate repetitive tasks, and stay productive across different apps and workflows.
summary_zh: Voxt 是一款专为 macOS 设计的语音输入与翻译应用，支持全局热键录音、实时波形显示、多引擎语音识别（本地 MLX 和远程 ASR 服务）及文本增强翻译，具备剪贴板安全粘贴、历史记录管理和多模式触发机制，适用于跨语言实时转录与翻译场景。
summary_en: Voxt is a macOS menu bar app for voice input and translation, featuring global hotkey recording, real-time waveform display, multi-engine speech recognition (local MLX and remote ASR), text enhancement, and clipboard-safe auto-paste. It supports transcription, translation, selected-text processing, and history management with configurable providers.

description: A jQuery tag/token input plugin for Twitter's Bootstrap, by the guys from Sliptree
summary_zh: Bootstrap Tokenfield 是一个基于 jQuery 和 Twitter Bootstrap 的标签输入插件，支持键盘操作、复制粘贴、自动补全集成等功能。虽然项目已停止维护，但仍可用于需要轻量级标签输入的场景，尤其适合与 Bootstrap 3+ 和 jQuery 1.9+ 配合使用。
summary_en: Bootstrap Tokenfield is a jQuery plugin for tag/token input built on Twitter Bootstrap, supporting keyboard navigation, copy-paste, and integration with autocomplete/typeahead. Though unmaintained, it remains useful for lightweight tagging in Bootstrap 3+ environments with jQuery 1.9+.

description: dead simple crontab powered job scheduling for django.
summary_zh: django-crontab 是一个为 Django 项目提供极简 Cron 任务调度的工具，支持通过 Python 方法或 Django 管理命令定义定时任务，自动同步到系统 crontab，并提供添加、查看和移除任务的管理命令，适用于 1.8-2.0 版本的 Django 项目。
summary_en: django-crontab is a dead-simple tool for Django that enables cron-powered job scheduling via Python methods or management commands. It automatically syncs CRONJOBS to the system crontab and provides commands to add, show, and remove tasks, supporting Django 1.8-2.0.

summary_zh: PPT Agent 是一个基于多智能体协作的自动化幻灯片生成系统，支持跨平台运行。通过 LLM 生成内容 + Gemini 质量审查的双阶段流程，输出符合 Bento Grid 布局的 SVG 格式演示文稿（1280×720），涵盖从需求调研到最终交付的全流程自动化，适用于品牌发布会、产品推介等场景。
summary_en: PPT Agent is a cross-platform multi-agent workflow for automated presentation generation. It combines LLM content creation with Gemini-powered quality review to produce SVG-based slides (1280×720) in Bento Grid layout, featuring end-to-end automation from requirement analysis to final delivery for use cases like product launches and business presentations.

summary_zh: Jev 聊天助手是一款 Android 对话副驾应用，通过无障碍服务读取微信/QQ/X/飞书等聊天内容，结合 TypeSafe Jev 判断对方意图与危险等级，并用 LLM 生成 3 条候选回复，一键填入输入框。不自动发送，隐私本地存储，支持多平台适配扩展。
summary_en: Jev Chat Assistant is an AI conversation co-pilot for Android. It reads chat content across WeChat, QQ, X, and Feishu via accessibility services, analyzes intent and risk levels using TypeSafe Jev, generates 3 candidate replies with LLM, and fills them into the input box with one tap. Non-invasive, privacy-first, extensible multi-platform design.

description: Bootstrap alert system made better, builds off of bootstrap-alert.js
summary_zh: bootstrap-notify 是对 Bootstrap 原生警告系统的增强扩展，基于 bootstrap-alert.js 构建，提供更丰富的通知样式与交互能力，适用于现代 Web 应用中的用户提示与消息展示。
summary_en: Bootstrap Notify enhances the native Bootstrap alert system by building on bootstrap-alert.js, offering improved notification styles and interactions for modern web applications.

description: 🦄 The world's largest Midjourney drawing API, generating over 1 million drawings daily, supporting Discord Youchuan Midjourney 🐂！
summary_zh: Midjourney API 是全球最大的 Midjourney 绘图 API 代理项目，日生成图像超百万张，完全免费开源。支持 Discord 绘图、悠船绘图及官网接入，提供 Imagine、Vary、Remix 等全套指令，集成账号池管理、多数据库支持、负载均衡、CloudFlare 验证绕过、图片/视频一键换脸等功能，适用于企业级绘图服务部署。
summary_en: Midjourney API is the world's largest free and open-source proxy for Midjourney's Discord channel, generating over 1 million images daily. It supports full-featured drawing via Discord, YouChuan, and official Midjourney, with comprehensive commands like Imagine, Vary, Remix, account pooling, load balancing, CloudFlare bypass, image/video face swap, and enterprise-grade deployment features.

description: AI-powered desktop SQL client. Cross-platform. Built with Flutter.
summary_zh: openhare 是一款基于 Flutter 开发的跨平台 AI 驱动桌面 SQL 客户端，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、SQLite 和 Oracle 等多种数据库。其核心亮点在于集成 AI 辅助功能，可智能生成、优化和理解 SQL 查询语句，显著提升开发者和 DBA 的工作效率。
summary_en: Openhare is an AI-powered, cross-platform desktop SQL client built with Flutter, supporting multiple databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite, and Oracle. Its standout feature is integrated AI assistance for generating, optimizing, and interpreting SQL queries, enhancing productivity for developers and DBAs.

description: Useful GPT Prompts
summary_zh: 该仓库收集并整理了实用的 GPT 提示词，涵盖 Midjourney 等 AI 工具的生成模板，旨在提升用户与 AI 交互的效率和创意表达，适用于内容创作、设计辅助等场景。
summary_en: This repository curates useful GPT prompts, starting with a Midjourney Prompt Generator, designed to enhance AI interaction efficiency and creative output for content creation and design assistance.

description: [EMNLP 2026] MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research · 浏览器里运行的安卓模拟器 · Browser-hosted Android Simulator · Verifiable Evaluation · Scalable Online RL Training
summary_zh: MobileGym 是一个基于浏览器的可验证、高并行移动 GUI Agent 研究仿真平台。它提供 28 个模拟应用和 416 个参数化任务模板，支持确定性亚毫秒级评测，单服务器可并行运行 256 个实例，并通过 Sim-to-Real 验证实现 +40.7 分真实设备性能提升。
summary_en: MobileGym is a browser-hosted, verifiable and highly parallel simulation platform for mobile GUI agent research. It ships 28 simulated apps with 416 parameterized task templates, deterministic sub-millisecond judges, 256 parallel instances per server, and achieves +40.7 pt sim-to-real transfer on real devices.

description: A calm menu bar, done the native way. Hides the icons you don't need until you do.
summary_zh: Pelmet 是一款原生 macOS 菜单栏管理工具，专为 macOS 27 重新设计的菜单栏打造。它可将不常用图标自动隐藏，通过悬停、点击或快捷键优雅恢复显示，支持可视化布局编辑器与三区域分组管理，免费开源无账号要求。
summary_en: Pelmet is an open-source macOS menu bar manager designed for the redesigned menu bar in macOS 27. It auto-hides unused icons and elegantly reveals them via hover, click, or shortcuts, featuring a visual layout editor with three-zone grouping. Free, native, no account needed.

description: 使用vercel的functions，将ai功能加入微信公众号
summary_zh: 该项目利用 Vercel Functions 实现零服务器成本部署，将 AI 功能接入微信公众号，支持 GPT、星火、通义千问、Gemini 等多种大模型，具备连续对话、自定义指令、关键词回复、图床等功能，通过 Redis 实现会话记忆，无需备案域名即可运行。
summary_en: This project leverages Vercel Functions to deploy AI-powered WeChat Official Account integration with zero server cost. It supports multiple AI models (GPT, Spark, Qwen, Gemini), continuous conversations via Redis, custom commands, keyword replies, image hosting, and system prompt configuration, all without domain registration or server maintenance.

description: Master your Mac’s ⌘Tab
summary_zh: BetterCmdTab 是一款专为 macOS 设计的 ⌘+Tab 应用切换器增强工具，提供列表、网格和实时预览三种布局，支持模糊搜索、窗口平铺、标签页切换及多显示器操作。采用原生 SwiftUI 开发，具备 Liquid Glass 视觉效果，无遥测且完全免费，极大提升 Mac 用户的窗口管理效率。
summary_en: BetterCmdTab enhances the macOS ⌘+Tab experience with three layouts (list, grid, live preview), fuzzy search, window tiling, and tab switching. Built natively with SwiftUI featuring Liquid Glass aesthetics, it offers zero telemetry and is free forever, significantly boosting window management efficiency for Mac users.

description: Next Generation of ShadowsocksX https://github.com/shadowsocks/shadowsocks-iOS
summary_zh: ShadowsocksX-NG 是 Shadowsocks 的下一代 macOS 客户端，提供高性能代理功能，支持 SSR 协议，适用于科学上网与隐私保护。项目因监管要求已停止维护，原代码存档于 shadowsocksr-backup 仓库。
summary_en: ShadowsocksX-NG is the next-generation macOS client for Shadowsocks, offering high-performance proxy capabilities with SSR protocol support for secure browsing and privacy protection. The project has been discontinued due to regulatory reasons, with archived code in the shadowsocksr-backup repository.

description: Clash X
summary_zh: ClashX 是一款基于 Clash 的 macOS 代理客户端，专为 macOS 15+ (Sequoia) 优化，支持 HTTP/HTTPS、SOCKS 协议及 Vmess/Shadowsocks/Trojan 等多种代理协议。提供直观的图形界面与 Surge 风格配置，集成 GeoIP 规则、Netfilter TCP 重定向等功能，适用于高级网络代理需求。
summary_en: ClashX is a rule-based proxy client for macOS built on Clash, optimized for macOS 15+ (Sequoia). It supports HTTP/HTTPS, SOCKS protocols and multiple proxy types including Vmess, Shadowsocks, and Trojan. Features intuitive UI, Surge-like configuration, GeoIP rules, Netfilter TCP redirection, and advanced scripting capabilities.

description: Team IDE 集成MySql、Oracle、金仓、达梦、神通等数据库、SSH、FTP、Redis、Zookeeper、Kafka、Elasticsearch、Mongodb、小工具等管理工具
summary_zh: Team IDE 是一款集成多种数据库（MySQL、Oracle、金仓等）、中间件（Redis、Kafka、Elasticsearch等）及开发工具的跨平台IDE。支持SSH终端、数据库可视化操作、SQL执行、Thrift服务测试、JSON/YAML转换等，提供终端透传、SSH隧道、节点管理等高级功能，支持单机和服务器部署。
summary_en: Team IDE is a cross-platform integrated development environment featuring support for multiple databases (MySQL, Oracle, Kingbase, etc.), middleware (Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch), and development tools. It offers SSH terminal, database visualization, SQL execution, Thrift service testing, and JSON/YAML conversion, with advanced features like terminal passthrough, SSH tunneling, and node management. Supports both standalone and server deployment modes.

description: 🖌 docsify cli tool - A magical documentation generator.
summary_zh: docsify-cli 是一个强大的文档生成工具，提供快速初始化、本地服务器和实时重载功能，支持自定义主题与插件，适用于快速搭建现代化文档站点。
summary_en: docsify-cli is a powerful documentation generator that offers quick initialization, local server with live reload, and support for custom themes and plugins, ideal for rapidly building modern documentation sites.

description: Canonical source and governance toolkit for Zhijian AI public Agent Skills
summary_zh: Zhijian Skills 是 OpenAI Codex Agent 的官方技能分发仓库，提供19个专注于 Codex 操作、工作流编排、模型推理与知识系统的即插即用技能包。支持通过 npx 一行命令快速安装，涵盖模型路由、上下文诊断、跨 Agent 交接、企业数字孪生、长文写作等场景。
summary_en: Zhijian Skills is the canonical distribution repository for OpenAI Codex Agent Skills, offering 19 plug-and-play modules covering workflow orchestration, model routing, context diagnosis, cross-agent handoff, enterprise digital twins, and long-form writing. Install via a single npx command, with independently verified releases and complete payloads.

description: 完全运行于 Cloudflare Worker的现代聊天系统：实时通信、Telegram 双向桥接、消息与文件加密 A modern, self-hosted team chat built on Cloudflare — realtime messaging, Telegram bridge, encrypted messages & files, and WebMCP. |
summary_zh: EdgeChat 是基于 Cloudflare 全家桶构建的零运维团队聊天系统，支持公开/私有群组、私信与实时消息通信。特色功能为 Telegram 双向消息桥接，Bot 驱动跨平台无缝同步。前端采用 Vue 3 + Hono，Durable Objects 承载 WebSocket 连接，AES-256-GCM 加密保障数据安全，在免费额度内即可落地企业级 IM。
summary_en: EdgeChat is a zero-infrastructure team chat system built on Cloudflare ecosystem, supporting public/private groups, DMs, and real-time messaging. Its standout feature is bidirectional Telegram bridge via Bot for seamless cross-platform sync. Powered by Vue 3 + Hono frontend, Durable Objects for WebSocket, and AES-256-GCM encryption, it delivers enterprise-grade IM within Cloudflare's free tier.

description: Turn hand-drawn story illustrations into 35–45 second line-reveal and gradual-coloring videos with HyperFrames.
summary_zh: Handdraw Story Video 是一个将手绘插画转化为竖屏短视频的工具，通过 HyperFrames 和 GSAP 实现从左到右的线稿显现与渐变色填充效果。项目支持故事配置校验、线稿提取及页面生成，可输出 40 秒 720×960 30fps 视频，适用于社交媒体内容创作。
summary_en: Handdraw Story Video transforms hand-drawn illustrations into vertical short videos using HyperFrames and GSAP, featuring left-to-right line art reveal and gradual coloring. It supports story config validation, line art extraction, and page generation, producing 40s 720×960 30fps videos ideal for social media content creation.

description: A diffusion model to colorize black and white images
summary_zh: 该项目利用扩散模型对黑白图像进行自动着色，采用LAB颜色空间分离亮度与色彩通道，仅对色彩通道添加噪声并预测去噪结果。模型基于UNet架构，结合灰度图像特征进行条件控制，实现端到端的图像着色。项目展示了从噪声生成彩色图像的过程，适用于历史影像修复、老照片上色等场景。
summary_en: This project implements a diffusion model for automatic colorization of black-and-white images using the LAB color space, where only the color channels are noised and predicted. The UNet-based model conditions on grayscale features and predicts denoised color channels, enabling end-to-end image colorization. It's suitable for restoring historical photos and enhancing old images.

description: Use opencli CLI to interact with social/content websites (Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, YouTube, Weibo, 小红书, V2EX, Reddit, HackerNews, 雪球, BOSS直聘 etc.)
summary_zh: opencli-skill 是一个 Claude Code 技能，通过复用 Chrome 登录态直接操控 B站、知乎、Twitter/X、YouTube 等 16 大平台，支持内容浏览、搜索与发布，无需 API Key，实现自然语言驱动的跨平台自动化交互。
summary_en: opencli-skill is a Claude Code skill that enables natural language control over 16 major platforms (e.g., Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, YouTube) by reusing your Chrome login sessions via opencli CLI—no API keys required—supporting reading, searching, and posting across social and content sites.

description: 这是一个基于AI的自动化交易程序，专为数字货币市场（BNB/USDT）设计。该程序旨在实现全自动化交易，通过AI算法帮助用户在数字货币市场中做出更智能的交易决策。
summary_zh: GridBNB 是一个基于 Python 的企业级自动化交易程序，专为币安交易所设计，支持多币种并发网格交易。通过动态波动率分析、EWMA 混合算法和多层风险管理，实现稳定捕捉市场波动收益。提供 Docker 容器化部署、Nginx 反向代理、实时监控 Web 界面及理财功能集成，适合专业交易者进行自动化数字货币交易。
summary_en: GridBNB is a Python-based enterprise-grade automated trading program designed for Binance exchange, supporting concurrent grid trading across multiple cryptocurrency pairs. It leverages dynamic volatility analysis, EWMA hybrid algorithms, and multi-layer risk management to capture market fluctuations profitably. Features include Docker deployment, Nginx proxy, real-time monitoring web UI, and integrated savings functionality for professional crypto trading automation.

description: 😃 md 编辑器使用的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步到多个内容平台。
summary_zh: COSE 是一款专为 Markdown 编辑器设计的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步至 30+ 主流内容平台。核心亮点包括跨平台同步、自动登录检测、标签页分组管理，尤其针对微信公众号提供样式保留与草稿自动保存功能，全程本地运行保障隐私安全。
summary_en: COSE is a browser extension designed for Markdown editors, enabling one-click article publishing to 30+ platforms. Key features include cross-platform sync, auto-login detection, tab grouping, and full CSS preservation for WeChat Official Accounts. Runs entirely locally with zero data collection.

description: a library for adding declarative ajax functionality to your website
summary_zh: eldarion-ajax 是一个用于为网站添加声明式 AJAX 功能的 JavaScript 库，通过 jQuery 实现。它简化了重复的 AJAX 代码编写，支持通过服务器返回的 JSON 中 `html` 字段渲染 HTML 片段，无需前端模板引擎。支持 `<a>` 点击、表单提交等常见交互，适用于现代 Web 应用的无刷新操作场景。
summary_en: eldarion-ajax is a JavaScript library that enables declarative AJAX functionality on websites using jQuery. It eliminates repetitive $.ajax code by leveraging server-rendered HTML fragments returned in JSON. Designed for seamless integration with server-side templates, it supports common actions like link clicks and form submissions without full page reloads.

description: berserkJS 是新形态的前端测试自动化工具 + 页面性能分析工具 ，同时也是个使用 JS 语法控制的命令行浏览器。可用 JS 编写前端自动测试用例 + 页面性能分析用例。 想了解更多？看看连接中的文档吧~~
summary_zh: berserkJS 是一款基于 Qt 的前端自动化测试与页面性能分析工具，支持无头浏览器模式运行主流测试框架，提供 DOM 操作、网络监控、屏幕捕获及性能指标采集功能，API 简洁且符合 W3C 标准，已在微博、Cisco、腾讯等企业落地应用。
summary_en: berserkJS is a Qt-based frontend automation and performance analysis tool that supports headless browser testing with mainstream frameworks, offering DOM manipulation, network monitoring, screenshot capture, and performance metrics collection. Its W3C-compliant APIs are simple and production-proven in enterprises like Sina Weibo, Cisco, and Tencent.

description: 爬取微信公众号文章
summary_zh: 该仓库通过搜狗微信接口爬取微信公众号文章，支持获取账号信息、文章列表及全文内容，集成反爬虫机制与动态渲染技术，适用于内容聚合与数据分析场景。
summary_en: This repository scrapes WeChat Official Account articles via Sogou's WeChat search platform, supporting account info retrieval, article list parsing, and full content extraction. It includes anti-scraping measures and dynamic rendering support for content aggregation and data analysis.

description: We don't need a lot of libraries. We just need the best ones. | Unofficial recommended first choice.
summary_zh: one-python 精选 Python 生态中最优质的库，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、自然语言处理、网络爬虫、数据分析等核心领域，推荐 scikit-learn、TensorFlow、pandas、requests、Scrapy 等高效工具，助力开发者以最少依赖实现强大功能。
summary_en: one-python curates the best Python libraries across key domains like machine learning, deep learning, NLP, web crawling, and data analysis. It recommends top tools such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, pandas, requests, and Scrapy, enabling developers to build powerful applications with minimal dependencies.

description: Downloads : https://brahma-dev.github.io/synergy-stable-builds/
summary_zh: Synergy 是一款开源的跨平台输入共享工具，允许用户通过一套键鼠无缝控制多台计算机。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，提供简洁的配置与编译流程，适用于多设备办公场景，强调自由使用与二次开发。
summary_en: Synergy is an open-source, cross-platform tool that enables sharing a single mouse and keyboard across multiple computers. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, with straightforward configuration and build processes, ideal for multi-device productivity environments.

description: A SSL-enabled development server for Django
summary_zh: django-sslserver 是一个为 Django 框架提供 SSL 支持的本地开发服务器，支持自签名证书和自定义 CA 证书，适用于开发环境 HTTPS 调试，但不建议用于生产部署。
summary_en: Django SSL Server is a development-only SSL-enabled server for Django, supporting self-signed and CA-trusted certificates, ideal for local HTTPS testing during development, though not recommended for production use.

description: TTSFM mirrors OpenAI's TTS service, providing a compatible interface for text-to-speech conversion with multiple voice options for free.
summary_zh: TTSFM 是一个免费的 OpenAI 兼容文本转语音 API 服务，基于 OpenAI GPT-4o mini TTS 提供多语音选项、6种音频格式支持、速度调节和实时流式生成，包含 Python SDK、Web 交互界面及 Docker 部署方案，适用于教育与研究场景。
summary_en: TTSFM is a free, OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech API service based on OpenAI's GPT-4o mini TTS, offering 11 voice options, 6 audio formats, speed control (0.25x–4.0x), real-time streaming, Python SDK, web playground, and Docker deployment for educational and research use.

description: RN 开源之初，写几个Mini-App
summary_zh: 该项目是React Native早期实战项目集合，包含通讯录、LBS附近服务、豆瓣API搜索等Mini-App。涵盖文件系统Node.js服务端、通讯录管理、公告系统、地图定位及Webview集成，提供完整移动端开发范例，适合RN初学者学习全栈移动应用开发。
summary_en: This repository contains early React Native practical projects including address book, LBS nearby services, and Douban API search apps. It covers Node.js file-based backend, contact management, announcements, map positioning, and Webview integration, serving as a comprehensive full-stack mobile development tutorial for RN beginners.

description: AI generate code
summary_zh: needware.dev 是一个开源的 AI 驱动全栈开发平台，支持在浏览器中直接生成、预览和部署 Web 应用。通过多智能体系统，可将文本描述、截图或 URL 转化为完整代码，集成 Supabase 数据库、实时预览和代码编辑器，实现从想法到产品的全流程开发。
summary_en: needware.dev is an open-source AI-powered full-stack development platform that generates, previews, and deploys web applications directly in the browser. It leverages a multi-agent system to transform text, screenshots, or URLs into functional code, with integrated Supabase database, real-time preview, and code editor for end-to-end development.

summary_zh: Shadowsocks 是一个高性能的 TCP/UDP 隧道代理工具，支持用户管理 API、TCP Fast Open 和 IP 黑名单，用于绕过网络防火墙，提供跨平台服务端与客户端支持，适用于 Linux、Windows、Android 及 OpenWRT 等环境。
summary_en: Shadowsocks is a high-performance TCP/UDP tunnel proxy with features like user management API, TCP Fast Open, and IP blacklisting, designed to bypass firewalls. It supports cross-platform deployment on Linux, Windows, Android, and OpenWRT, offering both server and client implementations.

description: QuietHarness：Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 共用的轻量 AI 工作系统
summary_zh: 这是一个经过实战检验的 Claude Code 工作流模板，提供内存管理、上下文工程和任务路由三大核心能力。基于3个月多项目日常使用经验构建，采用三层架构设计：常驻规则层、按需文档层和热数据工作区，实现智能持久化开发伙伴。支持多模型分级路由、自动保存进度、强制验证完成状态，显著提升开发效率与代码质量。
summary_en: A battle-tested Claude Code workflow template featuring memory management, context engineering, and task routing from 3 months of daily usage. Implements a three-layer architecture: always-loaded rules, on-demand docs, and hot working memory. Enables persistent, self-improving development with multi-model routing, auto-save, verification gates, and cross-session task tracking for production-ready workflows.

description: Open-source cross-platform software KVM for sharing keyboard, mouse, and clipboard across Windows, macOS, and Linux on trusted LANs.
summary_zh: MyKVM 是一款开源的跨平台软件 KVM 解决方案，允许用户通过局域网在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 设备间无缝共享键盘、鼠标和剪贴板。它利用 QUIC/TLS 加密传输输入与剪贴板数据，支持自动发现与多显示器布局，旨在替代传统硬件 KVM 切换器，为多机工作者提供零线缆的流畅体验。
summary_en: MyKVM is an open-source, cross-platform software KVM that enables seamless sharing of keyboard, mouse, and clipboard across Windows, macOS, and Linux devices over a trusted LAN. Utilizing encrypted QUIC/TLS for input and clipboard data transfer, it features automatic peer discovery and multi-monitor layout support, aiming to replace traditional hardware KVM switches with a zero-cable experience for multi-machine workflows.

description: Claude Code 公众号一键排版+发布技能 | Markdown → 微信兼容 HTML → 推送草稿箱 | 30 套主题 + 可视化画廊
summary_zh: 专为 Claude Code 设计的微信公众号一键排版工具，支持 Markdown 转微信兼容 HTML、30 套主题可视化预览、AI 内容增强（对话/图片容器）及直接推送草稿箱，覆盖新闻、科技、设计等多场景风格。
summary_en: A Claude Code skill for seamless WeChat Official Account publishing: converts Markdown to WeChat-compatible HTML, offers 30 visual themes with AI-enhanced content (dialogue/gallery containers), and enables one-click draft publishing via WeChat API.

description: [UNMAINTAINED] Online reStructuredText editor
summary_zh: rsted 是一个基于 Flask 的在线 reStructuredText 编辑器，提供实时预览功能，支持通过 Docker 快速部署。虽然项目已停止维护，但可作为轻量级 RST 文档编辑工具使用，适合快速编写和预览技术文档。
summary_en: rsted is a simple online reStructuredText editor built with Flask, offering real-time preview. Though unmaintained, it provides a lightweight solution for editing and previewing RST documents, deployable via Docker or local server on port 5000.

description: A customizable plug-in photo gallery management application for the Django web framework.
summary_zh: Django-photologue 是一个专为 Django 框架设计的强大图片管理与画廊应用，支持上传照片、创建画廊、添加水印等效果，提供灵活的插件化架构，适用于构建定制化图片展示网站。
summary_en: Django-photologue is a powerful image management and gallery application for Django, enabling photo uploads, gallery organization, watermarking, and flexible customization for web-based photo displays.

description: 移动端响应式插件
summary_zh: 移动端响应式插件通过transform:scale实现页面缩放适配，支持contain/cover/auto三种模式，兼容iOS4+与Android2.3+等老旧系统。采用视觉稿px单位直接适配，无需rem或媒体查询，零依赖仅1KB，适合单屏滑屏H5页面开发。
summary_en: A lightweight mobile responsive plugin using transform:scale for device adaptation. Supports contain/cover/auto modes with excellent legacy browser support (iOS4+/Android2.3+). Uses visual design px units directly without rem or media queries, ideal for single-screen H5 apps.

description: 金谷园饺子馆.Skill - 北邮旁的饺子馆
summary_zh: 金谷园饺子馆 AI Skill 是一个基于 MCP 协议的轻量级智能服务，专为北邮学生及周边人群提供餐厅信息查询、排队取号、外卖服务、生饺烹饪指导及店内 Wi-Fi 密码等六项核心功能，支持 Streamable HTTP 传输，部署于腾讯云函数，实现 AI 助手与实体餐饮服务的无缝对接。
summary_en: The JinGuYuan Dumpling Skill is a lightweight AI service built on the MCP protocol, offering six core functionalities including restaurant info, queue management, delivery, frozen dumpling cooking guidance, and in-store Wi-Fi access. It uses Streamable HTTP transport and is deployed via Tencent CloudBase functions, enabling seamless integration between AI assistants and real-world dining services.

description: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
summary_zh: AigoTools 是一款开源的网站目录导航系统，支持一键部署个人导航站点。内置基于 Playwright/Jina/OpenAI 的自动网站收录功能，集成 SEO 优化、多语言国际化、暗黑/亮色主题切换，并提供 MinIO/AWS S3/腾讯云 COS 多种图片存储方案，适合快速搭建个性化网站导航平台。
summary_en: AigoTools is an open-source website directory/navigation system enabling one-click deployment of personal navigation sites. It features automatic site crawling via Playwright/Jina/OpenAI, integrated SEO optimization, multilingual i18n, dark/light theme toggle, and multiple image storage options including MinIO, AWS S3, and Tencent Cloud COS — ideal for quickly building personalized navigation platforms.

description: django-request is a statistics module for django. It stores requests in a database for admins to see, it can also be used to get statistics on who is online etc.
summary_zh: django-request 是一个为 Django 框架设计的网站统计模块，自动记录用户请求至数据库，支持管理员查看访问数据、在线用户统计及流量分析。通过中间件集成和模板标签，可轻松实现用户活跃度监控与访问趋势可视化，适用于需要精细化运营分析的网站项目。
summary_en: django-request is a Django statistics module that logs HTTP requests to a database for admins to analyze. It enables real-time tracking of online users, visitor statistics, and traffic insights via built-in middleware and template tags, ideal for monitoring user engagement and site performance in Django applications.

description: A Markdown rendering engine that generates paginated PNG and SVG output — no browser, no Chromium, no DOM.
summary_zh: marknative 是一个原生 Markdown 渲染引擎，无需浏览器或 DOM，直接生成分页的 PNG/SVG 文档。它通过自建排版引擎实现确定性分页和头less服务端渲染，支持 CommonMark + GFM 语法，适用于 API 文档、电子书等需要精确控制排版的场景。
summary_en: marknative is a native Markdown rendering engine that generates paginated PNG/SVG output without requiring a browser, Chromium, or DOM. It parses Markdown into an internal document model, runs its own layout and pagination engine, and paints pages using Skia Canvas. Ideal for deterministic, server-side rendering of technical docs, e-books, and reports.

description: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
summary_zh: AigoTools 是一款导航站建站工具，支持快速创建和管理网站目录，内置自动爬虫抓取站点信息（基于 Playwright、Jina、OpenAI），提供用户管理、国际化、SEO 优化及多平台图片存储（MinIO、AWS S3、腾讯云 COS）。用户可一键部署个性化导航网站，适合内容聚合与分类管理场景。
summary_en: AigoTools is a navigation site builder that enables rapid creation and management of website directories with built-in auto-crawling (using Playwright, Jina, OpenAI), user management (Clerk), internationalization, SEO, and multi-cloud image storage (MinIO, AWS S3, Tencent COS). It allows instant deployment of customizable navigation sites for content aggregation and categorization.

description: A minimal modern terminal for AI coding experience — Sidebar workspaces; horizontal / vertical split panes; one-click agent launch; per-agent activity readout; live workspace state with one-click Node and branch switching.
summary_zh: kooky 是一款专为 AI 编码打造的现代化 macOS 终端模拟器，基于 libghostty 实现 GPU 渲染。核心特性包括侧边栏工作区、多窗格分屏、一键启动 Claude Code/Gemini CLI 等多种 AI Agent、Git Worktree 隔离开发、右键选中内容直接询问 Agent、模糊快速打开面板以及多行提示词编辑器。支持会话自动恢复、跨窗口拖拽标签页，无账号无遥测，状态完全本地存储。
summary_en: kooky is a minimal modern terminal emulator built for AI coding on macOS, powered by libghostty with GPU rendering. Key features include sidebar workspaces, horizontal/vertical split panes, one-click launch of Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, and other AI agents, Git Worktree isolation, right-click-to-ask-agent on selections, fuzzy Quick Open panel, and a multi-line prompt composer. Sessions auto-resume across restarts, tabs are draggable across panes and windows, and all state stays local with no accounts or telemetry.

description: 网站
summary_zh: 开源阅读官网基于 Docusaurus 2 构建，提供文档、博客和下载功能，支持 Markdown 内容创作，便于用户贡献阅读APP相关资源，提升社区知识共享效率。
summary_en: The open-source reading official website is built with Docusaurus 2, featuring documentation, blogs, and downloads. It supports Markdown-based content contributions for the reading app, enhancing community knowledge sharing.

description: Python爬虫，返回一定格式的信息，下载，使用flask提供简易api。抖音无水印、皮皮虾、快手、网易云音乐、qq音乐、咪咕音乐、荔枝FM音频、知乎视频、最右语音、视频、微博......
summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Python 的网页爬虫集合，支持抖音、快手、网易云音乐、知乎等平台的无水印视频、音频及内容下载，通过 Flask 提供简易 API 接口。代码风格较旧但功能实用，现计划迁移至 FastAPI 框架重构，适合学习或日常使用。
summary_en: This project is a collection of Python web crawlers for downloading unwatermarked videos, audio, and content from platforms like Douyin, Kuaishou, NetEase Music, and Zhihu. It provides a simple API via Flask. The codebase is outdated but functional, with plans to migrate to FastAPI for better structure and usability.

description: a sudoku game written in React Native
summary_zh: 这是一个使用 React Native 开发的数独游戏应用，具备动画效果、编辑模式、游戏进度保存及在线排行榜功能。开发者曾创下 3分43秒的解题记录，并计划扩展多难度等级、国际化支持和云端数据存储。
summary_en: A React Native-based Sudoku game featuring animations, editing mode, game resume, and online leaderboards. The developer holds a personal record of 3:43 and plans to add multiple difficulty levels, i18n support, and cloud-based score storage.

description: Document Web APIs made with Django Rest Framework
summary_zh: DRF Docs 是一个专为 Django Rest Framework 设计的 API 文档自动生成工具，支持 Python 2.7/3.x 和 Django 1.8+。它能自动解析 DRF 项目中的 API 结构，生成交互式文档页面，并提供配置选项控制文档可见性。项目包含演示环境，支持模板扩展，适用于需要快速搭建标准化 API 文档的中大型后端服务。
summary_en: DRF Docs is an automated API documentation generator for Django Rest Framework, supporting Python 2.7/3.x and Django 1.8+. It auto-generates interactive API docs by parsing DRF project structures, with configurable visibility and template extension support. Includes a demo project for development and testing, ideal for medium-to-large backend services requiring standardized API documentation.

description: HiApp written in react-native.
summary_zh: HiApp 是一款基于 React Native 开发的跨平台移动应用，支持 iOS 和 Android 平台。项目提供完整的开发环境配置指南，包含依赖安装、打包器启动及真机运行方案，适合学习 React Native 开发实践。
summary_en: HiApp is a cross-platform mobile application built with React Native, supporting both iOS and Android. It includes setup instructions for dependency installation, packager startup, and device deployment, serving as a practical reference for React Native development.

description: 一款手势驱动的裁图插件 / A gesture to drive image cropping plug-in
summary_zh: PhotoClip.js 是一款手势驱动的移动端图片裁剪插件，支持双指缩放、旋转等直观操作，兼容主流浏览器。通过集成 iscroll-zoom、hammer.js 和 lrz 压缩库，实现高效图片裁剪与压缩，适用于移动端照片处理场景，提供灵活的配置选项和回调机制。
summary_en: PhotoClip.js is a gesture-driven image cropping plugin for mobile devices, supporting intuitive pinch-to-zoom and rotation. It integrates iscroll-zoom, hammer.js, and lrz compression for efficient image processing. Compatible with modern browsers, it offers flexible configuration and callbacks for mobile photo editing workflows.

description: Community fetch recipes for bb-browser — pre-built adapters for Reddit, Twitter, GitHub, and more
summary_zh: bb-sites 是 bb-browser 的社区站点适配器集合，提供 95+ 个预置脚本，将主流平台（如 Reddit、Twitter、GitHub、YouTube、Bilibili 等）转换为 CLI 命令。无需 API 密钥或反爬绕过，直接通过浏览器环境运行，支持搜索、内容抓取、用户交互等场景，实现网页内容的命令行化访问。
summary_en: bb-sites is a community-driven collection of site adapters for bb-browser, enabling websites like Reddit, Twitter, GitHub, and YouTube to be accessed via CLI commands. With 95+ pre-built adapters across 35 platforms, it allows direct content retrieval without API keys or anti-bot workarounds, leveraging the browser's logged-in state for seamless automation.

summary_zh: 本仓库提供 Android Design Support Library 的完整教程，包含60分钟实战项目，涵盖 Snackbar、FloatingActionButton、NavigationView 等核心组件的集成与交互实现，适合 Android 开发者学习现代 UI 设计模式。
summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive 60-minute codelab tutorial on the Android Design Support Library, demonstrating integration of key UI components like Snackbar, FloatingActionButton, and NavigationView to build modern Android interfaces with Material Design principles.

description: Beautiful native macOS download manager for direct links, magnets, and torrents.
summary_zh: Harbor是一款原生macOS下载管理器，基于SwiftUI构建，支持直链、磁力链接与种子文件下载。主打本地优先、隐私友好设计，提供批量添加、流量控制、Torrent预览等实用功能，完美契合Mac原生工作流。
summary_en: Harbor is a beautiful native macOS download manager built with SwiftUI, supporting direct links, magnet links, and torrents. Local-first, privacy-friendly, and free, it offers batch queuing, traffic profiles, and Torrent preview for a seamless Mac-native experience.

description: django-threadedcomments is a simple yet flexible threaded commenting system for Django.
summary_zh: django-threadedcomments 是一个基于 Django 的简洁灵活线程化评论系统，支持评论嵌套回复。它构建于 django_comments 之上，易于扩展，提供完整的模板标签和表单渲染功能，适用于博客、文章等内容的互动评论场景。
summary_en: django-threadedcomments is a lightweight yet flexible threaded commenting system for Django, enabling nested replies to both posts and other comments. Built on django_comments, it offers extensible template tags and seamless integration with custom designs, ideal for blogs and articles.

description: Agent skill that draws architecture, flowchart, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams as hand-placed SVG, to one linted house style.
summary_zh: SVG 手绘风格架构图绘制技能，为 AI 编码代理提供统一的布局算术、颜色系统与零依赖校验器，支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 40+ 代理，确保生成的序列图、数据流图、生命周期图经 svg-lint 12 项检查后保持 house 样式一致。
summary_en: An agent skill that draws hand-crafted SVG diagrams — architecture, flowchart, sequence, data-flow, lifecycle — following a unified house style with layout arithmetic, a color system, and a zero-dependency linter (svg-lint) with 12 checks. Works with 40+ AI coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot.

summary_zh: Web Content Fetcher 是一个轻量级网页正文提取工具，支持自动将任意网页转换为标准 Markdown 格式。采用 Scrapling 优先策略（fast/stealth 双模式自动降级），并集成 Jina Reader 作为备选方案，完美适配微信公众号、掘金、CSDN 等国内主流平台及海外技术站点。
summary_en: Web Content Fetcher is a lightweight tool for extracting clean Markdown content from web pages. It prioritizes Scrapling with fast/stealth dual-mode auto-fallback, integrates Jina Reader as backup, and supports major Chinese platforms like WeChat Official Accounts, Juejin, and CSDN, plus global tech sites.

description: cxSelect 是基于 jQuery 的多级联动菜单插件，适用于省市、商品分类等联动菜单。
summary_zh: cxSelect 是一个基于 jQuery 和 Zepto 的多级联动菜单插件，支持通过 AJAX 或自定义 JSON 数据动态加载省市、商品分类等层级选项，兼容移动端，提供灵活的参数配置与 API 控制，适用于表单联动场景。
summary_en: cxSelect is a jQuery and Zepto-based plugin for multi-level cascading menus, supporting dynamic loading of hierarchical options (e.g., provinces, cities) via AJAX or custom JSON data. It offers flexible configuration, mobile compatibility, and full API control for form interactions.

description: Create stunning screen recordings for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use. An alternative to Screen Studio.
summary_zh: CursorLens 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为创作者、开发者和团队设计。基于 OpenScreen 构建，深度优化 macOS 原生捕获流程，支持全屏/窗口录制、摄像头画中画、语音录制、时间轴剪辑、字幕生成及多比例导出，无水印且商用免费。
summary_en: CursorLens is a free, open-source screen recorder and editor built on OpenScreen, enhanced for native macOS capture and editing. It supports full-screen/app recording, camera overlay, voice input, timeline editing, subtitle generation, and multi-aspect export—all watermark-free and commercially usable.

description: A native macOS menu-bar app that keeps your keyboard input source locked — global, per-app, and per-URL.
summary_zh: LockIME 是一款原生 macOS 菜单栏应用，专注于解决多输入法切换混乱问题。它支持全局、按应用及按浏览器 URL 锁定键盘输入源，一旦检测到输入法被切换，立即自动恢复。基于 Swift 6 和 Liquid Glass 技术构建，提供灵活的规则匹配与快捷键控制，显著提升多语言用户的输入效率。
summary_en: LockIME is a native macOS menu-bar utility that locks your keyboard input source globally, per-app, or per-URL. It instantly reverts any unauthorized input method switches, ensuring a consistent typing experience. Built with Swift 6 and Liquid Glass, it offers flexible rule matching and global shortcuts for power users.

description: 帮你从文档生成对应的多张配图，内置了歸藏精心探索的图片风格，支持 16:9 和 3:4 两种比例，方便发小红书以及推特。
summary_zh: Document Illustrator 是一款基于 AI 智能分析的文档配图生成工具，能自动理解任意格式文档内容并生成专业配图。支持三种风格（渐变玻璃卡片、票据风格、矢量插画）和两种比例（16:9/3:4），可生成封面图与内容配图，适用于小红书、推特等社交媒体内容创作。
summary_en: Document Illustrator is an AI-powered tool that intelligently analyzes document content to generate professional illustrations. It supports three visual styles (gradient glass, ticket, vector illustration) and two aspect ratios (16:9/3:4), capable of creating cover images and thematic illustrations for social media platforms like Xiaohongshu and Twitter.

description: A keyboard-driven window switcher for macOS. Notarized. Free.
summary_zh: Switch 是一款专为 macOS 设计的免费键盘驱动窗口切换器。它支持跨空间窗口管理、垂直列表视图及粘性模式，提供类似 Spotlight 的即时过滤与数字快捷键选择，彻底替代原生 ⌘Tab，大幅提升多窗口操作效率。
summary_en: Switch is a free, keyboard-driven window switcher for macOS. It replaces the native ⌘Tab with instant filtering, cross-space management, and sticky mode, allowing users to quickly navigate and manage windows using only the keyboard.

description: A review extension for Pi
summary_zh: pi-review 是 Pi AI 编码助手的代码审查扩展，支持通过简洁指令审查未提交变更、分支、提交、PR 及指定文件快照，输出优先级分明的审查结论与可操作建议，并支持自定义审查规范。
summary_en: pi-review is a code review extension for Pi AI coding assistant. It supports reviewing uncommitted changes, branches, commits, PRs, and file snapshots via simple commands, producing prioritized findings with actionable suggestions and custom review guidelines.

description: The unofficial V2EX app for iOS
summary_zh: darkerk/v2ex 是一款专为 iOS 平台开发的非官方 V2EX 客户端应用，采用 Swift 4.1 编写，支持 iOS 10.0+。该应用提供简洁的界面设计，让用户能够便捷地浏览 V2EX 社区内容，包括节点、主题和评论等核心功能，是 V2EX 用户的移动端优质替代方案。
summary_en: darkerk/v2ex is an unofficial iOS app for V2EX, built with Swift 4.1 and compatible with iOS 10.0+. It offers a clean interface for browsing V2EX content, including nodes, topics, and comments, serving as a convenient mobile alternative to the web version of V2EX.

description: A minimal django project containing a minimal app with a working jquery file upload form based on the work by Sebastian Tschan: http://aquantum-demo.appspot.com/file-upload
summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Sebastian Tschan 的 jQuery-File-Upload 组件的极简 Django 文件上传示例，支持拖拽上传、多文件选择、上传取消及文件删除功能，无需 Flash 等浏览器插件，适用于快速集成前端文件上传到 Django 后端。
summary_en: This is a minimal Django project demonstrating how to integrate Sebastian Tschan's jQuery-File-Upload component, featuring drag-and-drop, multi-file selection, upload cancellation, and file deletion. It requires no browser plugins like Flash and is ideal for quickly adding robust file upload functionality to Django applications.

description: AngularJS入门教程——AngularJS中文社区提供
summary_zh: 本仓库提供完整的AngularJS入门教程，涵盖快速开始、模板系统、双向绑定、路由、REST服务等核心功能。由AngularJS中文社区维护，包含15个循序渐进的实践章节，适合前端开发者系统学习AngularJS框架。
summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive AngularJS tutorial covering core features like templates, two-way binding, routing, and REST services. Maintained by the AngularJS Chinese Community, it includes 15 progressive chapters ideal for developers learning the framework.

description: Detect mobile browsers and serve different template flavours to them.
summary_zh: django-mobile 是一个 Django 中间件工具，用于自动检测移动端浏览器并动态切换模板渲染。它通过中间件识别用户设备类型，并基于预设的 'flavour'（如 mobile/desktop）透明加载对应模板（如 mobile/index.html），支持多设备适配和优雅降级，无需修改视图逻辑即可实现响应式站点。
summary_en: django-mobile is a Django middleware that detects mobile browsers and serves different templates accordingly. It uses middleware to identify device type, then transparently loads flavored templates (e.g., mobile/index.html) based on the detected 'flavour', enabling responsive design without altering view logic. It supports multiple mobile flavors and graceful fallback to default templates.

description: 源代码
summary_zh: Auto Cursor 是一款专业的 Cursor IDE 管理工具，支持一键备份与恢复账户配置、无感换号及自动轮换到期账户，实现真正的无缝切换。核心功能包括机器ID管理、配置备份、SQLite 数据库更新等，适用于 macOS 和 Windows 平台，所有操作均创建备份以确保安全。
summary_en: Auto Cursor is a professional Cursor IDE management tool enabling one-click backup/restore of account configurations, seamless account switching, and automatic rotation of expired accounts. It manages machine IDs, updates storage.json and SQLite databases, and supports macOS and Windows. All operations create backups for safety and user control.

description: A smart and beautiful markdown editor.
summary_zh: Markcook 是一款基于 Vue 2.0 和 Vuex 2.0 开发的智能美观 Markdown 编辑器，采用 Google Material Design 风格。支持多文件切换、拖拽加载、自动保存至本地存储、一键插入 Markdown 语法及导出为 Markdown 或 HTML 文件，提供流畅的动画交互与护眼配色，兼具在线便捷性与本地应用体验。
summary_en: Markcook is a smart and beautiful markdown editor built with VueJS 2.0 and Vuex 2.0, featuring Google Material Design. It supports multi-file editing, drag-and-drop loading, auto-save to local storage, toolbar-based markdown insertion, and export to .md or .html. With smooth animations, low-contrast colors, and componentized architecture, it offers a seamless online experience akin to desktop apps.

description: 微信聊天记录导出、分析工具
summary_zh: Wechat Explorer 是一款专为 iOS 设备设计的微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，通过解析 iTunes 备份中的微信数据，支持导出聊天室记录、统计好友标签及聊天室活跃度，并可生成 HTML 报告转为 PDF，适用于个人数据备份与社交行为分析。
summary_en: Wechat Explorer is an iOS-focused tool for exporting and analyzing WeChat chat records by parsing iTunes backups. It supports exporting chatroom logs, generating friend label statistics, and creating PDF reports from HTML exports, ideal for personal data archiving and social behavior insights.

description: Bootstrap-themed jquery tag interface
summary_zh: Bootstrap Tags 是一个 jQuery 插件，用于扩展 Twitter Bootstrap 的标签功能，支持 Bootstrap 2.3.2 和 3+ 版本。它提供自动建议、排除/过滤列表、占位符提示、Bootstrap 按钮样式集成以及可自定义的扩展点，适用于需要交互式标签输入的 Web 表单场景。
summary_en: Bootstrap Tags is a jQuery plugin that extends Twitter Bootstrap with tagging functionality, supporting Bootstrap 2.3.2 and 3+. It features autosuggest, exclusion/filtering, popovers, placeholder prompts, and Bootstrap button styling, making it ideal for interactive tag-based input in web forms.

description: A fast, native RSS reader — plus an agent-facing CLI so your AI agent can read, search and triage your feeds from the shell.
summary_zh: Papr 是一款专为桌面端设计的快速原生 RSS 阅读器，支持订阅管理、智能分类、全文抓取、AI 摘要与问答、音频播放及 FreshRSS 同步，数据本地存储于 SQLite，无云端依赖，提供多语言界面。
summary_en: Papr is a fast, native desktop RSS reader featuring feed organization, smart views, full-text fetching, AI-powered summaries and Q&A, audio playback, FreshRSS sync, and local-first data storage via SQLite—no cloud or account required.

description: Python项目自动化多服务器部署的工具
summary_zh: essay 是一个基于 Fabric 的 Python 项目自动化部署工具，支持多服务器打包与部署。它通过标准化流程简化开发到生产环境的交付，集成 PyPI 服务器和 Git 仓库，提供快速构建、版本化打包、虚拟环境管理及 Supervisord 进程控制，适用于需高效扩展的 Python 服务场景。
summary_en: Essay is a Python project automation deployment tool based on Fabric, supporting multi-server packaging and deployment. It streamlines the development-to-production pipeline with standardized workflows, integrating PyPI servers and Git repositories. It enables rapid builds, versioned packaging, virtual environment management, and Supervisord process control, ideal for scalable Python service deployments.

description: Resume template for Coder 适合程序员的简历模板 🎉
summary_zh: 专为程序员设计的简历模板，基于Sketch.app制作，提供多版本（2021/2019/2018/2017/中文版）设计，突出技术能力与项目经验，支持一键导出PDF，适配不同求职场景。
summary_en: A professional resume template designed for coders, built with Sketch.app. Offers multiple versions (2021/2019/2018/2017/Chinese) to showcase technical skills and project experience, with one-click PDF export for job applications.

summary_zh: 该项目通过 ISBN 空间可视化技术，将全球图书数据映射为二维空间，支持按出版社、稀有度等维度进行交互式探索。基于预处理的 ISBN 前缀数据和图书馆馆藏信息，生成高分辨率 PNG 瓦片数据集，适用于大规模图书数据的直观分析与展示。
summary_en: This project visualizes the global book catalog by mapping ISBNs into a 2D space, enabling interactive exploration by publisher, rarity, and other dimensions. It uses preprocessed ISBN prefix data and library holdings to generate high-resolution PNG tile datasets for intuitive analysis and visualization of massive book collections.

description: A set of utilities for creating robust pagination tools throughout a django application.
summary_zh: django-pagination 提供了一套用于在 Django 应用中构建健壮分页工具的实用程序，现已停止维护。其维护分支可在 pydanny/dj-pagination 获取，适用于需要高效处理大量数据展示的 Web 项目。
summary_en: django-pagination offers utilities for building robust pagination tools in Django applications. This project is no longer maintained; a supported fork is available at pydanny/dj-pagination, ideal for web apps requiring efficient data pagination.

description: :zap: Sync all of your VSCode settings across multiple devices, supports any VSCode variant.
summary_zh: VSCode Syncing 是一款强大的 VSCode 扩展，支持跨设备同步用户设置、键位绑定、扩展、语言包和代码片段至 GitHub Gist。支持增量同步、自动安装扩展、代理配置，并兼容 VSCodium、Cursor 等 VSCode 衍生版本。
summary_en: VSCode Syncing is a powerful extension that synchronizes all VSCode settings—including user settings, keybindings, extensions, snippets, and locales—across multiple devices via GitHub Gist. It supports incremental sync, automatic extension management, proxy configuration, and works with any VSCode variant like VSCodium and Cursor.

description: Scrapy extension to write scraped items using Django models
summary_zh: scrapy-djangoitem 是一个 Scrapy 扩展，允许使用 Django 模型定义 Scrapy 项目中的 Item。它提供 DjangoItem 类，将 Django 模型字段自动映射为 Scrapy Item 字段，并支持通过 save() 方法将抓取数据直接保存为 Django 模型实例，简化了爬虫与 Django 应用的数据集成。
summary_en: scrapy-djangoitem is a Scrapy extension that enables defining Scrapy items using existing Django models. It provides the DjangoItem class, which automatically maps Django model fields to Scrapy item fields and supports saving scraped data directly into Django model instances via the save() method, streamlining integration between Scrapy crawlers and Django applications.

description: Lemon is open source, embeddable, lightweight programming language http://www.lemon-lang.org
summary_zh: Lemon 是一种开源、轻量级、可嵌入的编程语言，提供完整的编译器与虚拟机实现。支持 POSIX 和 Windows 平台，内置 OS 与 Socket 模块，适用于嵌入式系统和脚本扩展。项目包含源码、核心库、文档与测试用例，采用 MIT 许可证。
summary_en: Lemon is an open-source, embeddable, lightweight programming language featuring a complete compiler and virtual machine. It supports POSIX and Windows, includes built-in OS and socket modules, and is ideal for embedded systems and scripting. The project provides source code, core library, documentation, and tests under the MIT license.

description: 爱V2EX（原掌上V2EX）
summary_zh: 爱V2EX是一款非官方的V2EX社区Android客户端，提供话题浏览、节点搜索、用户资料查看、话题创建与回复、未读提醒等功能，支持滑动手势操作，界面简洁易用，完全开源并遵循GPL协议。
summary_en: V2EX-android is a non-official Android client for the V2EX community, offering features like topic browsing, node search, user profiles, topic creation/replies, and unread notifications. It supports gesture navigation and is fully open-source under the GPL license.

description: Independent iOS client for Lody — native chat, sessions, and coding-agent collaboration on iPhone
summary_zh: 独立开源 iOS 客户端，为 Lody AI 协作平台打造。采用 React Native + Swift 6.0 混合架构，结合 CRDT 数据同步，支持无限聊天、流式文本渲染、代码 Diff 高亮与文件树导航，严格遵循 Apple HIG，提供安全的本地会话与远程服务桥接体验。
summary_en: Independent open-source iOS client for Lody AI platform. Hybrid React Native + Swift 6.0 architecture with CRDT sync (Loro/Flock). Features infinite chat, streaming rendering, code diff highlighting, and file tree. Strictly follows Apple HIG for authentic native experience bridging local sessions and remote services.

description: 🏯 Claude Code / Codex skill — transform Chinese architecture, cultural places & travel photos into art-directed editorial posters with GPT Image. 中国古建筑与在地文化照片 → 艺术指导海报
summary_zh: Yingzao 是将中国古建筑、文化场所与旅行照片转为艺术指导编辑海报的 Agent Skill。它通过构图识别、中式排版设计与图像重绘，保护建筑身份锚点，实现文字与主体的深度互动，支持多图融合与视频分镜扩展。
summary_en: Yingzao is an agent skill that transforms Chinese architectural and cultural photos into art-directed editorial posters. It combines composition analysis, Chinese typography design, and image model generation to preserve architectural identity while creating meaningful text-image interactions, with support for multi-image fusion and video storyboard extension.

description: Pi — A cross-platform AI coding agent, bringing the Claude Code experience to your desktop. No environment setup, no terminal commands. Download and start coding right away.
summary_zh: Pi Agent 是一款跨平台 AI 编码代理桌面应用，将 Claude Code 能力封装为免配置的一体化安装包。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，无需终端命令即可直接与 AI 助手协作编程。提供会话管理、模型配置、代码预览和自动更新等功能。
summary_en: Pi Agent is a cross-platform AI coding agent desktop app that packages Claude Code capabilities into a standalone, zero-config application. Supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux, it enables seamless AI-assisted development without terminal commands. Features include session management, model configuration, code preview, and automatic updates.

description: 🚀 MiniMax大模型海螺AI逆向API【特长：超自然语音】，支持MiniMax Text-01、MiniMax-VL-01模型，支持高速流式输出、语音合成、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
summary_zh: 本项目为MiniMax海螺AI提供逆向API服务，支持MiniMax-Text-01和MiniMax-VL-01模型，具备高速流式输出、语音合成与识别、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析及多轮对话能力。零配置部署，支持多路token并发，自动清理会话痕迹，接口兼容ChatGPT，适用于测试与个人使用。
summary_en: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for MiniMax Hailuo AI, supporting MiniMax-Text-01 and MiniMax-VL-01 models. It features high-speed streaming output, speech synthesis/ASR, web search, document analysis, image parsing, and multi-turn conversations. Zero-configuration deployment, multi-token concurrency, session auto-cleanup, and full ChatGPT compatibility. For testing only; commercial use requires official platform access.

description: 针对 Vue 框架移植的 We UI 框架的适配，让 mobile开发过程成为一种享受。 Demo:
summary_zh: vue-weui 是将 WeUI 移动端 UI 框架适配到 Vue.js 的项目，结合 vue-router、ES6 和 Webpack 构建现代化移动应用开发环境，提供开箱即用的组件库和开发工具链，显著提升移动端开发效率与体验。
summary_en: vue-weui is a Vue.js adaptation of the WeUI mobile UI framework, integrating vue-router, ES6, and Webpack to deliver a modern development stack for mobile apps. It offers ready-to-use components and tooling to streamline mobile development.

summary_zh: LazyTyper 是一个自动化输入工具，通过预定义脚本实现快速文本输入与操作，适用于重复性任务场景。本仓库提供其各版本的二进制发布文件，方便用户直接下载使用。
summary_en: LazyTyper is an automation tool that enables rapid text input and operations via predefined scripts, ideal for repetitive tasks. This repository hosts binary releases for easy download and deployment.

description: 🥘Base on element-ui, makes crud easily
summary_zh: el-data-table 是基于 element-ui 封装的 CRUD 表格组件，支持自动请求、分页、树形数据、自定义搜索和操作列，集成 @femessage/el-form-renderer 渲染表单，通过配置化实现快速开发 RESTful API 管理界面。
summary_en: el-data-table is a CRUD table component built on element-ui, featuring auto data fetching via axios, pagination, tree structures, custom search, and operation columns. It uses @femessage/el-form-renderer for form rendering and supports configuration-driven RESTful API management.

description: 📁 轻盈优雅的 Web 原生 Cloudflare R2 桶文件管理器，一切皆在浏览器中完成。 | 📁 A lightweight, elegant, pure-browser Cloudflare R2 file manager. Everything happens right in your browser.
summary_zh: R2 Web 是一款轻量级、优雅的纯浏览器 Cloudflare R2 文件管理器，无需构建或后端服务。它支持拖拽上传、图片压缩、多语言界面、深色模式及 PWA 桌面安装，所有操作均在客户端完成，直连 R2 API，保障数据安全。
summary_en: R2 Web is a lightweight, elegant, pure-browser file manager for Cloudflare R2, with no build step or backend required. It supports drag-and-drop uploads, image compression, multi-language UI, dark mode, and PWA desktop installation—all client-side operations directly connecting to the R2 API.

description: Aser is a lightweight, self-assembling AI Agent frame.
summary_zh: Aser 是一个轻量级、自组装的 AI 智能体框架，支持模块化组合与快速开发。通过几行代码即可构建具备工具调用、知识库、记忆、MCP 协议等能力的智能体，适用于 Web3、自动化任务和多智能体协作场景，提供丰富的示例与扩展能力。
summary_en: Aser is a lightweight, self-assembling AI agent framework enabling rapid development of modular agents. With just a few lines of code, users can build agents with tools, knowledge retrieval, memory, MCP protocol, and more, ideal for Web3 automation, multi-agent collaboration, and advanced AI workflows.

description: 想做真人口播，又不必自己对着镜头念。上传一段真人出镜视频，写好字幕，本机配音并对口型，合成竖屏 MP4。密钥只留在浏览器里。
summary_zh: 本机运行的AI真人口播视频生成工具。上传真人出镜视频后，自动AI配音并对口型，最终合成竖屏MP4。密钥仅存浏览器本地，支持阿里百炼/火山引擎TTS及VideoRetalk对口型，适用于短视频内容快速生产。
summary_en: A local AI talking-head video generator. Upload a real-person video, get AI dubbing and lip-sync via Alibaba VideoRetalk, then compile a vertical MP4. API keys stay in browser storage only. Supports multiple TTS providers, ideal for fast short-video content creation.

description: Versatile downloader for audio, video, podcasts, PDFs and more. Available as CLI and Docker | 多功能下载工具，支持音视频、播客、PDF等，提供 CLI 和 Docker 两种方式
summary_zh: vget 是一款多功能下载工具，支持从音视频、播客、社交媒体（如小红书、Twitter）及WebDAV等资源下载内容，提供 CLI 和 Docker 部署方式，具备多语言支持和交互式配置向导，适用于跨平台自动化下载场景。
summary_en: vget is a versatile downloader supporting audio, video, podcasts, PDFs, and social media content from platforms like Xiaohongshu and Twitter. It offers CLI and Docker deployment, multi-language support, and interactive configuration, ideal for cross-platform automated downloads.

description: Simple and easy use python web framework
summary_zh: Uliweb 是一个基于 Python 的全栈 Web 框架，核心设计目标是可重用性、可配置性和可替换性。采用 MVT 架构，支持模块化应用开发，集成 Werkzeug 路由、SQLAlchemy ORM 和 Alembic 数据库迁移，内置表单处理、国际化、缓存与会话管理，模板支持原生 Python 代码，提升开发效率与代码复用。
summary_en: Uliweb is a full-stack Python web framework emphasizing reusability, configurability, and replaceability. It uses the MVT pattern, modular apps, Werkzeug routing, SQLAlchemy ORM with Alembic migrations, built-in form handling, i18n, caching, and session management. Templates support native Python code, enabling efficient and DRY development.

description: A v2ex client on android platform.(deprecated)
summary_zh: v2ex-daily-android 是一款已停止维护的 Android 客户端应用，专为访问 v2ex 社区设计，支持浏览主题、节点搜索和用户信息查看，界面遵循 Material Design 风格，提供简洁高效的原生体验。
summary_en: v2ex-daily-android is a deprecated Android client for the v2ex community, offering topic browsing, node search, and user profiles with a clean Material Design interface, optimized for native mobile experience.

description: Agent-Native Terminal
summary_zh: Termany 是一款 Agent-Native 终端，采用本地优先、云端就绪的架构。通过统一的 React 与 xterm.js 界面，支持 Web、桌面（Tauri）及未来云端部署。核心亮点在于无缝集成 Claude、Codex 等十余种主流 AI 编码代理，支持分屏多任务、文件树内嵌编辑与预览，并提供详细的 AI 使用成本与 Token 消耗分析面板。
summary_en: Termany is an agent-native terminal with a local-first, cloud-ready architecture. It unifies Web, desktop (Tauri), and future cloud deployments under a single React and xterm.js UI. Key features include seamless integration of over a dozen AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, etc.), split-pane multitasking, inline file editing/preview, and a detailed dashboard for tracking AI usage costs and token consumption.

description: Agent Skill for Chinese-first HyperFrames motion-video production from articles, products, websites, and README files.
summary_zh: HyperFrames Motion Director 是一款专为中文场景优化的 AI Agent 技能，旨在将文章、产品文档或 README 快速转化为 9:16 竖版动态视频。它采用两阶段工作流（先确认创意提案，再生成素材与合成），通过严格的布局契约与动效引导，确保输出符合专业标准的宣传片与文字动画。
summary_en: HyperFrames Motion Director is an AI Agent skill optimized for Chinese-first workflows, transforming articles, product docs, or READMEs into 9:16 vertical motion videos. Utilizing a two-phase pipeline (brief confirmation followed by asset generation and composition), it enforces strict layout contracts and attention-guiding animations to produce professional kinetic typography and promotional content.

description: DjangoUeditor
summary_zh: DjangoUeditor 是一个用于在 Django 项目中集成百度 UEditor 富文本编辑器的 Python 模块，支持强大的 HTML 编辑功能（如拖拽调整表格单元格），提供灵活的上传路径配置和自定义按钮扩展，适用于内容管理系统、博客等富文本编辑场景。
summary_en: DjangoUeditor is a Python module that integrates Baidu UEditor, a powerful online HTML editor, into Django applications. It supports advanced editing features like drag-and-drop table cells and offers flexible image/file upload configurations, custom buttons, and admin integration, ideal for CMS and blog platforms.

description: weixin pay python 微信支付功能集，前期开发借鉴zwczou https://github.com/zwczou/weixin-python ，后期补充及完善微信支付新功能，处理因微信支付调用规则修改而无法使用的旧代码，升级到最新微信支付接口配套代码
summary_zh: 该仓库是一个已停止维护的微信支付 Python SDK，提供完整的微信支付功能封装，包括 JSAPI 支付下单、订单查询、退款、红包发放、企业付款及刷卡支付等接口。基于 zwczou/weixin-python 开发，后期适配微信支付接口规则变更，支持证书认证和回调通知，适用于需要集成微信支付功能的 Python 后端服务。
summary_en: This is a discontinued Python SDK for WeChat Pay, offering comprehensive API support including JSAPI payments, order queries, refunds, red packet distribution, enterprise transfers, and swipe-card payments. Built upon zwczou/weixin-python with updates to comply with WeChat Pay's evolving API standards, it supports certificate authentication and webhook notifications for secure payment processing in Python backends.

description: 开箱即用的微信公众平台API模拟服务器，帮助你开发与调试微信公众平台应用
summary_zh: Wecheat 是一个开箱即用的微信公众平台API模拟器，基于 Sinatra 框架开发，提供完整的仿真数据与消息交互功能，支持文本、图片、视频等多种消息类型及事件通知，适用于微信应用开发与调试。
summary_en: Wecheat is an out-of-the-box WeChat Official Account API simulator built on the Sinatra framework, offering comprehensive fake data and message interactions including text, images, videos, and events, ideal for developing and debugging WeChat applications.

description: A Django address model and field. Addresses may be specified by address components or by performing an automatic Google Maps lookup.
summary_zh: Django Address 是一个用于存储和管理邮政地址的 Django 模型库，支持通过 Google Maps API 自动解析地址或手动输入地址组件。它提供标准化的地址结构（国家、州、地区、街道），并包含一个便捷的 AddressField 字段类型，简化地址的创建、更新和查询操作，适用于需要精确地址管理的 Web 应用。
summary_en: Django Address is a Django library providing models and fields for storing and retrieving postal addresses. It supports automatic address resolution via Google Maps API or manual input of address components, offering a standardized structure (country, state, locality, street) and an AddressField for easy integration into Django models, ideal for applications requiring precise address handling.

summary_zh: 基于 Claude Sonnet 4.5 的多平台AI写作助手，提供从选题、创作到审校的全流程自动化工作流。通过个人素材库学习作者风格，采用三遍审校机制降低AI味至15-20%，集成标题优化、配图Prompt生成等功能，支持微信公众号、Twitter、小红书等多平台内容适配。
summary_en: A multi-platform AI writing agent built on Claude Sonnet 4.5, offering end-to-end automation from ideation to publication. Features style learning via personal material library, three-round editing to reduce AI flavor to 15-20%, and integrated title optimization with image prompt generation, supporting content adaptation across WeChat, Twitter, Xiaohongshu and other platforms.

description: Persistent, provider-neutral memory for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and MCP coding agents.
summary_zh: PAXM 是一款专为 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code 等）设计的持久化、跨厂商记忆系统。它通过本地 SQLite 存储项目决策、架构规范与上下文，实现不同会话和不同代理间的知识无缝流转，解决每次新会话需重复解释项目背景的问题，且支持灵活切换 Zep、Mem0 等外部记忆存储提供商。
summary_en: PAXM is a persistent, provider-neutral memory system designed for AI coding agents like Codex and Claude Code. It stores project decisions, conventions, and context locally via SQLite, enabling seamless knowledge transfer across different sessions and agents. It eliminates the need to re-explain project backgrounds and supports flexible switching between storage backends like Zep and Mem0.

description: WeSight Obsidian plugin for local agent runtimes.
summary_zh: WeSight Obsidian 插件将 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等本地 AI 代理集成至 Obsidian 笔记系统，提供侧边栏聊天、内联编辑、文件引用与斜杠命令等功能。支持互联网快照分享、飞书文档同步及微信公众号草稿发布，实现 AI 协作与多平台内容分发的无缝衔接。
summary_en: WeSight Obsidian plugin integrates local AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode directly into your Obsidian vault. Features include sidebar chat, inline editing, file mentions, and slash commands. It supports internet snapshot sharing, Feishu document sync, and WeChat Official Account draft publishing, enabling seamless AI collaboration and multi-platform content distribution.
