description: A Python binding for Hoedown.
summary_zh: Misaka 是一个已停止维护的 Python 绑定库，用于 Hoedown 的 Markdown 解析器。它提供高性能的 Markdown 转 HTML 功能，适用于需要轻量级、快速解析的场景。尽管项目不再更新，仍可作为历史参考或特定环境下的替代方案。
summary_en: Misaka is a discontinued Python binding for the Hoedown Markdown parser, offering fast and lightweight Markdown-to-HTML conversion. Though no longer maintained, it remains a historical reference or alternative for specific use cases where performance is critical.

description: 基于avalon的组件库
summary_zh: avalon.oniui 是去哪儿网前端团队基于 Avalon 1.4 开发的 UI 组件库，提供丰富的 UI 组件（如表格、弹窗、分页）和功能性组件（如拖拽、定位、快捷键），覆盖表单、交互、数据展示等场景，支持模块化调用与扩展。
summary_en: avalon.oniui is a UI component library developed by Qunar's frontend team, built on Avalon 1.4. It offers a comprehensive set of UI components (e.g., grids, dialogs, pagination) and utility modules (e.g., drag-and-drop, positioning, hotkeys), enabling modular integration for web applications with rich interactivity and data presentation.

description: Native AngularJS colorpicker directive. No dependency on jQuery or jQuery plugin is required.
summary_zh: 这是一个原生 AngularJS 颜色选择器指令，基于 bootstrap-colorpicker jQuery 库开发，无需依赖 jQuery。支持 Hex、RGB、RGBA 格式，可自定义位置、尺寸和事件，适用于 Bootstrap v3.x.x 项目，提供灵活的配置选项和丰富的交互事件。
summary_en: A native AngularJS color picker directive based on bootstrap-colorpicker jQuery library, with no jQuery dependency. Supports Hex, RGB, RGBA formats, customizable positioning, sizing, and events. Ideal for Bootstrap v3.x.x projects with flexible configuration and rich interaction events.

description: 设计模式的python实现
summary_zh: 该项目是设计模式在 Python3 中的完整实现，涵盖创建型、结构型与行为型三大类共23种经典模式，提供清晰代码示例与参考链接，适合学习设计模式与提升架构设计能力。
summary_en: This repository implements 23 classic design patterns in Python3, covering Creational, Structural, and Behavioral categories with clear examples and references, ideal for learning design patterns and improving software architecture skills.

description: (Deprecated) WeUI Components with love of vue.js
summary_zh: vue-weui 是一个已停止维护的 Vue 组件库，封装了 WeUI 0.4.0+ 的微信风格 UI 组件，完全解耦 CSS 样式，支持按需引入以优化包体积，适用于移动端 Web 应用开发。
summary_en: vue-weui is a deprecated Vue component library that encapsulates WeUI 0.4.0+ components for WeChat Web apps. It decouples CSS for full customization and supports selective imports to minimize bundle size.

description: 使用任何设备(浏览器)作为mac的副屏(随航) 将Android平板用作Mac的第二台显示器 还能在Win和Linux镜像屏幕
summary_zh: 咩Display 是一款跨平台屏幕镜像工具，支持将任意带浏览器的设备（如 Android 平板）作为 Mac 的副屏，实现类似 Apple 随航的功能。基于 ffmpeg 实时转码，支持 mjpg、vp8、h264、hevc 多种编码，延迟低至 100ms（mjpg 模式），适用于 Windows/Linux 屏幕镜像。内置自动旋转、全屏切换，支持通过 ADB 实现 Android 有线连接，适合多屏办公与移动场景。
summary_en: meDisplay is a cross-platform screen mirroring tool that turns any browser-equipped device (e.g., Android tablet) into a secondary display for Mac, mimicking Apple's Sidecar. Built with real-time ffmpeg transcoding, it supports mjpg, vp8, h264, and hevc encoding with ultra-low latency (as low as 100ms in mjpg mode). Also supports Windows/Linux X11 mirroring, auto-rotation, fullscreen toggle, and ADB-based Android wired connection for seamless multi-screen workflows.

description: Flux AI Image generator
summary_zh: Next Money 是一个基于 Next.js 14 的全栈 SaaS 启动模板，集成 Stripe 支付、Clerk 认证、Supabase 数据库、React Email 和 Shadcn/ui 等现代技术栈，专为快速构建商业化 SaaS 产品而设计，提供完整的用户管理、支付处理与邮件通知解决方案。
summary_en: Next Money is a full-stack SaaS starter template built with Next.js 14, integrating Stripe payments, Clerk authentication, Supabase database, React Email, and Shadcn/ui. It accelerates SaaS development with ready-to-use user management, payment processing, and email notification features.

description: Douban Search App Based on React Native
summary_zh: React-Dou 是基于 React Native 和豆瓣开放 API 开发的跨平台搜索应用，支持图书、音乐、电影三大类内容的搜索、列表展示与详情查看，具备完整的移动端交互体验，适用于快速构建豆瓣生态相关的数据检索工具。
summary_en: React-Dou is a cross-platform search app built with React Native and Douban Open API, supporting search, listing, and detail views for books, music, and movies. It delivers a complete mobile experience for accessing Douban's content ecosystem.

description: django-debug-toolbar in WebKit DevTools. Works fine with background Ajax requests and non-HTML responses.
summary_zh: Django Debug Panel 将 Django Debug Toolbar 集成至 WebKit DevTools，支持 AJAX 请求和 HTML 响应外的调试场景，专为单页应用和 AJAX 密集型项目设计，提供浏览器内实时调试能力。
summary_en: Django Debug Panel embeds the Django Debug Toolbar into WebKit DevTools, enabling debugging for AJAX requests and non-HTML responses. Ideal for single-page and AJAX-heavy applications, it offers in-browser real-time debugging.

description: Beans Music - iOS 26 液态玻璃风格第三方音乐播放器（仅供学习）
summary_zh: 基于 SwiftUI 构建的 iOS 第三方音乐播放器，采用 iOS 26 液态玻璃设计语言，聚合网易云音乐与 QQ 音乐双平台数据。支持歌词深度定制、动态封面取色、自由布局调整及一键备份，提供沉浸式本地化体验。
summary_en: A SwiftUI-based third-party iOS music player featuring iOS 26 Liquid Glass design. Aggregates NetEase Cloud Music and QQ Music with deep lyric customization, dynamic cover color extraction, free layout adjustment, and one-click backup for an immersive localized experience.

description: A full-stack, edge-native SaaS starter built with TanStack Start + Cloudflare Workers  | 基于 TanStack Start + Cloudflare Workers 构建的全栈、边缘原生 SaaS 起步模板
summary_zh: FlareStarter 是一款基于 TanStack Start 与 Cloudflare Workers 构建的全栈、边缘原生 SaaS 起步模板。它集成了鉴权、Stripe 计费、邮件、i18n 及运营后台等核心模块，利用 Cloudflare 全球边缘网络实现毫秒级响应与极低成本。项目强调端到端类型安全，提供开箱即用的生产级代码，支持 fork 即用，旨在帮助开发者快速部署具备商业闭环能力的现代 Web 应用。
summary_en: FlareStarter is a full-stack, edge-native SaaS starter built with TanStack Start and Cloudflare Workers. It integrates essential modules like authentication, Stripe billing, email, i18n, and an admin dashboard. Leveraging Cloudflare's global edge network, it delivers millisecond latency and near-zero operational costs. Featuring end-to-end type safety and production-ready code, it enables developers to quickly deploy modern web applications with complete commercial capabilities.

description: Django markdown support and wysiwig
summary_zh: Django-Markdown 是一个为 Django 框架提供 Markdown 富文本编辑支持的扩展应用，支持在模型字段、表单、管理后台及静态页面中集成所见即所得（WYSIWYG）编辑器，内置预览功能和可配置扩展，适用于内容管理系统（CMS）和文档类 Web 应用。
summary_en: Django-Markdown is a Django app enabling Markdown WYSIWYG editing in models, forms, admin interfaces, and flatpages. It integrates a rich text editor with preview functionality, configurable extensions, and admin overrides, ideal for CMS and documentation-driven web applications.

description: TTS-文本转语音/文本转语音前端，兼容OpenAI、EdgeTTS等接口
summary_zh: LibreTTS 是一款开源在线文本转语音工具，支持300+种语言和口音的声音，兼容OpenAI与EdgeTTS等主流TTS接口。提供实时试听、语速语调调节、长文本分段处理、历史记录及自定义API配置功能，支持Vercel和Cloudflare Pages一键部署，适合个人或企业快速搭建私有化TTS服务。
summary_en: LibreTTS is an open-source online text-to-speech tool supporting 300+ voices across multiple languages and accents. It integrates with OpenAI, EdgeTTS, and other compatible APIs, offering real-time preview, adjustable speech rate/pitch, long-text segmentation, history tracking, and custom API configuration. Deployable via Vercel or Cloudflare Pages for private TTS solutions.

description: A tiny macOS menu bar app that tracks your dev servers across projects.
summary_zh: Port Menu 是一款轻量级 macOS 菜单栏应用，专为开发者设计，用于自动追踪跨项目的本地开发服务器。它能实时扫描并展示 Git 仓库名、分支、端口及运行时长，支持一键打开浏览器、复制 URL 或终止进程，无需任何配置即可实现 localhost 服务的可视化管理。
summary_en: Port Menu is a lightweight macOS menu bar app designed for developers to automatically track local development servers across projects. It scans running processes to display Git repo names, branches, ports, and uptime. With zero configuration, it enables one-click access to open in browser, copy URLs, or kill processes directly from the menu bar.

description: A bilingual teaching guide to Claude Code, organized as a readable   learning path covering architecture, execution flow, tool systems,   and the real writing process behind the guide.
summary_zh: 本项目是一个双语教学指南，旨在从零开始系统学习 Claude Code 源码。通过结构化章节和实际执行流程分析，帮助开发者深入理解其架构设计、工具系统和核心模块。结合 VitePress 构建可导航网站，并提供完整的开发过程记录，适合 AI 编码代理架构研究与自学。
summary_en: This bilingual teaching guide provides a structured learning path to study the Claude Code source code from scratch. It covers architecture, execution flow, tool systems, and real writing processes, enabling readers to build a clear mental model of its design and implementation. Built with VitePress for web navigation and includes full development transcripts.

description: [Unmaintained] An easy to use material design based framework.
summary_zh: Material Framework 是一个轻量级、纯 CSS 实现的 Material Design 前端框架，提供完整的组件样式与响应式布局支持，适用于快速构建现代化网页应用，依赖 Google Material Design 图标与自定义配色方案。
summary_en: Material Framework is a lightweight, CSS-only implementation of Material Design, offering complete component styling and responsive layouts for rapid development of modern web applications, leveraging Google's Material Design Icons and custom color schemes.

description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到企业微信，无须VPN，速度快
summary_zh: 本项目实现零代码一键部署ChatGPT至企业微信，无需翻墙，支持手机端与电脑端使用。基于OpenAI API构建，提供智能问答、客服自动化等能力，适用于企业内部沟通、客户服务及营销场景，大幅降低沟通成本并提升效率。
summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into WeCom (WeChat Enterprise), with no need for VPN. It integrates OpenAI's ChatGPT API to deliver intelligent Q&A and automated customer service, enhancing internal communication and business efficiency across mobile and desktop platforms.

description: Urban governance - Where is the restroom?
summary_zh: 该应用为解决城市如厕难问题，提供附近2公里内卫生间实时搜索、导航及基础信息查询，集成地图、天气、文章推荐等功能，采用高德地图、七牛云存储、微信公众号及阿里云部署，展示如何快速构建实用型移动应用。
summary_en: This app addresses urban restroom accessibility by enabling users to search nearby toilets within 2km, view basic info, and get navigation. It integrates map services, weather, articles, and uses platforms like Amap, Qiniu Cloud, WeChat, and Aliyun for rapid deployment of a practical mobile solution.

summary_zh: Auto.js 是一个基于无障碍服务的 Android 平台 JavaScript IDE，支持自动化操作、界面录制、控件选择器及脚本打包。本修改版修复了内存泄漏、优化调度机制、集成 PaddleOCR、ONNXRuntime 和 ncnn 推理引擎，增强模型本地推理能力，适用于蚂蚁森林等脚本场景，同时支持防检测变包名功能。
summary_en: Auto.js is an Android-based JavaScript IDE leveraging accessibility services for automation, featuring UI recording, powerful selector APIs, and APK packaging. This modified version fixes memory leaks, integrates PaddleOCR, ONNXRuntime, and ncnn for local model inference, supports anti-detection via fake package names, and is optimized for stable script execution in apps like Ant Forest.

description: 月饼TV
summary_zh: MoonCakeTV 是一个基于 Next.js 15 和 TypeScript 的影视聚合搜索服务，支持多源聚合搜索（苹果CMS v10协议）、HLS.js 在线播放、收藏与历史记录、响应式深色主题及可选密码保护，数据持久化存储无需数据库，支持一键 Docker 部署与 HTTPS 自动配置。
summary_en: MoonCakeTV is a simple yet powerful video aggregation and search service built with Next.js 15 and TypeScript. It supports multi-source search via AppleCMS v10 protocol, HLS.js streaming, favorites, watch history, responsive dark mode, optional password protection, and stores data without a database. Features one-click Docker deployment with automatic HTTPS via Caddy.

description: Browser-Use Desktop app, control your local Chrome browser with AI agents!
summary_zh: Browser-Use Desktop 是一款基于 Electron 和 Gradio 的桌面应用，通过 AI 智能体控制本地 Chrome 浏览器，实现网页自动化操作。支持多模态 LLM（如 OpenAI、Google、Anthropic 等）和自定义浏览器配置，无需重新登录网站，支持高清屏幕录制，适用于网页抓取、自动化测试等场景。
summary_en: Browser-Use Desktop is an Electron-based desktop app that enables AI agents to control your local Chrome browser via Gradio UI. It supports multiple LLMs (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, etc.), custom browser profiles, and high-definition screen recording, eliminating re-authentication issues and ideal for web automation and scraping tasks.

description: 让 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI Agent 成为你的跨平台电脑维修助手：64 个按需加载的 Playbook，覆盖诊断、清理、性能、网络与安全维护——C 盘爆满、电脑卡顿、流氓软件、应用迁移、数据恢复都能直接问；先取证、再计划，确认后修改。
summary_zh: 这是一个面向AI Agent的跨平台电脑维修Skill，提供64个按需加载的Playbook，覆盖Windows/macOS/Linux的诊断、清理、性能优化、网络与安全维护。采用
summary_en: A cross-platform computer repair Skill for AI Agents, featuring 64 on-demand Playbooks covering Windows, macOS, and Linux diagnostics, cleanup, performance optimization, and security maintenance. Follows an evidence-first, plan-confirm-modify workflow for natural language-based PC troubleshooting.

description: Hexo七牛同步插件
summary_zh: Hexo七牛同步插件是一个专为Hexo博客设计的自动化工具，支持将本地静态资源（图片、JS、CSS）自动同步至七牛云存储，无需手动上传。通过配置实现一键部署，支持图片处理、缩略图生成及离线预览，提升博客资源管理效率。
summary_en: Hexo Qiniu Sync is an automation plugin for Hexo blogs that synchronizes local static assets (images, JS, CSS) to Qiniu Cloud Storage. It enables one-click deployment with image processing, thumbnail generation, and offline preview support, streamlining resource management.

summary_zh: bestK/tv 是一个基于 Next.js 的现代化电视直播应用，支持多源直播流聚合、频道分类与搜索功能，提供响应式界面与 EdgeOne Pages 一键部署，适用于构建个人或社区级 IPTV 平台。
summary_en: bestK/tv is a modern TV streaming app built with Next.js, featuring multi-source live stream aggregation, channel categorization, and search functionality. It offers a responsive interface and one-click deployment via EdgeOne Pages, ideal for building personal or community IPTV platforms.

description: 快速、明确、极简
summary_zh: 妹Blog v2 是一款基于 PHP+MySQL 的极简静态博客系统，采用 iTorr.JS 和 Q.JS 框架实现前后端分离，支持 Markdown 写作、代码高亮、多用户、分类管理、原生评论及多说集成，并针对 SAE/Hostker 云环境优化部署，提供缓存、模板与静态化加速，适合追求快速搭建与内容优先的个人博客。
summary_en: Imouto v2 is a minimalist static blog system built with PHP+MySQL, leveraging iTorr.JS and Q.JS for frontend-backend separation. It supports Markdown writing, syntax highlighting, multi-user management, categories, native and Duoshuo comments, and is optimized for cloud platforms like SAE and Hostker. Features include caching, templating, static generation, and AJAX search for fast content delivery.

description: A ShadowsocksR client for Android4.0+.Compatible Shadowsocks protocol and support some ShadowsocksR function.
summary_zh: ShadowsocksR Droid 是一款专为 Android 4.0+ 设备设计的 ShadowsocksR 客户端，兼容 Shadowsocks 协议并支持部分 ShadowsocksR 功能，采用 Kotlin 和 Java 开发，提供跨平台网络代理解决方案。
summary_en: ShadowsocksR Droid is an Android 4.0+ client for ShadowsocksR, compatible with Shadowsocks protocol and supporting some ShadowsocksR features. Built with Kotlin and Java, it offers a cross-platform network proxy solution for enhanced privacy and access.

description: 为访谈视频添加综艺风格视觉特效的 Claude Skill。AI 分析字幕内容生成建议，用户审批后自动渲染。A Claude Skill for adding variety-show-style visual effects to interview videos. The AI analyzes subtitle content to generate suggestions
summary_zh: Video-Wrapper-Skills 是一个 Claude Skill，专为访谈/播客视频添加综艺风格视觉特效。通过 AI 分析字幕内容自动生成效果建议（如关键短语、下三分之一栏、术语卡等），支持用户审批后一键渲染输出。提供 4 种主题风格（Notion、赛博朋克、Apple、极光）和双渲染引擎（浏览器/PIL），实现高质量专业级视频包装。
summary_en: Video-Wrapper-Skills is a Claude Skill that adds variety-show-style visual effects to interview/podcast videos. It uses AI to analyze subtitles, auto-generate effect suggestions (e.g., key phrases, lower thirds, term cards), and enables one-click professional rendering after user approval. Features 4 themes (Notion, Cyberpunk, Apple, Aurora) and dual rendering engines (browser/PIL) for high-quality output.

description: AI-enhanced reading tool for immersive language learning using the n+1 method. Learn languages by staying in the target language ecosystem, with a flow-state focused interface.
summary_zh: ReadBridge 是一款基于 AI 的沉浸式语言学习工具，采用 n+1 可理解输入法，帮助学习者在目标语言生态中通过阅读进行自然习得。其核心优势在于减少母语翻译依赖，提供句子级交互阅读、AI 目标语言解释、自定义难度设置及进度追踪，支持网页与跨平台桌面端（Tauri）。
summary_en: ReadBridge is an AI-enhanced reading tool for immersive language learning using the n+1 comprehensible input method. It enables learners to acquire languages naturally by reading within the target language ecosystem, featuring sentence-by-sentence interaction, AI-powered target-language explanations, customizable difficulty prompts, and progress tracking across web and desktop (via Tauri).

description: Django project template layout
summary_zh: django-layout 是一个基于最佳实践的 Django 项目模板，提供开箱即用的现代化开发体验。集成 uv 依赖管理、ruff/prettier 代码规范、goodconf 环境配置、结构化日志、TailwindCSS 样式方案、pytest 测试框架及 mypy 类型检查，支持 Docker 部署，显著提升 Django 项目初始化效率与生产环境健壮性。
summary_en: django-layout is a modern Django project template offering sane defaults based on best practices. It integrates uv for dependency management, ruff/prettier for linting, goodconf for config, structured logging, TailwindCSS, pytest with coverage, mypy for type safety, and production-ready settings via Docker, streamlining Django project setup and deployment.

description: 一个用于重新生成 Cursor 设备 ID 和设置 Access Token 的 Cursor 扩展
summary_zh: Fake Cursor 是一款专为 Cursor 编辑器设计的 VS Code 扩展，支持重新生成设备 ID、修补机器码获取逻辑及设置 Access Token，实现多账号共用同一设备。支持 0.45.x~0.46.x 版本，具备使用情况监控、自动备份配置等功能，适用于 Windows/macOS/Linux 系统。
summary_en: Fake Cursor is a VS Code extension for Cursor editor that enables device ID regeneration, machine code patching, and Access Token configuration to allow multiple accounts on one device. Supports Cursor 0.45.x-0.46.x, featuring usage monitoring, config backup, and cross-platform support (Windows/macOS/Linux).

description: a simple but powerful tool for validating form fields.  support bootstrap and your own styles.
summary_zh: SMValidator 是一个轻量、无依赖的前端表单验证工具，支持通过 HTML 属性或 JavaScript 配置验证规则，兼容 Bootstrap 和 Semantic UI 样式，支持正则表达式和自定义函数验证，兼容 IE8+，提供灵活的错误提示与样式定制能力。
summary_en: SMValidator is a lightweight, dependency-free form validation tool that supports rule configuration via HTML attributes or JavaScript. It integrates with Bootstrap and Semantic UI, supports RegExp and custom function validation, and is compatible with IE8+, offering flexible error messaging and styling options.

description: Nothing, just a simple ssh tool.
summary_zh: mmh 是一个轻量级 SSH 管理工具，提供便捷的远程主机连接与命令执行功能，适合运维场景下的快速访问。支持配置管理与批量操作，界面简洁，适合日常使用。
summary_en: mmh is a lightweight SSH management tool designed for quick remote host access and command execution. It supports configuration management and batch operations, featuring a simple interface ideal for routine system administration tasks.

description: Any Agent × Any Provider × Anywhere. Connect Cursor, Claude Code, OpenCode, or Codex to Slack, Telegram, Discord, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, WeChat — with any LLM provider.
summary_zh: GolemBot 是一个革命性工具，允许将 Cursor、Claude Code、OpenCode 或 Codex 等任意 AI 编程代理与任何 LLM 提供商集成，并部署到即时通讯（IM）、HTTP 接口或自有产品中。它通过单一配置实现跨平台运行，无需修改代码或依赖特定 AI 框架，支持 13,000+ OpenClaw 社区技能，极大扩展了 AI 代理的应用场景。
summary_en: GolemBot enables running any coding agent (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) with any LLM provider and deploying it to IM platforms, HTTP endpoints, or custom products. It requires zero code changes, supports 13,000+ OpenClaw community skills, and integrates seamlessly via configuration—no AI framework dependency.

description: 🐵 A Streamlit image-to-vector tool powered by the Vecto engine — upload PNG/JPG and get clean, editable SVG with live side-by-side preview. 基于 Vecto 引擎的图片转 SVG 工具:上传位图自动矢量化,分割视图对比,导出 SVG/PNG。
summary_zh: 悟空图片转SVG工具是一款基于Streamlit的开源位图矢量化Web应用。底层采用Vecto引擎，支持上传PNG/JPG等格式自动转为可编辑SVG。提供原图/矢量/分割视图三合一对比、调色板与风格参数实时调节，中英双语，可云端部署或本地运行。
summary_en: Goku Image to SVG Tool is an open-source web app built on Streamlit for bitmap vectorization. Powered by the Vecto engine, it converts PNG/JPG images into clean, editable SVG files with real-time parameter tuning and a three-view slider comparison. Features bilingual UI, cloud deployment support, and zero command-line required.

description: Local-first Windows WeChat memory archive with traceable PDF, Markdown, and JSON exports｜本地优先的微信个人记忆库
summary_zh: 微信 AI 记忆库是一款本地优先的桌面工具，直接从 Windows 微信 4.x 读取聊天记录，支持按会话、日期和关键词筛选，可导出 PDF、Markdown 与结构化 JSON。全程仅操作临时数据库副本，图片恢复、语音转写（faster-whisper）均在本机完成，无任何数据上传。
summary_en: WeChat AI Memory is a local-first desktop tool that directly reads Windows WeChat 4.x chat data, supports filtering by conversation, date, and keywords, and exports to PDF, Markdown, and structured JSON. All operations—including image recovery and voice transcription via faster-whisper—stay on-device with zero data uploads.

description: ChatGPT&AIGC资料汇总，包含前沿资讯、应用案例、技术教程、开源项目和商业变现等
summary_zh: 本项目为ChatGPT与AIGC领域的综合性资料库，涵盖前沿资讯、应用案例、技术教程、开源项目与商业变现路径，提供注册升级指南及深度行业研报，助力开发者与从业者快速掌握AI技术生态与落地场景。
summary_en: This repository aggregates comprehensive resources on ChatGPT and AIGC, including cutting-edge news, application cases, technical tutorials, open-source projects, and monetization strategies. It provides registration/guide tutorials and in-depth industry reports to help developers and professionals quickly master the AI technology ecosystem and real-world applications.

description: WeSpy 是一个用于获取wx公众号文章并转换为 Markdown 格式的 Python 工具
summary_zh: WeSpy 是一个专为微信公众号设计的 Python 工具，可抓取文章并转换为 Markdown 格式，支持防盗链处理、专辑批量下载及多格式输出（Markdown/HTML/JSON），提供命令行和 Python API 两种使用方式。
summary_en: WeSpy is a Python tool designed for scraping WeChat Official Account articles and converting them to Markdown format. It supports anti-hotlinking image handling, batch album downloads, and multi-format output (Markdown/HTML/JSON), with both CLI and Python API interfaces.

summary_zh: 这是一个现代化的个人作品集网站，基于 Next.js、Tailwind CSS 和 TypeScript 构建，采用严格模式开发。支持 Markdown/MDX 内容发布，集成 RSS 订阅、站点地图、评论系统和阅读量统计，结合 Motion 实现流畅的滚动动画与视图过渡，性能优化出色，Lighthouse 评分接近完美，适用于开发者展示个人项目与技能。
summary_en: A modern personal portfolio website built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript (strict mode). Features Markdown/MDX content publishing, RSS feed, sitemap, comment system, reading time, and view counter. Includes scroll-based animations via Motion for smooth UX, with near-perfect Lighthouse scores in performance, accessibility, and SEO. Ideal for developers to showcase projects and skills.

description: AI 图像编辑 Web 应用，使用 **FLUX.1 Kontext [pro]** 前沿模型提供强大的图像编辑功能，支持Stripe支付，注册登录，积分系统等，代码100%开源。
summary_zh: 基于 Next.js 15 构建的现代化 AI 图像编辑 Web 应用，集成前沿 FLUX.1 Kontext Pro 模型，支持智能编辑、背景移除、多格式输出及 Stripe 支付，提供完整的用户认证、积分系统和国际化支持，代码完全开源。
summary_en: A modern AI image editing web app built with Next.js 15, powered by the cutting-edge FLUX.1 Kontext Pro model. Features intelligent editing, background removal, multi-format support, Stripe payments, user authentication, points system, and full internationalization, with 100% open-source code.

description: 创业者的游戏： 中关村启示录
summary_zh: 《创业游戏：中关村启示录》是一款基于Ruby CLI的模拟经营类游戏，玩家通过雇佣程序员、管理资金与项目进度，体验创业公司从0到1的成长过程。支持自定义程序员角色、随机事件与动态交互，社区可提交Pull Request参与开发，具有高度开放性与趣味性。
summary_en: Startup-Game is a CLI-based simulation game written in Ruby, simulating the journey of building a startup from scratch. Players hire coders, manage funds and project progress, and experience the challenges of entrepreneurship. It supports custom coders via Pull Requests, random events, and dynamic gameplay, fostering community-driven development.

description: 影子作家 · 为角色建立可复用的写作与语言特征模型，让 AI 稳定地「像某个人」说话。Python / Agent Skill 双形态。
summary_zh: 本项目'ghostwriter'（影子作家）提供多来源语言特征JSON数据集，涵盖微博、文学影视角色及历史人物，支持非商业用途研究。采用CC BY-NC-ND 4.0许可，结合长上下文大模型可显著提升文本生成风格拟合度，适用于AI角色模拟与语言分析。
summary_en: The 'ghostwriter' project provides structured linguistic feature datasets in JSON format, covering sources like Weibo, literary characters, and historical figures. Licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for non-commercial use, it enhances AI text generation when combined with large language models featuring long context capabilities, ideal for character simulation and stylistic analysis.

description: A native macOS workspace terminal organized around Projects and Worktrees, powered by tmux and libghostty
summary_zh: Mori 是一款专为 macOS 设计的原生终端工作空间管理工具，围绕 Git 项目的 Worktree 构建，通过 tmux 实现持久化会话管理，并集成 libghostty 提供 GPU 加速的终端渲染。支持本地与远程仓库、项目级导航、独立分支会话及 SwiftUI 侧边栏交互，提供类 IDE 的高效开发体验。
summary_en: Mori is a native macOS terminal workspace manager centered on Projects and Git Worktrees, powered by tmux for persistent sessions and libghostty for GPU-accelerated terminal rendering. It enables project-first navigation, local/remote repo support, independent branch sessions, and a SwiftUI sidebar interface, delivering an IDE-like development workflow.

description: Think of it as flatpages for small bits of reusable content you might want to insert into your templates and manage from the admin interface.
summary_zh: django-chunks 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，提供类似 flatpages 的可复用内容块管理功能。通过简单的模型和模板标签，开发者可在后台管理界面创建命名内容块（如 'home_page_left'），并在模板中动态插入，支持富文本编辑，适用于需要多区域内容管理的场景。
summary_en: django-chunks is a lightweight Django app that enables reusable content blocks similar to flatpages. It provides a model and template tag to manage named content chunks via the admin interface, allowing dynamic insertion into templates with rich text editing support—ideal for sites requiring multiple editable content areas.

description: 📚《Flutter 入门指南》
summary_zh: 《Flutter 入门指南》是一本系统介绍 Flutter 跨平台开发框架的电子书，涵盖 Dart 语言、Skia 图形引擎及 Material Design UI 开发。适合有 JavaScript 基础的前端开发者快速掌握移动端、Web 和桌面端应用开发技能。
summary_en: 《Flutter 入门指南》is a comprehensive guide to Flutter, covering Dart language, Skia graphics engine, and Material Design UI development for cross-platform apps (mobile, web, desktop). Ideal for frontend developers with JavaScript background.

description: ByeType 是一个 Markdown 驱动的 AI 语音输入工具，用多模态大模型直接处理原始音频（使用自己的APIKEY），编辑 Markdown 文件即可自定义专有词汇、转录规则和格式化策略，人名、术语、口水词、数字格式一次转录到位，减少二次修改。支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS。
summary_zh: ByeType 是一款基于 Markdown 提示词的 AI 语音输入工具，支持多模态大模型直接处理原始音频，实现专有词汇、术语、人名及数字格式的一次性精准转录，内置 AI 图像文字提取功能，可智能修复断行与还原代码结构，支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS 平台，用户自备 API Key，数据直连服务商，安全高效。
summary_en: ByeType is an AI-powered voice input tool driven by Markdown prompts, using multimodal LLMs to process raw audio directly for accurate transcription of names, jargon, and formatting in one pass. It includes AI-based text extraction from images, intelligently restoring broken lines and code structure. Supports macOS, Windows, and iOS with user-provided API keys for secure, direct cloud processing.

description: 微信客户端模拟器，方便在本地进行微信公众平台API的开发和调试
summary_zh: 微信客户端模拟器，基于tkinter开发，提供本地微信公众平台API调试环境。支持模拟关注/取消关注、自定义菜单点击等交互场景，通过XML数据模拟微信消息推送，简化开发测试流程。
summary_en: WeChat client simulator built with tkinter for local debugging of WeChat Official Platform APIs. It simulates user interactions like following/unfollowing accounts and clicking custom menu items via XML data, enabling streamlined development and testing workflows.

description: 使用Claude Code，Cursor, codex, gemini 写微信公众号文章工具。
summary_zh: Article Writer 是一款专为微信公众号/自媒体设计的 AI 智能写作系统，集成 Claude、Cursor、Gemini 等 13 个 AI 助手平台。通过九步写作流程与四大多模式创作体系（教练/快速/混合/框架约束），结合素材库、文档爬虫与三遍审校机制，帮助用户产出高真实性、低 AI 检测率的内容，核心目标是保留人类真实表达与个性化细节。
summary_en: Article Writer is an AI-powered intelligent writing system designed for WeChat Official Accounts and self-media content. Integrated with 13 AI assistants including Claude, Cursor, and Gemini, it features a 9-step writing workflow and four multi-mode creation systems (Coach/Quick/Hybrid/Outline-constrained). With material libraries, document crawlers, and triple-review mechanisms, it helps users produce highly authentic content with low AI detection rates, preserving human voice and personal details.

description: A django app that provides Markdown-related template tags using the python-markdown2 library.
summary_zh: django-markdown-deux 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，基于 python-markdown2 库提供 Markdown 模板标签支持。它允许在 Django 模板中通过 `markdown` 过滤器或块标签渲染 Markdown 内容，并支持自定义样式配置，适用于需要统一 Markdown 渲染选项的场景。
summary_en: django-markdown-deux is a lightweight Django app that provides Markdown template tags using the python-markdown2 library. It enables rendering Markdown in Django templates via the `markdown` filter or block tag, with support for customizable styles via configuration, ideal for consistent Markdown processing across templates.

description: An efficient API documentation management tool that fully adheres to the OpenAPI specification and incorporates advanced LLM technology. This tool can automate the generation of API documentation, data models, and test cases, greatly enhancing development efficiency and documentation quality.
summary_zh: ApiCat 是一款高效 API 文档管理工具，完全遵循 OpenAPI 规范，集成先进 LLM 技术，可自动化生成 API 文档、数据模型和测试用例，显著提升开发效率与文档质量，支持本地部署与云端服务。
summary_en: ApiCat is an efficient API documentation management tool fully compliant with the OpenAPI specification. It leverages advanced LLM technology to automate API documentation, data model, and test case generation, significantly enhancing development efficiency and documentation quality. Supports local deployment and cloud services.

description: Assistant for get HTTP ONLY Cookies.
summary_zh: GetCookies 是一款 Chrome 扩展插件，专为突破 HTTP ONLY 限制而设计，可安全获取指定域下的 Cookie 数据。通过自定义 DOM 属性触发 Cookie 提取，支持跨域、指定名称与域名，并通过 postMessage 机制实现安全的跨页面通信，适用于自动化登录与数据抓取场景。
summary_en: GetCookies is a Chrome extension that bypasses HTTP ONLY restrictions to securely extract cookies from specified domains. It triggers cookie retrieval via custom DOM attributes, supports cross-domain access, allows naming and domain filtering, and uses postMessage for safe cross-page communication, ideal for automation and login workflows.

summary_zh: Atlas 是专为 OpenClaw 生态设计的专业 AI 赏金猎人技能，支持自动发现 GitHub、Upwork 等平台的高回报任务，通过智能 ROI 矩阵评估收益与成本，并生成高质量代码提交。具备身份管理、止损保护及自动化交付能力，助力智能体高效完成付费任务。
summary_en: Atlas is a professional AI bounty hunter skill for the OpenClaw ecosystem, autonomously discovering high-value tasks on GitHub, Upwork, and bug bounty platforms. It uses a smart ROI matrix to evaluate profitability, manages identity as a senior developer, and delivers high-quality pull requests with test evidence, featuring built-in stop-loss protection.

description: 一个简单的网络分析跟踪器和仪表板，在 Cloudflare Pages 上即可快速部署的网站分析仪表板,无成本稳定运行
summary_zh: Han-Analytics 是一个基于 Cloudflare Pages 的无服务器网站分析工具，提供轻量级网络跟踪与可视化仪表板功能，支持零成本部署、高并发访问（每日10万次免费统计），具备密码保护和网站白名单等安全特性，适用于个人或企业快速集成网站数据分析。
summary_en: Han-Analytics is a serverless web analytics tool built on Cloudflare Pages, offering lightweight tracking and dashboard visualization with zero-cost deployment, high-concurrency support (up to 100k daily free stats), password protection, and website whitelisting for secure data collection and analysis.

description: Pure-Python PDF Library; this repository is no longer maintained, please see https://github.com/knowah/PyPDF2/ insead.
summary_zh: pyPdf 是一个纯 Python 编写的 PDF 处理库，支持 PDF 文档的读取、写入、页面旋转、水印合并和裁剪等操作，适用于文档自动化处理场景。尽管项目已停止维护，其核心功能仍可用于基础 PDF 操作。
summary_en: pyPdf is a pure-Python library for reading, writing, and manipulating PDF files, supporting operations like page rotation, watermarking, and cropping. Though unmaintained, it remains useful for basic PDF automation tasks.

description: Cloudflare Worker; Claude Code; Proxy; Easy to deploy; Claude Code Router; claude-code-router; ccr
summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Worker 的 Claude Code 代理工具，支持将 Gemini 和 OpenAI 等第三方大模型 API 转换为 Claude 格式，实现零配置快速部署。核心特性包括流式响应、工具调用支持，并可通过 One-Balance 实现低成本 Claude Code 使用。
summary_en: This project is a Cloudflare Worker-based proxy that converts third-party LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI) into Claude-compatible format, enabling zero-config deployment. It supports streaming/non-streaming responses, tool calls, and integrates with One-Balance for cost-effective Claude Code usage.

description: Generates Unique (& Unicode) slugs in Django Edit Add topics
summary_zh: Django Uuslug 是一个专为 Django 框架设计的 slug 生成工具，核心功能是确保生成的 URL 标识符既支持 Unicode 字符又具备唯一性。它通过智能截断、分隔符控制和停用词过滤，适用于多语言内容管理系统、博客平台和电商网站等需要友好 URL 的场景。
summary_en: Django Uuslug is a Django-specific slug generator that guarantees both Unicode support and uniqueness for URLs. It intelligently truncates, handles separators, and filters stopwords, making it ideal for multilingual CMS, blogs, and e-commerce sites requiring clean, readable URLs.

description: A declarative, SwiftUI-like framework for building Terminal User Interfaces in Swift.
summary_zh: TUIkit 是一个 SwiftUI 风格的终端用户界面框架，提供纯 Swift 实现的声明式 TUI 开发体验。支持状态管理、布局容器、交互组件和完整样式系统，无需 ncurses 或 C 依赖，适用于 macOS 和 Linux 平台。
summary_en: TUIkit is a SwiftUI-like framework for building Terminal User Interfaces in pure Swift, offering declarative syntax with state management, layout containers, interactive components, and full styling support without ncurses or C dependencies.

description: ClashFX — macOS proxy tool with Enhanced Mode (TUN)
summary_zh: ClashFX 是一款基于 mihomo 核心的 macOS 代理工具，支持 TUN 模式实现全局流量捕获，提供规则路由、多协议代理（VMess/VLESS/Trojan 等）、DNS 安全及 Apple Silicon 原生支持，适用于高级网络代理与隐私保护场景。
summary_en: ClashFX is a macOS proxy client powered by the mihomo core, featuring TUN-based Enhanced Mode for system-wide traffic capture, rule-based routing, support for multiple protocols (VMess/VLESS/Trojan/Shadowsocks/Hysteria2), secure DNS with Fake-IP, and native Apple Silicon compatibility.

summary_zh: EdgeMirror 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers 和 Vercel Functions 构建的 CDN 式边缘镜像网关。它通过单一域名路径路由，为 PyPI、PyTorch、Hugging Face、GitHub、Docker 及 Linux 镜像等主流开发者资源提供统一的加速代理，有效解决网络访问受限或速度慢的问题。
summary_en: EdgeMirror is a CDN-style edge mirror gateway built on Cloudflare Workers and Vercel Functions. It provides unified acceleration for major developer resources like PyPI, PyTorch, Hugging Face, GitHub, Docker, and Linux mirrors via single-domain path routing, solving network access and speed issues.

description: WordPress look and feel for Django administration panel
summary_zh: Django WP Admin 为 Django 管理后台提供 WordPress 风格界面，支持响应式设计、可折叠侧边栏、Font Awesome 图标及9种配色主题，兼容 Python3 与多 Django 版本，显著提升后台操作体验。
summary_en: Django WP Admin delivers a WordPress-inspired interface for Django's admin panel, featuring responsive design, collapsible menus, Font Awesome icons, 9 color themes, and Python3 compatibility across multiple Django versions for enhanced usability.

description: Parallel Programming with Python简体中文版
summary_zh: 《Parallel Programming with Python》简体中文版是一本系统讲解Python并行编程的书籍，涵盖并发、并行与分布式编程的核心概念、算法设计与实践工具。内容从GIL限制、通信机制到分治、数据分解、管道任务等并行模式，结合斐波那契计算与网页爬取等实例，帮助开发者识别可并行问题并高效实现多核/分布式加速。
summary_en: The Chinese translation of 'Parallel Programming with Python' is a comprehensive guide covering core concepts, algorithms, and tools for concurrent, parallel, and distributed programming in Python. It addresses GIL limitations, communication patterns, and parallel design techniques like divide-and-conquer and data decomposition, with practical examples such as Fibonacci computation and web scraping to demonstrate parallelizable problems and multi-core/distributed acceleration.

description: Deepin Terminal written by vala
summary_zh: Deepin Terminal 是深度操作系统默认终端模拟器，基于 Vala 语言开发，支持多标签页、分屏、快捷键操作及主题定制，提供高效命令行工作环境。
summary_en: Deepin Terminal is the default terminal emulator for Deepin OS, built with Vala, offering multi-tab, split-screen, customizable shortcuts, and theming for efficient command-line workflows.

description: Agent Skills for theming AI desktop apps: reference image → reversible Codex/WorkBuddy skin → verify, repair, publish. | 给 AI 桌面应用换肤的 Agent Skills：参考图 → 可逆皮肤 → 验证、修复、发布。
summary_zh: CodeDrobe Skills 是一个开源的 AI 桌面应用主题生成与管理系统，专为 OpenAI Codex 和腾讯 WorkBuddy 等基于 Chromium/Electron 的 AI 桌面端提供可逆的主题定制方案。它通过 AI 技能（Skill）驱动，支持 DOM 快照分析、语义化主题生成与跨平台应用，极大简化了 AI 桌面环境的个性化与视觉管理。
summary_en: CodeDrobe Skills is an open-source AI-driven theming engine for Chromium/Electron-based AI desktop apps like OpenAI Codex and Tencent WorkBuddy. It provides a reversible theme customization workflow utilizing DOM snapshot analysis and semantic generation. Managed via installable Agent Skills, it simplifies visual personalization and cross-platform theme deployment for AI desktop environments.

description: Another opensource blog system  based on Django1.6
summary_zh: 基于Django1.6开发的开源个人博客系统，支持文章、分类管理，支持RST/HTML/Markdown格式写作，集成多说评论、RSS和微信自动回复，采用xadmin后台，提供Ansible一键部署方案，适合学习Django开发实践与博客搭建。
summary_en: An open-source personal blog system built with Django 1.6, featuring article management, support for RST/HTML/Markdown content, integration with Duoshuo comments, RSS, and WeChat auto-reply. Includes xadmin backend and Ansible deployment script for easy setup and learning.

summary_zh: 刘聪 NLP 的 Agent Skill 仓库，提供可复用的提示工程模块。核心包含三渲二动画短片提示词生成（覆盖剧情、角色、Midjourney 故事板与 Seedance 视频提示）与微信公众号标题策略分析（多风格生成、评分及风险检查）。通过软链接安装实现热更新，专为 AI Agent 平台设计，大幅提升内容创作自动化效率。
summary_en: A repository of reusable Agent Skills for NLP tasks by Liucong. It features a 3D-to-2D animation prompt generator (covering storyboards for Midjourney and Seedance) and a WeChat public account title strategist (multi-style generation, scoring, and risk checking). Designed for AI Agent platforms with hot-reload support via symlinks, it significantly boosts content creation automation.

description: Android Client for Carbon Forum with Material Design.
summary_zh: Android-Carbon-Forum 是一个基于 Material Design 的 Carbon Forum 论坛 Android 客户端，提供流畅的移动端浏览体验，支持主题查看、发帖、登录、通知推送等功能，采用模块化架构便于二次开发和定制部署。
summary_en: Android-Carbon-Forum is an Android client for Carbon Forum built with Material Design, offering seamless mobile browsing, topic viewing, posting, login, and push notifications. It features a modular architecture for easy customization and deployment.

description: A simple theme for Hexo
summary_zh: hexo-theme-Daily 是一个简洁优雅的 Hexo 主题，专为版本 4.x 设计，提供现代化的博客展示体验。支持 SASS 渲染，兼容 IE9+，内置完整文档和演示站点，适合个人或团队快速搭建美观静态博客。
summary_en: hexo-theme-Daily is a clean and modern theme for Hexo (v4.x), featuring simple design and full compatibility with IE9+. It supports SASS rendering, includes demo sites, documentation, and is ideal for building elegant static blogs quickly.

description: A simple theme for Hexo
summary_zh: hexo-theme-Daily 是一个简洁优雅的 Hexo 主题，专为版本 4.x 设计，提供现代化的博客展示体验。支持 SASS 渲染、响应式布局，兼容 IE9+，并参考了 WordPress Daily 主题风格，适合个人技术博客或内容站点使用。
summary_en: hexo-theme-Daily is a clean and modern theme for Hexo (v4.x), featuring responsive design, SASS support, and compatibility with IE9+. Inspired by the WordPress Daily theme, it offers a professional layout ideal for personal blogs or content sites.

description: SnackBase is a Python/FastAPI-based BaaS providing auto-generated REST APIs, multi-tenancy, row-level security, authentication, enterprise OAuth/SAML, and comprehensive admin UI.
summary_zh: SnackBase 是一个基于 Python/FastAPI 的开源后端即服务（BaaS）平台，旨在作为 Supabase 的自托管替代方案。它提供自动生成的 REST API、多租户架构、行级安全（RLS）、企业级认证（OAuth/SAML）以及功能完备的 React 管理后台，支持 SQLite 与 PostgreSQL，助力开发者快速构建安全的企业级应用。
summary_en: SnackBase is an open-source, Python/FastAPI-based Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform designed as a self-hosted Supabase alternative. It offers auto-generated REST APIs, multi-tenancy, row-level security (RLS), enterprise authentication (OAuth/SAML), and a comprehensive React admin UI, supporting both SQLite and PostgreSQL for rapid enterprise application development.

description: 孙宇晨.skill — 注意力收割操作系统 | Justin Sun Perspective Skill for Claude Code | 由女娲.skill蒸馏
summary_zh: 孙宇晨.skill 是基于1528行调研素材的深度蒸馏成果，提炼出6个核心心智模型与8条决策启发式，构建了一套以‘注意力收割’为核心的营销思维框架。该技能专为 Claude Code 设计，通过模拟孙宇晨的认知模式，提供高冲突性、强传播性的应对策略，适用于公关危机处理、热点事件响应及品牌叙事构建等场景。
summary_en: Sun Yuchen.skill is a distilled framework of 6 core mental models and 8 decision heuristics, built from 1,528 lines of research material. It functions as an 'attention harvesting operating system' for marketing strategy, specifically designed for Claude Code to emulate Sun Yuchen's high-impact, controversial response patterns. It excels in crisis management, trend exploitation, and narrative construction through bold positioning and calculated provocation.

summary_zh: 一个轻量级 VPN 配置生成工具，通过一条命令在 VPS 上自动生成支持 Reality 协议的节点配置，并输出二维码供 OneXray、Shadowrocket、Clash Meta 等主流客户端扫码一键导入，免去手动配置的繁琐流程。
summary_en: A lightweight VPN config generator that creates Reality protocol-compatible node configurations via a single command. Outputs QR codes for seamless one-click import into popular clients like OneXray, Shadowrocket, and Clash Meta, eliminating manual setup.

description: 一个现代化的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，为AI助手提供交互式用户反馈收集功能。
summary_zh: MCP反馈收集器是一个基于Model Context Protocol的现代化反馈收集服务器，专为AI助手设计。支持多图片上传、文字反馈及中文界面，提供700x800像素GUI交互界面，通过uvx一键安装，适用于Claude Desktop等AI工具，显著提升人机交互效率。
summary_en: MCP Feedback Collector is a modern Model Context Protocol server for interactive user feedback collection in AI assistants. It supports multi-image uploads, text feedback, and a Chinese GUI with a 700x800px interface. Installable via uvx, it enhances AI-human interaction in tools like Claude Desktop.

description: Audit log for your Django models
summary_zh: django-audit-log 是一个 Django 模型审计日志库，提供用户追踪、变更记录和会话信息存储功能。支持 Django 1.6/1.7 及多版本 Python，通过中间件自动记录模型创建与修改操作，适用于需要完整操作历史追溯的 Web 应用。
summary_en: django-audit-log is a Django model audit logging library that tracks user actions, changes, and session keys for model instances. It supports Django 1.6/1.7, South and Django 1.7 migrations, and both Python 2.x and 3.x, enabling full audit trails for data modifications in web applications.

description: Get Inspired by the World's Greatest Artworks Every Time You Open a New Tab. Extension Available for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox.
summary_zh: Artab 是一款浏览器扩展，每次打开新标签页时展示世界顶级艺术作品，为用户提供每日艺术灵感。支持 Chrome、Edge 和 Firefox，基于现代前端技术栈开发，具备本地存储管理和跨浏览器兼容特性。
summary_en: Artab is a browser extension that displays world-class artworks on every new tab, inspiring users with daily art inspiration. Available for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox, it features modern frontend architecture with local storage and cross-browser compatibility.

description: 一个基于 Nuxt.js 3 开发的小红书工具网站，提供图文，视频，评论 浏览与导出
summary_zh: 基于 Nuxt.js 3 构建的小红书工具网站，支持图文视频内容浏览、评论导出及下载功能，集成多代理轮换与本地数据持久化，提供现代化 UI 与完整代理配置，适用于内容采集与数据分析场景。
summary_en: A Nuxt.js 3-based tool for browsing, exporting, and downloading Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) content including images, videos, and comments. Features modern UI, multi-proxy support, local data persistence, and automated browser interactions via Playwright.

description: Full-featured GUI for Claude Code CLI in VS Code — Windows (no WSL) & macOS. Third-party API, MCP plugins, Skills, Hooks, real-time token tracking. Actively maintained.
summary_zh: 为 Windows 平台打造的 Claude Code 原生聊天界面扩展，提供现代化 UI 和自定义 API 支持，兼容 VS Code 和 Cursor，支持第三方 API 接入，显著提升开发效率。
summary_en: A native Windows UI extension for Claude Code that enhances the CLI experience with a modern chat interface, custom API support, and seamless integration with VS Code/Cursor for improved developer productivity.

description: top, but for the HTTP endpoints on your host — a live dashboard of the most active plaintext HTTP endpoints, right in the terminal.
summary_zh: httpinspect 是一款基于 eBPF 的终端实时监控工具，类比 top 命令，直接在内核 TC 层抓取网卡明文 HTTP 请求，按流量、速率和延迟排序展示活跃端点。无需代理、Sidecar 或修改应用代码，支持回环接口监控本地微服务通信，提供 p50/p95/max 延迟、状态码分布及每秒请求数等详细指标。
summary_en: httpinspect is an eBPF-powered terminal live dashboard that ranks plaintext HTTP endpoints by traffic, rate, and latency — like top, but for HTTP. It attaches at the TC layer to read packets directly off the wire with no proxy, sidecar, or application changes. It covers loopback traffic for local microservice chatter and surfaces per-endpoint latency percentiles, status-code mix, and req/s sparklines in a TUI.

description: person blog powered by flask
summary_zh: 这是一个基于 Flask 开发的个人博客系统，支持文章发布与展示，提供完整的用户认证与数据库管理功能。项目包含传统单应用结构和蓝图（Blueprint）分离结构两种实现方式，适合学习 Flask 基础与模块化开发。
summary_en: A personal blog built with Flask, featuring article publishing, user authentication, and database management. Includes both monolithic and Blueprint-based modular architectures, ideal for learning Flask fundamentals and application structuring.

description: Twitter Trend Radar
summary_zh: Twitter Trend Radar 是一款实时扫描 Twitter/X 上带有链接且具备传播力推文的反向域名侦察工具。它通过提取
summary_en: Twitter Trend Radar scans X/Twitter in real time for tweets carrying links and traction, then reverse-looks up each domain's registration age and recent traffic to surface emerging products before Google Trends catches up. It uses launch-signal phrase pools, greylisting of major sites, WHOIS age checks, and 3-month traffic bar charts. A zero-dependency local proxy keeps API keys on-device with no build step required.

description: 这是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 项目，它充当一个代理服务器，能够将 Claude API 格式的请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式。这使得任何与 Claude API 兼容的客户端（例如官方的 @anthropic-ai/claude-code CLI）都能够与任何支持 OpenAI API 格式的服务进行通信，如 Google Gemini, Groq, Ollama 等。
summary_zh: 该项目是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 代理服务器，可将 Claude API 请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式，支持动态路由至 Google Gemini、Groq、Ollama 等兼容服务，具备全功能 API 兼容、函数调用转换、Haiku 模型快捷配置及一键部署脚本，实现 Claude 客户端与多 AI 服务的无缝互通。
summary_en: This is a TypeScript project deployed on Cloudflare Workers that acts as a proxy server, seamlessly converting Claude API requests to OpenAI API format. It enables any Claude-compatible client (e.g., @anthropic-ai/claude-code) to communicate with OpenAI-compatible services like Google Gemini, Groq, and Ollama via dynamic routing, full API compatibility, tool calling conversion, and one-click deployment.

description: Django template tag for rendering Page objects as Bootstrap pagination HTML
summary_zh: 该仓库提供 Django 模板标签，用于将 Django 的 Page 对象渲染为兼容 Bootstrap 的分页 HTML。支持 Bootstrap 2.x/3.x/4.x 版本，提供灵活的配置选项如页码范围、前后跳转链接等，适用于 Django 1.2+ 项目，现已归档不再维护。
summary_en: This Django template tag renders Page objects into Bootstrap-compatible pagination HTML. It supports Bootstrap 2.x/3.x/4.x, offers configurable options like page ranges and prev/next links, and is compatible with Django 1.2+. The project is now archived and no longer maintained.

description: :metro: 即刻 Ⓙ SDK
summary_zh: Jike Metro 🚇 是一个即刻（Jike）平台的 Python SDK，提供用户信息获取、动态浏览、内容发布、收藏管理、评论互动等全套接口，支持流式数据拉取与自动化操作，适用于开发者快速集成即刻生态功能。
summary_en: Jike Metro 🚇 is a Python SDK for the Jike platform, offering comprehensive APIs for user profiles, news feeds, content creation, collections, comments, and interactions. It supports streaming data and automation, enabling developers to integrate Jike's ecosystem efficiently.

description: ByeType 是一个 Markdown 驱动的 AI 语音输入工具，用多模态大模型直接处理原始音频。编辑 Markdown 文件即可自定义专有词汇、转录规则和格式化策略，人名、术语、口水词、数字格式一次转录到位，减少二次修改。支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS。
summary_zh: ByeType 是一款基于 Markdown 驱动的 AI 语音输入工具，利用多模态大模型直接处理原始音频，支持自定义专有词汇、转录规则和格式化策略。通过编辑 Markdown 提示词，实现人名、术语、数字格式等一次性精准转写，减少二次修改，支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS 平台。
summary_en: ByeType is a Markdown-driven AI voice input tool that uses multimodal large models to directly process raw audio. It supports custom vocabulary, transcription rules, and formatting strategies via editable Markdown prompts. Achieving accurate, one-time transcription of names, terms, and numbers without post-processing, it runs on macOS, Windows, and iOS.

description: Public docs & issues for flow.ci
summary_zh: flow.ci 是一个开源的持续集成与部署平台，提供中英文双语文档和公开的问题追踪系统，旨在帮助开发者高效管理 CI/CD 流程，支持自动化构建、测试与部署。
summary_en: flow.ci is an open-source continuous integration and deployment platform offering bilingual documentation (English and Chinese) and a public issue tracker to help developers streamline CI/CD workflows with automation.

description: A cross-platform skills manager for AI IDEs. Search marketplace, download locally, and install to Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and more with one click.
summary_zh: Skills Manager 是一款跨平台 AI IDE 技能管理工具，支持聚合搜索 Claude、Cursor、Windsurf 等10+主流AI开发环境的技能插件，一键下载至本地统一仓库并通过安全符号链接快速安装，提供版本控制、批量部署和自定义IDE支持，显著提升AI编程助手的功能扩展效率。
summary_en: Skills Manager is a cross-platform AI IDE skills management tool that aggregates search across major marketplaces (Claude Plugins, SkillsLLM, etc.), downloads skills to a unified local repository, and enables one-click installation into 10+ supported AI IDEs via secure symlinks. It features version control, bulk deployment, and custom IDE support for enhanced AI programming assistant capabilities.

description: Django tools for building nonrel backends
summary_zh: Djangotoolbox 是 Django 的非关系型数据库后端通用工具包，提供标准化接口支持在 NoSQL 数据库上运行 Django。它包含字段类型（如 ListField、DictField）、管理后台适配及权限处理支持，帮助开发者构建兼容 Django ORM 的非关系型数据层。
summary_en: Djangotoolbox is a Django utility library providing a unified API for running Django on non-relational/NoSQL databases. It includes base classes for custom backends, specialized field types (e.g., ListField, DictField), and admin integration to support Django's admin interface without JOINs.

summary_zh: 魔法AI绘画是一个基于Next.js构建的跨平台AI绘画应用，支持多种主流AI模型（如Sora、DALL-E、GPT、GEMINI等）及自定义模型扩展。提供文生图、图生图、区域编辑和多图参考功能，所有数据本地存储保障隐私安全，支持网页版与桌面应用部署。
summary_en: Magic Image is a cross-platform AI painting application built with Next.js, supporting multiple AI models (Sora, DALL-E, GPT, GEMINI, etc.) and custom model integration. It offers text-to-image, image-to-image, region editing, and multi-reference image support, with all data stored locally for privacy. Available as both a web app and desktop application.

summary_zh: Augment2Api 是一个连接 Augment API 的中间件服务，提供兼容 OpenAI 的接口，支持 Claude3.7 和 Claude4 模型调用，具备流式输出、多 token 管理、Redis 存储及批量检测功能，但存在账号被封风险，需谨慎使用。
summary_en: Augment2Api is a middleware service that connects to Augment API, offering OpenAI-compatible interfaces for Claude3.7 and Claude4 models with streaming support, multi-token management, and Redis storage, though it carries account ban risks and should be used cautiously.

description: Django storage for 七牛云存储
summary_zh: Django Qiniu Storage 是一个专为 Django 框架设计的七牛云存储后端存储库，支持通过标准 Django Storage API 无缝集成七牛云存储服务，适用于托管静态资源和用户上传文件，支持 HTTPS 访问和灵活的配置方式。
summary_en: Django Qiniu Storage is a Django backend storage library for Qiniu Cloud Storage, enabling seamless integration with Django's Storage API to manage static files and user uploads via Qiniu's CDN, supporting HTTPS access and flexible configuration via environment variables or settings.

description: Improved memcached cache backend for Django
summary_zh: django-newcache 是 Django 的增强型 memcached 缓存后端，支持 pylibmc、键哈希/版本化/风味化、无限超时及雪崩防护。通过自动处理键格式、版本控制和命名空间隔离，提升缓存安全性与多环境兼容性，默认行为已优化，支持自定义键生成函数。
summary_en: django-newcache is an enhanced memcached backend for Django, offering pylibmc support, key hashing/versioning/flavoring, infinite timeouts, and thundering herd mitigation. It auto-hashes keys for safety, uses versioning for cache invalidation, and adds flavor prefixes for environment isolation—all with sensible defaults and optional custom key functions.

description: 轻量级的clawdbot/openclaw，支持飞书，钉钉，QQ和企业微信
summary_zh: OpenMozi 是一个轻量级、专注国产生态的 AI 助手框架，支持 DeepSeek、豆包、通义千问等国产大模型及 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容接口，提供统一的 Function Calling 能力。它原生集成 QQ、飞书、钉钉、企业微信等通讯平台适配器，内置 25 个工具（文件操作、浏览器自动化、定时任务等）、记忆系统、Skills 技能扩展机制，以及智能上下文压缩策略，适用于企业内部机器人和团队协作场景。
summary_en: OpenMozi is a lightweight AI assistant framework focused on the Chinese ecosystem, supporting domestic LLMs like DeepSeek, Doubao, and Qwen via unified OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible interfaces with native Function Calling. It integrates adapters for QQ, Feishu, DingTalk, and WeCom, featuring 25 built-in tools (file ops, browser automation, cron jobs), memory system, Skills extension via SKILL.md, and intelligent context compression—ideal for enterprise bots and team collaboration.

summary_zh: QDuo是一款macOS原生效率工具，支持在任何应用中选中文本后直接在光标处弹出操作面板，无需剪贴板切换即可执行翻译、润色、搜索、朗读、代码解释等AI操作或22种本地文本变换，结果可直接替换/追加原文。
summary_en: QDuo is a macOS-native productivity tool that lets you select text anywhere and access AI-powered actions (translate, polish, search, explain) or 22 local text transformations via an inline popup—no clipboard switching needed. Results can replace or append to the original text seamlessly.

description: 《Django设计模式与最佳实践》2015年03月-基于Django 1.7
summary_zh: 《Django设计模式与最佳实践》系统讲解Django 1.7下的模型设计模式与工程实践，涵盖规范化、类图建模、多文件模型拆分等核心模式，强调模型作为Django应用基石的重要性，适用于构建可维护的大型Web应用。
summary_en: This book systematically covers Django 1.7 design patterns and best practices, focusing on model design including normalization, class diagrams, and modularization. It emphasizes models as the foundation of Django applications, enabling scalable and maintainable web development.

description: 股票数据接口
summary_zh: stock-open-api 是一个开源的股票数据接口库，提供从上海证券交易所和东方财富等公开数据源的股票信息查询功能，支持A股、港股、科创板、新三板及中国概念股等市场数据，适用于学习交流与量化研究场景，不可用于商业用途。
summary_en: stock-open-api is an open-source library providing stock data interfaces from public sources like the Shanghai Stock Exchange and East Money, supporting queries for A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, STAR Market, New Third Board, and US-listed Chinese companies, intended for educational and research use only.

description: Phantom-Motion is an incredibly powerful, epic interactive dynamic visual storytelling generator. Its capabilities are limited only by the bounds of your imagination! 它是一个极其硬核的史诗级交互式动态视觉叙事生成器。它的实力只取决于你的想象力高低！
summary_zh: Phantom-Motion 是一款基于 AI 智能体的交互式动态视觉叙事生成引擎，融合 GSAP 电影级运镜、Three.js 3D 渲染、GPGPU 粒子系统与东方美学算法，支持从文本剧本自动生成 4K/60FPS 商业级 MP4 动画，具备音画微秒同步、非遗全息展示与零版权风险等核心优势。
summary_en: Phantom-Motion is an AI-powered interactive visual storytelling engine that combines cinematic GSAP camera rigs, Three.js 3D rendering, GPGPU particle systems, and Eastern aesthetic algorithms to auto-generate commercial-grade 4K/60FPS MP4 animations from text scripts, featuring microsecond audio-visual sync and zero copyright risk.

description: A lightweight, no-dependency image slider library
summary_zh: PureSlider 是一个轻量级、无依赖的 JavaScript 图片轮播库，支持淡入淡出切换效果。它无需 jQuery 等外部库，提供简洁的 API 和自定义配置选项，适用于现代网页开发中的图片展示场景。
summary_en: PureSlider is a lightweight, dependency-free image slider library that supports fade transitions. It offers a simple API and customizable options, ideal for modern web projects requiring jQuery-free image carousels.

description: Lenny Rachitsky 播客与 Newsletter 知识库。搜索、阅读、学习 Lenny 的 638 篇内容（289 播客转录 + 349 篇 Newsletter）。 涵盖产品管理、增长、设计、工程、AI、创业、领导力等 17 个主题。 触发词：Lenny、Lenny's Newslet
summary_zh: Lenny Rachitsky播客与Newsletter知识库，将638篇硅谷顶级产品内容（289篇播客转录+349篇Newsletter）转化为可自然语言搜索的知识库。支持Claude Code调用，覆盖产品管理、增长、设计、AI等17个主题，提供带来源引用的精准问答服务。
summary_en: A searchable knowledge base for Lenny Rachitsky's 638 podcast transcripts and newsletter articles, enabling natural language queries via Claude Code. Covers 17 topics including product management, growth, AI, and leadership, with source-attributed answers from top Silicon Valley content.

description: A robot of wechat based on python (Not maintained)
summary_zh: wechat-bot 是一个基于 Python 开发的微信机器人项目，支持通过配置文件自定义端口、令牌、用户名等参数，集成 simsimi 等对话接口，提供基础的消息处理与自动回复功能，适用于简单的微信自动化场景。
summary_en: wechat-bot is a Python-based WeChat robot that supports configuration via a text file for port, token, username, and simsimi integration, enabling basic message handling and automated replies for simple WeChat automation use cases.

description: Seamless integration of Algolia into your Django project.
summary_zh: 该仓库提供 Django 项目与 Algolia 搜索服务的无缝集成，支持自动索引同步、自定义索引命名、字段预处理等功能，适用于实现高性能实时搜索与自动补全。兼容 Python 3.8+ 和 Django 4.x/5.x，提供完整的搜索、地理搜索、标签及多索引支持。
summary_en: This repository enables seamless integration of Algolia Search API into Django projects, offering features like automatic indexing, custom index naming, field preprocessing, and support for geo-search and tagging. Compatible with Python 3.8+ and Django 4.x/5.x, it simplifies building high-performance real-time search and autocomplete experiences.

description: Professional SEO and GEO audit workflows for brands, SaaS teams, SEO operators, agencies, and AI-search growth teams.
summary_zh: SEO GEO Audit 是一个统一的网站审计框架，专为品牌、SaaS团队、SEO运营者、代理机构和AI搜索增长团队设计。它将技术健康度、内容质量、EEAT（经验、专业性、权威性、可信度）、实体信号和AI可见性整合为可执行决策框架，解决传统SEO检查表无法回答的‘网站是否真正准备好在搜索引擎和AI驱动发现中获胜’的核心问题。
summary_en: SEO GEO Audit is a unified audit framework for teams needing more than basic technical SEO checks. It diagnoses whether a website is technically sound, structurally clear, trustworthy, AI-packaged, externally visible, and aligned with multiple AI platforms. Instead of fragmented findings, it delivers a prioritized decision framework covering technical health, content quality, EEAT, entity signals, authority, and off-site visibility to answer the critical question: Is this site ready to win in both search engines and AI-driven discovery?

description: Git worktree-based task manager with integrated terminals for CLI coding agents
summary_zh: Ouijit 是一款基于 Git worktree 的 AI 编程代理任务管理器，集成终端会话、生命周期钩子与脚本系统，支持 Claude Code、Codex 等代理工具。提供看板式任务管理、自动并行工作流、实时代理状态通知、VM 沙箱隔离及会话恢复等功能，无需账号、无遥测，专为 AI 辅助开发流程打造。
summary_en: Ouijit is a Git worktree-based task and terminal session manager designed for AI coding agents. It integrates with Claude Code, Codex, and other agent CLIs via lifecycle hooks, scripts, and a session-aware CLI. Features include kanban task management, automatic parallel workstreams, live agent status with notifications, VM sandboxing for untrusted code, and session resumption—fully open-source with no accounts or telemetry.

description: ThinkFlow AI 是一个轻量级“从想法到结构化图谱”的工作台：输入一个核心想法，应用会把它扩展为可浏览的知识图谱（模块/子模块）。每个节点支持继续追问扩展、深挖详情，以及可选的配图生成。
summary_zh: ThinkFlow AI 是一个轻量级‘从想法到结构化图谱’工作台，支持输入核心概念自动生成可交互知识图谱。具备AI驱动发散扩展、深度内容挖掘、视觉配图生成、沉浸式演示模式等功能，采用Vue 3 + Vite 5 + @vue-flow/core技术栈，实现本地优先的零平台锁定体验。
summary_en: ThinkFlow AI is a lightweight 'idea-to-structured-graph' workspace that transforms core concepts into interactive knowledge graphs. Features AI-driven divergence expansion, deep content mining, visual image generation, immersive presentation mode, and local-first architecture with zero platform lock-in. Built with Vue 3 + Vite 5 + @vue-flow/core stack.

summary_zh: Content Signal Radar 是一个基于 GitHub Actions 的自动化信号情报系统，从 X、博客、播客、即刻、公众号等多源抓取信息，通过去重、评分和噪声过滤，生成结构化信号报告。它不是新闻摘要，而是面向内容创作者和产品决策者的决策辅助系统，输出可直接用于 X 推文草稿、小红书选题或产品洞察，支持 Telegram 推送和仪表盘集成。
summary_en: Content Signal Radar is an automated signal intelligence system powered by GitHub Actions. It ingests feeds from X, blogs, podcasts, Jike, and WeChat public accounts, then deduplicates, scores, and filters noise to produce structured signal reports. Designed for content creators and product decision-makers, it generates actionable outputs—X drafts, Xiaohongshu angles, and product signals—deliverable via stdout, Telegram, or dashboard integration.

description: 轻量级的clawdbot/openclaw，支持飞书，钉钉，QQ和企业微信
summary_zh: OpenMozi 是一个轻量级 AI 助手框架，专为国产生态设计，支持 DeepSeek、豆包、Qwen 等国产大模型及 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容接口，提供飞书、钉钉、QQ、企业微信等多平台机器人接入，具备 Function Calling、25 个内置工具、记忆系统、定时任务等核心功能，代码简洁（约1.6万行），适合学习 Agent 原理和快速开发企业级智能助手。
summary_en: OpenMozi is a lightweight AI assistant framework designed for the Chinese ecosystem, supporting domestic LLMs like DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs. It offers multi-platform bot integration (Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, WeCom), native Function Calling, 25 built-in tools, memory system, cron jobs, and a skill-based architecture. With ~16K lines of clean code, it's ideal for learning agent principles and rapid development of enterprise-grade AI assistants.

description: Self-hosted short link and live QR platform with ownership, review, branded QR codes, analytics, and an auditable path to AI-assisted operations.
summary_zh: AI Shortlink 是一个自托管的短链与活码管理平台，强调链接传播后的可控性。核心功能包括短链管理、多策略活码运营、品牌二维码生成及团队协作审核。采用 Go 单体架构与 SQLite 部署，支持 Docker 一键启动，并规划了基于大模型的 AI 辅助运营演进路线。
summary_en: AI Shortlink is a self-hosted short link and live QR platform emphasizing post-distribution control. It offers short link management, multi-strategy live QR operations, branded QR code generation, and team collaboration with audits. Built as a monolithic Go service with SQLite, it supports Docker deployment and outlines a roadmap for AI-assisted operations.

description: Yet another django based blog created in May 2015
summary_zh: MayBlog 是一个基于 Django 和 Bootstrap 开发的博客系统，于2015年5月创建。支持多用户、多角色、Markdown 写作、SEO 优化，并通过 Docker 实现容器化部署。提供 RESTful API（开发中）和后台管理界面，采用微服务架构设计，适合个人或团队搭建内容管理平台。
summary_en: MayBlog is a Django and Bootstrap-based blog system created in May 2015. It supports multi-user, multi-role access, Markdown writing, SEO optimization, and containerized deployment via Docker. Features include RESTful API (in development), admin interface, and modular deployment configurations, ideal for personal or team content management.

description: 节点过滤器
summary_zh: ProxyFilter 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Clash 代理配置过滤工具，支持多格式输入（YAML、Base64、URI列表），智能匹配中英文地区名称，过滤 VMess、Shadowsocks、Trojan 等协议节点，自动去重并支持多源合并与自定义命名，适用于高效管理代理订阅。
summary_en: ProxyFilter is a Cloudflare Workers-based tool for filtering Clash proxy configurations. It supports multiple input formats (YAML, Base64, URI lists), intelligently matches region names in Chinese and English, filters nodes by protocol (VMess, Shadowsocks, Trojan, etc.), removes duplicates, and merges multiple sources with customizable naming.

description: One Page Agent.The browser-native workbench that lives in One Page.
summary_zh: OnePagent 是一款单文件部署的浏览器原生 AI 智能体工作台，仅需一个 HTML 文件即可实现多轮对话、工具调用、Python 沙箱、网络搜索及长期记忆等全功能。支持多 LLM 提供商、MCP 服务器集成与子代理协作，无需后端或构建工具，开箱即用。
summary_en: OnePagent is a single-file, browser-native AI agent workbench delivering full functionality—multi-turn chat, tool calls, Python sandbox, web search, and long-term memory—in one HTML file. It supports multi-provider LLMs, MCP server integration, and sub-agent collaboration with zero backend or build dependencies.

description: A carefully curated list of awesome OpenClaw resources — not everything, just the best.  Skills · Plugins · MCP · Tools · Deployments · Security · Research · Alternatives。精心策划的 OpenClaw 优质资源大合集 —— 不求大而全，只求真有用。
summary_zh: OpenClaw 是一个精心策划的优质资源合集，聚焦于本地优先、自主运行的 AI 智能体框架。涵盖技能插件、MCP集成、部署方案、安全实践及替代工具，旨在提供实用而非泛化的技术指南，帮助用户快速构建和运行自主 AI 代理。
summary_en: Awesome OpenClaw is a meticulously curated collection of top-tier resources for the OpenClaw autonomous AI agent framework. It covers skills, plugins, MCP integrations, deployments, security, and alternatives, focusing on practicality over exhaustiveness to empower developers in building local-first, self-hosted AI agents.

description: PyTime is an easy-use Python module which aims to operate date/time/datetime by string.
summary_zh: PyTime 是一个简洁易用的 Python 模块，专注于通过字符串操作日期、时间和 datetime 对象。它支持解析非标准格式的日期字符串（如 '2015.5.17'、'April 3rd 2015'），并允许通过自然语言式字符串进行时间加减运算（如 '2years 3mon'）。同时提供周、月时间区间计算及节日生成功能，适用于脚本自动化与数据处理场景。
summary_en: PyTime is a user-friendly Python module designed to handle date/time/datetime operations via string input. It parses irregular date formats (e.g., '2015.5.17', 'NOV21th2015') and supports natural-language-like timedelta calculations (e.g., '2years 3mon'). Features include week/month interval generation, holiday computation, and datetime arithmetic, making it ideal for automation and data processing tasks.

description: Bird is a cli for twitter, so your agents can tweet.
summary_zh: Bird 是一款基于命令行界面的 X (Twitter) 客户端，专为自动化脚本和 AI 智能体设计。它支持通过浏览器 Cookie 或 Sweetistics API 进行身份验证，提供发推、回复、读取推文、搜索及查看提及等核心功能，并支持 JSON 格式输出，便于集成到自动化工作流中。
summary_en: Bird is a fast command-line interface for X (Twitter), designed for automation scripts and AI agents. It supports authentication via browser cookies or the Sweetistics API, offering core functionalities like tweeting, replying, reading, searching, and viewing mentions. It also supports JSON output for seamless integration into automated workflows.

summary_zh: 10xagent 是一个极简的 AI Agent 原型，仅用 10 行 JavaScript 代码实现了基于 for 循环、工具调用与 LLM 的自进化 Harness。通过 30-50 轮迭代，Agent 能自主优化代码、执行 Bash 命令并验证结果，展示了 AI 自我进化的核心原理。
summary_en: 10xagent is a minimal AI Agent prototype that implements a self-evolving harness using just 10 lines of JavaScript code with for-loop, tool calling, and LLM. Through 30-50 iterations, the agent autonomously optimizes code, executes Bash commands, and verifies results, demonstrating the core principles of AI self-evolution.

description: Local-first dashboard for observing Claude Code usage, cost, sessions, and time.
summary_zh: Lumo是一款本地优先的桌面应用，专为开发者设计，用于追踪Claude Code的使用情况。它通过本地SQLite数据库收集并可视化成本、令牌消耗、会话时长和编码时间等关键指标，提供直观的仪表盘视图，无需云端账户或数据外传，完全在用户机器上运行。
summary_en: Lumo is a local-first desktop application that tracks Claude Code usage by collecting telemetry data locally. It provides real-time dashboards for cost, tokens, sessions, and coding time using a native Tauri + Next.js UI, storing everything in a local SQLite database without requiring cloud accounts or external data transmission.

description: A super blog lite -- just one page. use vue with github api !
summary_zh: 基于 GitHub Issue 的单页极简博客系统，使用 Vue 和 GitHub API 构建，支持自定义配置与 CI/CD 自动化部署，适合个人知识管理与轻量级内容展示。
summary_en: A minimalist single-page blog built with Vue and GitHub API, powered by GitHub Issues for content. Supports custom configuration and CI/CD via GitHub Actions for static site deployment.

description: Get a better UI of V2EX.
summary_zh: v2ex.k 是一款专为 V2EX 设计的界面增强浏览器插件，采用 Vue 重构，提供全新配色、左侧导航栏和快速阅读模式。支持主题切换、全键盘操作及 URL 动态更新，显著提升浏览效率与视觉体验。
summary_en: v2ex.k is a browser extension that enhances the V2EX website with a modern UI, featuring new themes, sidebar navigation, quick-read mode, keyboard shortcuts, and dynamic URL updates for improved browsing efficiency and user experience.

description: Easy PJAX for Django
summary_zh: django-easy-pjax 是一个为 Django 项目提供 PJAX 支持的轻量级应用，通过智能模板切换实现无刷新页面加载，提升用户体验。它自动根据请求头选择基础模板，支持缓存清理与 URL 净化，无需修改视图或 URL 配置，集成简单且兼容性强。
summary_en: django-easy-pjax is a lightweight Django app that enables PJAX support by intelligently switching templates to enable partial page loads without full reloads. It auto-selects base or PJAX-specific templates based on HTTP headers, supports cache-busting cleanup, and requires no view or URL changes, making integration seamless and non-intrusive.

description: Detect file modification in background and push it to git automatically.
summary_zh: file_sync 是一个轻量级自动化工具，通过监听文件变化并自动提交到 Git 仓库，实现配置文件的实时同步与版本追踪。支持跨平台运行，可设置开机自启，适用于个人配置文件管理场景。
summary_en: file_sync is a lightweight automation tool that monitors file modifications in the background and automatically pushes changes to a Git repository, enabling real-time synchronization and version tracking of configuration files. It supports cross-platform operation and can be configured to run at system startup.

description: It is a materializecss.com implementation with Vue.js.
summary_zh: material-ui-vue 是一个基于 Vue.js 的 MaterializeCSS 组件库实现，提供 Material Design 风格的 UI 组件封装。支持通过 npm 安装，需配合 MaterializeCSS 资源文件使用，适用于快速构建现代化前端界面，但当前版本为试验性质，稳定性未经验证。
summary_en: material-ui-vue is a Vue.js implementation of MaterializeCSS, offering Material Design UI components. It can be installed via npm and requires MaterializeCSS assets including CSS, JS, and jQuery. Designed for rapid development of modern web interfaces, though marked as unstable and not recommended for production use.

description: 文科生也会配的微信个人号后台，Content based wechat massive platform framework, what you need to do is only adding your articles in :)
summary_zh: MyPlatform 是一个专为非技术用户设计的微信个人号内容管理平台，支持通过添加文章快速搭建微信公众号。基于 Python 开发，部署于新浪云（SAE），完全免费且配置简单，文科生也可在20分钟内完成搭建，实现内容分发与互动功能。
summary_en: MyPlatform is a content-based WeChat personal account backend framework designed for non-technical users. Built with Python and hosted on SAE, it enables quick setup by adding articles, allowing anyone to create a functional WeChat content platform in under 20 minutes with zero cost.

description: 著名紫薇排盘工具iztro的python版本，用法和原版完全一致
summary_zh: py-iztro 是著名紫微排盘工具 iztro 的 Python 版本，完全复刻原版功能，支持通过公历日期和性别生成详细的紫微斗数命盘，包含星曜分布、五行局等信息，采用 pydantic 进行数据建模，确保类型安全与代码可维护性。
summary_en: py-iztro is a Python reimplementation of the renowned iztro astrology tool, offering identical functionality to the original JavaScript version. It generates comprehensive Ziwei Dou Shu charts using solar dates and gender, with full Pydantic-based data modeling for type safety and maintainability.

description: Professional SEO and GEO audit workflows for brands, SaaS teams, SEO operators, agencies, and AI-search growth teams.
summary_zh: SEO GEO Audit 是一个统一的审计框架，专为品牌、SaaS团队、SEO运营者、代理机构和AI搜索增长团队设计。它将技术健康度、内容质量、信任背书、外部平台可见性及AI适配性整合为可执行的决策体系，帮助判断网站是否真正具备在搜索引擎和AI驱动发现中获胜的能力。
summary_en: SEO GEO Audit is a unified audit framework for teams needing more than technical SEO checks. It evaluates whether a website is technically sound, structurally clear, trustworthy, AI-ready, externally visible, and aligned across platforms—turning fragmented findings into a prioritized executive decision system.

description: Building WebApp in Android way.
summary_zh: Jndroid 是一个 JavaScript 框架，允许开发者以 Android 原生应用的方式构建 WebApp。它通过提供类似 Android 的 UI 组件（如 TextView）和 setContentView 等 API，简化了 Web 应用的开发流程，适用于需要跨平台或移动端体验优化的场景。
summary_en: Jndroid is a JavaScript framework enabling WebApp development in an Android-like manner. It provides Android-style UI components (e.g., TextView) and APIs like setContentView, simplifying cross-platform mobile web app development with native-like structure.

description: AI-powered JSON translation tool with agentic reflection using OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini APIs
summary_zh: Jta 是一款基于 AI 的智能 JSON 翻译工具，采用代理式反思机制实现自我优化翻译。通过 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Gemini 三大 AI 平台，支持多语言国际化文件翻译，具备术语管理、增量翻译和格式保护等生产级功能，确保翻译准确性和一致性。
summary_en: Jta is an AI-powered JSON translation tool featuring an agentic reflection mechanism for self-optimizing translations. Using OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini APIs, it supports multi-language i18n files with terminology management, incremental translation, and format protection for production-grade accuracy and consistency.

description: A minimalist, terminal-style new tab page for your browser.
summary_zh: Neko-Tab 是一款极简终端风格的浏览器新标签页扩展，基于 React + TypeScript + Vite 构建。核心亮点是键盘优先的命令面板（Ctrl+K），集成模糊搜索、URL 别名、内置计算器、标签页搜索、多搜索引擎切换及 AI 命令解释器（支持 OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini）。AI 模块可学习浏览历史、智能解析自然语言指令（如打开多个应用），并支持基于历史记录的问答与日志保存。提供 22+ 主题、自定义 ASCII 艺术和便签本功能。
summary_en: Neko-Tab is a minimalist, terminal-style browser new tab extension built with React, TypeScript, and Vite. Its keyboard-first command palette (Ctrl+K) unifies fuzzy search, URL aliases, a built-in calculator, tab switching, multi-engine search, and an AI command interpreter (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini). The AI learns from browsing history, resolves natural-language navigation, answers history-based Q&A, and saves summaries to a journal. Features 22+ themes, custom ASCII art, and a scratchpad.

description: 一个将本地markdown在尽可能保持格式的情况下复制到公众号、知乎、飞书、X等平台的浏览器插件
summary_zh: Markdown Paste Helper 是一款浏览器插件，可将本地 Markdown 内容一键粘贴至知乎、微信公众号、飞书、X Articles 等主流平台，自动转换为适配的富文本格式。支持预处理语法（如 GitHub alerts、任务列表）、自定义公众号主题色与代码高亮，并提供一键分发功能，实现‘一次编写，多端发布’的高效内容创作体验。
summary_en: Markdown Paste Helper is a browser extension that enables one-click pasting of Markdown content into major platforms like Zhihu, WeChat Official Accounts, Feishu, and X Articles, automatically converting it to platform-specific rich text formats. It supports preprocessing syntax (e.g., GitHub alerts, task lists), custom WeChat themes with code highlighting, and offers batch distribution across logged-in platforms for efficient multi-platform publishing.

description: Hugo theme for engineering documentation
summary_zh: OINK是一款面向工程文档的本地优先Hugo主题，通过单次构建将原生Markdown转化为完整的知识发布站点，内置搜索、图表、数学公式等组件，无需Node.js或CDN，同时支持AI代理索引、多语言及渐进增强。
summary_en: OINK is a local-first Hugo theme for engineering documentation that transforms native Markdown into a complete knowledge site with one build. It bundles search, diagrams, and math locally without Node.js or CDN, and supports AI agent indexing, multilingual routing, and progressive enhancement.

description: Local-first desktop API client built for developers and AI agents
summary_zh: Voleeo 是一款面向 AI 时代的本地优先桌面 API 客户端，原生支持 HTTP、gRPC、WebSocket 和 GraphQL 四大协议。内置 MCP Server，允许 AI 智能体直接读写工作区、发起请求与管理环境。具备 AES-256-GCM 加密、OAuth 2.0 等全链路认证、Git 版本控制、OpenAPI/Postman 导入及插件扩展能力，零遥测、无云端锁定。
summary_en: Voleeo is a local-first desktop API client built for the AI era, natively supporting HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket, and GraphQL in a single app. It doubles as an MCP server, enabling AI agents to read, create, and execute requests directly from chat. Features include AES-256-GCM encryption, full auth suites (OAuth 2.0, SigV4, etc.), Git-based collection versioning, OpenAPI/Postman imports, plugin extensibility, and zero telemetry with no cloud lock-in.

description: A jquery and bootstrap basic tree view plugin, easily use.
summary_zh: EasyTree 是一个基于 jQuery 和 Bootstrap 3 的轻量级树形视图插件，可将无序列表快速转换为支持选择、添加、编辑和删除操作的交互式树形结构，适用于需要动态层级数据管理的 Web 应用。
summary_en: EasyTree is a lightweight jQuery and Bootstrap 3-based plugin that transforms unordered lists into interactive tree views with selectable, addable, editable, and deletable nodes, ideal for dynamic hierarchical data management in web applications.

description: python code style guide book / python 代码、单元测试和项目规范
summary_zh: 本项目是 Python 代码风格、单元测试与项目规范的完整指南，旨在为 Python 项目（尤其是 Web 项目）提供统一的开发标准。涵盖代码风格、测试实践、项目结构等核心内容，支持在线阅读与多种格式下载，采用 CC0 许可，鼓励社区协作完善。
summary_en: This repository provides a comprehensive Python code style guide, unit testing practices, and project standards, particularly for web projects. It covers coding conventions, testing methodologies, and project structure, available for online reading and download in multiple formats. Released under CC0, it encourages community contributions to improve and expand the guide.

description: 开源AI生图工具，免登录畅玩 FLUX2、SDXL，支持 cloudflare workers 一键部署自托管，并集成各大主流AI提供商，提供一站式的创作体验。
summary_zh: Typix 是一款开源 AI 生图工具，支持免登录使用 FLUX2、SDXL 等主流模型，提供 Cloudflare Workers 一键自托管部署，集成 Google、OpenAI、Fal 等多平台 AI 服务，兼具浏览器本地存储与可选云同步，保障用户数据隐私与创作自由。
summary_en: Typix is an open-source AI image generation tool that enables login-free access to FLUX2, SDXL, and other models. It offers one-click self-hosting via Cloudflare Workers, integrates multiple AI providers like Google and OpenAI, and supports local browser storage with optional cloud sync for privacy and seamless cross-device creativity.

description: 一个监控股票的工具
summary_zh: iNeedMyMoneyBack 是一款面向个人投资者的桌面端股票监控工具，支持 A 股、港股、美股及指数的实时行情展示。用户可自定义监控列表、显示字段与刷新频率，并在价格达到目标值时接收系统通知。界面支持表格与滚动模式、全局快捷键、双击跳转行情网站，并内置自动更新组件，适合需要持续关注持仓与大盘动态的股民使用。
summary_en: iNeedMyMoneyBack is a desktop stock monitoring tool for individual investors, providing real-time quotes for A-shares, HK, US stocks, and major indices. Users can customize watchlists, display fields, and refresh intervals, and receive system notifications when target prices are reached. The app supports table and scroll views, global shortcuts, double-click navigation to financial sites, and includes an auto-update component, making it ideal for tracking portfolios and market movements.

description: A full blog system based on Django
summary_zh: GeekBlog是一个基于Django 1.6.5构建的全功能博客系统，集成MySQL和MongoDB双数据库，支持UEditor富文本编辑、多说评论、移动端适配及静态资源优化。通过django-admin-tools深度定制后台管理界面，具备完整的Feed和Sitemap功能，适合技术博主部署个人站点。
summary_en: GeekBlog is a full-featured blog system built on Django 1.6.5, utilizing MySQL and MongoDB for data storage. It features UEditor rich text editing, Duoshuo comments, mobile responsiveness, and static asset optimization via Django Pipeline. The backend is enhanced with django-admin-tools for improved admin experience, supporting feeds and sitemaps for SEO.

summary_zh: 该仓库为 Django 项目提供基于 Bootstrap 3 的日期时间选择器组件，集成 Eonasdan 的 bootstrap-datetimepicker 插件，支持通过 moment.js 进行灵活的时间格式化，适用于表单中的日期和 datetime 字段输入，自动适配当前语言环境。
summary_en: This Django package integrates the Bootstrap 3 datetimepicker widget (v2) by Eonasdan, enabling date and datetime field inputs in forms with moment.js-based formatting. It auto-detects the current language and requires Bootstrap 3 and jQuery. Compatible with Django 1.3+ and Python 2.4+.

description: Rime 词库及配置
summary_zh: Rime 输入法跨平台配置文件集合，涵盖 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 系统下的词库与配置扩展，支持自定义快捷键、候选栏、输入方案及外观样式，提供 luna_pinyin 扩展词库与个性化定制模板，适用于高效中文输入与本地化部署。
summary_en: A comprehensive collection of Rime input method configurations for Windows, macOS, and Linux, including custom dictionaries, input scheme definitions, candidate display settings, and UI styling. Features extended pinyin dictionaries and user-customizable templates for personalized Chinese input experience.

description: weui sketch by ZTfer
summary_zh: 该仓库提供微信官方 WeUI 设计框架的 Sketch 源文件，包含完整 UI 组件库（按钮、单元格、弹窗、进度条等），尺寸与色彩严格遵循 WeUI 规范，支持 750*1334 设计稿尺寸，配套字体与@0.5x/@2x 效果图，助力设计师高效产出符合微信原生体验的界面。
summary_en: This repository provides Sketch source files for WeUI, a UI framework by WeChat. It includes fully designed components (buttons, cells, dialogs, progress bars, etc.) with exact adherence to WeUI's design specs, supporting 750*1334 layout, bundled with @0.5x/@2x preview images and system fonts for rapid prototyping.

description: 一套可直接安装到 ~/.codex 的专家配置，面向 Codex CLI / Codex App 桌面版的 Skill 调用方式 提供 3 个专家团、3 个单专家与 1 个总路由入口。
summary_zh: 一套面向 Codex CLI / Codex App 桌面版的专家团配置方案，通过 Skill 调用方式将单一 AI 助手升级为可路由、可协作的多专家团队系统。提供软件开发、设计原型、产品战略三个专家团及一个总路由入口，覆盖 PRD、架构设计、编码、QA、原型构建、竞品分析、路线图等完整工作流。
summary_en: A ready-to-install expert team configuration for Codex CLI / Codex App desktop, upgrading a single AI assistant into a routable, collaborative multi-expert team system via Skill invocation. Includes software engineering, design prototyping, and product strategy teams with a unified router, covering PRD, architecture, coding, QA, prototyping, competitive analysis, and roadmap workflows.

description: A simple django app to use emojis on your website ⛺
summary_zh: django-emoji 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，用于在网站中便捷地渲染表情符号。它支持将文本中的 :emoji: 标记自动转换为 Unicode 字符或图片，并提供 HTML 实体转换功能，适用于提升用户交互体验的 Web 项目。
summary_en: django-emoji is a lightweight Django app that enables easy emoji rendering on websites. It automatically converts :emoji: text patterns into Unicode or image tags, with support for HTML entity conversion, ideal for enhancing user engagement in web applications.

description: A free macOS native app to remove image backgrounds locally
summary_zh: Figura 是一款免费的 macOS 原生应用，利用系统 Vision 框架实现本地快速背景去除，支持拖拽、粘贴或点击上传，界面简洁现代，兼容深色/浅色模式，专为 macOS 14+ 设计。
summary_en: Figura is a free native macOS app that leverages the system's Vision framework for fast, local background removal. It supports drag-and-drop, paste (⌘V), or click upload, features a minimalist SwiftUI interface, and works on macOS 14+ with dark/light mode support.

description: 用 LLM 和 jina reader 生成的总结
summary_zh: 该项目利用 LLM 和 jina reader 自动读取 bookmark-collection 中的网页书签内容，生成结构化摘要。通过 GitHub Action 实现自动化处理，支持按月归档，适用于个人知识管理和内容聚合，核心亮点在于结合 AI 总结与网页内容提取技术。
summary_en: This project uses LLM and jina reader to automatically extract and summarize web content from bookmarks in bookmark-collection. Integrated with GitHub Actions for automation, it supports monthly archiving and enables personal knowledge management through AI-powered content aggregation and summarization.

description: A Django app for unified and persistent user messages/notifications, built on top of Django's messages framework
summary_zh: Django Persistent Messages 是一个基于 Django 消息框架的扩展应用，提供持久化用户消息/通知功能。支持认证用户将消息存储在数据库中，实现跨会话的‘粘性’提醒，直到用户标记为已读。未认证用户仍使用会话存储。统一 API 支持屏幕显示和邮件通知，兼容 Django 原生消息系统。
summary_en: Django Persistent Messages is a Django app extending the built-in messages framework to support persistent user notifications. It stores messages in the database for authenticated users, enabling sticky reminders until marked read. Anonymous users use session storage. Offers unified API for display and email notifications, fully compatible with Django's native messaging system.

description: Django Brake - a versatile ratelimiting app for Django.
summary_zh: Django Brake 是一个为 Django 框架设计的速率限制应用，支持基于 IP 地址或请求字段（GET/POST）的灵活限流策略。它提供装饰器接口，可阻止超限请求或标记请求状态，适用于登录防护、API 保护等场景，兼容 Django 1.3+ 并支持多时间阈值与路径级限流。
summary_en: Django Brake is a versatile rate-limiting app for Django that uses decorators to limit views based on IP or request fields (GET/POST). It supports blocking or annotating exceeded requests, with configurable time thresholds and path-based buckets. Designed as a maintained fork of Django Ratelimit, it enhances flexibility for login protection and API security.

description: Unified, persistent user messages with live notifications via SSE for Django.
summary_zh: Django Monitio 是一个基于 Django 的消息通知系统，支持持久化存储和实时推送。它利用 Redis 和 Server-Sent Events (SSE) 实现消息的持久化与实时同步，兼容主流浏览器，适用于需要长期保留用户通知的场景。
summary_en: Django Monitio is a unified, persistent messaging system for Django that stores messages in the database and delivers live updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE). Built on Redis and compatible with modern browsers, it enables real-time notifications while supporting both authenticated and anonymous users.

description: command line interface for weixin-robot
