summary_zh: webot-cli 是微信机器人（weixin-robot）的命令行接口工具，支持发送文本、图片、位置等消息，以及创建、删除、获取微信自定义菜单。通过配置文件管理 appid 和 secret，结合 webot 框架可实现消息自动响应与事件触发，适用于本地测试与快速开发微信机器人应用。
summary_en: webot-cli is a command-line interface for weixin-robot, enabling sending text, image, location, and event messages to WeChat. It supports managing custom menus via JSON configuration, integrates with webot framework for automated responses, and is ideal for local testing and rapid development of WeChat bot applications.

description: Generate RESTful json data for Hexo plugins.
summary_zh: hexo-generator-restful 是一个 Hexo 插件，可将博客内容生成 RESTful 风格的 JSON 数据，支持分页、分类、标签和文章详情等 API 接口，便于构建 SPA 应用或前后端分离架构。
summary_en: hexo-generator-restful is a Hexo plugin that generates RESTful JSON data from blog content, supporting pagination, categories, tags, and article details via API endpoints, ideal for building SPA applications or decoupled front-end systems.

description: singleFile + gh pages + deepseek api + notion db + tg bot = web clipper and notify
summary_zh: Web Clipper Backend 是一个网页剪藏服务，支持将网页通过 SingleFile 插件保存至 GitHub Pages，利用 DeepSeek API 自动生成摘要与标签，并同步至 Notion 数据库，同时通过 Telegram Bot 推送通知，实现全自动化内容归档与知识管理。
summary_en: Web Clipper Backend is an automated web clipping service that saves web pages via SingleFile to GitHub Pages, uses DeepSeek API for AI-generated summaries and tags, syncs data to Notion database, and sends notifications via Telegram Bot, enabling seamless content archiving and knowledge management.

description: A local macOS desktop matting tool built with Tauri, Vue, and Rust.
summary_zh: Apple Matting 是一款基于 Tauri、Vue 和 Rust 开发的本地 macOS 桌面背景抠图工具，支持单张及批量图片处理，兼容 JPG/PNG/WEBP/BMP 格式，提供实时预览、透明/纯色/渐变背景替换及编辑修正功能，集成中文/英文双语界面。
summary_en: Apple Matting is a local macOS desktop background removal tool built with Tauri, Vue, and Rust. It supports single and batch image processing, offers real-time preview, transparent/solid-color/gradient backgrounds, and includes a bilingual UI (Chinese/English) with editing refinements.

description: This is a Django helper for @defunkt's jquery-pjax.
summary_zh: django-pjax 是一个 Django 扩展库，用于集成 jQuery-PJAX 实现页面局部异步加载，提升用户体验并保持浏览器历史记录。支持函数视图和类视图装饰器，自动替换模板为 `-pjax` 后缀版本，兼容 Python 2.7+/3.3+ 和 Django 1.3+。
summary_en: django-pjax is a Django helper library that integrates jQuery-PJAX for partial page loading via AJAX, enhancing performance while maintaining browser navigation. It supports decorators for function and class-based views, auto-swapping templates to `-pjax` variants, compatible with Python 2.7+/3.3+ and Django 1.3+.

description: Django database backend for MySQL that provides pooling ala SQLAlchemy.
summary_zh: django-mysqlpool 是一个基于 SQLAlchemy 的 Django MySQL 数据库后端，提供连接池功能，通过 Monkey-patch 方式无缝集成，避免冻结 Django 核心代码。支持自定义连接池实现与参数配置，有效限制进程级连接数，提升高并发场景下的数据库资源利用率。
summary_en: django-mysqlpool is a Django MySQL database backend leveraging SQLAlchemy for connection pooling. It uses monkey-patching to integrate seamlessly without freezing Django's core, supporting customizable pool implementations and arguments. It helps limit per-process connections, improving resource efficiency in high-concurrency environments.

description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到钉钉，无须VPN
summary_zh: 本项目提供零代码、一键部署ChatGPT到钉钉的完整解决方案，无需翻墙即可在钉钉中直接使用ChatGPT智能问答功能。支持个人与企业级场景，集成钉钉机器人实现一对一或群聊交互，适用于客服、办公助手等场景，大幅降低AI接入门槛。
summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into DingTalk without requiring a VPN. It integrates ChatGPT with DingTalk via robot functionality, supporting both individual and group interactions. Ideal for enterprise customer service and office automation, it significantly lowers the barrier to AI adoption.

description: 让 Claude Code 更易用，支持多配置切换。
summary_zh: auo 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的 CLI 工具，通过多配置切换和环境变量管理提升使用体验。支持自动配置升级与向后兼容，适用于多账号/代理场景下的无缝切换，显著简化 Anthropic API 的复杂配置流程。
summary_en: auo is a CLI tool designed to enhance Claude Code usability by enabling easy multi-configuration switching and environment variable management. It supports automatic config upgrades with full backward compatibility, ideal for seamless transitions between multiple accounts or proxy setups, streamlining Anthropic API configuration.

description: bootstrap3 validation
summary_zh: bootstrap3-validation.js 是一个专为 Bootstrap 3 设计的 jQuery 表单验证插件，支持多种内置校验规则（如邮箱、URL、日期、数字等），支持自定义校验逻辑和异步验证，兼容 IE8，提供简洁的 HTML 属性配置方式，适用于水平表单和内联表单样式。
summary_en: bootstrap3-validation.js is a jQuery plugin designed for Bootstrap 3 form validation, supporting built-in rules (e.g., email, URL, date, number), custom validation logic, asynchronous checks, IE8 compatibility, and clean HTML attribute-based configuration for horizontal and inline forms.

description: Story-first Agent Skill for creating, routing, and QA-checking PPT, HTML, and image-first presentation decks
summary_zh: Knowledge Cat PPT Skill 是一款专为 AI 智能体（如 Codex、Claude Code）设计的演示文稿生产系统。它采用“故事优先”理念，通过受众分析、叙事构建和多通道路由（原生可编辑 PPTX、HTML 演示、图像优先 PPTX），将零散素材转化为结构化演示。系统集成了严格的 JSON 与 HTML 校验器、证据追踪机制及 44 种风格模板库，确保从大纲规划到最终渲染 QA 的全流程专业性与高可用性。
summary_en: Knowledge Cat PPT Skill is a story-first presentation production system for AI agents like Codex and Claude Code. It transforms rough ideas into structured decks through audience analysis, narrative planning, and multi-lane routing (Native PPTX, HTML, Image-first). Featuring strict validators, evidence tracking, and a 44-style template library, it ensures professional quality from planning to rendered QA.

description: Materializecss for Django Form
summary_zh: 这是一个为 Django 表单集成 MaterializeCSS 样式的轻量级模板标签库，支持自动渲染表单字段并应用 Material Design 风格，提供图标、自定义尺寸和日期时间选择器等功能，简化了响应式表单的开发流程。
summary_en: A lightweight Django template tag library that integrates MaterializeCSS styling into forms, enabling automatic rendering with Material Design aesthetics, including icons, custom grid sizes, and datetime pickers for streamlined responsive form development.

description: 微信输入法（WeType）跨设备剪贴板的独立 Rust 客户端
summary_zh: 微信输入法跨设备剪贴板的独立 Rust SDK，通过协议逆向实现文本、图片及文件的多设备同步。提供 CLI 工具 wxc，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows，基于局域网 TLS 直连传输，适合自动化脚本与跨设备数据流转场景。
summary_en: An independent Rust SDK for WeType cross-device clipboard, enabling text, image, and file synchronization via protocol reverse engineering. Provides CLI wxc with multi-platform support and LAN TLS direct transfer, suitable for automation scripts and cross-device data workflows.

description: 使用 Gemini (Nano Banano 和 Veo) 的短视频和漫画创作工具
summary_zh: 基于 Gemini Nano Banano 和 VEO 的短视频与漫画创作工具，支持剧本导入、AI 生成分镜图/视频、角色一致性管理及画布视图，提供完整的内容创作工作流，适用于自媒体、IP 孵化等场景。
summary_en: A video and comic creation tool powered by Gemini (Nano Banano and VEO), featuring script import, AI-generated storyboards/videos, character consistency management, and canvas view, enabling end-to-end content production for creators and IP developers.

description: Core library for Cola. Provides essential capabilities commonly used by agents.
summary_zh: coli 是 Cola 项目的核心库，为 AI 智能体提供语音识别（ASR）、文本转语音（TTS）及云端 TTS 等基础能力。支持本地模型与 ListenHub OpenAPI 集成，具备流式 ASR 和 macOS 专用 TTS 功能，适用于构建语音交互应用。
summary_en: Coli is the core library for the Cola project, delivering essential capabilities like automatic speech recognition (ASR), text-to-speech (TTS), and cloud-based TTS via ListenHub OpenAPI for AI agents. It supports local models, streaming ASR, and macOS-exclusive TTS features, ideal for voice-enabled applications.

description: A User-agent analyze project.
summary_zh: useragent.js 是一个轻量级用户代理解析库，支持 Node.js、浏览器及经典 ASP 环境，可精准识别浏览器、操作系统和设备类型。提供结构化输出，包含名称、版本、平台及图标信息，兼容主流浏览器及 IE8+，适用于流量分析、设备适配等场景。
summary_en: useragent.js is a lightweight user-agent parsing library supporting Node.js, browsers, and classic ASP environments. It accurately identifies browsers, operating systems, and device types, providing structured output with name, version, platform, and icon data. Compatible with major browsers and IE8+, ideal for traffic analysis and device adaptation.

description: A skill for coding agents that build, review, and refactor Web UI that should be easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate.
summary_zh: 为AI编码代理提供的Web UI设计技能，指导构建、审查与重构前端界面，使其对人类、屏幕阅读器、浏览器自动化、Playwright测试及AI代理更友好。核心聚焦语义HTML、清晰状态、稳定定位器与可复现URL模式，附带分级审查报告，助力提升前端可访问性与自动化兼容性。
summary_en: A skill for coding agents to build, review, and refactor Web UI that is easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate. It focuses on semantic HTML, clear state, stable locators, and reproducible URL patterns, providing severity-graded review reports to enhance accessibility and automation compatibility.

description: Nuxt full-stack blog.
summary_zh: 基于 Nuxt 的全栈博客系统，采用 MongoDB 存储、Cloudflare R2 图片存储和 Zeabur PaaS 部署，集成全文搜索、Markdown 编辑器、友链截图生成、评论系统等功能，支持 SEO 优化与主题切换，显著降低服务器成本。
summary_en: A full-stack blog built with Nuxt, MongoDB, and Cloudflare R2, deployed on Zeabur PaaS. Features include full-text search, Markdown editor, friend link screenshot generation, Giscus comments, SEO optimization, and theme switching, reducing server costs by consolidating backend logic into Nuxt.

description: Cached instances for Django REST Framework
summary_zh: 该仓库为 Django REST Framework (DRF) 提供缓存实例功能，通过将序列化后的实例数据存储在缓存中，显著提升 API 读取性能。支持零数据库查询读取实例或仅一次查询获取主键列表，适用于高读负载场景。核心机制包括缓存代理类、JSON 序列化及缓存失效策略。
summary_en: This project enhances Django REST Framework (DRF) by caching serialized instance data, enabling zero or minimal database queries for read-heavy APIs. It uses a cache-aware proxy to store only necessary attributes, including foreign keys and relations, improving performance for APIs with complex object relationships.

description: A self-hosted MCP relay for native coding runtimes
summary_zh: Agenvo是一个自托管的MCP中继服务，将ChatGPT、Grok Bot等AI助手与运行在本地电脑和服务器的编码代理（如Codex、Herdr）无缝连接。用户可通过AI助手跨设备统一调度、监控和续接编码任务，无需开放入站端口，支持Agent自行重连恢复工作。
summary_en: Agenvo is a self-hosted MCP relay that bridges AI assistants (ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Muse) with native coding runtimes (Codex, Herdr) on your computers and servers. It enables cross-device agent coordination via WSS connections without inbound ports, letting AI assistants monitor, manage, and resume coding tasks seamlessly.

description: 公众号阅读增强插件是一款 Chrome 浏览器扩展，旨在提升用户阅读微信公众号文章的体验。通过自动生成文章的结构化目录，让您轻松了解文章结构、快速导航到感兴趣的部分，并在阅读长文时保持位置感知。
summary_zh: 公众号阅读增强插件是一款 Chrome 扩展，专为优化电脑端阅读微信公众号长文体验而设计。核心功能包括自动生成结构化目录、图片放大预览、链接智能识别与跳转，以及阅读位置实时追踪，显著提升信息获取效率与视觉舒适度。
summary_en: WeChat Reader Enhancer is a Chrome extension designed to improve the reading experience of WeChat Official Account articles on desktop. It features auto-generated structured table of contents, image zoom-in preview, URL recognition and clickable linking, and real-time reading position tracking, significantly enhancing content navigation and visual comfort.

description: Your desktop AI agent, always ready
summary_zh: TouchAI 是一款桌面端 AI 智能体工具，通过快捷键 Alt+Space 快速唤起，支持全键盘操作，不打断用户工作流。它能智能感知桌面上下文（文件、屏幕、剪贴板），内置 7 大工具并支持 MCP 协议扩展，采用 BYOK 模式允许用户自由切换 AI 提供商和模型，无厂商锁定。支持文件搜索、可视化交互界面及模型自升级功能，是提升桌面办公效率的 AI 自动化工具。
summary_en: TouchAI is a desktop AI agent that can be instantly summoned via Alt+Space hotkey without interrupting workflow. It supports full keyboard operation and intelligently perceives desktop context including files, screen, and clipboard. With 7 built-in tools and MCP protocol extensibility, it adopts a BYOK model allowing users to freely switch between AI providers and models without vendor lock-in. Features include file search, visual interactive UI, and model self-upgrade.

description: Let AI truly understand you. A Claude Code skill that extracts tacit knowledge through structured dialogue. 隐性知识挖掘技能。
summary_zh: tacit-mining 是一款基于 Claude Code 的隐性知识挖掘技能，融合 Polanyi 隐性知识理论与 CDM、Laddering 等认知科学方法，通过结构化对话从用户行为中反推其说不清的判断标准。支持写作、选题、产品、审美、受众五大领域，采用关键事件法、对比逼近等四种提取技术，将模糊直觉转化为带边界条件的精确规则，显著提升 AI 对用户深层偏好的理解深度。
summary_en: Tacit-mining is a Claude Code skill that extracts users' tacit knowledge through structured dialogue, based on Michael Polanyi's theory and cognitive science methods like CDM and Laddering. It infers unspoken judgment criteria from behavioral patterns across five domains (writing, topics, products, aesthetics, audience), transforming vague intuitions into precise rules with boundaries via four extraction techniques, dramatically enhancing AI's understanding of deep user preferences.

description: v2ex 的 Material design 风格 CSS
summary_zh: 该仓库为 V2EX 论坛提供 Material Design 风格的自定义 CSS 主题，通过注入样式实现现代化视觉升级，支持 Chrome 浏览器，用户可通过自定义 CSS 功能一键应用，显著提升界面美观度与用户体验。
summary_en: This repository provides a Material Design-styled CSS theme for V2EX forum, enabling a modern visual upgrade through custom CSS injection. It supports Chrome browsers and allows users to apply the theme instantly via the custom CSS setting, enhancing UI aesthetics and user experience.

description: python_sdk for TencentYoutuyun-person-face-service
summary_zh: 腾讯云优图人脸服务Python SDK，提供人脸检测、比对、识别、验证及人脸库管理功能，支持本地图片与URL输入，集成API签名鉴权，适用于身份认证、安防监控等场景。
summary_en: Tencent YouTu Face Service Python SDK enables face detection, comparison, recognition, and verification, with support for local images and URLs. It includes API authentication and person/group management, ideal for identity verification and security applications.

summary_zh: 基于 FastMCP 框架的 VSCode 扩展，将 VSCode 转换为 MCP 服务器，支持通过 HTTP Streaming 和 SSE 协议远程执行内部命令，提供工作区信息查询、异步执行、命令白名单等能力，兼容 Model Context Protocol 标准。
summary_en: A VSCode extension using FastMCP framework to convert VSCode into an MCP server, enabling remote execution of internal commands via HTTP Streaming and SSE, with workspace info, async execution, command whitelisting, and full Model Context Protocol compatibility.

description: ToMic - Turn Your Phone into a PC Microphone
summary_zh: ToMic 是一款基于 Web 技术的局域网虚拟麦克风工具，可将手机浏览器作为电脑的麦克风输入源。通过 Wi-Fi 传输音频流，并利用虚拟声卡（如 BlackHole 或 VB-CABLE）实现低延迟音频路由，适用于 Zoom、Teams、Discord 等会议场景，无需安装 App，支持 macOS 和 Windows 平台。
summary_en: ToMic is a Web-based LAN virtual microphone tool that turns your phone into a PC microphone via browser. It streams audio over Wi-Fi using WebSocket and Opus encoding, then routes it through virtual sound cards (e.g., BlackHole or VB-CABLE) for low-latency input in apps like Zoom, Teams, or Discord. No app installation required on mobile, with native support for macOS and Windows.

description: 一款跨平台智能笔记 Agent 应用，支持多格式笔记、本地知识库、AI 智能助手、向量语义检索 。
summary_zh: OpenNote 是一款跨平台智能笔记 Agent 应用，支持多格式笔记管理、本地知识库构建、AI 智能助手及向量语义检索。具备长期记忆与自我进化能力，通过 MCP 协议与 AI 大模型深度集成，实现知识的高效组织与智能问答，适合个人知识管理与 AI 增强型笔记场景。
summary_en: OpenNote is a cross-platform intelligent note-taking Agent application that supports multi-format note management, local knowledge base building, AI-powered assistance, and vector semantic search. With long-term memory and self-evolving capabilities, it integrates deeply with AI large language models via the MCP protocol, enabling efficient knowledge organization and intelligent Q&A for personal knowledge management and AI-enhanced note-taking scenarios.

description: A lightweight HTTP relay that forwards /{absolute-url} requests with optional proxy and traffic dump.
summary_zh: http-relay 是一个轻量级 HTTP 中继工具，支持将形如 /{absolute-url} 的请求转发至目标地址，支持代理配置与流量抓包功能，适用于调试、代理转发及流量分析场景。
summary_en: http-relay is a lightweight HTTP relay tool that forwards requests in the format /{absolute-url} to target URLs, supporting proxy configuration and traffic dumping for debugging, proxying, and traffic analysis.

description: A controllable timing task widgets with Celery
summary_zh: celery-task-tigger 是一个基于 Celery 的可控定时任务组件，支持任务执行次数限制（max_times）和自定义执行间隔（countdown），解决了原生周期性任务依赖 beat 的痛点，实现更灵活的任务调度与控制。
summary_en: celery-task-tigger is a Celery-based controllable timing task widget that supports execution frequency control (max_times) and custom intervals (countdown), solving the limitation of native periodic tasks relying on beat for more flexible task scheduling.

description: Markdown  在线阅读器
summary_zh: 在线 Markdown 阅读器支持代码高亮、目录自动生成、本地图片显示及导出 HTML，并集成 Todo 列表、MathJax 公式、时序图、Emoji 和 ECharts 图表等扩展语法，提供丰富的富文本阅读体验。
summary_en: An online Markdown reader featuring code highlighting, auto-generated table of contents, local image support, HTML export, and rich extensions including Todo lists, MathJax, sequence diagrams, Emoji, and ECharts visualizations.

description: :zap: :rocket:This is a upload plug-ins
summary_zh: lUpload 是一个基于 jQuery 开发的轻量级文件上传插件，支持拖拽、粘贴、选择三种上传方式，具备实时进度显示、速度监控、多文件队列/并发上传控制，并可自定义文件类型缩略图与模板。适用于需要快速集成多模式上传功能的 Web 项目。
summary_en: lUpload is a lightweight jQuery-based file upload plugin supporting drag-and-drop, paste, and file selection uploads. It features real-time progress tracking, upload speed monitoring, concurrent/sequential upload modes, custom thumbnails per file type, and flexible templating. Ideal for rapid integration of multi-mode uploads in web applications.

description: A calm, local-first Chrome MV3 new tab dashboard
summary_zh: 乔木Tab 是一款基于 Chrome MV3 的本地优先新标签页仪表盘，将浏览器首页替换为安静、美观的个人工作台。集成时间显示、待办事项、常用网站、最近访问、便签、天气和音乐等功能，支持本地搜索、网页搜索与 AI 入口切换。核心数据默认存储于本机，无需注册登录，注重隐私保护，界面设计克制且中文体验友好，适合追求高效与专注的用户。
summary_en: Qiaomu Tab is a calm, local-first Chrome MV3 new tab dashboard that transforms your browser's homepage into a minimalist personal workspace. It integrates time display, to-do lists, frequently used sites, recent history, sticky notes, weather, and music—all rendered locally without requiring an account. With support for local, web, and AI search, it emphasizes privacy, performance, and a distraction-free experience tailored for Chinese users.

description: Source code to dannysite.com
summary_zh: DannySite 是一个基于 Django 框架开发的个人网站，包含博客、图片展示、账户管理等功能，支持邮件注册、密码重置、RSS 订阅及富文本编辑。采用 django-simple-captcha 和 DjangoUeditor 等第三方库，UI 设计版权归作者所有，建议查看 dannysite4 获取最新版本。
summary_en: DannySite is a personal website built with Django, featuring blog, image gallery, and user account management with email registration, password reset, RSS feeds, and rich text editing via UEditor. It uses third-party packages like django-simple-captcha and DjangoUeditor. UI design is copyrighted by the author. Check dannysite4 for the latest version.

summary_zh: AI驱动的交互式需求澄清工具，通过引导式问答将模糊创意转化为结构化技术规格文档，支持SSE流式输出，可直接对接AI编码代理执行。
summary_en: AI-powered interactive requirements refinement tool that transforms vague ideas into structured technical specs via guided Q&A, with SSE streaming and ready-to-execute output for AI coding agents.

description: An out-of-the-box, lightweight JavaScript i18n auto-translation solution
summary_zh: i18n-pro/core 是一个开箱即用的轻量级 JavaScript 国际化自动翻译解决方案，支持文本提取、多平台自动翻译（如 Google、OpenAI、百度等）、增量更新和日志追踪，提供文本即键、变量插值、类型标签等功能，简化多语言开发流程。
summary_en: i18n-pro/core is an out-of-the-box, lightweight JavaScript i18n auto-translation solution that supports text extraction, multi-platform translation (e.g., Google, OpenAI, Baidu), incremental updates, and logging. It offers features like text-as-key, variable interpolation, and type tags to streamline internationalization.

description: Qiniu(http://www.qiniu.com) is a cloud storage service, this package interages it with django framework.
summary_zh: django-qiniu 是一个过时的 Django 插件，用于将七牛云存储服务集成到 Django 框架中。它通过自定义字段（如 QiniuFileField 和 QiniuImageField）简化文件上传与管理，支持自动生成文件 URL 和图像缩略图处理。需配合七牛 Python SDK 使用，现已不推荐使用，建议迁移至更现代的 django-qiniu-storage 方案。
summary_en: django-qiniu is an outdated Django package that integrates Qiniu cloud storage with Django. It provides custom fields like QiniuFileField and QiniuImageField for seamless file uploads, URL generation, and image processing (e.g., thumbnails). Requires the Qiniu Python SDK and is no longer maintained; modern alternatives like django-qiniu-storage are recommended.

description: claudeclaw
summary_zh: MateCode 是一个通过 Telegram 远程控制 Claude Code 的桥接工具，支持长期记忆、会话管理、代码高亮等功能。采用纯 Python 标准库开发，基于长轮询实现低延迟通信，所有数据本地存储保障隐私安全。
summary_en: MateCode is a bridge tool that enables remote control of Claude Code via Telegram, featuring long-term memory, session management, and code highlighting. Built with pure Python standard libraries, it uses long polling for low-latency communication with local SQLite storage for privacy.

summary_zh: django-pjaxr 是一个为 Django 项目提供 PJAX 支持的轻量级扩展，通过集成 jquery-pjaxr 实现无刷新页面加载，提升用户体验。它通过模板标签和上下文处理器简化配置，支持自定义模板，适用于需要局部刷新的 Web 应用。
summary_en: django-pjaxr is a lightweight Django extension enabling PJAX support via jquery-pjaxr, allowing seamless partial page updates without full reloads. It simplifies integration with template tags and context processors, supporting customizable templates for enhanced user experience in Django web applications.

description: Carbon Forum HTTP API Documentation.
summary_zh: Carbon Forum HTTP API 文档为开发者提供完整的论坛接口规范，涵盖用户认证、帖子管理、通知系统等核心功能，支持分页浏览、安全验证码及头像上传，适用于构建第三方论坛客户端或集成自动化工具。
summary_en: Carbon Forum HTTP API Documentation provides comprehensive interface specifications for forum operations, including user authentication, topic management, notifications, and avatar handling. It supports pagination, security codes, and is designed for building third-party clients or integrating automation tools.

description: Claude Code Skill-driven resume system — one source, many tailored resumes
summary_zh: 基于 Claude Code 的智能简历系统，支持从结构化经验数据自动生成多版本 LaTeX 简历。通过自然语言交互完成初始化、维护和定制化生成，实现同一份经历针对不同岗位的智能适配与重塑，输出专业 PDF 格式简历。
summary_en: A skill-driven resume system powered by Claude Code that generates tailored LaTeX résumés from structured experience data. Features zero-config onboarding, AI-powered tailoring for multiple roles, natural language maintenance, and professional PDF output via XeLaTeX.

description: 🚀 8000+ Verified n8n Workflows. Free to download. Includes a self-hostable frontend to browse and search automation templates.
summary_zh: 该项目是经过验证的8000+个n8n自动化工作流的开源集合，提供可直接下载使用的JSON格式模板。包含基于Next.js 14构建的自主托管前端，支持按角色和集成智能搜索，涵盖营销、DevOps、销售和AI等场景。数据以JSON和SQL形式开放，支持本地部署，致力于让自动化技术普惠大众。
summary_en: This project offers 8,000+ verified n8n automation workflows in JSON format, freely downloadable for immediate use. It includes a self-hostable Next.js 14 frontend with intelligent search by role/integration, covering marketing, DevOps, sales, and AI scenarios. Open-source data (JSON/SQL) enables local deployment, promoting accessible automation technology for all.

description: 微信支付的python接口
summary_zh: weixin_pay 是一个为 Python 开发者提供的微信支付接口库，简化了微信支付 API 的调用流程。该库经过实际项目测试验证，支持核心支付功能，适合快速集成到电商、服务类应用中，提升支付模块开发效率。
summary_en: weixin_pay is a Python library providing a simplified interface for WeChat Pay API. Developed for production use, it supports core payment functionalities and has been tested successfully. Ideal for integrating WeChat Pay into e-commerce or service applications efficiently.

description: Python implementation of the (inactive) HTML JSON Forms spec.
summary_zh: html-json-forms 是一个 Python 实现的 HTML JSON Forms 规范库，用于通过传统 HTML 表单提交结构化 JSON 数据。它采用数组式命名约定（如 items[0][name]），支持嵌套对象解析，兼容 Django REST Framework，提供功能函数与序列化器集成，适用于前后端分离场景下的表单数据处理。
summary_en: html-json-forms is a Python implementation of the HTML JSON Forms specification, enabling structured JSON submission via traditional HTML forms using array-style naming (e.g., items[0][name]). It supports nested object parsing, integrates with Django REST Framework via JSONFormSerializer, and provides both functional parsing and DRF-compatible serializers for complex form data handling.

description: QuickShare on Cloudflare Workers with R2, D1 and per-user content management
summary_zh: QuickShare Cloudflare 是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers、R2 和 D1 构建的轻量级内容分享工具，专为 AI 生成的 HTML、Markdown、SVG 和 Mermaid 内容设计。用户粘贴内容即可生成可分享链接，无需注册或登录，支持可选的 5 位数字密码保护。内容正文存储在 R2，元数据管理在 D1，实现高效分离。每个浏览器自动获得 owner cookie，支持个人后台管理、编辑和删除内容。一键部署到 Cloudflare，完全掌控数据与部署。
summary_en: QuickShare Cloudflare is a lightweight content-sharing tool built on Cloudflare Workers, R2, and D1, designed for AI-generated HTML, Markdown, SVG, and Mermaid content. Users paste content to generate shareable links instantly—no sign-up required—with optional 5-digit password protection. Content bodies are stored in R2, while metadata is managed in D1 for efficient separation. Each browser gets an owner cookie for personal admin control. Fully deployable to Cloudflare with one click, giving you full ownership of data and deployment.

description: Yet Another Pair Programming Package for Atom.
summary_zh: Coeditor 是一个为 Atom 编辑器设计的实时协同编程插件，支持多用户无冲突文本编辑、语法高亮同步、文件操作同步及项目级协作感知。通过自建 WebSocket 服务器实现客户端间状态同步，适用于远程结对编程场景，需统一配置换行符以避免内容不一致。
summary_en: Coeditor is a real-time collaborative programming plugin for Atom, enabling conflict-free text editing, syntax highlighting sync, file operations, and project awareness across multiple users. It relies on a custom WebSocket server for state synchronization, ideal for remote pair programming, with strict line ending consistency requirements across clients.

summary_zh: 本项目演示如何使用 Docker Compose 快速搭建基于 Docker 的 Django 应用开发环境，包含 Django、MySQL 和 Redis 服务编排，支持一键构建与部署，适用于容器化 Django 项目的开发与测试。
summary_en: This project demonstrates how to quickly set up a Django development environment using Docker Compose, including orchestration of Django, MySQL, and Redis services. It supports one-click build and deployment, ideal for containerized Django development and testing.

description: ⚡ Excel Plugin Framework | Excel插件框架 - C# .NET hot-reload template for VSTO add-ins. Features: WPF/WinForms UI, auto-update, COM safety, MVVM pattern. Perfect for Office automation & Excel/WPS plugins
summary_zh: BasePlugin 是一个基于 DTI_Tool.AddIn 热插拔框架的 Excel 插件开发模板，专为 C#/.NET Framework 构建 VSTO 插件而设计。支持 WPF/WinForms UI、MVVM 模式、自动更新、COM 安全交互，适用于 Excel/WPS 自动化扩展开发。
summary_en: BasePlugin is a comprehensive Excel add-in development template built on the DTI_Tool.AddIn hot-pluggable framework, enabling C#/.NET Framework VSTO plugin development with WPF/WinForms UI, MVVM pattern, auto-update, and COM-safe Excel interop for Office automation.

description: Cross-platform desktop wrapper for TUIStudio (Wails v2 + Go) http://tui.studio
summary_zh: TUIStudio Desktop 是基于 Wails v2（Go + WebView）构建的跨平台桌面应用，为 TUIStudio 提供原生 GUI 支持。支持 macOS (.dmg)、Windows (.exe) 和 Linux (.deb) 多平台发布，体积小巧（约8MB），通过 Go 与前端 Vite 热重载集成实现高效开发流程，适用于 TUI 界面可视化设计场景。
summary_en: TUIStudio Desktop is a cross-platform desktop wrapper for TUIStudio, built with Wails v2 (Go + WebView). It packages as lightweight installers: .dmg (~8 MB), NSIS .exe, and .deb. Features hot-reload dev workflow via Vite and Go IPC bridge, enabling native file dialogs and seamless integration for TUI design tools.

description: Turn an approved product design, PRD, prototype, design system, or architecture brief into an AI-governed, deployable full-stack project with a pnpm monorepo, requirement traceability, canonical multi-agent rules, mandatory AI review, executable quality gates, CI, container deployment assets, and handoff evidence.
summary_zh: 面向VibeCoding的Codex工程Skill，将产品设计与架构规范转化为可部署的全栈项目。采用pnpm monorepo架构，支持多Agent协同规则、AI审查、质量门禁与CI/CD流水线，Routine模式高效处理日常修复，Init模式负责标准化初始化。
summary_en: A Codex engineering skill for VibeCoding that transforms product designs into deployable full-stack projects using pnpm monorepo. Supports multi-agent rules, AI review, quality gates, and CI/CD pipelines, with Routine mode for efficient daily fixes and Init mode for standardized project setup.

description: Turn an approved product design, PRD, prototype, design system, or architecture brief into an AI-governed, deployable full-stack project with a pnpm monorepo, requirement traceability, canonical multi-agent rules, mandatory AI review, executable quality gates, CI, container deployment assets, and handoff evidence.
summary_zh: 面向 AI 辅助开发的工程 Skill，帮助 Codex、Claude Code 等 Agent 将产品设计与架构方案转化为可部署的全栈项目。支持 pnpm monorepo、多 Agent 协作规则、强制 AI 审查、可执行质量门禁、CI 流水线及容器化部署资产，覆盖初始化、日常开发、仓库审计与发布准备等完整生命周期。
summary_en: An engineering skill for AI-assisted development that helps Codex, Claude Code, and compatible agents transform product designs and architecture briefs into deployable full-stack projects. Supports pnpm monorepo, multi-agent collaboration rules, mandatory AI review, executable quality gates, CI pipelines, and container deployment assets across initialization, daily development, audits, and release workflows.

description: django最佳实践 项目目录结构布局
summary_zh: 该项目提供 Django 最佳实践的项目目录结构布局，推荐采用分层结构：apps 存放功能模块，configs 管理各类服务配置（如 Gunicorn、Nginx），deploy 包含自动化部署脚本，settings 按环境分离配置，static 和 templates 分别管理静态资源与模板文件。同时建议用 Gunicorn 替代 Apache、Celery + Redis 处理异步任务、MongoDB 替代传统 SQL 数据库，并推荐使用 TastyPie 构建 REST API。
summary_en: This project presents Django best practices for directory structure, recommending a modular layout with apps for functionality, configs for service setups (Gunicorn, Nginx), deploy for deployment scripts, settings per environment, and static/templates for assets. It also advises using Gunicorn over Apache, Celery+Redis for async tasks, MongoDB for schema flexibility, and Django-TastyPie for REST APIs.

description: Self-hostable NGINX module that serves Markdown to AI agents via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown), powered by a Rust converter.
summary_zh: 该项目是一个自托管的 NGINX 模块，通过 HTTP 内容协商（Accept: text/markdown）将 HTML 页面转换为 Markdown 格式供 AI 智能体读取。基于 Rust 构建，无需修改现有应用即可为浏览器返回原始 HTML，同时为支持 Markdown 的请求提供纯净内容，降低 AI 处理成本。
summary_en: This project is a self-hostable NGINX module that converts HTML to Markdown via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown) for AI agents, powered by a Rust converter. It serves clean Markdown only when requested while preserving original HTML for browsers, enabling seamless agent-friendly content delivery without application changes.

description: A lightweight, context-aware AI assistant designed specifically for macOS
summary_zh: Sidey 是一款专为 macOS 打造的轻量级、上下文感知 AI 助手。它以菜单栏弹出窗口和悬浮窗伴侣形式快速调用，支持选中文本即时处理、应用感知提示词推荐、多应用专属 AI 人格自动创建，并深度集成 Safari 与 Finder。内置公共 AI 服务无需 API Key，支持 Markdown 渲染、iCloud 同步与全局热键，实现无缝跨应用智能辅助。
summary_en: Sidey is a lightweight, context-aware AI assistant built exclusively for macOS. It launches instantly from the menu bar or as a window-docked companion, offering selection-based text processing, app-aware prompt suggestions, and auto-generated AI personas per application. With deep Safari and Finder integration, built-in public AI service, Markdown rendering, iCloud sync, and global hotkeys, Sidey delivers seamless cross-app intelligent assistance without disrupting your workflow.

description: A fault-tolerant pylibmc cache backend for Django
summary_zh: django-ft-cache 是一个为 Django 设计的容错 pylibmc 缓存后端，通过 FaultTolerantCacheMixin 机制在缓存操作失败时记录日志而非抛出异常，避免因缓存故障导致应用崩溃，提升系统稳定性。
summary_en: django-ft-cache is a fault-tolerant pylibmc cache backend for Django that catches and logs cache failures instead of raising exceptions, preventing application crashes due to cache issues and improving system resilience.

description: Awesome open-source macOS applications
summary_zh: 自动聚合GitHub星标仓库，构建macOS开源应用 browsable 目录。收录281款应用，涵盖AI大模型、开发者工具、系统维护等26个分类，每日自动同步更新，提供免手工维护的macOS生态发现入口。
summary_en: An auto-generated browser curating 281 macOS open-source apps from GitHub stars across 26 categories. Covers AI/LLM, developer tools, productivity, and system utilities. Synced daily with zero manual editing — a hands-off discovery hub for the macOS ecosystem.

description: My independent fork of django-persistent-messages. A Django app for unified and persistent user messages/notifications, built on top of Django's messages framework
summary_zh: django-persistent-messages 是一个基于 Django 消息框架的扩展应用，为认证用户提供持久化消息存储，支持消息标记已读、删除和回复，同时为匿名用户保留会话级消息功能，实现统一的消息管理接口。
summary_en: Django Persistent Messages extends Django's messaging framework to provide persistent message storage for authenticated users via database, with features like mark-as-read, delete, and reply. Anonymous users retain session-based messages. Offers a unified API combining persistent and temporary messaging.

description: A CLI/TUI tool to manage and switch tokens & base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex.
summary_zh: agtok 是一个 CLI/TUI 工具，用于集中管理和切换 Claude、Gemini 和 Codex 等 AI 代理的令牌与基础 URL。支持交互式终端界面、预设分组、原子化写入与备份，适用于多环境 AI 工具配置管理。
summary_en: agtok is a CLI/TUI tool for centrally managing and switching tokens and base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex. It supports interactive TUI, preset grouping, atomic writes with backups, and seamless configuration switching across environments.

description: MOVED TO https://github.com/jezdez/django-avatar
summary_zh: 该仓库已迁移至新地址，原项目不再维护。新的 django-avatar 项目由 jezdez 维护，提供 Django 应用的用户头像管理功能，支持图片上传、裁剪和显示，适用于需要用户头像功能的 Web 应用。
summary_en: This repository is outdated - the new one is at https://github.com/jezdez/django-avatar. The new django-avatar project by jezdez provides user avatar management for Django apps, supporting image upload, cropping, and display for web applications requiring user profile pictures.

description: 一键批量抠图。两种方法。一.使用remove.bg网站账号免费api额度，二.使用rembg和onnxruntime训练模型本地抠图
summary_zh: Image_matting 提供一键批量抠图功能，支持两种模式：使用 remove.bg 在线 API（高精度需网络）或本地 rembg+onnxruntime 模型（快速清晰需算力）。自动轮换 API 密钥解决额度问题，支持批量处理与文件名规范，适用于电商、设计等领域。
summary_en: Image_matting enables one-click batch background removal with two modes: using remove.bg's online API (higher accuracy, requires internet) or local rembg+onnxruntime model (faster, clearer, requires hardware). It auto-rotates API keys to bypass limits, supports batch processing and standardized file naming, ideal for e-commerce and design workflows.

description: 🛡️ Workspace file protection plugin for OpenClaw — guards against prompt injection attacks
summary_zh: OpenClaw Guard 插件为 OpenClaw AI 代理提供工作区文件防护，有效防御提示注入攻击。通过拦截外部会话的文件操作，自动屏蔽对身份、记忆等关键文件的读写，并将非关键写入重定向至沙箱目录，确保主会话权限隔离与系统安全。
summary_en: The OpenClaw Guard plugin protects OpenClaw AI agents from prompt injection attacks by intercepting file operations in external sessions. It blocks access to critical files like identity and memory, redirecting non-sensitive writes to a sandboxed directory, ensuring secure agent isolation and integrity.

description: A reusable django application for handling Avatars.
summary_zh: django-simple-avatar 是一个可复用的 Django 应用，用于处理用户头像。支持默认使用 Gravatar 作为头像，自动生缩略图并存储至默认文件存储后端，简化头像管理流程。
summary_en: django-simple-avatar is a reusable Django app for handling user avatars. It supports default Gravatar fallback, automatically generates thumbnails, and stores them in the default file storage backend for efficient retrieval.

description: django动态生成百度地图。
summary_zh: djangoBaidusitemap 是一个 Django 扩展库，用于动态生成百度地图 XML 站点地图，支持 HTML5、WML 和 XHTML 多格式 URL 输出，兼容 Django 内置 sitemap 机制，适用于 SEO 优化与多终端内容分发。
summary_en: djangoBaidusitemap is a Django extension that dynamically generates Baidu XML sitemaps, supporting multi-format URLs (HTML5, WML, XHTML), compatible with Django's built-in sitemap framework, ideal for SEO optimization and cross-platform content delivery.

description: 一个发布 Telegram 翻译的 Bot
summary_zh: Telegram-cn-l10n-bot 是一个用于发布 Telegram 中文翻译的自动化 Bot，支持通过命令上传和管理 Android、iOS、桌面端语言文件。用户发送语言文件获取 file_id 后，使用 /setandroid、/setios、/setdesktop 命令绑定文件槽，实现多平台翻译包的高效分发。
summary_en: Telegram-cn-l10n-bot is an automated bot for publishing Telegram Chinese translations. It allows users to upload language files via commands (/setandroid, /setios, /setdesktop) using file_id, enabling efficient distribution of localized packages across platforms.

description: A Flask-based tool that types or copies text from mobile devices directly to Windows computers.
summary_zh: EasyType 是一款基于 Flask 的跨平台输入工具，支持手机实时输入内容并直接推送到 Windows 剪贴板或模拟键盘输入，具备低延迟同步、移动端优化界面和多种快捷键支持，适用于远程办公与高效输入场景。
summary_en: EasyType is a Flask-based tool enabling real-time text input from mobile devices to Windows via clipboard or direct keyboard simulation, featuring low-latency sync, mobile-optimized UI, and shortcut support for remote typing and clipboard sharing.

description: Integrate awesome Bleach library into Django
summary_zh: django-bleach 是一个 Django 应用，用于将 Bleach 库集成到项目中，实现对用户提交的 HTML 内容进行安全过滤和净化。它提供模型字段、表单字段和模板过滤器三种使用方式，支持自定义允许的标签、属性和样式，防止 XSS 攻击，适用于需要富文本输入的 Web 应用。
summary_en: django-bleach is a Django app that integrates the Bleach library to sanitize user-submitted HTML content. It offers model fields, form fields, and template filters for safe HTML processing, with customizable allowed tags, attributes, and styles to prevent XSS attacks in web applications requiring rich text input.

description: Local-first Codex orchestration for continuous product development
summary_zh: Codrive 是一个本地优先的 Codex 编排工具，将产品想法转化为可视化的开发任务流。它连接 Codex App 对话、任务看板与文件系统，支持持续规划、独立审查、返工集成等全生命周期管理，无需额外基础设施，所有数据本地存储，为长期产品开发提供可靠工作流。
summary_en: Codrive is a local-first Codex orchestration tool that transforms product ideas into visible task workflows. It connects Codex App conversations with a task board and filesystem state, supporting continuous planning, independent review, rework, and integration. Running entirely locally without external infrastructure, it provides a reliable workflow for long-running product development.

description: django verify code
summary_zh: DjangoVerifyCode 是一个用于 Django 框架的验证码生成库，支持英文单词和数字两种验证码模式，具备自适应字体尺寸的图片生成与校验功能，适用于网站用户身份验证场景。
summary_en: DjangoVerifyCode is a Django-based library for generating captcha images with English words or numbers, featuring adaptive font sizing and validation, ideal for user authentication in web applications.

description: Middleware that sets a base template name on the context
summary_zh: django-pjax-middleware 是一个 Django 中间件，用于在 PJAX 请求中自动设置基础模板名称，简化了 PJAX 页面的模板继承结构。它支持自定义基础模板和 PJAX 模板名称，并通过版本控制机制确保布局更新时触发完整页面重载，提升用户体验。
summary_en: django-pjax-middleware is a Django middleware that automatically sets the base template name in PJAX requests, simplifying template inheritance for PJAX-enabled pages. It supports custom base and PJAX-specific templates, and uses versioning to force full page reloads when layout changes occur, enhancing user experience.

description: hexo插件 - 七牛资源同步. 可以在本地存放好静态资源（图片、JS、CSS），然后在md文章中直接使用标签引用，在发布时会自动将静态资源上传到你的七牛空间中，并在hexo生成的静态页面中自动引用这些静态资源在千牛的url。
summary_zh: hexo-qiniu-sync 是一个 Hexo 插件，用于自动将本地静态资源（如图片、JS、CSS）同步至七牛云存储，并在生成的静态页面中自动替换为七牛外链 URL。支持离线预览、增量同步、图片处理（缩略图/水印）等功能，简化博客资源管理流程。
summary_en: hexo-qiniu-sync is a Hexo plugin that automatically syncs local static resources (images, JS, CSS) to Qiniu Cloud Storage and replaces references in generated pages with Qiniu CDN URLs. It supports offline preview, incremental sync, image processing (thumbnails/watermarks), and simplifies blog asset management.

description: 利用reactnative技术，开发，生成app
summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 React Native 开发的移动端应用 demo，参考淘宝手机端 UI 设计，实现了包含首页、微淘、社区、购物车、个人中心等模块的 TabBar 界面。支持图标切换、角标提醒等功能，展示了 React Native 在跨平台 App 开发中的高效性和前端开发者上手友好的特点。
summary_en: This project is a React Native-based mobile app demo, inspired by Taobao's mobile interface. It features a TabBar with modules like Home, Weitao, Community, Cart, and Profile, supporting icon switching and badge notifications. It demonstrates React Native's efficiency in cross-platform development and ease of use for frontend developers.

description: Document Web APIs made with Django Rest Framework
summary_zh: DRF Docs 是一个专为 Django Rest Framework 设计的 API 文档生成工具，支持 Python 2.7/3.x 和 Django 1.8+。它能自动解析 DRF 项目中的 API 结构，生成交互式文档页面，并提供安装配置指南、模板扩展及开发示例。项目提供实时 API 端点演示，支持隐藏文档和登录验证等配置选项，适合快速构建可维护的 RESTful API 文档。
summary_en: DRF Docs is a tool to auto-generate interactive documentation for Django Rest Framework APIs, supporting Python 2.7/3.x and Django 1.8+. It parses API structures to create browsable docs with installation guides, template customization, and live demo endpoints. Features include optional doc hiding, login protection, and seamless integration via pip and URL routing, ideal for maintaining RESTful API documentation.

description: Generate SQL query from natural language.
summary_zh: GenQL 是一款将自然语言转换为 SQL 查询的工具，基于 Pinecone 向量数据库和 OpenAI 大模型技术，支持数据库模式索引、语音输入、查询历史记录等功能，适用于数据分析、应用开发和团队协作等场景，显著提升非技术用户与数据库交互的效率。
summary_en: GenQL is a natural language to SQL translation tool powered by Pinecone vector database and OpenAI LLM, enabling schema indexing, voice input, and query history. It streamlines database interactions for data analysts, developers, and non-technical users, enhancing productivity in reporting, exploration, and app development.

description: Natural language to shell command. Type what you want, get the exact command + explanation. Rust, 5.4MB, dual-request parallel.
summary_zh: how2cli 是一款将自然语言实时转换为精确 Shell 命令的工具，支持 SSE 流式响应、会话记忆、Markdown 渲染及双模式（快速/推理）。基于 Rust 开发，单二进制部署，兼容任意 OpenAI API 端点，适用于 Linux 环境的高效命令行自动化。
summary_en: how2cli is a natural language to shell command converter that instantly translates user queries into exact commands with explanations. Features SSE streaming, session memory, talk mode, dual models (fast/reasoning), and single-binary deployment in Rust. Compatible with any OAI-compatible API endpoint.

description: My hexo blog source code
summary_zh: 这是一个基于 Hexo 框架的个人博客源码仓库，用于部署静态博客网站。项目包含完整的博客配置、主题定制、文章管理及插件集成，适合技术分享与个人内容发布。
summary_en: This repository contains the source code of my personal blog built with Hexo, a static site generator. It includes configuration, themes, posts, and plugins for deploying a fully functional blog.
